text: Ginapanindugan sang defense team nga nag-represent na si Khan sa Philippines Human Rights Commission (PHRC) sa pagpangalan kay Duterte bilang nagapanguna nga suspek sa sa mga krimen sang ginpatuman ang war on drugs sa Pilipinas.
english: The defense team insists that Khan has already represented the Philippine Human Rights Commission (PHRC) in naming Duterte as the main suspect in the crimes of the war on drugs in the Philippines.

text: Gani suno pa sa amo nga kampo, indi na siya maka-conduct pa sang impartial ukon patas nga imbestigasyon kun siya ang prosecutor sa kaso ni Duterte nga war crimes sa ICC.
english: Therefore, according to the camp, he can no longer conduct an impartial or fair investigation if he is the prosecutor in Duterte's war crimes case at the ICC.

text: Gin-grant naman sang Appeals Chamber ang request sang defense, bangud ila ginpahayag nga posible nga mangin biased si Khan bangud sa iya nauna nga papel sa PHRC.
english: The Appeals Chamber granted the defence's request, saying Khan was likely to be biased because of his previous role in the PHRC.

text: Matandaan nga antes sini, nagpanaog si Khan bilang chief prosecutor sang Mayo agud hatagan sang ligwa ang imbestigasyon sang United Nations batok sa iya bangud sang ginaalegar nga sexual misconduct.
english: Earlier, Khan stepped down as chief prosecutor in May to pause the United Nations investigation against him for alleged sexual misconduct.

text: Kumbinsido ang pamilya sang lalaki nga nasapwan-patay sa gymnasium sa Barangay Gua-an, Leganes, Iloilo nga wala sang foul play sa kamatayon sini.
english: The family of a man found dead in a gymnasium in Barangay Gua-an, Leganes, Iloilo is convinced that there was no foul play in his death.

text: Ang biktima amo si Joel Caturas, 36, may live-in partner, residente sang Barangay Guinobatan, Leganes, Iloilo.
english: The victim was identified as Joel Caturas, 36, with a live-in partner, resident of Barangay Guinobatan, Leganes, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Patrolman Jomar Nerios, imbestigador sang Leganes Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nagapati ang pamilya nga wala sang rason para patyon ang ila himata kag wala man ini sang kaaway sa lugar.
english: Patrolman Jomar Nerios, investigator of the Leganes Municipal Police Station, said the family believes there was no reason to kill their relative and he had no enemies in the area.

text: Wala man sang pilas nga nakita sa lawas sini sang ini ang nasapwan.
english: No injuries were found on his body when he was found.

text: Suno kay Nerios, nag-inom pa kahapon ang biktima sang makahulubog nga ilimnon sa tyangge sa kilid sang gymnasium.
english: According to Nerios, the victim had been drinking alcohol at a stall next to the gymnasium yesterday.

text: Matapos sini, nagtulog na lang ini sa gymnasium sa diin nagahapa ang posisyon sini.
english: After that, he slept in the gymnasium where he was lying on his back.

text: Gindeklarar ang isa ka semana nga mourning period sa South Korea kasunod ang plane crash sa Muan International Airport nga ginkamatay sang 179 ka mga tawo.
english: South Korea has declared a week-long mourning period following the plane crash at Muan International Airport that killed 179 people.

text: Sandig sa anunsyo ni acting President Choi Sang-mok, magalawig ini tubtub sa Enero 4.
english: According to the announcement of acting President Choi Sang-mok, it will last until January 4.

text: Magluwas diri, may igabutang man nga 17 ka memorial altars sa bilog nga pungsod.
english: Besides, 17 memorial altars will be installed across the country.

text: 181 ang sakay sang Boeing 737-800 sang natabo ang aksidente, buot silingon, duha lang gid ka tawo ang nakaluwas nga amo ang babaye kag lalaki nga crew members.
english: 181 were on board the Boeing 737-800 when the accident occurred, meaning that only two people survived, the female and male crew members.

text: Wala pa gin-release ang identity sang mga pasahero kag wala pa nahibaluan kun ano ang ila nationalities.
english: The identities of the passengers have not been released and their nationalities are unknown.

text: Apang base sa fire service, ang pinakabata nga biktima naga-edad sang tatlo ka tuig samtang 78-anyos naman ang pinakatigulang.
english: However, based on the fire service, the youngest victim was three years old while the oldest was 78 years old.

text: Samtang, nagpaguwa naman sang public apology ang CEO sang South Korean airline nga Jeju Air kasunod sang amo nga insidente.
english: Meanwhile, the CEO of South Korean airline Jeju Air issued a public apology following the incident.

text: Suno kay CEO Kim E-bae, indi pa subong matumod kun ano gid ang rason sang crash apang suno sa iya, wala gid ini anay sang record sang aksidente kag wala man nakitaan sang senyales sang malfunction.
english: According to CEO Kim E-bae, the exact cause of the crash cannot be determined but he said it had no record of an accident and no signs of malfunction.

text: Ginpasalig sang airline nga maga-kooperar ini sa mga imbestigador kag suportahan ang pamilya sang mga biktima.
english: The airline assured that it will cooperate with investigators and support the families of the victims.

text: Nag-bow man ang CEO kag iban nga opisyal sang airlines agud ipakita ang ila pagpangayo sang pasaylo.
english: The CEO and other officials of the airlines also took a bow to show their apologies.

text: Halin ang Jeju Air flight 7C2216 sa Bangkok, Thailand antes ang insidente.
english: Jeju Air flight 7C2216 was from Bangkok, Thailand before the incident.

text: Ginalantaw nga may pag-malfunction sa landing gear, kag may impormasyon man nga nakahimo pa ang piloto sang mayday call matapos nagpaandam ang control tower kaangot sa mga pispis nga yara sa area.
english: It is believed that there was a malfunction in the landing gear, and there is also information that the pilot made a mayday call after the control tower warned about the birds in the area.

text: Ini ang ginakabig nga pinakamakamamatay nga trahedya sa aviation industry sang South Korea sa sulod sang masobra duha ka dekada.
english: It is considered the deadliest tragedy in South Korea’s aviation industry in more than two decades.

text: Nasapwan nga yara na sa advanced state of decomposition ang bangkay sang isa ka engineering student matapos ini nalumos sa suba nga sakop sang Barangay Buyo, Sta.
english: The body of an engineering student was found in an advanced state of decomposition after he drowned in the river in Barangay Buyo, Sta.

text: Barbara, Iloilo.
english: Barbara, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Braint Jan Suacito, 21-anyos, residente sang nasambit nga lugar, kag isa ka third-year student sa Iloilo Science and Technology University (ISAT-U).
english: The victim was identified as Braint Jan Suacito, 21, resident of the said area, and a third-year student at Iloilo Science and Technology University (ISAT-U).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Raffy Señeres, hepe sang Sta.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Raffy Señeres, chief of Sta.

text: Barbara Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga na-retrieve ang bangkay sa Zone 7 sa Barangay Balabag, Sta Barbara.
english: Barbara Municipal Police Station, he said the body was retrieved in Zone 7 in Barangay Balabag, Sta Barbara.

text: Natigayon nga na-identify sang pamilya ang biktima bangud sa iya ginasuksok nga shorts.
english: The family was able to identify the victim because of the shorts he was wearing.

text: Matandaan nga gin-report ang insidente sang Myerkules sang hapon, Hulyo 23, apang pila ka beses nga nag-negatibo ang rescue operation tubtub nga nakit-an ang lawas sini subong nga weekend, Hulyo 26.
english: The incident was reported on Wednesday afternoon, July 23, but the rescue operation turned negative several times until the body was found this weekend, July

text: Santo sa pahayag sang mga nakakita, naligo ang biktima kaupod ang tatlo niya ka abyan sa suba bisan pa nga nagabubo ang ulan.
english: According to witnesses, the victim was bathing with three friends in the river despite the heavy rain.

text: Antes sini nga insidente, may tatlo ka separado nga drowning incidents sa Iloilo nga ginalakipan sang isa sa Tagbak, Jaro; isa sa Boulevard, Molo; kag isa sa Tigbauan nga nasapwan man sa Ortiz, City Proper.
english: Prior to this incident, there were three separate drowning incidents in Iloilo including one in Tagbak, Jaro; one in Boulevard, Molo; and one in Tigbauan which was also found in Ortiz, City Proper.

text:
Kadungan ini sang mamunog nga pag-ulan kag pagbaha tuga sang Habagat.#

(Photo is from R6 Iloilo Unicorns Rescue Volunteer Group)
english:
This is accompanied by heavy rains and flooding caused by the Habagat.#

(Photo is from R6 Iloilo Unicorns Rescue Volunteer Group)

text: Ginakabig sang Employers Confederation of the Philippines (ECOP) nga dako nga palas-anon sa mga magagmay nga negosyante ang paghatag sang 14th month pay sa mga empleyado.
english: The Employers Confederation of the Philippines (ECOP) considers the payment of 14th month pay to employees as a big burden on small businesses.

text: Suno kay ECOP vice president George Barcelon nga presidente man sang president of Philippine Chamber of Commerce and Industry (PCCI), wala pa nakarekober ang mga negosyante sa COVID-19 pandemic.
english: According to ECOP vice president George Barcelon, who is also president of the president of the Philippine Chamber of Commerce and Industry (PCCI), businessmen have not yet recovered from the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: “Kaya tingin ko mahihirapan ang mga negosyente sa 14th month pay,” pahayag ni Barcelon.
english: “So I think businessmen will have difficulty with the 14th month pay,” Barcelon said.

text: Ang House Bill No.
english: House Bill No.

text: 520 nga nagamando sa paghatag sang 14th month pay sa mga public kag private sector ang ginduso ni Kabayan party-list Representative Ron Salo.
english: 520 mandating the payment of 14th month pay to the public and private sectors was proposed by Kabayan party-list Representative Ron Salo.

text: Nasaad sa hagna nga dapat hatagan sang 14th month pay ang mga empleyado, anuman ang ila status of employment.
english: The bill states that employees should be given 14th month pay, regardless of their status of employment.

text: Sa idalom sang hagna ni Salo, nasaad nga ang 13th month pay nga required na sa layi ang nagakadapat nga ihatag sa mga empleyado ”on or before May 31” sa kada tuig antes ang school enrollment sang mga dependents sang mga empleyado.
english: Under Salo's bill, it is stated that the 13th month pay which is required by law should be given to employees "on or before May 31" of each year before the school enrollment of the dependents of the employees.

text: Samtang ang 14th month pay naman ang nagakadapat nga ihatag sa mga empleyado ”on or before November 30” sang kada tuig nga antes antes ang traditional nga Christmas celebration.
english: Meanwhile, the 14th month pay should be given to employees "on or before November 30" of each year before the traditional Christmas celebration.

text: Ginpahayag ni Barcelon nga may mga employer na nga nagahatag sang 14th month pay sa ila mga empleyado, apang mabug-at ini para sa magagmay nga mga negosyante.
english: Barcelon said there are employers who are already giving 14th month pay to their employees, but it is heavy for small businessmen.

text: “May leeway sa mga negosyante, depende sa tao kung maganda ang performance, malakas ang kanilang negosyo, they can afford the 14th month pay.
english: “There is leeway for entrepreneurs, depending on the person if the performance is good, their business is strong, they can afford the 14th month pay.

text: Pero as a requirement, mahihirapan sila lalo ‘yung MSMEs,” dugang pa ni Barcelon.
english: But as a requirement, they will have difficulty especially the MSMEs,” Barcelon added.

text: Sa idalom sang proposal ni Salo, ang 14th month pay sang mga empleyado nga employed sang ”less than one year” ang prorated santo sa numero sang bulan nga iya naserbisyo.
english: Under Salo's proposal, the 14th month pay of employees employed for less than one year will be prorated according to the number of months he or she has served.

text: Nasaad man sa hagna nga ang 14th month pay ang nagakadapat nga indi magnubo sa monthly basic salary sang isa ka empleyado.
english: The bill also states that the 14th month pay should not be less than the monthly basic salary of an employee.

text: Ginaduso man sang mamalidha nga ang 14th month pay ang i-exclude sa computation sang gross income sang empleyado, apang dapat nga indi maglapaw sa allowed exemptions santo sa National Internal Revenue Code ukon ang iya Implementing Rules and Regulations.
english: The lawmaker also proposes that the 14th month pay be excluded from the computation of the employee's gross income, but should not exceed the allowed exemptions according to the National Internal Revenue Code or its Implementing Rules and Regulations.

text: Ginpanubo sang Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) sa 4.2 ang magnitude sang linog nga nagtay-og sa Guimbal, Iloilo 6:48 kaina sang aga.
english: The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) downgraded the magnitude of the earthquake that struck Guimbal, Iloilo at 6:48 this morning to 4.2.

text: Matandaan nga 4.4 magnitude ang una nga gin-report sang ahensya.
english: The agency initially reported a 4.4 magnitude earthquake.

text: Tectonic in origin ang linog kag may kadalumon nga 15 kilometros.
english: The quake was tectonic in origin and measured 15 kilometers deep.

text:
Yari ang reported intensities:

Intensity IV – CITY OF ILOILO; Nueva Valencia, GUIMARASIntensity III – Guimbal, Miagao, and Oton, ILOILO

english:
Here are the reported intensities:

As of press time, those who announced the suspension of classes are Guimbal, Oton, and Pavia.

text: Desidido ang tennis player sang Ukraine nga nagapasakop sa Australian Open nga i-snub ang iya mga kasumpong halin sa Russia kag Belarus nga wala sang may hinimuan agud pamatukan ang Russian invasion.
english: The Ukrainian tennis player, who is competing in the Australian Open, is determined to snub her opponents from Russia and Belarus who have done nothing to resist the Russian invasion.

text: Ang 20-anyos nga number two tennis player sang Ukraine nga si Marta Kostyuk amo man ang nangin agaw-atensyon sang nagligad nga tuig sang wala sini ginsunod ang customary handshake sa net kaupod sa former world number one nga si Victoria Azarenka nga halin sa Belarus nga sang amo nga tion naglutos sa iya sa US Open.
english: Ukraine’s 20-year-old number two tennis player Marta Kostyuk was also in the spotlight last year when she did not follow the customary handshake at the net with former world number one Victoria Azarenka of Belarus who at the time beat her at the US Open.

text: Ang Belarus amo ang ginakabig suod nga kaalyado sang Russia kag ginakabig pa nga mayor nga staging ground sang gyera sang Russia sa Ukraine.
english: Belarus is considered Russia’s closest ally and is still considered the main staging ground of Russia’s war in Ukraine.

text: Kahapon, daog ang Ukrainian tennis player sa iya una nga hampang batok sa isa ka American athlete.
english: Yesterday, the Ukrainian tennis player won his first match against an American athlete.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa tanan nga grand slams, ang Wimbledon lamang nga ginapatigayon sa United Kingdom ang nag-ban sa Russian kag Belarusian players.
english: Of all the grand slams, only Wimbledon, which is held in the United Kingdom, has banned Russian and Belarusian players.

text: Ang duha pa sa grand slams amo ang US Open kag ang French Open.
english: The other two at grand slams are the US Open and the French Open.

text: Ginapahanugutan ang Russia kag Belarus nga maghampang sa Australian Open subong nga tuig apang wala sang flag ukon pungsod nga naka-display.
english: Russia and Belarus are allowed to play at this year’s Australian Open but no flags or countries are on display.

text: Wala pa gani naka-get over ang Cebu City sa pagdaog sang Cebuana Beauty Queen nga si Bea Luigi Gomez sa Miss Universe Philippines 2021 apang nakuha naman sang isa pa ka Cebuana beauty ang korona sa Miss World Philippines 2021!
english: Cebu City has not even got over the victory of Cebuana Beauty Queen Bea Luigi Gomez in Miss Universe Philippines 2021 but another Cebuana beauty has won the crown in Miss World Philippines 2021!

text: Sa 44 ka mga kandidata, nangibabaw ang Cebuana industrial engineer nga si Tracy Maureen Perez.
english: Of the 44 candidates, Cebuana industrial engineer Tracy Maureen Perez topped the list.

text: Natalana nga itiglawas ni Perez ang Pilipinas sa 70th Miss World contest sa Puerto Rico sa Disyembre.
english: Perez is scheduled to represent the Philippines at the 70th Miss World contest in Puerto Rico in December.

text:
Ang iban nga winners nga maga-tiglawas man sang Pilipinas sa international competitions amo sanday:

Miss Eco Philippines: Kathleen Paton sang AklanReinahispanoamericana Filipinas: Emmanuelle Vera sang TaguigMiss Tourism Philippines: Trisha Martinez sang Pila, LagunaMiss Environment Philippines: Michelle Arceo sang Quezon CityMiss Multinational Philippines: Shaila Rebortera sang CebuMiss Eco Teen Philippines: Tatyana Austria sang Parañaque City

Matandaan nga una na nga na-appoint bilang Miss Supranational Philippines 2021 si Dindi Pajares.
english:
Other winners who will also represent the Philippines in international competitions are:

Miss Eco Philippines: Kathleen Paton of AklanReinahispanoamericana Philippines: Emmanuelle Vera of TaguigMiss Tourism Philippines: Trisha Martinez of Pila, LagunaMiss Environment Philippines: Michelle Arceo of Quezon CityMiss Multinational Philippines: Shaila Rebortera of CebuMiss Teen Teen Austria Parañaque City

Dindi Pajares was previously appointed as Miss Supranational Philippines 2021.

text: Yara man sa top 15 ang pambato sang Iloilo City nga si Anne Palmares nga nakakuha naman sang best in National Costume nga award.
english: Also in the top 15 is Iloilo City's Anne Palmares who won the best in National Costume award.

text: Ang costume ni Anne ang inspired sa Lapaz Batchoy kag gin-desinyo ni Tata Blas Pinuela nga amo man ang nag-design sa national costume ni Miss Universe Philippines Rabiya Mateo.
english: Anne's costume is inspired by Lapaz Batchoy and designed by Tata Blas Pinuela who also designed the national costume of Miss Universe Philippines Rabiya Mateo.

text: Nakuha sang Barangay Ginebra ang kampeonato sa 2022 Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) Commissioner’s Cup matapos ginlutos ang Bay Area Dragons, 114-99, sa Game 7.
english: Barangay Ginebra won the 2022 PBA Commissioner’s Cup after defeating the Bay Area Dragons, 114-99, in Game 7.

text: Umpisa pa lang sang sambuwa, wala na ginpaporma sang Gin Kings ang kasumpong sa atubang sang record-breaking crowd nga nagdangat sa 54,589 sa Philippine Arena sa Bulacan.
english: Early in the fight, the Gin Kings did not form their opponent in front of a record-breaking crowd of 54,589 at the Philippine Arena in Bulacan.

text: Nagpanguna sa team ang newly-naturalized star nga si Justin Brownlee nga nakaangkon sang 34 points, walo ka rebounds, kag 12 ka assists samtang may yara naman sang 18 points kag siyam ka rebounds si Scottie Thompson.
english: Newly-naturalized star Justin Brownlee led the team with 34 points, eight rebounds, and 12 assists while Scottie Thompson had 18 points and nine rebounds.

text: Sulit man kun kabigon ang una nga finals ni Jamie Malonzo nga may yara naman sang 22 points kag 17 rebounds.
english: It's also worth considering Jamie Malonzo's first finals with 22 points and 17 rebounds.

text: Ginkilala naman bilang Finals Most Valuable Player (MVP) si Christian Standhardinger.
english: Christian Standhardinger was named the Finals Most Valuable Player (MVP).

text: Ginkwestyon sang mga Senador ang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) matapos mahibaluan nga wala sa gihapon gin-revoke sang Philippine Contractors Accreditation Board (PCAB) ang lisensya sang Wawao Builders kag Syms Construction Trading, mga kompaniya nga may kahilabtanan sa flood control anomalies.
english: Senators questioned the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) after learning that the Philippine Contractors Accreditation Board (PCAB) has not yet revoked the licenses of Wawao Builders and Syms Construction Trading, companies involved in flood control anomalies.

text: Sa hearing sang 2026 national budget sang DTI sa Senate Subcommittee on Finance, ginbuyagyag ni Senator Imee Marcos, chairperson sang komite, nga aktibo sa gihapon ang PCAB license sang Wawao Builders sa pihak sang ila lifetime ban halin sa Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).
english: During the hearing of the 2026 national budget of the DTI in the Senate Subcommittee on Finance, Senator Imee Marcos, chairperson of the committee, revealed that the PCAB license of Wawao Builders is still active despite their lifetime ban from the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).

text: “Buhay na buhay pa rin ang kanilang PCAB license,” pahayag ni Marcos.
english: “Their PCAB license is still alive,” Marcos said.

text: Ganito rin umano ang sitwasyon ng Syms Construction, na “wala ring ni-revoke” kahit paso na ang lisensya noong Oktubre.
english: The same is true of Syms Construction, which “did not revoke” even though its license expired in October.

text: Suno kay PCAB Executive Director Sergie Retome, indi pa sila makahulag bangud wala pa sang bag-o nga myembro ang PCAB board matapis magbuya sa pwesto ang tatlo ka mga anay myembro.
english: According to PCAB Executive Director Sergie Retome, they cannot move because the PCAB board has no new members and the three former members are about to resign.

text: Dugang pa, isumiter nila ang rekomendasyon sang license revocation kun may na-appoint na nga bag-o nga board.
english: In addition, they will submit the recommendation of license revocation once a new board has been appointed.

text: Ginpakamalaot man ni Marcos ang Construction Industry Authority of the Philippines (CIAP) nga may supervisory function sa PCAB.
english: Marcos also criticized the Construction Industry Authority of the Philippines (CIAP) which has a supervisory function in the PCAB.

text: Suno sa iya, daw wala sini nahimo ang ila katungdanan bilang regulatory body.
english: He said it seems that it has not done its duty as a regulatory body.

text: Samtang, ginsiling naman ni Senator Sherwin Gatchalian, Chair sang Senate Committe on Finance nga ginadumilian sa gihapon ang mga shareholders sang mga kompaniya nga na-ban, agud indi na sila makabalik sa mga government projects gamit ang bag-o nga company.
english: Meanwhile, Senator Sherwin Gatchalian, Chair of the Senate Committee on Finance, said that the shareholders of the banned companies are still prohibited from returning to government projects using the new company.

text: Ginpunto man ni Gatchalian ang kaso sang pamilya Discaya nga ginaalegar nag-ilis lamang sang pangalan sang kompaniya apang mga himata sa gihapon ang tag-iya.
english: Gatchalian also pointed to the case of the Discaya family who allegedly changed the name of the company but the owners are still relatives.

text: Lima gid ang patay sa nagluntad nga bungguanay sang duha ka motorsiklo sa Brgy.
english: Five people were killed in a collision between two motorcycles in Brgy.

text: Crossing Rubber, Tupi, South Cotabato.
english: Crossing Rubber, Tupi, South Cotabato.

text: Ang isa ka motorsiklo amo ang XRM 125 nga ginamaneho sang 20-anyos nga lalaki kag may angkas nga 19-anyos nga si alyas Darel kag si alyas Bikay nga isa ka babaye.
english: One of the motorcycles was an XRM 125 driven by a 20-year-old man and was ridden by 19-year-old alias Darel and alias Bikay, a woman.

text: Samtang ang isa ka motorsiklo amo ang Rusi 125 nga ginamaneho ni alyas Christian, 20-anyos kag angkas sini ang 14-anyos nga solterito nga si alyas John.
english: Meanwhile, one of the motorcycles was a Rusi 125 driven by Christian, 20, and a 14-year-old boy, John.

text: Dead on the spot ang tatlo nga sakay sang XRM 125 kag ang driver sang Rusi 125.
english: The three occupants of the XRM 125 and the driver of the Rusi 125 died on the spot.

text: Nadala pa sa ospital si alyas John apang ginbawian man sang kabuhi.
english: John was rushed to the hospital but died.

text: Base sa inisyal nga imbestigasyon, ang XRM 125 ang pakadto sa Brgy.
english: Based on initial investigation, the XRM 125 was heading to Brgy.

text: Cebuano, samtang ang Rusi 125 ang pakadto sa Brgy.
english: Cebuano, while Rusi 125 is going to Brgy.

text: Crossing Rubber kag ginapahayag nga madasig ang pagpadalagan.
english: Crossing Rubber and reportedly speeding.

text: Pag-abot sa lugar sang aksidente, nadulaan sang kontrol ang Rusi 125 kag naglapaw ini sa pihak nga linya nga nagresulta sa head-on collision sang duha ka motorsiklo.
english: On reaching the scene of the accident, the Rusi 125 lost control and crossed the other lane resulting in a head-on collision between the two motorcycles.

text: Nagdangat sa P5.1 billion ang napyerde sang pribado nga sektor bangud sa pag-expire sang 4,252,830 ka COVID-19 vaccines suno kay former Presidential Adviser for Entrepreneurship Joey Concepcion.
english: The private sector lost P5.1 billion due to the expiration of 4,252,830 COVID-19 vaccines, according to former Presidential Adviser for Entrepreneurship Joey Concepcion.

text: Sa statement ni Concepcion, ginpahayag sini nga maga-expire sa Hulyo 31 ang final batch sang AstraZeneca vaccines.
english: In a statement, Concepcion said the final batch of AstraZeneca vaccines will expire on July 31.

text: Subong nga adlaw naman, Hulyo 27, sang nag-expire ang last batch sang Moderna vaccines.
english: Today, July 27, the last batch of Moderna vaccines expired.

text: Sa kabug-usan, 3,629,150 diri ang Moderna vaccines; buot silingon, Pfizer vaccines na lang ang nabilin para sa first and second boosters nga mahimo gamiton.
english: In total, 3,629,150 of these are Moderna vaccines; that is, only Pfizer vaccines remain for the first and second boosters that can be used.

text: Kadungan sang pagpaguwa sini nga data, ginpahayag ni Conception nga may “lack of urgency” sa bahin sang Department of Health kag sa Health Technology Assessment Council (HTAC) bangud late na sang na-desisyunan sang ahensya nga pasugtan ang paghatag sang second booster vaccinations sa mga tawo nga naga-edad 50 anyos pasaka kag 18 tubtub 49 anyos nga may comorbidities.
english: Along with the release of this data, Conception said there is a “lack of urgency” on the part of the Department of Health and the Health Technology Assessment Council (HTAC) because it was too late for the agency to allow the administration of second booster vaccinations to people aged 50 years and above and 18 to 49 years old.

text: Bangud kahinay sang hulag sang DOH suno kay Concepcion, nauyang ang bakuna kag posible man nga mag-expire ang mga bakuna nga iya sang gobyerno.
english: Due to the slow movement of the DOH, Concepcion said, the vaccine was wasted and it is possible that the vaccines belonging to the government will expire.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa idalom sang tripartite agreement sang ginbakal ang Covid-19 vaccines, ang gobyerno ang naga-uyat sang katunga sang bakuna nga ginbakal sang private sector.
english: Under the tripartite agreement when purchasing Covid-19 vaccines, the government holds half of the vaccines purchased by the private sector.

text: Abril pa lang, nagpanawagan na si Concepcion sa gobyerno nga pahanugutan ang ikaduha nga booster vaccinations agud nga ma-save pa ang suplay kag indi mabasura.
english: As early as April, Concepcion called on the government to allow the second booster vaccinations in order to save the supply and not waste it.

text: Ginpahayag man sini sang una nga handa man ang private sector nga magpabakuna.
english: He also said earlier that the private sector is also ready to get vaccinated.

text: Apisar nanugunan, may paglaum man ang natungdan nga may “positive developments” matapos nagpasalig si President Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos, Jr.
english: Despite his concerns, he is also hopeful that there will be “positive developments” after President Ferdinand 'Bongbong' Marcos, Jr.

text: nga lakip ang Health sa iya nga prayoridad.
english: that Health is one of his priorities.

text: Talikdan sang isa ka prinsesa sang Japan ang iya nga royal status agud nga pakaslan ang iya anay classmate nga isa ka commoner.
english: A Japanese princess will give up her royal status to marry her former classmate who is a commoner.

text: Ang prinsesa nga si Princess Mako ang anak ni Crown Prince Fumihito kag pinakamagulang nga hinablos ni Emperor Naruhito.
english: Princess Mako is the daughter of Crown Prince Fumihito and eldest niece of Emperor Naruhito.

text: Suno sa Imperial Household Agency, pakaslan na sang prinsesa ang iya commoner fiance nga si Kei Komuro sa Oktubre 26.
english: According to the Imperial Household Agency, the princess will marry her commoner fiance Kei Komuro on October 26.

text: Indi kaangay sa royal status ni Mako, si Komuro ang nagatrabaho bilang isa ka abogado sa New York sa Estados Unidos.
english: Unlike Mako’s royal status, Komuro works as a lawyer in New York in the United States.

text: Una nga gin-schedule ang kasal sang duha sang 2018, apang wala nadayon bangud sa ginapahayag problema sa kwarta sang pamilya ni Komuro.
english: The couple's wedding was initially scheduled for 2018, but was canceled due to Komuro's family's alleged money problems.

text: Subong nga madayon na gid ang kasal, 24/7 ang pag-cover sang media sa prinsesa rason nga nagbatyag ini sang post-traumatic stress disorder, kondisyon nga ginbatyag man anay sang iya nga tiya nga si Empress Masako nga nagsuprer sang stress-related illness bangud sa pressure nga maka-produce sang male heir.
english: Now that the wedding is about to take place, the media coverage of the princess is 24/7, causing her to suffer from post-traumatic stress disorder, a condition that was also experienced by her aunt, Empress Masako, who suffered from a stress-related illness due to the pressure to produce a male heir.

text:
A FAIRY TALE LOVE STORY

2012 sang una nga nagkilalahay ang prinsesa kag si Komuro sa International Christian University sa Tokyo.
english:
A FAIRY TALE LOVE STORY

2012 when the princess and Komuro first met at the International Christian University in Tokyo.

text: Sang 2017, na-engage ang duha apang nag-guwa ang kontrobersiya may kaangtanan sa utang sang iloy ni Komuro.
english: In 2017, the two got engaged but controversy surfaced regarding Komuro’s mother’s debt.

text: Sa Japan, sandig sa imperial law, ang mga male heirs lang ang mahimo nga makapanubli sang trono.
english: In Japan, according to imperial law, only male heirs can inherit the throne.

text: Kun ang prinsesa sa pamilya ang magapamana sang isa ka commoner, madula ang iya nga royal status.Ginapahayag nga indi man pagbatunon ni Mako ang traditional lump-sum payment nga 150 million yen kun magbiya na siya sa royal family.
english: If the princess of the family marries a commoner, she will lose her royal status. Mako will reportedly not accept the traditional lump-sum payment of 150 million yen when she leaves the royal family.

text: Ginapahayag man nga wala na sang rites nga nga matabo ukon royal family wedding.Kun balibaran ni Mako ang payment kag ang rites, siya ang una nga female member sang royal family nga makahimo sini.
english: It is also said that there will be no more rites or royal family wedding. If Mako refuses the payment and the rites, she will be the first female member of the royal family to do so.

text: Ginalantaw nga pagkatapos sang kasal, magapadulong si Mako kag ang iya nga bana sa US kun sa diin nagatrabaho si Komuro.
english: It is expected that after the wedding, Mako and her husband will go to the US where Komuro works.

text: Nagapabilin sa normal flood height (expected during inclement weather) ang Aganan River subong nga adlaw matapos magbubo ang mamunog nga ulan.
english: The Aganan River remains at normal flood height (expected during inclement weather) today after heavy rains.

text: Base sa situational report sang Alimodian Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office, paga-ekspektaron ang mahinay tubtob mabaskog nga ulan sa masunod pa nga mga inadlaw.
english: Based on the situational report of the Alimodian Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office, light to heavy rains are expected in the coming days.

text: Nagpahanumdom man ang amo nga opisina nga maghalong kag magbantay sa weather advisory.
english: The office also reminded the public to be vigilant and monitor the weather advisory.

text: By: Bombo Hanna Andasa
english: By: Bombo Hanna Andasa

text: Nagtupa sa lockup cell sang Pavia Municipal Police Station ang 26 ka mga indibidwal matapos nga nadakpan nga iligal nga nagapauwak sa Brgy.
english: Twenty-six individuals were arrested for illegally breeding crows in Brgy.

text: Pandac, Pavia, Iloilo.
english: Pandac, Pavia, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Gabriel Manguera, Deputy Chief of Police sang Pavia Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga una na nga nakabaton sang report ang talatapan nga may ginapatigayon nga pauwak sa amo nga lugar rason nga nagpatuman sila sang operasyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Gabriel Manguera, Deputy Chief of Police of the Pavia Municipal Police Station, said the office had already received a report that there was a crow in the area.

text: Suno kay Manguera, nakuha sa amo nga operasyon ang duha ka cockfighting rings, 15 ka mga manok, wall clock, duha ka syringe, kag P9,100 nga bet money.
english: According to Manguera, two cockfighting rings, 15 chickens, a wall clock, two syringes, and P9,100 bet money were recovered from the operation.

text: Yara na sa paghinakop sang Pavia PNP ang nagkaladakpan kon sa diin, nagapangatubang sang kaso sa paglapas sa Presidential Decree 1602 ukon Anti-Illegal Gambling Law.
english: The suspects are now in the custody of Pavia PNP where they are facing charges of violating Presidential Decree 1602 or Anti-Illegal Gambling Law.

text: Bisan pa nga nangin madinalag-on ang pagpatuman sang hagna nga Republic Act No.
english: Although the implementation of Republic Act No.

text: 12309 ukon Free Funeral Services Act, may mga pagpangduha-duha ang pila ka administrador sang mga semi-private nga sementeryo sa Iloilo parte sa posibilidad nga malibre ang pagpalubong sa ila lugar.
english: 12309 or Free Funeral Services Act, some administrators of semi-private cemeteries in Iloilo have doubts about the possibility of free burial in their area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Alejandro Ordaniel, Caretaker sang Jaro Catholic Cemetery, ginpahayag niya nga kada tuig may bayad nga ₱200 para sa arkila sang pantyon bilang maintenance.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Alejandro Ordaniel, caretaker of the Jaro Catholic Cemetery, said that every year there is a fee of ₱200 for the rent of the cemetery as maintenance.

text: Dugang pa niya, ang bayad para sa kalkal kag pagsira sang lulubngan nagalab-ut sa ₱1,500.
english: He added that the fee for digging and closing the grave amounts to ₱1,500.

text: Kung magpalubong ka sa pantyon nga wala sang amoroso, kinahanglan bayaran sang ₱3,500.
english: If you are buried in a cemetery without an amoroso, you will have to pay ₱3,500.

text: Suno kay Ordaniel, pabor man sila sa hagna nga nagahatag sang libre nga serbisyo sa mga imol, apang ginpunto niya nga indi dapat malibre ang pagpalubong sa mga pantyon nga wala gina-arkilahan.
english: Ordaniel said they are also in favor of a bill that provides free services to the poor, but he pointed out that burials in cemeteries that are not rented should not be free.

text: Ginpabutyag niya nga wala sang labot ang gobyerno sa ila sementeryo bangud semi-private ini kag kun librehon ang serbisyo, posible nga indi na mapuslan ang lugar bangud wala na sang tawo nga magapaninlo kag magabantay.
english: He said the government has nothing to do with their cemetery because it is semi-private and if the service is free, the place may not be useful because there is no one to clean and guard it.

text: Matandaan nga ang Republic Act No.
english: It can be recalled that Republic Act No.

text: 12309 epektibo sang Setyembre 28, 2025.
english: 12309 effective September 28, 2025.

text: Ginapahanumdom nga ang mga pamilya nga ginakabig nga indigent suno sa National Economic and Development Authority kag Department of Social Welfare and Development ang maka-avail sang libre nga kabaong nga disente kag barato, kag serbisyo sa pagpalubong para sa mga pamilya nga yara sa krisis.
english: It is reminded that families who are considered indigent according to the National Economic and Development Authority and Department of Social Welfare and Development can avail of free coffins that are decent and affordable, and burial services for families in crisis.

text: Ang DSWD ang mangin panguna nga ahensya sa pagpatuman sang hagna.
english: The DSWD will be the primary agency in implementing the bill.

text: Katuyuan sang hagna amo ang pagbulig sa mga pamilya nga wala sang kapasidad magbayad sang pagpalubong kag pagsiguro nga may dignidad ang kada Pilipino tubtob sa iya katapusan.
english: The purpose of the bill is to help families who do not have the capacity to pay for burial and ensure that every Filipino has dignity until his or her end.

text: Daku ang paglaum sang Philippine Olympic Committee nga matigayon nga mapangunahan sang Barangay Ginebra import nga si Justin Brownlee ang men’s national basketball team agud maagaw ang gold sa Southeast Asian Games nga natalana na sa Mayo 5-17 sa Cambodia.
english: The Philippine Olympic Committee is hopeful that Barangay Ginebra import Justin Brownlee will be able to lead the men's national basketball team to win gold at the Southeast Asian Games scheduled for May 5-17 in Cambodia.

text: Suno kay Bambol Tolentino sang Philippine Olympic Committee, magapadala ang Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas sang mabaskog kag indi maasi-asi nga roster sa ika-32 nga edisyon sang SEA Games, kag posible nga si Brownlee ang manguna kun manaturalize na ini kag mahimo nga Philippine passport holder antes ang hampang sa Mayo.
english: According to Bambol Tolentino of the Philippine Olympic Committee, the Philippine Basketball Association will send a strong and unprecedented roster to the 32nd edition of the SEA Games, and Brownlee is likely to lead once he is naturalized and can become a Philippine passport holder before the games in May.

text: Nahibaluan nga subong, pirma na lang ni Presidente Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos ang kulang sa naturalization sang 34-anyos nga basketball star.
english: It is known that now, only the signature of President Ferdinand 'Bongbong' Marcos is missing for the naturalization of the 34-year-old basketball star.

text: Kumpyansa si Tolentino nga daku ang mabulig sang 6-foot-6 Gin Kings’ import agud mabawi ang bulawan nga medalya apisar nga mahampang man ang iban nga mga pungsod nga may yara man sang naturalized players.
english: Tolentino is confident that the 6-foot-6 Gin Kings' import will help them regain the gold medal despite the fact that other countries with naturalized players will also play.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga SEA Games, napaslawan ang Pilipinas nga makuha ang kuntani ika-14 na nga sunod-sunod nga gold medal sa basketball sa amo nga biennal meet matapos nalutos ini sa Indonesia sa skor nga 85-81.
english: It can be recalled that in the last SEA Games, the Philippines failed to win what would have been its 14th consecutive gold medal in basketball at the biennial meet after losing to Indonesia with a score of 85-81.

text: Sa labing una nga tion halin sang 1989, silver ang nakuha sang Gilas sa baylo nga gold.
english: For the first time since 1989, the Gilas won silver instead of gold.

text: Magluwas sa SEA games, yara man si Brownlee sa away sang Gilas batok sa Lebanon sa Pebrero 24 kag batok sa Jordan sa Pebrero 2 sa final qualifying window sang Fiba World Cup 2023 nga lunsay patigayunon sa Philippine Arena.
english: In addition to the SEA games, Brownlee will also be in the Gilas’ clash against Lebanon on February 24 and against Jordan on February 2 in the final qualifying window of the Fiba World Cup 2023, both of which will be held at the Philippine Arena.

text: Isa ka adlaw antes ang koronasyon sang bag-o nga Miss Universe Philippines, nagaguwa ang pangalan ni US-based host-actress Katrina Dimaranan nga amo ang top choice sang pageantologists sa pungsod.
english: A day before the coronation of the new Miss Universe Philippines, the name of US-based host-actress Katrina Dimaranan is emerging as the top choice of pageantologists in the country.

text: Veteran beauty queen na si Katrina kag subong nagatiglawas sang Taguig City.
english: Katrina is a veteran beauty queen and now represents Taguig City.

text: Nakoronahan siya bilang Binibining Pilipinas Tourism sang 2012 kag nag-first runner-up sa Miss Supranational 2018 pageant sang gintiglawas niya ang USA.
english: She was crowned Miss Philippines Tourism in 2012 and was first runner-up in the Miss Supranational 2018 pageant when she represented the USA.

text: Sa mga top picks sang mga beterano nga pageant watchers, masami man nga nagapangaduha ang Cebuana beauty queen nga si Steffi Aberasturi.
english: Among the top picks of veteran pageant watchers, Cebuana beauty queen Steffi Aberasturi also often comes second.

text: Yara man masami sa top 5 ang actress-model nga si Maureen Wroblewitz sang Pangasinan, Victoria Vincent sang Cavite, kag Leren Mae Bautista sang Laguna.
english: Actress-model Maureen Wroblewitz of Pangasinan, Victoria Vincent of Cavite, and Leren Mae Bautista of Laguna are also often in the top 5.

text: Ang coronation ang patigayunon buwas sa gab-i sa Henann Resort Convention Center sa Panglao, Bohol.
english: The coronation will be held tomorrow night at the Henann Resort Convention Center in Panglao, Bohol.

text: Magabalik bilang host si KC Montero kag guest artists naman sanday Sam Concepcion kag Michael Pangilinan.488People Reached29Engagements.
english: KC Montero will return as host and Sam Concepcion and Michael Pangilinan will be guest artists.

text: Carles, Iloilo — Isa ka insidente sang pagkulob sang sakayan pandagat ang natabo sa kadagatan nga sakop sang Carles, Iloilo matapos ini maigo sang tatlo ka sunod-sunod nga dalagko nga balod.
english: Carles, Iloilo — An incident of a boat capsizing occurred in the waters of Carles, Iloilo after it was hit by three consecutive big waves.

text: Ang sakayan, nga ginamaneho sang kapitan nga si Manuel Banes sang Brgy.
english: The boat, driven by captain Manuel Banes of Brgy.

text: Poblacion Zone 2, Sitio Calumpang, Estancia, Iloilo, upod ang duha pa ka sakay nga sanday Melvin Parojinog, 26, sang Brgy.
english: Poblacion Zone 2, Sitio Calumpang, Estancia, Iloilo, along with two other passengers, Melvin Parojinog, 26, of Brgy.

text: Bulaquenia, Estancia kag Neil Bullos, 24, sang Brgy.
english: Bulaquenia, Estancia and Neil Bullos, 24, of Brgy.

text: Tacbuyan, Pabahay Village, Carles, ginkasangkutan sang trahedya sang Huwebes sang hapon.
english: Tacbuyan, Pabahay Village, Carles, was involved in the tragedy on Thursday afternoon.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo sa kay PO3 Jurada PCG, naghalin sa Estancia ang sakayan kag nakabatyag sang problema sa makina nga nagtugas sang pagka-angkorahe sini.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, PO3 Jurada PCG said the boat was leaving Estancia when it experienced an engine problem that prevented it from anchoring.

text: Pagkatapos ma sekyar ang makina, ginpanghaylo nila ang angkla bisan wala pa nagaandar liwat ang makina, wala nila napunggan ang dalagko nga balod nga nagluntad sunod-sunod, rason nga nagkakulob ang sakayan sa 2.75 kilometros kalayuon halin sa shoreline kag 3.69 kilometros gikan sa pinakamalapit nga isla.
english: After checking the engine, they lured the anchor even though the engine was not running again, they could not stop the big waves that occurred one after another, causing the boat to capsize 2.75 kilometers from the shoreline and 3.69 kilometers from the nearest island.

text: May nakalabay nga bangka nga nakakita sang insidente, nakakuha sang litrato kag nakapadala sang mensahe sa Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management sang Carles.
english: A passing boat saw the incident, took a picture and sent a message to the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management of Carles.

text: Gilayon nga nagbulig ang MDRRMO personnel sa pagtawag sa Coast Guard.
english: MDRRMO personnel immediately called the Coast Guard.

text: Ginkumpirma sang PNP nga yara na sa maayo nga kahimtang ang tatlo ka mga sakay sang bangka kag gindul-ong na pabalik sa Estancia.
english: The PNP confirmed that the three passengers are in good condition and have been taken back to Estancia.

text: Ang bangka, subong, yara pa sa tunga sang dagat.
english: The boat, as of now, is still in the middle of the sea.

text: Ginklaro sang lokal nga barangay nga wala sila nagkulang sa pagpahanumdom sang kahingalanon nga seguridad sa kadagatan.
english: The local barangay clarified that they did not fail to remind the public of the importance of security at sea.

text: Padayon ang pagpaninguha sang mga lokal nga otoridad sa pagpatuman sang safety protocols agud malikawan ang kapareho nga insidente.
english: Local authorities continue to implement safety protocols to prevent similar incidents.

text: By: Bombo Bryan Gonzales
english: By: Bombo Bryan Gonzales

text: Kasal na ang actress nga si Kris Bernal, 32, sa chef nga si Perry Choi, 37, matapos ang ila apat ka tuig nga magnobyohanay.
english: Actress Kris Bernal, 32, is married to chef Perry Choi, 37, after four years of dating.

text: Ang ila nga church wedding ang ginhiwat sa St.
english: Their church wedding was held at St.

text: Alphonsus Mary de Liguori Parish sa Magallanes Village, Makati City.
english: Alphonsus Mary de Liguori Parish in Magallanes Village, Makati City.

text: Suksok ni Kris ang wedding gown nga himo ni Mak Tumang.
english: Kris was wearing a wedding gown made by Mak Tumang.

text:
Sang nagalakat sa aisle ang actress, wala naman niya napunggan nga mangin emosyonal samtang ginakanta sang singer nga si Yeng Constantino ang ambahanon nga “Ikaw.”

Gamay lamang nga mga himata kag close friends ang gin-imbitahan sang duha para sa ila nga okasyon.
english:
As the actress walked down the aisle, she couldn't help but get emotional as singer Yeng Constantino sang the song “Ikaw.”

Only a small number of relatives and close friends were invited by the two for their occasion.

text: Nagpabilin nga wala nakapauli sa ila puluy-an ang anay barangay tanod nga nagpalupok sang armas-luthang sa Brgy.
english: The former barangay tanod who fired his firearm in Brgy.

english: Ticud, La Paz, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Barangay Roy Dichoson, iya ginpahayag nga kasunod sang insidente, gilayon sila nga nagresponde sa lugar.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Punong Barangay Roy Dichoson said that following the incident, they immediately responded to the scene.

text: Apang sang pag-abot nila sa lugar, wala na ang amo nga indibidwal.
english: But when they arrived at the scene, the individual was gone.

text: Suno kay Dichoson, madulom ang lugar kon sa diin ini nagpalupok.
english: According to Dichoson, the area where he opened fire was dark.

text: Ginkakibot naman sang kadam-an lakip na ang kaupod sini ang ginhimo sang amo nga persona.
english: The crowd, including his companion, was shocked by the actions of the suspect.

text: Gintuad man ni Dichoson nga naga-inom-inom sang makahulubog nga ilimnon ang indibidwal antes nagluntad ang pagpinalupok.
english: Dichoson also admitted that the individual was drinking alcohol before the shooting.

text: Ginaimbestigaran naman sang kapulisan ang nagluntad nga insidente.
english: Police are investigating the incident.

text: Gintay-og sang linog nga may kabaskugon nga magnitude 5.0 ang bahin sang Zambales sini nga Sabado sang hapon, Oktubre 11.
english: An earthquake measuring 5.0 on the Richter scale shook parts of Zambales this Saturday afternoon, October 11.

text: Suno sa record sang Philippine seismic monitoring agency, ang sentro sang linog ang makita sa kalayuon nga 19 kilometro Northern nga bahin sang Cabangan, Zambales.
english: According to the Philippine seismic monitoring agency, the epicenter of the quake was located 19 kilometers north of Cabangan, Zambales.

text: May kadalumon ini nga 100 kilometro.
english: It is 60 miles [100 km] deep.
