text: Nagtukod ang Iloilo City Government sang Multi-Disciplinary Team agud matapna ang pagdata sang kinagamo sang mga kabataan sa Iloilo City.
english: The Iloilo City Government has established a Multi-Disciplinary Team to curb the spread of child abuse in Iloilo City.

text: Ini kasunod man sa kinagamo sang duha ka grupo sang mga estudyante nga involved sa stabbing incident sa distrito sang Molo.
english: This follows the riots between two groups of students involved in a stabbing incident in Molo district.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ms. Grace Centino, Division Head sang Child and Youth Welfare Program, iya ginpahayag nga ang team applicable sa pila ka mga buluthuan sa syudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ms. Grace Centino, Division Head of the Child and Youth Welfare Program, said the team is applicable to several schools in the city.

text: Suno kay Tolentino, nagpatuman sila sang conference agud nga matumod ang mga tikang nga nagakadapat ubrahon agud indi na masulit ang amo nga insidente.
english: Tolentino said they held a conference to identify the steps that should be taken to prevent the incident from happening again.

text: Nagkoordinar man ang talatapan sa mga barangay officials, sa Schools Division of Iloilo City, Iloilo City Police Office, kag sa Women and Children Protection Desk.
english: The office also coordinated with barangay officials, the Schools Division of Iloilo City, Iloilo City Police Office, and the Women and Children Protection Desk.

text: Nahibaluan nga nakaagum sang stab wound sa butkon ang 15-anyos nga halin sa grupo sang mga freshmen, pilason man ang 16-anyos nga halin naman sa grupo sang mga Senior High School students.
english: It was learned that the 15-year-old from the group of freshmen sustained a stab wound in the arm, while the 16-year-old from the group of Senior High School students was also injured.

text: Ginkustodiya naman sang ICPS 4 ang 5 ka mga estudyante, samtang gindala agud mabulong sa ospital ang 16-anyos nga solterito.
english: ICPS 4 took five students into custody, while a 16-year-old boy was taken to the hospital for treatment.

text: Narecover sang kapulisan ang apat tanan ka patalom sa mga estudyante.
english: Police recovered all four sharp objects from the students.

text: Nagmandu na si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has ordered

text: sa mga opisyal sang Department of Agriculture (DA) nga makig-angot sa Bureau of Customs kag sa Kongreso agud nga madasig nga matapna ang smuggling sang ulutanon kag ang iligal nga importasyon sang iban pa nga agricultural products.
english: to officials of the Department of Agriculture (DA) to liaise with the Bureau of Customs and Congress to quickly curb the smuggling of vegetables and the illegal importation of other agricultural products.

text: Si Marcos amo man ang nagapamuno subong sa DA.
english: Marcos is also the current head of the DA.

text: Ginhatag sini ang amo nga assignment sang ginpatigayon ang meeting sa main office sa Quezon City subong nga semana.
english: He gave the assignment during a meeting held at the main office in Quezon City this week.

text: Ginpahayag ni Marcos nga kinahanglan man ang plano agud nga mapasigurado ang food supply kag presyo nga masarangan sang ordinaryo nga mga Pilipino.
english: Marcos said the plan is also needed to ensure food supply and affordable prices for ordinary Filipinos.

text: Sang nagligad nga bulan, una na nagpahayag ang Bureau of Customs nga nagapakig-angot ini sa DA agud kakason ang smuggled items sa merkado sa pungsod.
english: Last month, the Bureau of Customs earlier said it was working with the DA to remove smuggled items from the country's market.

text: Nagdeploy ang duha ka ahensya sang mga personnel sa mga merkado agud nga i-check kun may yara sang illegally imported agricultural products.
english: The two agencies deployed personnel to the markets to check for illegally imported agricultural products.

text: Kun basehan ang rekord sang Customs, halin sang 2016, may 103 na ka criminal complaints nga gin-file batok sa importers kag brokers nga amo ang iligal nga naga-ship sini sa Pilipinas.
english: Based on Customs records, since 2016, there have been 103 criminal complaints filed against importers and brokers who illegally ship it to the Philippines.

text: Halin naman sang 2019, yara na sa P1.99 billion ang balor sang smuggled agricultural goods nga nakumpiskar sang Customs.
english: Since 2019, the value of smuggled agricultural goods seized by Customs has reached P1.99 billion.

text: Ginkumpirma ni House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy nga naghangyo na siya sang bulig sa Department of Justice (DOJ) agud kaselaron ang pasaporte sang nag-resign nga anay Ako Bicol Partylist Representative Zaldy Co, sa tunga sang padayon nga imbestigasyon sa ginapahayag nga korapsyon sa mga flood control projects.
english: House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy confirmed that he has already requested assistance from the Department of Justice (DOJ) to seal the passport of resigned former Ako Bicol Partylist Representative Zaldy Co, amid the ongoing investigation into alleged corruption in flood control projects.

text: Suno kay Speaker Dy, gilayon siya nga nakig-angut kay Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla nga subong amo na ang Ombudsman sang adlaw nga nagbuya sa puwesto si Co, Setyembre 29.
english: Speaker Dy said he immediately contacted Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla who is now the Ombudsman on the day Co resigned on September 29.

text: Ginpanugyan ni Dy nga ginhimo niya ini agud istriktuhan ang posibilidad nga makabiyahe si Co sa guwa sang pungsod samtang ginahimo ang imbestigasyon.
english: Dy suggested that he did this to restrict the possibility of Co traveling outside the country while the investigation was being conducted.

text: Ginklaro man ni Dy nga bisan pa wala sang hurisdiksyon ang DOJ sa pag-kansela sang pasaporte, ginpangayo lang niya ang assistance sang ahensya para sa angay nga mga tikang.
english: Dy also clarified that although the DOJ has no jurisdiction to cancel passports, he only sought the agency's assistance for appropriate measures.

text: Ginpasiguro naman ni Remulla nga magahimo gilayon sang mga kinahanglanon nga lihok ang DOJ para mapadasig ang proseso.
english: Remulla assured that the DOJ will immediately take the necessary steps to expedite the process.

text: Ginpunto sang isa ka disaster expert, nga ang bagyo kag baha amo ang pinaka-delikado kag seryoso nga hazard nga ginatubang sang probinsya kag syudad sang Iloilo subong.
english: A disaster expert pointed out that typhoons and floods are the most dangerous and serious hazards facing the province and city of Iloilo today.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Dr. Jerry Bionat, former Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO) Head, ginpahayag sini nga bisan wala sang bagyo nga nagasulod sa Pilipinas, posible gihapon ang mabaskog nga ulan kag pagbaha bangud sang Southwest Moonsoon ukon Habagat nga kabahin sang moonsoon season halin Hunyo tubtob Oktubre.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Dr. Jerry Bionat, former Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO) Head, said that even if there is no typhoon entering the Philippines, heavy rains and flooding are still possible due to the Southwest Monsoon or Habagat which is part of the monsoon season from June to October.

text: Gindugang pa niya nga ang mga bagyo nagaporma sa Pacific Ocean malapit sa Caroline Islands, kag ini naga-evolve halin sa tropical depression tubtob sa super typhoon.
english: He added that cyclones form in the Pacific Ocean near the Caroline Islands, and they evolve from a tropical depression to a super typhoon.

text: Ginsaysay man ni Dr. Bionat nga ginapabaskug sang climate change ang epekto sang panahon, kag ang pagbaha nagaluntad bangud sang pagdamo sang mga tawo, pagkalbo sang mga kagulangan, poor drainage system, pag-ubra sang mga subdivision, kag pagpabaya sang mga basura.
english: He also explained that Dr. Bionat said climate change is intensifying the effects of weather, and flooding is caused by population growth, deforestation, poor drainage systems, subdivisions, and waste disposal.

text: Ginpahanumdom niya ang publiko nga maghalong kag magpabilin nga alerto sa mga advisory kag laygay sang mga otoridad, bangud bisan wala sang bagyo, posible gihapon ang pagbaha kag peligro nga dala sang climate change.
english: He reminded the public to be vigilant and remain alert to the advisories and advice of the authorities, because even if there is no typhoon, flooding and dangers brought about by climate change are still possible.

text: Antes ipasa ang Miss Universe Philippines crown sa iya successor, ginbalikan sang Ilongga beauty queen nga si Rabiya Mateo ang pinakamasakit nga tinaga nga iya nabatian gikan sa iya bashers.
english: Before passing the Miss Universe Philippines crown to her successor, Ilongga beauty queen Rabiya Mateo recounted the most hurtful words she heard from her bashers.

text: Suno kay Rabiya, sang nadag-an niya ang korona sang nagligad nga tuig, gintawag siya nga ‘kabit’.
english: According to Rabiya, when she won the crown last year, she was called ‘kabit’.

text: “Dark horse ako noon, wala akong kapanga-pangalan, galing sa probinsya.
english: “I was a dark horse, I had no name, from the province.

text: Yung narinig kong issue is, ‘Ah, kabit ‘yan kaya nanalo ‘yan’.
english: The issue I heard was, 'Ah, that's a wife so she won'.

text: That was nasty,” pahayag ni Rabiya.
english: That was nasty,” Rabiya said.

text: Unfair ini para sa nasambit nga biracial beauty bangud suno sa iya, tanan nga iya naangkon, ginpangabudlayan niya.
english: This is unfair for the said biracial beauty because according to her, everything she has, she has worked hard for.

text:
“Isa akong babae kung saan lahat ng meron ako, pinaghihirapan ko.”

Ginpahayag ni Rabiya nga sa tanan nga masakit nga iya naagyan, ang iloy niya ang iya nga ginadalaganan.
english:
“I am a woman where everything I have, I struggle.”

Rabiya said that in all the pain she went through, her mother was the one she ran to.

text: Nakuha ni Rabiya ang Miss Universe Philippines crown sang October 2020, kag nalakip siya sa Top 21 sa 69th Miss Universe pageant sang Mayo.
english: Rabiya won the Miss Universe Philippines crown in October 2020, and she placed in the Top 21 at the 69th Miss Universe pageant in May.

text: ILOILO CITY- Magapatigayon sang School Sports Program ang Department of Education umpisa subong nga Enero.
english: ILOILO CITY- The Department of Education will conduct a School Sports Program starting this January.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Nicasio Valenzuela, Division Sports Officer sang Deped Division of Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga ini ang ginkasugtan sang Department of Education Central Office sa pagsinapol nga iya man gintambungan sang nagligad nga Disyembre.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Nicasio Valenzuela, Division Sports Officer of the Deped Division of Iloilo, said this was agreed upon by the Department of Education Central Office in a meeting he also attended last December.

text: Suno sa iya, base sa calendar sang ahensya para sa School Sports Program, subong nga Enero patigayunon ang Intramurals kag ang Municipal level meet, pagasundan sang congressional meet sa Pebrero, sunod amo ang division meet kag inter-division meet.
english: He said that based on the agency's calendar for the School Sports Program, this January will be held the Intramurals and the Municipal level meet, followed by the congressional meet in February, followed by the division meet and inter-division meet.

text: Ginpahayag ni Valenzuela, nga sa congressional meet, may yara sang bag-o nga format nga ipatuman kun sa diin wala sang exclusive host sang hinampang kundi sa lain-lain nga venue.
english: Valenzuela said that in the congressional meet, there will be a new format to be implemented where there will be no exclusive host of the game but in different venues.

text: Ini nga format ang maga-feature man sang home and away games kun sa diin sa kada matapos ang hampang, papaulion ang mga atleta kag wala sang may matabo nga housing sang mga players.
english: This format will also feature home and away games where after each game, the athletes will be sent home and there will be no housing of the players.

text: Sa tagsa ka pagtakop sang meet, may yara sang patigayunon nga selection process sa winning kag losing teams agud i-evaluate ang mga players kun sin-o ang magabug-os sang team nga maga-proceed sa Division level meet.
english: At the end of each meet, there will be a selection process for the winning and losing teams to evaluate the players who will make up the team that will proceed to the Division level meet.

text: Suno kay Valenzuela, may yara man sang qualifying requirements para sa tagsa ka event kag kinahanglan nga malab-ot ini sang atleta.
english: According to Valenzuela, there are also qualifying requirements for each event and the athlete must meet them.

text: Dugang sang natungdan, sa subong, wala pa sang final guidelines sa mga sports events kag ini ang istoryahan pa sang natungdan nga mga sports officials sang Department of Education.
english: He added that at present, there are no final guidelines for sports events and this will be discussed by the concerned sports officials of the Department of Education.

text: Patigayunon naman ang Palarong Pambansa sa Hulyo.
english: The National Games will be held in July.

text: Isa ka tuig matapos gin-deport ang nine-time champion kag Serbian tennis superstar nga si Novak Djokovic bangud wala nagpabakuna batok sa Covid-19, ginpahalugan na ang restrictions sa Australian Open.
english: A year after nine-time champion and Serbian tennis superstar Novak Djokovic was deported for failing to get vaccinated against Covid-19, restrictions on the Australian Open have been eased.

text: Gin-anunsyo sang tournament director nga si Craig Tiley nga indi na required ang players nga mag-take sang Covid-19 tests; buot silingon, may virus man sila ukon wala, mahimo sila makahampang.
english: Tournament director Craig Tiley announced that players will no longer be required to take Covid-19 tests; that is, whether they have the virus or not, they can play.

text: Suno kay Tiley, ang bag-o nga pagsulundan ang repleksyon sang kun ano ang nagakatabo sa mas masangkad nga komunidad ilabi na bangud indi na tuman ka istrikto ang mga pagsulundan subong sa Australia.
english: According to Tiley, the new rules are a reflection of what is happening in the wider community especially since the rules are not so strict now in Australia.

text: Magapanumbalik si Djokovic sa Australian Open subong nga tuig kag nagalaum nga maangkon ang iya fourth title sa five editions sang amo nga tournament.
english: Djokovic will return to the Australian Open this year and hopes to win his fourth title in five editions of the tournament.

text: Ang Australian Open amo ang una sa apat ka Grand Slam tennis tournaments kada tuig.
english: The Australian Open is the first of four Grand Slam tennis tournaments every year.

text: Indi pa maathag kun ano ang mangin masunod nga pagsulundan sa magasunod nga tournament nga French Open, Wimbledon sa United Kingdom kag ang U.S. Open.
english: It is not clear what the next rules will be for the next tournaments, the French Open, Wimbledon in the United Kingdom and the U.S. Open.

text: Sa apat ka Grand Slam hosts, ang France lamang ang may yara pa sang mandatory isolation requirements sa mga naga-positibo sa Covid-19.
english: Of the four Grand Slam hosts, only France still has mandatory isolation requirements for those who test positive for Covid-19.

text: ILOILO CITY – Padayon pa nga nagasaka ang presyo sang mga produkto nga indi sakop sang suggested retail price sa supermarkets.
english: ILOILO CITY – The prices of products that are not covered by the suggested retail price in supermarkets continue to rise.

text: Ini ang suno sa grupo sang supermarket owners.
english: This is according to the group of supermarket owners.

text: Suno kay Steven Cua, pinuno sang Philippine Amalgamated Supermarkets Association, indi mahibaluan kun tubtob san-o ini matabo.
english: According to Steven Cua, head of the Philippine Amalgamated Supermarkets Association, it is not known how long this will happen.

text: Dugang pa niya, mangin ang tiglikom sang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) ang indi makahibalo.
english: He added that even the secretary of the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) does not know.

text: Sakop sini ang delata, condiments, noodles, habon kag iban pa nga ginagamit sa sulod sang balay.
english: This includes candy, condiments, noodles, soap and other household items.

text: Matandaan nga nagtaas ang presyo sang mga balaklon sa tunga sang epekto sang serye sang oil price hikes nga resulta sang gyera sa tunga sang Ukraine kag Russia.
english: It can be recalled that commodity prices rose amid the impact of a series of oil price hikes resulting from the war between Ukraine and Russia.

text: Wala pa sang ginpasugtan ang DTI nga bag-o nga saka sang presyo sang mga produkto nga may SP sa pihak sang pila ka mga petition sang manufacturers.
english: The DTI has not yet approved any new price increases for products containing SP despite several petitions from manufacturers.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni DTI Undersecretary Ruth Castelo nga wala nila gina-ipit ang price adjustments bangud lang sang State of the Nation Address (SONA) ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: Earlier, DTI Undersecretary Ruth Castelo said they are not insisting on price adjustments just because of the State of the Nation Address (SONA) of President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: Cancer-free na ang vetertan screen actor nga si Rez Cortez.
english: Veteran screen actor Rez Cortez is cancer-free.

text: Ini ang suno sa iya nga anak ang isa man ka actress nga si Cai Cortez.
english: This is the daughter of another actress, Cai Cortez.

text: Sa instagram, ginpost ni Cai ang video niya kaupod ang amay kag sa caption, iya ginpahayag nga nagapasalamat ini sa mga tawo nga nagpangamuyo para sa ikaayong lawas sang iya amay.
english: On Instagram, Cai posted a video of himself with his father and in the caption, he said he was grateful to the people who prayed for his father's health.

text: Nagpaidalom si Rez sa surgery sang Septyembre 1 bangud sa suspected liver cancer.
english: Rez underwent surgery on September 1 for suspected liver cancer.

text: Nahibaluan nga “traidor” ang masami nga role sang nasambit nga aktor sa mga action movies.
english: The actor often plays a “traitor” in action movies.

text: Siya ang isa man sa mga sidekicks sadto ni the late Fernando Poe Jr.
english: He was also one of the sidekicks of the late Fernando Poe Jr.

text: Iginiit ng BAYAN-Panay na ginagamit umano ng gobyerno ang pamimigay ng ayuda sa gitna ng krisis bilang paraan para makakuha ng political gain.
english: BAYAN-Panay insists that the government is allegedly using the distribution of aid in the midst of the crisis as a way to gain political gain.

text: Ayon sa grupo, sa halip na maging patas at sistematiko ang distribusyon ng tulong, nagiging instrumento umano ito para mapalakas ang impluwensiya ng ilang opisyal, lalo na sa mga komunidad na may mataas na bilang ng botante.
english: According to the group, instead of making the distribution of aid fair and systematic, it is becoming an instrument to strengthen the influence of some officials, especially in communities with high voter turnout.

text: Binigyang-diin pa ng BAYAN-Panay na dapat nakabatay sa pangangailangan ng mamamayan ang pamamahagi ng ayuda at hindi sa interes ng pulitika.
english: BAYAN-Panay stressed that the distribution of aid should be based on the needs of the people and not on political interests.

text: Anila, mahalaga ang transparency at accountability upang matiyak na ang tulong ay makarating sa mga tunay na nangangailangan.
english: According to them, transparency and accountability are important to ensure that the aid reaches those who really need it.

text: Idinagdag pa ni Forro na umano’y “highly selective” ang implementasyon ng subsidy rollout, kung saan sinasabing bibigyang prayoridad sa Iloilo City ang mga miyembro ng kooperatiba at rehistradong botante.
english: Forro added that the implementation of the subsidy rollout is “highly selective”, where cooperative members and registered voters are said to be given priority in Iloilo City.

text: Ayon kay Forro, tila mas nakatuon ang naturang sistema sa pagkontrol ng distribusyon para sa political gain kaysa sa agarang pagtugon sa pangangailangan ng mamamayan.
english: According to Forro, the current system seems to be more focused on controlling distribution for political gain than on responding to the needs of the people.

text: Sa kabila nito, nanawagan ang grupo sa pamahalaan na ayusin ang sistema ng distribusyon at tiyakin na hindi ito maaabuso, lalo na sa panahon ng krisis kung kailan umaasa ang maraming Pilipino sa ayuda mula sa gobyerno.
english: Meanwhile, the group called on the government to fix the distribution system and ensure that it is not abused, especially in times of crisis when many Filipinos rely on government assistance.

text: Liwat nga nagdaog ang Gilas Pilipinas batok kasumpong sini nga Guam sa score nga 95-71 sa first window sang FIBA World Cup Asian Qualifiers.
english: Gilas Pilipinas again won against its opponent Guam with a score of 95-71 in the first window of the FIBA ​​World Cup Asian Qualifiers.

text: Nagpakita gilayon sang kabaskog ang Gilas sa first quarter pa lang sang kompetisyon kun sa diin ginlutos ang world number 81 nga Guam sa ginpatigayon nga hampang sa Ateneo Blue Eagle Gym.
english: Gilas immediately showed strength in the first quarter of the competition where they defeated world number 81 Guam in the match held at the Ateneo Blue Eagle Gym.

text:
May yara na subong sang 2-0 nga abanse ang Gilas sa Group A.

Patas na ang Gilas kag Australia nga may 2-0 win-loss record kun sa diin magaatubangay sila sa Marso 1 nga patigayunon man diri sa Pilipinas.
english:
The Gilas now have a 2-0 lead in Group A.

The Gilas and Australia are tied with a 2-0 win-loss record when they face each other on March 1 in the Philippines.

text: Ginpahayag ni Punong Barangay Mary Jane Jecara sang Brgy.
english: Punong Barangay Mary Jane Jecara of Brgy.

text: Tagbak, Jaro nga natural nga flood-prone area ang ila barangay, gani kada magmunog ang ulan amo man ang pagsaka sang tubig.
english: Tagbak, Jaro that their barangay is a natural flood-prone area, so every time it rains, the water rises.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, gin-acknowledge man sang kapitan nga may bulig man ang ginpatukod nga revetment project ukon bike lane, bangud wala sang alagyan sa una sa amo nga parte.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, the barangay captain also acknowledged that the construction of the revetment project or bike lane also helped, because there was no road in the past in that area.

text: Apang base sa ila obserbasyon, nagnubo ang kapasidad sang creek, rason nga mas dasig na subong magbaha.
english: However, based on their observations, the capacity of the creek has decreased, which is why it is now flooding faster.

text: Ginkilala man sini nga bisan sang una pa, may pagbaha na sa Tagbak, pero subong nangin ”alarming” na ang kahimtangan.
english: He also acknowledged that even in the past, there were floods in Tagbak, but now the situation has become “alarming”.

text: Ginapanawagan niya sa DPWH nga matagaan sang talupangod ang posibilidad nga padakuon ang creek agud malimitahan ang pagbaha sa lugar
english: He urged the DPWH to give attention to the possibility of widening the creek to limit flooding in the area

text: Kun si Toyang nagaistar sa kweba bangud isa ini ka ermitanya, ikaw, ano ayhan ang magtulod sa imo agud mag-istar man sa kweba?
english: If Toyang lives in a cave because he is a hermit, what would drive you to live in a cave?

text: Pero samtang nagapanumdom ka, istoryahan ko na lang ikaw natuhoy sa isa ka lalaki nga 2 ka tuig na nga nagapuyo sa sulod sang kweba.
english: But while you are thinking, I will tell you about a man who has been living in a cave for 2 years.

text: Ini amo ang isa ka lalaki sa Turkey, ang pungsod nga gintay-og sang 7.8 magnitude nga linog sang 2023 kun sa diin madamo ang nagkalamatay.
english: This is a man in Turkey, the country that was rocked by a 7.8 magnitude earthquake in 2023 where many died.

text: Suno kay Ali Bozoğlan, amay sang tatlo ka kabataan halin sa southern province sang Hatay, nadula ang iya balay bangud sang linog.
english: Ali Bozoğlan, a father of three from the southern province of Hatay, said he lost his house in the earthquake.

text: Apisar nakaluwas sila sang iya pamilya, tuman nga nahadlok na ini sa linog gani nagdesisyon siya nga indi na mag-istar sa isa ka building nga ginhimo sang tawo.
english: Although they were able to save his family, he was so afraid of the earthquake that he decided not to live in a man-made building.

text: Sa baylo, nakapangita siya sang isa ka gamay nga kweba malapit man sa ila ginaistaran kag ini ang ginhimo niya nga puluy-an.
english: Instead, he found a small cave also near where they lived and made it his home.

text: Apisar wala niya nakumbinse ang iya pamilya nga mag-upod sa iya sa kweba, nalipay gihapon si Ali sa iya bag-o nga puluy-an bangud malinong diri kag matawhay.
english: Despite not being able to convince his family to join him in the cave, Ali is still happy with his new home because it is peaceful and serene.

text: Apisar madamo ang mga naghaboy sang malain nga mga komento batok sa iya, wala na lang ini ginasapak ni Ali bangud ini ang ginakabig niya nga pinakamatahum nga puluy-an.
english: Although many people threw bad comments against him, Ali just ignored it because he considered it the most beautiful home.

text: ANG tourism industry naghina gid sing labi tungod sa Covid 19 nga nagpakunol sang panghulag sang mga tawo sugod sadtong una nga binulan sang 2020.
english: THE tourism industry has slowed down significantly due to Covid 19, which has restricted people's movement since the first month of 2020.

text: Indi lang sa pagpadayon sang negosyo, pagpangita sang trabaho, kag bisan sa pagpatuman sang mga obligasyon kag serbisyo sang gobyerno.
english: Not just to carry on a business, find a job, and even to carry out government obligations and services.

text: In fact, naapektuhan gid sini ang ekonomiya sang bug-os nga kalibutan.
english: In fact, it has severely affected the global economy.

text: Kag indi manegar nga daku gid nga halit ang natuga sini sa turismo.
english: And there is no denying that it has caused a lot of damage to tourism.

text: Tungod sa kulba sa Covid 19, nagkunol ang mga byahe sa tunga sang mga pungsod kag dira mismo sa kada pungsod.
english: Due to the fear of Covid 19, flights between countries and within each country have decreased.

text: Paagi sa eroplano man, tren, kag iban pa labi na gid ang naga-cross border.
english: By plane, train, etc. especially those who cross borders.

text: Masakit batunon, pero madamo nga mga tourism establishment kag travel agencies ang nagpaloy-paloy ang negosyo.
english: It's hard to admit, but many tourism establishments and travel agencies have boosted their business.

text: Namilagpilag man ang nabilin sa minilyon nga mga empleyado nila sadto.
english: The rest of their millions of former employees were also dispersed.

text:
***

Sa pagkalma na sang pagpanghalit sang Covid 19 sa sige pang-bakuna kag padayon nga health measures, of course, kinahanglan mapabalik na sing husto ang kapagsik sang turismo.
english:
***

With the calm of the damage of Covid 19 with the ongoing vaccination and continuous health measures, of course, the vitality of tourism must be restored.

text: Apang ang bag-o bala nga tourism slogan sang pungsod sa idalom ni Presidente Marcos Jr.
english: But does the country's new tourism slogan under President Marcos Jr.

text: ang bagay nga sabat sa pagsanyog na sang aton tourism industry?
english: the right answer to the growth of our tourism industry?

text: Ining bag-o nga tourism slogan amo ang “Love the Philippines”.
english: This new tourism slogan is “Love the Philippines”.

text: Ginbulos ini sa “It’s more fun in the Philippines” sa panahon ni Presidente Aquino tubtub sa panahon ni Presidente Duterte, nga nagsalig gid sa mabungahon nga epekto sini sa aton turismo.
english: It was replaced by “It’s more fun in the Philippines” during the time of President Aquino until the time of President Duterte, who relied heavily on its fruitful impact on our tourism.

text: Upod kita sa pagpati sang duha ka presidente nga mas makagalanyat gihapon ang “It’s more fun…” sangsa “Love the Philippines”.
english: We share the belief of the two presidents that “It’s more fun…” is still more attractive than “Love the Philippines”.

text:
***

Sa pagbaligya sang turismo sa mga bisita, foreigner man ukon local folk, importante nga masabat ang ila “expectations” nga mag-enjoy sa lugar nga luyag nila kadtuan, ukon diin man nga makumbinse sila sang tourist agency.
english:
***

In selling tourism to visitors, whether foreign or local folk, it is important to meet their “expectations” to enjoy the place they want to visit, or wherever the tourist agency convinces them.

text: “Mag-enjoy ka!” siling gani sang sexy nga kasumpong sa poker ni James Bond sa pelikula nga Golden Eye pagkatapos lutuson siya ni Bond sa sugal nga Lucky 9 sa casino.
english: “Enjoy!” said James Bond's sexy poker opponent in the movie Golden Eye after Bond beat her at Lucky 9 in the casino.

text:
Sabat ni Bond: “Amo gid man ina ang akon motto sa kabuhi: Mag-enjoy!”

Of course, interesado ang sin-o man nga luyag mag-turista nga mahibal-an ang kinaiya nga kultura, sa kabug-usan, sang local folks nga makadtuan, ang pinasahe nga mga bagay sa palibut, kag mga kahiwatan kag adventure nga ginapasalig sang slogan nga “Love the Philippines”.
english:
Bond replies: “That’s really my motto in life: Have fun!”

Of course, it is interesting for anyone who wants to be a tourist to know the unique culture, in general, of the local folks to visit, the unique things in the environment, and the activities and adventure that the slogan “Love the Philippines” promises.

text: Apang ina kon mahimo gid nila ang tanan nga ini!
english: But that’s if they can actually do all of this!

text: Ang slogan nga “It’s more fun in the Philippines” wala nagapasalig nga ini tanan ma-enjoy sang mga turista.
english: The slogan “It’s more fun in the Philippines” does not guarantee that all of this will be enjoyed by tourists.

text: Kay imposible ini!
english: Because it’s impossible!

text: Ang ginapasalig lang sini ang luyag lang nila ma-enjoy sa partikular nga lugar nga kaya sang ila badyet.
english: All it assures is that they only want to enjoy the particular place that their budget can afford.

text:
***

First impression is lasting!
english:
***

First impression is lasting!

text: Importante sa isa ka nagaplano sa pag-tourist visit sa isa ka lugar ang una niya ma-expect halin sa sugid sang iban…kag sa tourism slogan mismo!
english: It is important for a person planning a tourist visit to a place to expect the first thing from what others say...and from the tourism slogan itself!

text: Halin dira makalaum na siya mag-enjoy sa iya pagbisita sa ina nga lugar sa bulig na sang travel agency kag sang tourist guide.
english: From there he can hope to enjoy his visit to that place with the help of the travel agency and the tourist guide.

text: Tungod sini dapat maathag sa tourism slogan mismo kon ano ang ma-expect niya sa iya pagbisita.
english: Therefore, the tourism slogan itself should be clear what he can expect from his visit.

text: Maathag ini sa mensahe mismo sa slogan nga: “It’s more fun…”.
english: This is evident in the message itself in the slogan: “It’s more fun…”.

text: Indi ini maathag sa “Love the Philippines”.
english: This is not evident in “Love the Philippines”.

text: Sa nasiling ta na sa ibabaw, indi tanan nga talan-awon ukon buluhaton sa kaladtuan nga lugar ang ma-enjoy sang turista nga ginatanyag sang “Love the Philippines”.
english: As mentioned above, not all sights or activities in the destination can be enjoyed by the tourist that “Love the Philippines” offers.

text: Isa pa, ngaa “piliton” ta gid ma-love ang Filipinas sang foreign tourists kay lain man ang ila pungsod nga dapat ma-love gid nila?
english: Also, why should we “force” foreign tourists to love the Philippines because they have a different country that they should love?

text: Labi na gid kon magsulod sa ila pensar ang madamo nga malaw-ay nga hitabo diri sa pungsod.
english: Especially when they think of the many immoral events in the country.

text: Matuod, madamo man nga bagay nga ma-love sang mga turista sa pila ka aspeto sang Filipinas, pero indi sa kabug-usan kay dapat natuon lang ini sa ila kaugalingon nga pungsod.
english: It is true that there are many things that tourists can love about some aspects of the Philippines, but not in general because they should be learned in their own country.

text: Samtang maathag ang mensahe sang “It’s more fun…” agud mag-enjoy lang ang mga turista sa ila lang maluyagan kag kaya sang ila badyet.
english: While the message of “It’s more fun…” is clear, tourists should enjoy what they like and can afford.

text: Basi gusto man lang nila mag-enjoy sing swimming sa isa ka matahum nga beachline diri kag magpaayaw-ayaw lagaw sa maputi kag malawig nga baybayon sini.
english: Maybe they just want to enjoy swimming on a beautiful beachline here and take a walk along its white, long shore.

text: Basi luyag lang nila mag-bakasyon sang pila ka adlaw ukon binulan pa gani sa isa ka malinong kag matahum nga beach resort.
english: Maybe they just want to spend a few days or even months at a quiet and beautiful beach resort.

text: Ukon mag-experyensya sang nature living (eco-tourism) sa isa ka ligwa nga isla.
english: Or experience nature living (eco-tourism) on a remote island.

text: Etcetera.
english: Etc.

text: Ang pasalig nga “more fun” lakip man dira ang pasalig sang security kag pag-amlig sa ila ikaayong lawas labi na gid kay nagaluntad pa ang Covid 19 sa bug-os nga kalibutan.
english: The promise of “more fun” also includes the promise of security and protection of their health especially since Covid 19 still exists around the world.

text: Gani, sa “It’s more fun in the Philppines” pa kami gihapon!/PN
english: So, we are still in “It’s more fun in the Philppines”!/PN

text: Ginpirmahan ni Presidente Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.
english: Signed by President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.

text: ang duha ka proklamasyon nga nagatukod sang bag-o nga economic zones sa Tanauan City, Batangas, kag Iloilo City.
english: the two proclamations establishing new economic zones in Tanauan City, Batangas, and Iloilo City.

text: Ini agud makaganyat sang investors kag makabulig pa-uswag sang ekonomiya sa rehiyon.
english: This is to attract investors and help boost the economy in the region.

text: Sa Proklamasyon Blg.
english: In Proclamation No.

text: 1127, apat ka parte sang duta sa Tanauan ang gindugang sa First Industrial Township–Special Economic Zone sa Batangas, nga may kabug-usan nga 55,859 square meters.
english: 1127, four parcels of land in Tanauan were added to the First Industrial Township–Special Economic Zone in Batangas, with a total of 55,859 square meters.

text: Samtang, sa Proklamasyon Blg.
english: Meanwhile, in Proclamation No.

text: 1128, gin-establisar ang Atria Gardens, isa ka bag-o nga IT park sa Donato Pison Avenue sa Barangay San Rafael, Mandurriao, Iloilo City, nga may may total land area nga 48,569 square meters.
english: 1128, established Atria Gardens, a new IT park on Donato Pison Avenue in Barangay San Rafael, Mandurriao, Iloilo City, with a total land area of ​​48,569 square meters.

text: Suno sa Malacañang, ini nga mga ecozones ginapaabot nga makaganyat sang investors, makahatag sang trabaho, kag makabulig sa padayon nga pag-uswag sang ekonomiya sa duha ka rehiyon.
english: According to Malacañang, these ecozones are expected to attract investors, create jobs, and contribute to the continued economic growth of the two regions.

text: Nagapangatubang subong sang sampaw-sampaw nga kaso administratibo ang 10 ka mga pulis sang Angono Police Station sa Rizal bangud sa ginaalegar nga pag-aresto sa isa ka working student kag ila pa ini nga ginkawatan.
english: Ten policemen of the Angono Police Station in Rizal are facing administrative charges for allegedly arresting a working student and robbing him.

text: Ang biktima amo si Nestor Macabenta Jr, isa ka third year crimino­logy student.
english: The victim was identified as Nestor Macabenta Jr, a third year criminology student.

text: Base sa iya panaysasyon, natabo ang insidente sang Nobyembre 10 sang gindakop siya sang mga pulis bangud sa akusasyon nga involved ini sa pagbaligya sang illegal drugs.
english: According to his testimony, the incident occurred on November 10 when he was arrested by the police on charges of involvement in the sale of illegal drugs.

text: Nagapatigayon sang anti-illegal drug operation ang mga pulis sang naglabay si Macabenta sakay sa motorsiklo kag ginparahan ini kag ginpreso sang duha ka bulan.
english: Police were conducting an anti-illegal drug operation when Macabenta passed by on a motorcycle and was stopped and jailed for two months.

text: Pahayag sang biktima, matapos gindakop, ginpangayuan siya sang P50,000 sang mga pulis kag ginkuha pa ang suksok nga singsing.
english: According to the victim, after being arrested, the police demanded P50,000 from him and took the ring he was wearing.

text: Napalab-ot ni Macabenta ang reklamo sa National Police Commission gani natumod gilayon ang mga involved nga pulis.
english: Macabenta forwarded the complaint to the National Police Commission and the involved policemen were immediately identified.

text: Ginkasubo sang pila ka residente sang Sooc, Arevalo, Iloilo City ang asud-asud nga pagluntad sang insidente sa Sunset Boulevard.
english: Some residents of Sooc, Arevalo, Iloilo City lamented the sudden occurrence of the incident on Sunset Boulevard.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Wilson Hernandez, iya ginpahayag nga sa pagsulod pa lang sang 2025, may mga nagakadisgrasya na nga motorista sa lugar.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Wilson Hernandez said that by 2025, there will be motorist accidents in the area.

text: Suno kay Hernandez, sang ginatukod pa lang ang Sunset Boulevard, naglaum na sila nga mabutangan sang mga early warning devices ukon mga signages.
english: According to Hernandez, when Sunset Boulevard was being built, they hoped to install early warning devices or signages.

text: Ginpahayag man sini ang masubo, mismo kabarangay nila ang nagtaliwan bangud sa kakulangan sang mga signages sa lugar.
english: He also said that sadly, their own barangay died due to the lack of signages in the area.

text: Ginlaragway man sang natungdan nga mas dako pa ang mga tarpaulin sang mga pulitiko kon ikumpara sa mga signages sa Sunset Boulevard.
english: He also described the tarpaulins of the politicians as larger than the signages on Sunset Boulevard.

text: Nagpalab-ot man ini sa city government sang iya hingyo nga butangan na sang mga road signage agud indi na maliwat ang insidente kag mapabilin nga safe ang mga motorista lakip na ang mga turista kag residente.
english: He also conveyed to the city government his request to install road signage to prevent the incident from happening again and to keep motorists including tourists and residents safe.

text: Una na nga nagpahayag ang Iloilo City Government nga magpahamtang sang temporary nga mga traffic signs sa Sunset Boulevard.
english: Earlier, the Iloilo City Government announced that it will install temporary traffic signs on Sunset Boulevard.

text: Sa pihak sini, nagpanugyan man ang Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office sa mga motorista nga maghalong sa pagmaneho kag magbahar agud malikawan ang mga aksidente sa dalanon.
english: Meanwhile, the Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office also advised motorists to be careful while driving and slow down to avoid road accidents.

text: Nagpaguwa si Mayor Raisa Treñas sang executive order nga naga-suspinde sang trabaho sa tanan nga opisina sang city government kag klase sa tanan nga lebel sa syudad sang Iloilo buwas, Hulyo 25.
english: Mayor Raisa Treñas issued an executive order suspending work in all city government offices and classes at all levels in Iloilo City tomorrow, July 25.

text: Ini nga direktiba ginpatuman kasunod sang rekomendasyon sang Iloilo City Emergency Operations Center (OpCen) kaangot sa epekto sang mabaskog nga ulan dala sang Habagat kag Typhoon Emong.
english: The directive was implemented following the recommendation of the Iloilo City Emergency Operations Center (OpCen) regarding the impact of heavy rains caused by Habagat and Typhoon Emong.

text:
“Magapadayon naman ang operasyon sang mga ahensya nga responsable sa basic, vital, kag essential services para sa publiko,” suno sa City Government sa social media post subong nga gab-i.

Pahayag sang alcalde, naga-susprer sa gihapon sang baha ang 37 ka mga barangay samtang 30 ka mga evacuation center ang bukas para sa operasyon kun sa diin involved man ang city employees.
english:
“Agencies responsible for basic, vital, and essential services for the public will continue to operate,” the City Government said in a social media post tonight.

The mayor said 37 barangays are still suffering from floods while 30 evacuation centers are open for operation involving city employees.

text: Dugang ni Treñas, gin-isyu sini ang direktiba bangud indi mahimo makompromiso ang safety kag ikaayo sang mga residente ilabi na sa mga areas kun sa diin malala gid nga pagbaha ang natabo tuga sang Habagat kag bagyo.
english: Treñas said he issued the directive because the safety and well-being of residents cannot be compromised especially in areas where severe flooding occurred due to the Habagat and typhoons.

text: “We cannot compromise the safety and wellbeing of our residents, particularly those severely affected by the flooding.
english: “We cannot compromise the safety and wellbeing of our residents, particularly those severely affected by the flooding.

text: This proactive measure is intended to provide temporary relief and ensure that government responders and volunteers can continue to focus on immediate recovery and assistance efforts,” dugang sini.
english: This proactive measure is intended to provide temporary relief and ensure that government responders and volunteers can continue to focus on immediate recovery and assistance efforts,” it added.

text: “Padayon lang kita sa pagbinuligay.
english: “Let’s just keep working together.

text: Maghalong kita pirmi kag magbantay sa mga anunsyo sang gobyerno.”#
english: Let's always be careful and watch out for government announcements.”#

text: Pilason ang isa ka babaye matapos ginsumbag sang lalaki nga wala makilal-an sa sulod sang isa ka jeep sa Iloilo City Proper subong nga gab-i, Hulyo 24.
english: A woman was injured after being stabbed by an unidentified man inside a jeep in Iloilo City Proper tonight, July 24.

text: Ang biktima amo si Alyas Nene, 43-anyos, residente sang Barotac Nuevo, Iloilo kag isa ka sidewalk vendor sa downtown area.
english: The victim was identified as Nene, 43, resident of Barotac Nuevo, Iloilo and a sidewalk vendor in the downtown area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo sa pakaisa ni Nene, iya ginpahayag nga pauli na ini kuntani sa Brgy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Nene's cousin said she was on her way home from Brgy.

text: San Isidro, Jaro matapos ang ila nga pagbaligya.
english: San Isidro, Jaro after their sale.

text: Samtang nagasakay sa jeep, hinali lang ini ginsumbag sang lalaki sa mata nga wala man sang rason.
english: While riding in the jeep, the man suddenly punched her in the eye for no reason.

text: Pagkatapos, nagpanaog kag nagdalagan ang lalaki sa direksyon sang E.Lopez St., Jaro.
english: Then, the man got off and ran in the direction of E. Lopez St., Jaro.

text: Gilayon naman nga nag-responde ang Iloilo City Emergency Response (ICER) team agud nga madapatan sang pagbulong ang biktima.
english: The Iloilo City Emergency Response (ICER) team immediately responded to provide treatment to the victim.

text: Nagapadayon man ang pagpangita sang kapulisan sa nasambit nga lalaki.
english: Police are still searching for the man.

text:
Nakasuksok ini sang orange nga t-shirt, naka-shorts, naka-tsinelas kag naka-backpack.#

(Article: Bombo Hanna Andasa)
english:
He was wearing an orange t-shirt, shorts, slippers and a backpack.

(Article: Bombo Hanna Andasa)

text: Nagpasalig ang Chinese embassy sa Manila nga handa ini magbulig sa Pilipinas pag-abot sa mga proyekto sang gobyerno sa imprastraktura.
english: The Chinese embassy in Manila has assured that it is ready to assist the Philippines when it comes to government infrastructure projects.

text: Sa statement nga ginpagwa sang embahada, ginpahayag nga may yara sang “comprehensive strength” ang China kag kilala sa ila nga kalidad kag kadasig.
english: In a statement issued by the embassy, ​​it said China has a “comprehensive strength” and is known for its quality and speed.

text: Ginpaguwa ang pahayag sang embahada pila ka adlaw matapos nga ginpahayag man ni Undersecretary Cesar Chavez sang Department of Transportation nga wala sang ginhimo ang Chinese government sa request sang Duterte administration para sa loan financing para sa tatlo ka major railway projects sa pungsod.
english: The embassy's statement came days after Undersecretary Cesar Chavez of the Department of Transportation also said that the Chinese government has not done anything about the Duterte administration's request for loan financing for three major railway projects in the country.

text: Sa pahayag ni Chavez, “nag-atras” ang China sa pagpondo sa Laguna-Bicol, Subic-Clark, kag Mindanao Railway projects.
english: In Chavez's statement, China has “stepped back” from funding the Laguna-Bicol, Subic-Clark, and Mindanao Railway projects.

text: Una naman nga nagmandu si President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: Earlier, President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: nga i-negosyar liwat ang amo nga kasugtanan sa China.
english: to renegotiate such an agreement with China.

text: Suno naman sa Chinese embassy sa Pilipinas, bukas ang China sa technical discussions sa government-to-government projects kag handa man nga mag-trabaho upod ang bag-o nga administrasyon.
english: Suno naman sa Chinese embassy sa Pilipinas, bukas ang China sa technical discussions sa government-to-government projects kag handa man nga mag-trabaho upod ang bag-o nga administrasyon.

text: Ginpahayag man sang China nga may 17 na ka proyekto nga natapos na kag may 20 pa nga “under implementation or in progress.”
english: China also said that 17 projects have been completed and 20 more are “under implementation or in progress.”

text: Ginbawian na sang kabuhi ang driver sang motorsiklo nga nabungguan sang kotse sa Sunset Boulevard nga sakop sang Sooc, Arevalo sang Pebrero 27, 2025.
english: The driver of a motorcycle that was hit by a car on Sunset Boulevard in Sooc, Arevalo on February 27, 2025 has died.

text: Ang driver sang motorsiklo amo si Jonazardo Abong, 26-anyos, isa ka criminology board passer, kag residente sang Sooc, Arevalo.
english: The driver of the motorcycle was identified as Jonazardo Abong, 26, a criminology board passer, and resident of Sooc, Arevalo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Senior Master Sergeant Toto Karl Petalco, Imbestigador sang Traffic Enforcement Unit (TEU), iya ginpahayag nga ginbawian kagina sang aga ang driver sang motorsiklo samtang nga ginabulong sa ospital bangud sa naagum sini nga head injury kag pilas sa nagkalain-lain nga parte sang lawas.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Senior Master Sergeant Toto Karl Petalco, investigator of the Traffic Enforcement Unit (TEU), said the driver of the motorcycle died yesterday morning while being treated at the hospital due to head injury and injuries in various parts of his body.

text: Sa subong, padayon ang negosasyon sa tunga sang duha ka pamilya nga involved sa amo nga aksidente kun sa diin, una na nga ginpahayag nga sabton sang driver sang salakyan ang medical expenses sang driver sang motorsiklo.
english: Currently, negotiations are ongoing between the two families involved in the accident where, earlier it was announced that the driver of the vehicle will bear the medical expenses of the driver of the motorcycle.

text: Nahibaluan nga naghalin sa Mandurriao ang kotse samtang halin naman sa Gloryville Subdivision ang motorsiklo sang natabo ang aksidente.
english: The car was coming from Mandurriao while the motorcycle was coming from Gloryville Subdivision when the accident occurred.

text: Santo sa pahayag sang mga testigo, nagtumpilak gid ang biktima kag ginyudyod pa sang kotse ang motorsiklo.
english: According to witnesses, the victim fell down and was dragged by the motorcycle.

text: Buka naman ang unahan nga parte sang kotse kalakip na ang windshield sini.
english: The front of the car was open including the windshield.

text: Nagtanyag ang White House sa rapper nga si Nikki Minaj sang phone call sa tunga sini kag isa sa mga doctor matapos ginpalapta sang rapper ang impormasyon nga nangin impotent ang abyan sang iya nga himata matapos nakabaton sang COVID-19 vaccine.
english: The White House offered rapper Nikki Minaj a phone call between her and one of the doctors after the rapper spread information that her relative's friend became impotent after receiving the COVID-19 vaccine.

text: Ginpahayag ni Nikki Minaj nga gin-imbitar ini sang White House matapos nga nangin viral ang iya nga tweet kag suno sa rapper, ginbaton niya ang imbitasyon.
english: Nikki Minaj said she was invited by the White House after her tweet went viral and according to the rapper, she accepted the invitation.

text: Apang gin-athag sang White House official nga ang gin-offer lamang kay Nikki Minaj amo ang isa ka educational phone call kaupod ang isa ka doctor nga amo ang magasabat sang palamangkutanon sang rapper tuhoy sa safety kag ka-epektibo sang bakuna.
english: But the White House official clarified that all Nikki Minaj was offered was an educational phone call with a doctor who would answer the rapper's questions about the safety and effectiveness of the vaccine.

text: Nahibaluan nga wala nakatambong sa 2021 Met Gala ang Grammy-nominated rapper bangud kinahanglan nga vaccinated ang mga attendees.
english: The Grammy-nominated rapper did not attend the 2021 Met Gala because attendees were required to be vaccinated.

text: Imbukada pa lang sang Enero 2023, gintapos na ni Melvin Jerusalem ang madugay na nga paghulat sang mga Pinoy nga makaangkon liwat sang world champion sa boxing matapos gin-agaw sini ang WBO world minimumweight title sang ginlutos sini paagi sa second-round technical knockout si Masataka Taniguchi sa EDION Arena in Osaka, Japan.
english: Earlier in January 2023, Melvin Jerusalem ended the long wait for Filipinos to regain the world boxing champion after he captured the WBO world minimumweight title when he defeated Masataka Taniguchi by second-round technical knockout at the EDION Arena in Osaka, Japan.

text: Duha ka minutos ang nabilin sa second round sang gintumba sang 28-anyos nga General Santos City native ang hometown favorite.
english: Two minutes remained in the second round when the 28-year-old General Santos City native knocked out the hometown favorite.

text: Gintinguhaan pa sang defending champion nga ma-beat ang mandatory eight-count, apang wala na natigayon kag gin-untat na sang referee nga si Robert Ramirez Jr.
english: The defending champion even tried to beat the mandatory eight-count, but was unsuccessful and referee Robert Ramirez Jr. stopped the fight.

text: ang sambuwa.
english: the fight.

text: Yara na sa 1:04 sang second frame ang official time sa pag-untat sa hampang.
english: The official time to stop the game was at 1:04 of the second frame.

text: Si Jerusalem na ang bag-o nga WBO 100-pound champion, kag nag-improve na ang professional record sa 20-2 nga may 12 ka knockouts.
english: Jerusalem is now the new WBO 100-pound champion, and has improved the professional record to 20-2 with 12 knockouts.

text: Antes ang pagdaog ni Jerusalem, nawad-an sang world boxing champion ang Pilipinas kasunod sang asud-asud nga kalutusan nanday Mark Magsayo, Nonito Donaire Jr.
english: Before Jerusalem's victory, the Philippines lost its world boxing champion following the consecutive defeats of Mark Magsayo, Nonito Donaire Jr.

text: kag Rene Mark Cuarto sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: and Rene Mark Cuarto last year.

text: Sang nagligad man nga tuig sang ginkakasan sang WBO world bantamweight belt si John Riel Casimero.##
english: Last year, John Riel Casimero was stripped of his WBO world bantamweight belt.##

text: Dakop sa drug buy bust operation ang duha ka mga lalaki nga masami ginareklamo nga masabad sa ila lugar sa Zone 1-A, Brgy.
english: Two men were arrested in a drug buy bust operation who were often complained of being robbed in their area in Zone 1-A, Brgy.

text: San Juan, Molo, Iloilo City.
english: San Juan, Molo, Iloilo City.

text: Ang mga subject amo sanday Alyas Pepoy, 25, kag Alyas Josh, 18, lunsay mga residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The subjects were identified as Pepoy, 25, and Josh, 18, both residents of the said area.

text: Na-recover sa operasyon ang 20 gramos sang suspected shabu kag may standard drug price nga P136,000.
english: Recovered from the operation were 20 grams of suspected shabu with a standard drug price of P136,000.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Lloyd Pagulayan, deputy chief sang Iloilo City Police Station 4, iya ginpahayag nga madugay na nga ginareklamo sang mga residente sang San Juan ang duha bangud nagahimo sang gamo sa ila lugar.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Lloyd Pagulayan, deputy chief of Iloilo City Police Station 4, said the residents of San Juan have been complaining about the two for a long time because they are causing trouble in their area.

text: Suno kay Pagulayan, dira lang sa barangay ang ila nga operation area bangud mismo ang mga parokyano nila ang nagakadto kag nagabakal sa ila.
english: According to Pagulayan, their operation area is only in the barangay because their parishioners themselves come and buy from them.

text: Yara sila subong sa custodial facility sang ICPS 4 kag magapangatubang sa panumbungon nga palglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: They are currently in the custodial facility of ICPS 4 and will face charges of violation of Republic Act 9165 or Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: Nagpili sang bag-o nga set sang mga officers ang Vice Mayors’ League of the Philippines- Iloilo Chapter para sa CY 2025-2028 kun sa diin nagapabilin sa posisyon si Lambunao Vice Mayor Arvin Losaria bilang chapter president.
english: The Vice Mayors' League of the Philippines-Iloilo Chapter has elected a new set of officers for CY 2025-2028 with Lambunao Vice Mayor Arvin Losaria remaining in office as chapter president.

english: of his support to VM Losaria while endorsing Badiangan Mayor Suzette Mamon as LMP President.

text: Nag-serbe nga COMELEC Chair si Engr.
english: Engr. served as COMELEC Chair.

text: Carmelo F. Orbista, CESO V, Provincial Director sang DILG Iloilo upod si Vice Mayor Julius Andrew L. Castaños sang Calinog kag Vice Mayor Lyka Joy A. Debuque sang Anilao bilang COMELEC members.
english: Carmelo F. Orbista, CESO V, Provincial Director of DILG Iloilo with Vice Mayor Julius Andrew L. Castaños of Calinog and Vice Mayor Lyka Joy A. Debuque of Anilao as COMELEC members.

text: Sa kabug-usan, nag-partisipar ang 34 ka mga vice mayors sa ginpatigayon nga eleksyon.
english: A total of 34 vice mayors participated in the election.

text: Na pa-WOW ang mga netizens sang makita ang picture sang lola sang aktor nga si Dominic Roque nga si Zeny Tamayo bangud pareho sila sang nawong sang nobya sang aktor nga si Bea Alonzo.
english: Netizens were WOW when they saw the picture of actor Dominic Roque's grandmother Zeny Tamayo because they have the same face as the actor's girlfriend Bea Alonzo.

text: Si Zeny Tamayo ang iloy sang anay aktres man nga si Beth Tamayo.
english: Zeny Tamayo is the mother of former actress Beth Tamayo.

text: Gin-upload sa instagram sang mga fans nanday Bea kag Dominic ang picture sang aktres kaupod ang picture man ni Nanay Zeny sang siya ang yara pa sa lamharon nga edad.
english: Fans of Bea and Dominic uploaded a picture of the actress on Instagram along with a picture of Nanay Zeny when she was young.

text: Nakakitaay na sanday Bea kag Nanay Zeny.
english: Bea and Nanay Zeny have met.

text: Nakaangkon sila sang tyansa nga magkilalahay sang Hunyo 2021 , antes ang pagpadulong nanday Bea kag Dominic sa Estados Unidos para magbakasyon.
english: They had a chance to meet in June 2021, before Bea and Dominic went to the United States for a vacation.

text: Una na nga ginbuyagyag ni Bea nga nakilala na niya ang mga himata ni Dominic magluwas lang sa tiya sang aktor nga si Beth Tamayo.
english: Bea previously revealed that she has met Dominic’s relatives except for the actor’s aunt Beth Tamayo.

text: ILOILO CITY- Mahimo nga magtaas pa gid sa masunod nga mga inadlaw ang presyo sang itlog matapos ang isa ka semana nga may ginpatuman man nga price increase sa amo nga poultry product.
english: ILOILO CITY – The price of eggs may rise in the coming days after a week of price increases in the poultry product.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ian Adonia, Sales Manager sang isa ka local producer kag distributor itlog sa Panay, iya ginpahayag nga sang nagligad pa nga semana sila nagpasaka sang presyo sang itlog bangud sa pagtaas man sa presyo sang components sang feeds sa manok.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Ian Adonia, Sales Manager of a local egg producer and distributor in Panay, said that last week they increased the price of eggs due to the increase in the price of components of chicken feeds.

text: Suno kay Adonia, 20 centavos tubtob 40 centavos kada bilog ang ila ginpatuman nga price increase.
english: According to Adonia, they implemented a price increase of 20 centavos to 40 centavos per piece.

text: Pahayag niya, nakadepende na sa mga retailers sang itlog kun pila ang ila idugang sa presyo sang itlog.
english: He said it is up to the egg retailers how much they will add to the price of eggs.

text: Dugang niya, kun magtaas pa gid ang presyo sang components sang feeds, posible nga magpamahal sila liwat sa presyuhanay.
english: He added that if the price of components of feeds increases further, they may become more expensive again.

text: Una na nga nagpaandam ang grupo nga Agricultural Sector Alliance of the Philippines Inc.
english: Earlier, the group Agricultural Sector Alliance of the Philippines Inc.

text: (AGAP) sa posibilidad nga maghampak ang presyo sang itlog sa P10 tubtob P15 bangud sa pagtimbuok sang production cost kag kaso sang bird flu sa mga manok.
english: (AGAP) on the possibility of egg prices hitting P10 to P15 due to rising production costs and cases of bird flu in chickens.

text: Sa paglibot naman sang Bombo News Team sa mga merkado publiko sa syudad, nagsaka sang 50 tubtob 75 sentimos ang presyo sang itlog kada isa.
english: When the Bombo News Team toured the public markets in the city, the price of eggs rose by 50 to 75 cents each.

text: 𝗠𝗨𝗔𝗡, 𝗦𝗼𝘂𝘁𝗵 𝗞𝗼𝗿𝗲𝗮 – Nag-crash ang South Korean passenger airplane sa Muan International Airport sa South Jeolla Province sa South Korea.
english: A South Korean passenger plane crashed at Muan International Airport in South Jeolla Province in South Korea.

text: Suno sa South Korean news agency nga Yonhap, sakay sang Jeju Air Flight 2216 ang 175 ka mga pasahero kag anom ka mga crew.
english: According to South Korean news agency Yonhap, Jeju Air Flight 2216 was carrying 175 passengers and six crew members.

text: Naghalin ang eroplano sa Bangkok, Thailand antes nag-crash sa Muan International Airport.
english: The plane took off from Bangkok, Thailand before crashing into Muan International Airport.

text: Ini ang may kalayuon nga 288 kilometers sa Capital sang South Korea nga Seoul.
english: It is located 288 kilometers from the Capital of South Korea Seoul.

text: Naghugpa naman ang eroplano sa runway apisar wala sang landing gear tubtob nagbunggo sa fence sang paluparan.
english: The plane landed on the runway despite not having landing gear until it hit the airport fence.

text: Nagapadayon naman ang imbestigasyon sa insidente.
english: The investigation into the incident is ongoing.

text: Apang may nagwa man nga impormasyon nga ‘bird strike’ ang rason sa pagkaguba sang landing gear sang eroplano.
english: However, there was also information that a bird strike was the cause of the damage to the plane's landing gear.

text: Nagpadulong naman si acting South Korean President Choi Sang-mok sa Central Disaster Management Headquarters sa diin ginmando sini ang madasig nga rescue operations.
english: Acting South Korean President Choi Sang-mok went to the Central Disaster Management Headquarters where he ordered immediate rescue operations.

text: Naka-abot na kag naka-ensayo sa Melbourne ang 17-anyos nga Filipino tennis star nga si Alex Eala samtang nagahanda para sa iya una nga Women’s Grand Slam stint sa Australian Open.
english: 17-year-old Filipino tennis star Alex Eala has arrived and trained in Melbourne as she prepares for her first Women’s Grand Slam stint at the Australian Open.

text: Ika-numero 215 subong si Eala sa Women’s Tennis Association kag tinguhaan sini nga malab-ot ang main draw sang iya una nga professional Grand Slam stint.
english: Eala is currently ranked 215th in the Women’s Tennis Association and will be looking to reach the main draw of her first professional Grand Slam stint.

text: Si Eala nga isa ka Rafael Nadal Academy scholar amo ang una nga Singles Grand Slam champion sang Pilipinas matapos ini nagpangibabaw sa 2022 US Open Girls’ tournament.
english: Eala who is a Rafael Nadal Academy scholar is the Philippines’ first Singles Grand Slam champion after she dominated the 2022 US Open Girls’ tournament.

text: Nakadaog man siya sang duha ka junior Grand Slam doubles championships sa Australian Open tatlo ka tuig na ang nakaligad.
english: He also won two junior Grand Slam doubles championships at the Australian Open three years ago.

text: Tatlo ka adlaw lang ang nakaligad sang nag-compete siya sa W60 Canberra apang napierde siya sa second round sang qualifiers.
english: Just three days ago he competed in W60 Canberra but lost in the second round of qualifiers.

text: Duha na ang kumpirmado nga patay kasunod sang magnitude 7.4 nga linog sa Davao Oriental kaina sang aga.
english: Two people have been confirmed dead following the magnitude 7.4 earthquake that struck Davao Oriental this morning.

text: Ginkumpirma ini ni Davao Oriental Governor Nelson Dayanghirang kag ni Davao Rep.
english: This was confirmed by Davao Oriental Governor Nelson Dayanghirang and Davao Rep.

text: Cheeno Almario amo man sang Davao City Police Office (DCPO).
english: Cheeno Almario of the Davao City Police Office (DCPO).

text: Base sa pulis, napatay ang 80-anyos nga lalaki matapos narumpagan sang sementado nga pader sa Purok 3, Soliman, Barangay Tomas Monteverde, Davao City.
english: According to police, an 80-year-old man was killed after a concrete wall collapsed in Purok 3, Soliman, Barangay Tomas Monteverde, Davao City.

text: Sa Mati City, isa man ka senior citizen ang ginbawian sang kabuhi matapos natumbahan sang poste sang kuryente.
english: In Mati City, a senior citizen also died after being hit by an electricity pole.

text: Apektado man sang linog ang suplay sang kuryente sa probinsya.
english: The quake also affected the power supply in the province.

text: Gin-evacuate man ang mga pasyente sa pito ka mga ospital agud ipaidalom sa inspection ang integrity sang mga building.
english: Patients were also evacuated from seven hospitals to inspect the integrity of the buildings.

text: Natabo ang linog eksakto 9:43 kaina sang aga nga ang sentro yara sa Manay, Davao Oriental.
english: The quake occurred at exactly 9:43 am with the epicenter in Manay, Davao Oriental.

text: Una gin-report sang Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) nga magnitude 7.6 ang kabaskugon sini, gin-downgrade sa 7.5, kag sunod nga gin-revise liwat sa 7.4 magnitude.
english: It was initially reported by the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) as magnitude 7.6, downgraded to 7.5, and subsequently revised to 7.4 magnitude.

text: Gin-isyu naman ang tsunami warning 11:43 kaina sang aga para sa Davao Oriental, Dinagat Islands, Surigao del Norte, Surigao del Sur, Eastern Samar, Southern Leyte, kag Leyte.
english: A tsunami warning was issued at 11:43 am for Davao Oriental, Dinagat Islands, Surigao del Norte, Surigao del Sur, Eastern Samar, Southern Leyte, and Leyte.

text: Ginbawi man ini sang ahensya 1:43 subong nga hapon.
english: The agency also withdrew it at 1:43 this afternoon.

text: As of 4:00 p.m., 299 na ka mga aftershocks ang napagkit sang Phivolcs.
english: As of 4:00 p.m., 299 aftershocks have been detected by the Phivolcs.

text: Nagtuga sang pagpugok sa trapiko ang pagkarambola sang walo ka mga salakyan sa Muelle Loney, City Proper.
english: Eight vehicles collided at Muelle Loney, City Proper.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Corporal Jun Oliver Diaz, imbestigador sang Iloilo City Police Office Traffic Enforcement Unit, iya ginpahayag nga lakip sa mga nagbunggo-anay amo ang apat ka mga taxi, isa ka motorsiklo, duha ka pribado nga salakyan, kag isa ka 10-wheeler truck.
english: Police Corporal Jun Oliver Diaz, investigator of the Iloilo City Police Office Traffic Enforcement Unit, said four taxis, a motorcycle, two private vehicles, and a 10-wheeler truck were among those involved in the collision.

text: Suno kay Diaz, gulpyada nga nagpondo ang truck kag nag-atras rason nga nalab-ot ang mga kaingod sini nga motorista.
english: According to Diaz, the truck suddenly stopped and reversed, causing his neighbors to reach the motorist.

text: Gintuad man sini nga santo sa panaysayon sang driver sang truck, napatay ang makina kag ginhingagaw pa sini nga bangilan apang, nag-atras.
english: He also confessed that according to the statement of the driver of the truck, the engine died and he tried to grab the bangilan but, retreated.

text: Halin ang walo ka mga salakyan sa Freedom grandstand kag padulong kontani sa intersection sang Drilon Bridge.
english: The eight vehicles were heading from the Freedom grandstand to the intersection of the Drilon Bridge.

text: Gina-track down naman sang talatapan ang closed circuit television agud nga matumod ang rason sang pagkarambola sang mga salakyan.
english: The office is tracking down closed circuit television to determine the cause of the collision.

text: Nagsabat na ang aktor nga si Paolo Contis may kaangtanan sa ila pagbulagay sang aktres nga si LJ Reyes matapos ang anom ka tuig nga relasyon.
english: Actor Paolo Contis has responded to his breakup with actress LJ Reyes after six years of relationship.

text: Gin-ako mismo ni Paolo nga may yara sang third party nga involved.
english: Paolo himself admitted that there was a third party involved.

text: Ginsabat sang aktor ang mga isyu kaangay sang paggamit sini sang iligal nga droga kag domestic violence nga iya man nga ginpanginwala; isyu sa third party nga iya naman gin-ako kag nagpangayo sang kapatawaran.
english: The actor addressed issues such as his use of illegal drugs and domestic violence which he also denied; third party issue which he acknowledged and apologized for.

text: Indi man rason suno sa iya ang co-star nga si Yen Santos sa pagbulagay nila ni LJ apang gin-ako sini nga updanay sila sa Baguio bilang mag-abyanay lamang.
english: He said co-star Yen Santos was not the reason for the breakup with LJ but he admitted that they were together in Baguio as friends.

text: Pahayag pa ni Paolo, ginakahuya niya ang iya ginhimo nga pagpanglu-ib.
english: Paolo said he was ashamed of his betrayal.

text: Nagpangayo man sang sorry si Paolo sa iya anak kay LJ nga si Summer kag mangin kay Aki nga ginpalangga man niya.
english: Paolo also apologized to his daughter LJ Summer and also to Aki whom he loved.

text: Si Aki ang una nga anak ni LJ sa aktor nga si Paolo Avelino.
english: Aki is LJ’s first child with actor Paolo Avelino.

text: Ginlibot sang Facility Conservation Office sang syudad ang pila ka mga pumping station agud siguruhon nga naga-operate ini sang insakto sa tunga sang pagbaha nga naeksperyensyahan sa syudad.
english: The city's Facility Conservation Office toured several pumping stations to ensure they are operating properly amid the flooding experienced in the city.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joel Gerasmia, Chief of Staff sang Facility Conservation Office, ginpahayag sini nga isa lang sa anom ka pumping station sa syudad ang temporaryo nga non-functional, amo ang ara sa Calajunan nga ginbarado sang basura kag may mga lay-on.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joel Gerasmia, Chief of Staff of the Facility Conservation Office, said that only one of the six pumping stations in the city is temporarily non-functional, the one in Calajunan which is blocked by garbage and has debris.

text: Suno kay Gerasmia, gilayon nila nga ginlibot ang mga pump stations sa Jalandoni, Lapuz, Maria Clara, City Proper kag General Luna sang nagsugod ang pagbaha, agud masiguro nga naga-operate sang insakto.
english: Gerasmia said they immediately toured the pump stations in Jalandoni, Lapuz, Maria Clara, City Proper and General Luna when the flooding started, to ensure that they were operating properly.

text: Ang Facility Conservation Office, nga gintukod ni Mayor Raisa Treñas paagi sa Executive Order No.
english: The Facility Conservation Office, established by Mayor Raisa Treñas through Executive Order No.

text: 020, amo ang may mandato nga magmintinar sang mga pasilidad sang gobyerno lakip na ang drainage system kag mga electrical equipment.
english: 020, is mandated to maintain government facilities including the drainage system and electrical equipment.

text: Ginklaro sang opisina nga padayon ang ila pagbantay kag koordinasyon agud mapadasig ang pagresolba sa mga problema sa pasilidad, ilabi na sa tunga sang kalamidad.
english: The office clarified that they continue to monitor and coordinate to expedite the resolution of problems in the facility, especially in the midst of the disaster.

text: Nagbuya ang football superstar nga si Cristiano Ronaldo nga luyag sini nga mangguba sang rekord sa iya nga pag-abot sa bag-o nga club nga Al Nassr sa Saudi Arabia.
english: Football superstar Cristiano Ronaldo has joked that he wants to break the record with his arrival at new club Al Nassr in Saudi Arabia.

text: Ginpahayag man sang 37-anyos nga Portuguese forward nga isa siya ka sahi sang unique player kag apisar sang iya nga edad, indi pa tapos ang iya karera sa football.
english: The 37-year-old Portuguese forward also said that he is a kind of unique player and despite his age, his football career is not over yet.

text: Matandaan nga nagdangat sa $211m ukon P11.8 billion ang ginpirmahan nga kontrata ni Ronaldo sa Saudi matapos ang indi paghangpanay sa una nga club nga Manchester United.
english: Ronaldo signed a $211m or P11.8 billion contract with Saudi Arabia after a disagreement with his first club, Manchester United.

text: “I’m a unique player.
english: “I’m a unique player.

text: It’s good to come here, I broke all the records there (in Europe) and I want to break a few records here,” suno sa football superstar.
english: It’s good to come here, I broke all the records there (in Europe) and I want to break a few records here,” said the football superstar.

text: Suno pa kay Ronaldo, ginpang-turn down niya ang mga tanyag halin sa Brazil, Australia, US, kag mangin sa Portugal kag ginpasulabi ang Saudi kun sa diin magahampang siya sa bag-o nga club tubtub sa 2025.
english: Ronaldo said he turned down offers from Brazil, Australia, the US, and even Portugal and preferred Saudi where he will play for the new club until 2025.

text: Ulihi nga nakit-an si Ronaldo sa paghampang para sa Portugal sa World Cup sa Qatar.
english: Ronaldo was last seen playing for Portugal at the World Cup in Qatar.

text: Sa ila opening game batok sa Ghana, naghimo siya sang maragtas bilang labing-una nga footballer nga naka-skor sa lima ka edition sang World Cup.
english: In their opening game against Ghana, he made history as the first footballer to score in five editions of the World Cup.

text: Nagpagwa sang abiso ang Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) sa publiko matapos magbalik direksyon ang tropical depression nga si “Emong” padulong sa Cagayan, kun sa diin ginapaabot nga ini magasugata kay tropical storm “Dante” nga pakadto sa Japan.
english: The Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) issued an advisory to the public after tropical depression “Emong” returned its direction towards Cagayan, where it is expected to meet tropical storm “Dante” which is heading towards Japan.

text: Suno kay DILG Secretary Jonvic Remulla, ginpaguwa ang listahan sang mga lugar nga wala klase sa tanan nga lebel sang edukasyon buwas, Hulyo 25, 2025 (Biyernes), lakip na ang mga estudyante sa idalum sang TESDA.
english: According to DILG Secretary Jonvic Remulla, the list of areas without classes at all levels of education was released tomorrow, July 25, 2025 (Friday), including students under TESDA.

text: Suspendido man ang trabaho sa mga ahensya sang gobyerno sa mga apektado nga lugar, maluwas sa mga government frontline offices.
english: Work in government agencies in the affected areas is also suspended, except for government frontline offices.

text: Ang iban nga mga ahensya may ginapatuman nga hybrid work arrangements, suno sa desisyon sang tagsa ka opisina.
english: Some agencies have hybrid work arrangements in place, at the discretion of each office.

english: Note: The province and city of Iloilo, and other neighboring areas, are not included in the list of areas with cancellation of classes or work.

text: Nagsaka na sa 299 ang na-rekord nga mga aftershock kasunod sang magnitude 7.4 nga linog sa Davao Oriental.
english: The number of aftershocks recorded following the magnitude 7.4 earthquake in Davao Oriental has risen to 299.

text: Base ini sa 4 p.m. data nga gin-release sang Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) subong nga adlaw, Oktubre 10.
english: This is based on 4 p.m. data released by the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) today, October 10.

text: Suno sa ahensya, na-rekord ang aftershocks sa masobra 40 ka mga barangay kag nagabaskog halin sa 1.3 tubtub sa 5.8 magnitude.
english: According to the agency, aftershocks were recorded in more than 40 barangays and ranged in magnitude from 1.3 to 5.8.

text: Suno kay Phivolcs Director Teresito Bacolcol, mahimo maglab-ot sa magnitude 6.4 ang pinakamabaskog nga aftershock.
english: According to Phivolcs Director Teresito Bacolcol, the strongest aftershock could reach magnitude 6.4.

text: Ginalantaw nga magalawig man sang pila ka semana ang pagtay-og nga mabatyagan sang mga taga-Davao.
english: The quake is expected to be felt by Davao residents for several weeks.

text: Gin-anunsyo man sang Phivolcs nga ang rason sang linog amo ang Philippine Trench nga isa sa anum ka mga trench diri sa pungsod.
english: The Phivolcs also announced that the cause of the quake was the Philippine Trench, one of six trenches in the country.

text: Una gin-report sang Phivolcs nga magnitude 7.6 ang kabaskugon sini, gin-downgrade sa 7.5, kag sunod nga gin-revise liwat sa 7.4 magnitude.
english: The Phivolcs initially reported the quake at magnitude 7.6, downgraded to 7.5, and subsequently revised to 7.4 magnitude.

text: Sa Iloilo City, Intensity III ang nabatyagan.
english: In Iloilo City, Intensity III was felt.

text: Gin-isyu naman ang tsunami warning 11:43 kaina sang aga para sa Davao Oriental, Dinagat Islands, Surigao del Norte, Surigao del Sur, Eastern Samar, Southern Leyte, kag Leyte.
english: A tsunami warning was issued at 11:43 am for Davao Oriental, Dinagat Islands, Surigao del Norte, Surigao del Sur, Eastern Samar, Southern Leyte, and Leyte.

text: Ginbawi man sang ahensya ang warning 1:43 subong nga hapon.#
english: The agency also lifted the warning at 1:43 this afternoon.

text: Gin-impeach man sang South Korean lawmakers ang acting president sang pungsod nga si Han Duck-soo nga duha ka semana pa lang nga nagapungko sa pwesto.
english: South Korean lawmakers also impeached the country's acting president, Han Duck-soo, who has been in office for only two weeks.

text: Matandaan nga nagbulos si Han sa posisyon sang gin-impeach sang parliament si President Yoon Suk Yeol bangud sa iya gulpyada nga pagpatuman sang martial law sang Disyembre 3 nga ginkakibot mangin sang ila mga kaalyado nga pungsod.
english: Han took office when parliament impeached President Yoon Suk Yeol for his sudden imposition of martial law on December 3, which shocked even their allies.

text: Si Han naman nga amo man ang prime minister ang ginkakasan man sang mga mamalidha sang presidential duties paagi sa 192 votes.
english: Han, who is also the prime minister, was also removed from presidential duties by lawmakers by 192 votes.

text: Gin-file sang opposition ang impeachment motion batok kay Han sang Huwebes bangud ginbalabagan sini ang appointment sang tatlo ka judges nga ginpili sang parliament para nga magpanguna sa kaso batok kay President Yoon.
english: The opposition filed the impeachment motion against Han on Thursday for blocking the appointment of three judges appointed by parliament to preside over the case against President Yoon.

text: Magluwas nga ini ang ikaduha nga impeachment sang South Korean head of state sa sulod lamang sang duha ka semana, ini man ang una nga impeachment sang pungsod sa ila nga acting president.
english: Besides being the second impeachment of a South Korean head of state in just two weeks, it is also the country's first impeachment of its acting president.

text: Nagbulos naman bilang acting president si Finance Minister Choi Sang-mok nga nagpasalig nga tapuson sini ang krisis sa pulitika sa amo nga Asian country.
english: Finance Minister Choi Sang-mok took over as acting president and promised to end the political crisis in the Asian country.

text: Ginabantayan man ang mangin pinal nga desisyon sang Constitutional Court nga amo ang opisyal nga makahambal kun sundon ang desisyon sang parliament sa impeachment nanday Yoon kag Han.
