english: The final decision of the Constitutional Court, which will officially decide whether to follow the parliament's decision on the impeachment of Yoon and Han, is also awaited.

text: Nagalaum ang aktres nga si Julia Barretto nga ang pagsulod niya bilang volunteer sang Auxiliary K9 Squadron sang Philippine Coast Guard ang magaserbe nga inspirasyon sa kadam-an.
english: Actress Julia Barretto hopes that her entry as a volunteer of the Auxiliary K9 Squadron of the Philippine Coast Guard will serve as an inspiration to many.

text: Ang nobyo sang aktres nga si Gerald Anderson amo ang Auxiliary Lieutenant Commander sang Auxiliary K9 Squadron kag dako ang kahilabtanan sang aktor rason nga nangin myembro man si Julia sang organisasyon.
english: The actress' boyfriend, Gerald Anderson, is the Auxiliary Lieutenant Commander of the Auxiliary K9 Squadron and the actor was so involved that Julia became a member of the organization.

text: Suno kay Julia, nakaupod siya sa iban nga mga charity works, sa mga proyekto kag donation drives rason nga ginpamangkot siya sang Philippine Coast Guard kun interesado bala ini nga mangin volunteer.
english: According to Julia, she has been involved in other charity works, projects and donation drives so the Philippine Coast Guard asked her if she was interested in volunteering.

text: Pahayag ni Julia, nakit-an niya ang epekto sa pagbulig niya sa iban nga tawo pinaagi sa mga proyekto nga iya gina-updan.
english: Julia said she has seen the impact of helping others through the projects she is involved in.

text: Ginkumpirma ni Davao Oriental Governor Nelson Dayanghirang nga duwa na ang napatay sa magnitude 7.4 nga linog kaina sang aga.
english: Davao Oriental Governor Nelson Dayanghirang confirmed that two people have been killed in the magnitude 7.4 earthquake this morning.

text: Suno kay Dayanghirang, apektado man sang linog ang suplay sang kuryente.
english: According to Dayanghirang, the electricity supply was also affected by the quake.

text: Gin-evacuate man ang mga pasyente sa pito ka mga ospital agud ipaidalom sa inspection ang integrity sang mga building.
english: Patients were also evacuated from seven hospitals to inspect the integrity of the buildings.

text: Nalutos ang Philippine Azkals sa ulihi sini nga hampang sa Asean Football Federation Cup.
english: The Philippine Azkals lost their last match in the Asean Football Federation Cup.

text: Nagtakop ang hampang pabor sa Indonesia, 2-1, matapos ang skor nanday Dendy Sulistyawan kag Marselino Ferdinan sa ika-20 kag ika-42 nga minuto sang match sa group stage.
english: The match ended in Indonesia's favor, 2-1, after Dendy Sulistyawan and Marcelino Ferdinan scored in the 20th and 42nd minutes of the group stage match.

text: Nabuhian man kuntani sang paglaum ang Pilipinas sang naka-goal si Sebastian Rasmussen sa ika-83 nga minuto apang wala na ini nadugangan rason nga nagpangibabaw ang Indonesians.
english: Sebastian Rasmussen scored in the 83rd minute but the Indonesians took the lead.

text: Ini ang katapusan nga hampang sang team captain nga si Stephan Schrock para sa Azkals, bangud antes pa man ang hampang, nag-anunsyo na ini nga maga-retiro siya sa football.
english: This will be team captain Stephan Schrock’s last game for the Azkals, as even before the game, he announced his retirement from football.

text: Sa kabug-usan nga tournament, nagpang-apat ang Pilipinas sa Group A mapos isa ka bes lang nga nagdaog (batok sa Brunei) kag tatlo ka beses nga nalutos (batok sa Thailand, Cambodia, kag Indonesia).
english: In the overall tournament, the Philippines finished fourth in Group A after winning only once (against Brunei) and losing three times (against Thailand, Cambodia, and Indonesia).

text: Wala naman napunggan sang football fans sa Rizal Memorial Stadium nga ipabutyag ang ila nga disappointment sa resulta sang hampang.
english: Football fans at the Rizal Memorial Stadium could not help but express their disappointment with the result of the match.

text: Sa second half pa lang sang hampang, may mga nagbayaw na sang sign nga nagapanawagan sa Philippine Football Federation nga i-improve man ang on-field play.
english: In the second half of the game, some people raised signs calling on the Philippine Football Federation to improve the on-field play.

text:
Nakabutang sa sign ang,”Put some F***** Fight.”

Thailand kag Indonesia ang maga-abanse sa knockout semis sang tournament matapos pareho nga naka-record sang 10 points (sa top spot ang Thailand bangud sa superior goal difference).
english:
The sign reads, “Put some F***** Fight.”

Thailand and Indonesia will advance to the knockout semis of the tournament after both recording 10 points (Thailand is in the top spot due to superior goal difference).

text: Ini ang ika-siyam nga tion sa 13 ka appearances nga nakakas ang Pilipinas sa group stage sang nasambit nga regional biennial tournament.
english: This is the ninth time in 13 appearances that the Philippines has qualified for the group stage of the regional biennial tournament.

text: Ini man ang ikaduha nga sunod-sunod nga edition nga napaslawan ang team nga makasulod sa semifinal round.
english: It was also the second edition in a row that the team failed to qualify for the semifinal round.

text: Nagtukod sang tracker team ang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) kasunod sang nagadamo nga kaso sang hold up sa Iloilo.
english: The Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) has set up a tracker team following the increasing number of hold up cases in Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Colonel Bayani Razalan, Provincial Director sang IPPO, iya ginpahayag nga nagmando na sila sa Provincial Intelligence Unit agud mag-focus sa nagasangakad nga kaso sang pagpang-holdup.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Colonel Bayani Razalan, Provincial Director of the IPPO, said they have already ordered the Provincial Intelligence Unit to focus on the increasing number of holdup cases.

text: Suno kay Razalan, tinutuyo sang tikang nga mapapas ang sunod-sunod nga nagaluntad nga insidente sang pagpangawat sa Iloilo.
english: According to Razalan, the move aims to eradicate the ongoing incidents of theft in Iloilo.

text: Nagpasalig man ini nga padayon ang pag-track down sang otoridad sa mga aktibidad sa probinsya.
english: He also assured that the authorities will continue to track down the activities in the province.

text: Nahibaluan nga santu sa data sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office, sa sulod lang sang bulan sang Pebrero 2025, nakarekord na ini sang apat ka mga holdup incidents lakip na ang sa Pavia sang Pebrero 10 sa diin nakuha sang mga suspek ang P300,000 nga benta sang fuel tanker sang Metro Iloilo Transport Service Cooperative.
english: According to the data of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office, during the month of February 2025, it has recorded four holdup incidents including the one in Pavia on February 10 where the suspects stole P300,000 worth of fuel tanker of the Metro Iloilo Transport Service Cooperative.

text: Yara na sa warning status ang Sta.
english: Sta. is now in warning status.

text: Barbara Dam nga nahamtang sa Brgy.
english: Barbara Dam located in Brgy.

text: Tungay, Sta.
english: Tungay, Sta.

text: Barbara, Iloilo, suno sa datos halin sa Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office ukon PDRRMO, base sa report sang National Irrigation Administration Region 6.
english: Barbara, Iloilo, according to data from the Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office or PDRRMO, based on the report of the National Irrigation Administration Region 6.

text: Suno sa impormasyon nga ginpagwa alas 5 sang hapon sang Hulyo 23, ang Sta.
english: According to information released at 5 pm on July 23, the Sta.

text: Barbara Dam may current water level nga 2.10 meters above river bed (marb), mas mataas sa iya normal operating level nga 1.8 marb.
english: Barbara Dam has a current water level of 2.10 meters above river bed (marb), higher than its normal operating level of 1.8 marb.

text: Samtang, nagpabilin naman nga normal ang water level sang anum ka iban nga dam sa probinsya.
english: Meanwhile, the water level of six other dams in the province remained normal.

text: Kalakip diri ang:– Aganan Dam sa Brgy.
english: These include:– Aganan Dam in Brgy.

text: Igtambo, San Miguel nga yara lang sa 1.35 marb, layo pa sa 2.6 marb nga normal;– Jalaur Dam sa Brgy.
english: Igtambo, San Miguel which is only at 1.35 marb, far from 2.6 marb normal;– Jalaur Dam in Brgy.

text: Moroboro, Dingle nga yara sa 23.90 meters above sea level (masl), malapit sa 24 masl nga normal;– Barotac Viejo Dam sa Brgy.
english: Moroboro, Dingle at 23.90 meters above sea level (masl), close to 24 masl normal;– Barotac Viejo Dam in Brgy.

text: Rizal, Barotac Viejo nga yara lang sa 0.50 marb kun sa diin 1.2 marb ang normal;– Suage Ris Dam sa Brgy.
english: Rizal, Barotac Viejo which is only at 0.50 marb where 1.2 marb is normal;– Suage Ris Dam in Brgy.

text: Tolarucan, Mina nga may 1.50 marb, ubos sa 2.0 marb nga normal level;– Sibalom Diversion Dam sa Brgy.
english: Tolarucan, Mina with 1.50 marb, below 2.0 marb normal level;– Sibalom Diversion Dam in Brgy.

text: Anonang, Leon nga may 1.80 marb, mas manubo sa 2.2 marb nga normal;– kag ang Jalaur High Dam sa Brgy.
english: Anonang, Leon with 1.80 marb, lower than 2.2 marb normal;– and the Jalaur High Dam in Brgy.

text: Agcalaga kag Alibunan, Calinog nga may 164 masl, malayo pa sa 189 masl nga normal operating level.
english: Agcalaga and Alibunan, Calinog with 164 masl, far from the 189 masl normal operating level.

text: Suno sa PDRRMO, wala pa sang dam sa Iloilo nga yara sa critical level subong nga tion.
english: According to the PDRRMO, there are no dams in Iloilo that are at critical level at this time.

text: Ginabantayan pa gihapon ang movement sang tubig bangud sang padayon nga ulan.
english: Water movement is still being monitored due to continuous rains.

text: Reported by: Bombo Phauline Pillora
english: Reported by: Bombo Phauline Pillora

text: Good news sa mga motorista!
english: Good news for motorists!

text: Epektibo na subong nga Martes, Hulyo 12, ang big-time rollback sa presyo sang produktong-petrolyo.
english: The big-time rollback in petroleum product prices is effective this Tuesday, July 12.

text:
Yari ang pag-nubo sa presyo sang gatong:

Ini nga price rollback amo ang pinakadaku nga ginbuhin sa presyo sang gatong subong nga tuig.
english:
Here’s the drop in fuel prices:

This price rollback is the biggest cut to fuel prices this year.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau Director Rino Abad nga lakip sa mga rason sa price adjustments amo ang lockdown sa Shanghai, China, ang interest hikes sa nagkalain-lain nga pungsod, kag ang pamahog sang recession nga posible makatuga sang demand destruction.
english: Earlier, Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau Director Rino Abad said that among the reasons for the price adjustments were the lockdown in Shanghai, China, interest hikes in various countries, and the threat of recession that could cause demand destruction.

text: Natalana nga magbalik sa boxing ring si former eight-division world champion kag former Senator Manny Pacquiao sa 2023.
english: Former eight-division world champion and former Senator Manny Pacquiao is set to return to the boxing ring in 2023.

text: Ini matapos nakahimo ini ang agreement sa mixed martial arts promotion nga Rizin Fighting Federation.
english: This is after it made an agreement with the mixed martial arts promotion Rizin Fighting Federation.

text: Suno kay Pacquiao, natalana pa nga i-anunsyo kun san-o ang sambuwa kag kun sin-o ang iya nga kasumpong, apang excited siya nga makaatubang sa isa ka Japanese fighter.
english: According to Pacquiao, it is still scheduled to be announced when the fight and who his opponent will be, but he is excited to face a Japanese fighter.

text: Indi pa maathag kun official match ang ginatumod sang anay senador ukon isa ka exhibition para sa Rizin.
english: It is not clear whether the former senator was referring to an official match or an exhibition for Rizin.

text: Ang Rizin amo ang federation nga naga-organize sang kickboxing kag boxing fights.
english: Rizin is the federation that organizes kickboxing and boxing fights.

text: Antes sini, ginlutos man ni Pacquiao ang Korean mixed martial artist kag YouTuber nga si DK Yoo sa six-round exhibition tatlo ka semana na ang nakaligad sa South Korea.
english: Earlier, Pacquiao also defeated Korean mixed martial artist and YouTuber DK Yoo in a six-round exhibition three weeks ago in South Korea.

text: Padayon ang panawagan sang ‘accountability’ sa mga responsable sa palpak nga proyekto sang Aganan Flyover kag Ungka Flyover sa Pavia, Iloilo, nga tubtob subong ginakabig sang pumuluyo nga isa ka daku nga kapaltahan sa pagpatuman sang imprastruktura.
english: The call for accountability continues for those responsible for the failed Aganan Flyover and Ungka Flyover projects in Pavia, Iloilo, which is still considered by the people as a major failure in the implementation of infrastructure.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Pyt Trimañez, anay miyembro sang Sangguniang Bayan sang Pavia, ginpahayag niya nga aktibo na siya sang una pa sa pagpanawagan sang hustisya para sa mga apektado sang proyekto.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Pyt Trimañez, former member of the Sangguniang Bayan of Pavia, said he has been active in the past in calling for justice for the victims of the project.

text: Nadumduman niya nga sang Mayo 31, 2023 sang nagkadto siya mismo sa Senado kag personal nga ginhatag ang restitution sa 11 ka senador.
english: He recalled that it was on May 31, 2023 when he personally went to the Senate and personally handed over the restitution to 11 senators.

text: Apang suno sa iya, wala gid natuman ang ginpasalig ni Senator Bong Revilla nga matinguhaan nga maimbestigaran ang isyu antes matapos ang termino si Senator Revilla bilang chairman sang committee sa Public Works.
english: However, he said, Senator Bong Revilla's promise to investigate the issue before the end of Senator Revilla's term as chairman of the Public Works committee was not fulfilled.

text: Ginpabutyag pa ni Trimañez nga indi lang isa kundi madamo pa gid nga resolution ang napadala sa House of Representatives, apang wala pa sang klaro nga sabat ukon solusyon halin sa mga opisyal.
english: Trimañez said that not only one but many more resolutions have been sent to the House of Representatives, but there is no clear answer or solution from the officials.

text: Ginpahayag niya nga pwerti na gid ang sakripisyo sang pumuluyo, ilabi na sa problema sang traffic nga ginadala sang palpak nga flyover.
english: He said the people have made a lot of sacrifices, especially in the traffic problem caused by the failed flyover.

text: Suno pa sa iya, ini nga sitwasyon ginakabig nga economic sabotage, pareho sang ginpahayag ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr., bangud madamo na gid sang nawad-an sang negosyo kag palangabuhian nga naapektuhan.
english: He said this situation is considered economic sabotage, as stated by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., because many people have lost their businesses and livelihoods that have been affected.

text: Gindugang pa ni Trimañez nga kabay pa nga ini nga mga hitabo mangin leksyon sa tanan, kag magkahadlok na ang mga opisyal nga nainvolve sa maanomaliya nga proyekto.
english: Trimañez added that he hopes that these incidents will be a lesson to everyone, and that the officials involved in the anomalous project will be afraid.

text: Gintuad man niya nga kahuluya gid kun isa ka ka parte sang proyekto nga pareho sang flood control scandal, nga tubtob subong ginakabig nga simbolo sang kapalpakan sa serbisyo publiko.
english: He also admitted that it is a shame to be part of a project like the flood control scandal, which is still considered a symbol of failure in public service.

text: Padayon ang iya panawagan nga dapat may mangin accountable, kag indi lang ini tapuson sa kasulatan kundi sa aktwal nga tikang para sa kaayuhan sang pumuluyo.
english: He continued to call for accountability, and not just end it with writing but with actual steps for the benefit of the people.

text: 𝑭𝒓𝒐𝒎 𝑨𝒏𝒕𝒊𝒒𝒖𝒆 𝒕𝒐 𝑴𝒐𝒍𝒐, 𝒂 𝒔𝒊𝒔𝒕𝒆𝒓’𝒔 𝒍𝒐𝒗𝒆 𝒍𝒊𝒗𝒆𝒔 𝒐𝒏.
english: 𝑭𝒓𝒐𝒎 𝑨𝒏𝒕𝒊𝒒𝒖𝒆 𝒕𝒐 𝑴𝒐𝒍𝒐, 𝒂 𝒔𝒊𝒔𝒕𝒆𝒔’ 𝒍𝒐𝒗𝒆 𝒍𝒊𝒗𝒆𝒔 𝒐𝒏.

text: Sa pihak sang malain nga panahon, padayon nga nagpadulong ang mga tumuluo sa St.
english: Despite the bad weather, the faithful continued to flock to St.

text: Anne Parish Church sa distrito sang Molo, Iloilo City para sa selebrasyon sang ika-100 ka tuig nga anibersaryo sang Dominican Sisters.
english: Anne Parish Church in Molo district, Iloilo City for the celebration of the 100th anniversary of the Dominican Sisters.

text: Isa sa mga nagtambong amo si Aileen Panganiban, taga-Libertad, Antique.
english: One of the attendees was Aileen Panganiban, from Libertad, Antique.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, iya ginpahayag nga may utod siya nga Dominican sister nga naka-assign subong sa Legazpi, Albay.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, she said she has a Dominican sister who is currently assigned in Legazpi, Albay.

text: Suno sa iya, lima na ka tuig nga wala nakapauli ang iya utod, gani ginpaninguhaan gid sini nga makaupod sa selebrasyon bilang isa ka importante nga parte sang relihiyoso nga komunidad.
english: He said his brother had not been home for five years, so he made every effort to join in the celebration as an integral part of the religious community.

text: Ginpangunahan ang Holy Mass sang aga ni Cardinal Jose Advincula, kaupod ang mga kaparian sang Archdiocese of Jaro nga ginapangunahan ni Archbishop Midyphill Billones.
english: The morning Holy Mass was presided over by Cardinal Jose Advincula, along with the priests of the Archdiocese of Jaro led by Archbishop Midyphill Billones.

text: Napuno ang simbahan sang mga tumuluo nga naghalad sang bulak kag nagpangamuyo.
english: The church was filled with believers who offered flowers and prayed.

text: Isa sa mga ginpasidunggan amo si Mother Rosario, nga tul-an ginbutang sa isa ka sealed reliquary kag ginhalaran sang mga bulak.
english: Among those honored was Mother Rosario, whose skeleton was placed in a sealed reliquary and offered flowers.

text: Lakip ang director-general sang World Health Organization (WHO) nga si Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus sa mga tawo nga yara sa Sanaa Airport sa Yemen sang gin-igu ini sang airstrike sang Israel.
english: World Health Organization (WHO) director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus was among those at Sanaa Airport in Yemen when it was hit by an Israeli airstrike.

text: Sa iya post sa X, ginsiling sang opisyal nga naigu gid ang air traffic control tower amo man ang departure lounge nga minetros lamang ang kalayuon sa ila nahamtangan.
english: In his post on X, the official said that the air traffic control tower was hit as well as the departure lounge, which is only minutes away from their location.

text: Dugang sini, safe ang iya sitwasyon amo man ang iban nga staff sang UN apang gin-atrasar lang ang ila paghalin.
english: He added that his condition is safe as well as other UN staff but their departure was delayed.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga may pila ka crew members sang eroplano nga napilasan kag may duha ka tawo nga na-report nga napatay sa paluparan.
english: He also said that several crew members of the plane were injured and two people were reported killed at the airport.

text: “As we were about to board our flight from Sanaa… the airport came under aerial bombardment.
english: “As we were about to board our flight from Sanaa… the airport came under aerial bombardment.

text: One of our plane’s crew members was injured,” kabahin sang statement ni Ghebreyesus.
english: One of our plane’s crew members was injured,” Ghebreyesus said in a statement.

text: “The air traffic control tower, the departure lounge — just a few meters from where we were — and the runway were damaged.
english: “The air traffic control tower, the departure lounge — just a few meters from where we were — and the runway were damaged.

text: We will need to wait for the damage to the airport to be repaired before we can leave,” dugang sini.
english: We will need to wait for the damage to the airport to be repaired before we can leave,” it added.

text: Didto si Tedros sa Yemen bilang kabahin sang misyon nga iduso ang pag-release sa UN staff kag i-assess man ang health and humanitarian situations sa amo nga pungsod.
english: Tedros is in Yemen as part of a mission to push for the release of UN staff and also assess the health and humanitarian situations in the country.

text: Ginkumpirma man sang Israel nga gin-igu matuod sang ila air strikes ang international airport sa Sanaa magluwas pa sa duha ka power stations kag mga pantalan nga ginaalegar ginaagyan sang mga hinganiban nga ginapadala sang Iran.
english: Israel also confirmed that its air strikes hit the international airport in Sanaa as well as two power stations and ports allegedly used by Iranian weapons.

text: Sang weekend, una na nga nagpaandam si Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nga pudpudon nila ang mga imprastraktura sang rebelde nga group nga Houthis matapos nga nag-atake man ang amo nga grupo sa Israel.
english: Over the weekend, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu earlier warned that they would cut down the infrastructure of the Houthis rebel group after the group also attacked Israel.

text: Ang Houthis amo ang armado nga grupo nga naka-base sa Yemen kag suportado sang Iran.
english: The Houthis are the armed group based in Yemen and backed by Iran.

text: Sunod man nga ginpasaka sang Israel Defense Forces (IDF) ang alert level sang ila nga air defense systems bilang preparasyon pananglitan magbalos ang Houthi rebels.
english: The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) also raised the alert level of its air defense systems in preparation in case of retaliation by Houthi rebels.

text: Gindepensahan ni Fighting Senator Manny Pacquiao ang misis nga si Jinkee Pacquiao batuk sa mga tawo nga nagpakamalaot sa malahalon nga mga outfit nga ginsuksok sini sa Pacquiao-Ugas match sa Las Vegas sa Estados Unidos.
english: Fighting Senator Manny Pacquiao defended his wife Jinkee Pacquiao against people who criticized the expensive outfits she wore during the Pacquiao-Ugas match in Las Vegas in the United States.

text: Suno kay Manny, ang mga bayo kag iban pa nga gamit sang iya asawa ang ginbaka-bakahan niya.
english: According to Manny, he stole his wife's clothes and other belongings.

text: Ang kwarta pahayag niya nga gingamit sa pagbakal ang halin sa iya dugo kag balhas ukon sa iya pagpaninguha.
english: The money he said was used to buy came from his blood and sweat or his efforts.

text: Dugang pa sang senador, wala man sang malain sa mga bayo sang iya asawa bangud wala man niya ginkawat sa gobyerno ukon sa tawo ang kwarta nga ginbakal.
english: The senator said there was nothing wrong with his wife's clothes because she did not steal the money from the government or the people.

text: Handom nila kun ano man ang may yara sa ila pamilya subong dugang ni Pacquiao.
english: They want whatever their family has now, Pacquiao added.

text: Kun magsuksok man sila sang indi branded nga mga panapton, pahayag sang senador, tawgon naman sila sang mga tawo nga “plastic.”
english: If they wear non-branded clothes, the senator said, people will call them “plastic.”

text: Ginaduso sang Department of Agriculture (DA) nga maghimo sang cropping calendar para sa bilog nga pungsod agud nga wala sang mausik sa mga produkto sang mga mangunguma kag malikawan ang oversupply.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) is proposing to develop a cropping calendar for the entire country so that nothing is wasted in the produce of farmers and avoid oversupply.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Undersecretary for Consumer and Political Affairs Kristine Evangelista, paagi sa cropping calendar, makapangita na nga daan sang buyers antes pa man mag-harvest ang mga mangunguma.
english: According to Agriculture Undersecretary for Consumer and Political Affairs Kristine Evangelista, through the cropping calendar, farmers can find buyers before they harvest.

text: Ang cropping calendar amo ang schedule sang growing season halin sa pag-preparar sang gamiton nga duta tubtub sa crop establishment tubtub sa maintenance (halimbawa, weeding kag fertilizing) tubtub sa pag-ani.
english: The cropping calendar is the schedule of the growing season from land preparation to crop establishment to maintenance (e.g., weeding and fertilizing) to harvest.

text: Depende man ang kalawigon — halin sa establishment tubtub sa harvest — depende sa tanum sang mangunguma.
english: The duration — from establishment to harvest — also depends on the farmer’s crop.

text: Ang pagduso sini ang kasunod sang report nga may kinahon sang kamatis nga ginpanghaboy sang mangunguma sa Bukidnon bangud naga-sululobra lang kag wala na sang nagabakal.
english: The proposal follows reports that a box of tomatoes was thrown away by a farmer in Bukidnon because it was just overflowing and no one was buying it.

text: Kun basehan naman ang latest data sang Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), nagnubo na gani ang produksyon sang kamatis sa 90,000 metric tons sa first quarter sang tuig.
english: Based on the latest data from the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), tomato production has dropped to 90,000 metric tons in the first quarter of the year.

text: Halin ini sa 95,870 metric tons sa amo man nga quarter sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: This is down from 95,870 metric tons in the same quarter last year.

text: Suno naman sa DA, naga-preparar naman ang ahensya sa paghatag sang grants sa mga kooperatiba agud nga makahatag sang nagakaigu nga pasilidad agud ma-proseso ang agricultural produce kag mahimo sa mga produkto kaangay sang sun-dried tomatoes, tomato sauce, ukon tomato juice.
english: According to the DA, the agency is preparing to provide grants to cooperatives to provide adequate facilities to process agricultural produce and make products such as sun-dried tomatoes, tomato sauce, or tomato juice.

text: Suno sa DA, mahimo nga makapakig-angot ang kooperatiba sa regional field offices sang ahensya para maka-avail sang grants.
english: According to the DA, the cooperative can contact the agency's regional field offices to avail of grants.

text: Huyhuy ang abaga sang Philippine Azkals matapos ginkamasaan sang defending champions nga Thailand, 4-0, sa Group A match sa Asean Football Federation (AFF) Cup sa Thammasat Stadium sa Pathum Thani, Thailand.
english: The Philippine Azkals' shoulders are shaking after being beaten 4-0 by defending champions Thailand in the Group A match of the Asean Football Federation (AFF) Cup at the Thammasat Stadium in Pathum Thani, Thailand.

text: Duha sa goals sang Thailand ang nagikan kay Teerasil Dangda sa ika-tres minuto sang hampang kag sa penalty kuatro minutos antes ang halftime.
english: Two of Thailand's goals came from Teerasil Dangda in the third minute of the game and from a penalty four minutes before halftime.

text: Ang duha ka iban pa nga goals ang courtesy nanday Adisak Kraisorn sa ika-57 nga minuto, kag Suphanan Bureerat sa ika-63 nga minuto sang match.
english: The other two goals were courtesy of Adisak Kraisorn in the 57th minute, and Suphanan Bureerat in the 63rd minute of the match.

text: Ini na ang ikaduha nga kalutusan sang Pilipinas sa tournament matapos nga ginlutos man ini sang Cambodia, 3-2, sa imbukada pa lang sang hinampang sang Disyembre 20.
english: This is the Philippines' second defeat in the tournament after Cambodia also defeated it, 3-2, in the opening match on December 20.

text: Nagapabilin nga tres ang puntos sang Pilipinas sa group phase, samtang may anum naman ka puntos kag nagapanguna ang Thailand nga nagdaog sa ila una nga duha ka mga hampang.
english: The Philippines remain on three points in the group stage, while Thailand have six points and are leading the table after winning their first two matches.

text: Delikado ang tyansa sang Pilipinas sa semi-finals bangud nga pareho man nga abanse ang Indonesia kag Cambodia sa Group A bangud sa points tally kag sa head-to-head result.
english: Delikado ang tyansa sang Pilipinas sa semi-finals bangud nga pareho man nga abanse ang Indonesia kag Cambodia sa Group A bangud sa points tally kag sa head-to-head result.

text: Sa Group A, pinaka-nubo ang pwesto sang Brunei nga lunsay nalutos sa tatlo na ka mga hampang.
english: In Group A, Brunei are bottom with three losses.

text: Duha gid lamang ka teams halin sa kada grupo ang maga-abanse sa semifinal round.
english: Duha gid lamang ka teams halin sa kada grupo ang maga-abanse sa semifinal round.

text: Ginkumpirma ni Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla nga isa ka sindikato ang sa likod sang pagkidnap sa 14-anyos nga Chinese student nga nasalbar sang Martes.
english: Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla confirmed that a syndicate was behind the kidnapping of the 14-year-old Chinese student who was rescued on Tuesday.

text: Ang biktima, gin-utdan sang tudlo samtang ang iya driver ang ginpatay naman.
english: The victim, his finger was cut off while his driver was killed.

text: Suno kay Remulla, mga tawo nga involved sa Philippine Offshore Gaming Operator (POGO) ang yara sa likod sang pagkidnap sa solterito.
english: According to Remulla, people involved in the Philippine Offshore Gaming Operator (POGO) were behind the kidnapping of the young man.

text: Pebrero 20 sang una nga gin-report sang mga ginikanan sang biktima ang pagkadula sang ila anak.
english: The victim's parents first reported their daughter missing on February 20.

text: Ang salakyan nga nagasugat sa solterito ang nakit-an sa C5 Southbound.
english: The vehicle meeting the young man was found on the C5 Southbound.

text: Sang Biyernes sang nakit-an ang bangkay sang driver sang biktima.
english: The body of the victim's driver was found on Friday.

text: May impormasyon ang mga otoridad nga nakuha sa salakyan kun sa diin nasapwan ang driver kag nakabulig sa pagpangita sa mga kidnapper.
english: Authorities had information obtained from the vehicle where the driver was found and helped find the kidnappers.

text: Yara sa $20 milyon ang una nga ginpangayo sang mga suspek bilang ransom tubtob nga nagnubo sa $1 milyon.
english: The suspects initially demanded $20 million in ransom until it dropped to $1 million.

text: Apang wala naghatag sang ransom ang pamilya.
english: But the family did not pay a ransom.

text: Sang Lunes, nakakuha ng impormasyon ang mga otoridad sa posible nga nahamtangan sang mga kidnaper.
english: On Monday, authorities received information on the possible whereabouts of the kidnappers.

text: Sang Martes kadungan sang hot pursuit operation, nakita ang solterito nga nagalakat sa dalan nga may bandage ang kamot.
english: On Tuesday, during the hot pursuit operation, the young man was seen walking on the street with a bandage on his hand.

text: Matapos ang serye sang mga challenges, humalin sa 100 nga mga kandidata sa Miss Universe Philippines, napili-an na ang Top 30 candidates nga maga-agaway sang titulo sa coronation night.
english: After a series of challenges, from the 100 contestants in Miss Universe Philippines, the Top 30 candidates have been selected to compete for the title on the coronation night.

text: Nakasulod sa Top 30 ang tiglawas sang Iloilo City nga si Kheshapornam Ramachandran.
english: Iloilo City representative Kheshapornam Ramachandran made it to the Top 30.

text: Indi man magpa-ulihe ang pambato sang Aklan nga si Christelle Abello kag ang tiglawas sang Antique nga si Noelyn Rose Mabugay Campos nga nalakip man sa Top 30.
english: Aklan's Christelle Abello and Antique representative Noelyn Rose Mabugay Campos, who are also in the Top 30, will not be left behind.

text: Ang 30 ka mga kandidata ang magapadayon sa in-person competition sa Septyembre 27.
english: The 30 contestants will continue in-person competition on Sept. 27.

text: Ipasa naman sang Ilongga nga si Miss Universe Philippines 2020 Rabiya Mateo ang korona sa iya successor.
english: Ilongga Miss Universe Philippines 2020 Rabiya Mateo will pass the crown to her successor.

text: Apisar wala pa nakumpleto ang imbestigasyon sa natabo nga pagtibusok sang eroplano sang Azerbaijan Airlines, may sources na nga nagapahayag nga ang Russia ang may kahimuan sini.
english: Although the investigation into the crash of the Azerbaijan Airlines plane is not yet complete, there are sources that say Russia was involved.

text: Base sa nagaguwa nga mga impormasyon, nag-crash ang amo nga eroplano kag ginkamatay sang 38 ka mga tawo matapos gin-igu sang Russian air defense system.
english: According to reports, the plane crashed and killed 38 people after being hit by a Russian air defense system.

text: Base sa footage sang nabilin nga parte sang eroplano, may mga buho ang eroplano — baliskad sa una naguwa nga impormasyon nga bird strike ang posible rason sang insidente.
english: Based on footage of the rest of the plane, the plane had holes — contrary to earlier reports that a bird strike was the possible cause of the incident.

text: Base sa preliminary results sang imbestigasyon, ang nag-igu sa aircraft amo ang Russian Pantsir-S air defense system, kag naparalisa man ang communications sini paagi sa electronic warfare systems samtang nagahilapit ini sa airport sa Grozny.
english: Based on the preliminary results of the investigation, the aircraft was hit by the Russian Pantsir-S air defense system, and its communications through electronic warfare systems were also paralyzed as it approached the airport in Grozny.

text: Matandaan nga nag-crash ang Azerbaijan Airlines flight J2-8243 malapit sa syudad sang Aktau sa Kazakhstan matapos ini nag-divert halin sa area sang Russia kun sa diin nagagamit ang Moscow sang air defense systems batok sa Ukrainian drone strikes.
english: It can be recalled that Azerbaijan Airlines flight J2-8243 crashed near the city of Aktau in Kazakhstan after it diverted from the area of ​​Russia where Moscow is using air defense systems against Ukrainian drone strikes.

text: Una na nagpaguwa sang statement ang Russian government nga likawan ang pagpakot-pakot samtang wala pa natapos ang imbestigasyon.
english: The Russian government earlier issued a statement to avoid speculation until the investigation is completed.

text: Gina-uyatan subong sang Kazakh authorities ang flight data recorder kag padayon nga ginatun-an agud mahibaluan kun ano gid ang rason sang trahedya.
english: Kazakh authorities are now holding the flight data recorder and are continuing to study it to determine the exact cause of the tragedy.

text: Balantayan 8:30 karon sa gab-i ang hampang sa tunga sang Philippine national football team batok sa defending champion nga Thailand sa group stage sa Asean Football Federation Cup sa Bangkok.
english: Watch the match between the Philippine national football team against defending champion Thailand in the group stage of the Asean Football Federation Cup in Bangkok at 8:30 pm tonight.

text:
Target sang Azkals nga makahimo sang upset batok sa War Elephants agud masagunsunan ang paglutos sini sa Brunei, 5-1, sang nagligad nga Byernes sang gab-i.

Kun lantawon ang rekord sang duha ka pungsod sa group stage, sa pagbukas sang tournament, nalutos ang Pilipinas sa Cambodia, 2-3; samtang daog naman ang Thailand batok sa Brunei, 5-0.
english:
The Azkals are targeting an upset against the War Elephants to follow up their 5-1 win over Brunei last Friday night.

Looking at the record of the two countries in the group stage, in the opening of the tournament, the Philippines lost to Cambodia, 2-3; while Thailand won against Brunei, 5-0.

text: Magluwas sa Brunei, Cambodia, kag Thailand, kaupod man sang Pilipinas sa Group A ang Indonesia.
english: In addition to Brunei, Cambodia, and Thailand, the Philippines is also in Group A with Indonesia.

text: Ang top 2 teams amo ang maga-abanse sa knockout semis.
english: The top 2 teams will advance to the knockout semis.

text: Magalawig ang Asean Football Federation Cup tubtub sa January 16, 2023.
english: The Asean Football Federation Cup will run until January 16, 2023.

text: Nagbubo ang kasubo kag pagpakig-unong sang pila ka mga fans kag local showbiz industries kasunod sang anunsyo sang pagtaliwan sang komedyante nga si Mahal ukon si Noeme Tesorero sa matuod nga kabuhi sa edad nga 46.
english: Some fans and local showbiz industries have poured out their grief and condolences following the announcement of comedian Mahal or Noeme Tesorero's passing in real life at the age of 46.

text: Ginkumpirma mismo sang iya step mother nga si Josefa Tesorero ang pagtaliwan sang komdeyante.
english: His step mother, Josefa Tesorero, confirmed the death of the comedian.

text: Wala man ini naghatag sang dugang nga detalye kun ano ang ginkamatay ni Mahal.
english: He did not provide further details on the cause of Mahal's death.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang 3 feet nga komedyante ang nangin bantog matapos nagbida sa nanuhay-tuhay nga mga pelikula sang 90s.
english: It is known that the 3 feet comedian became famous after starring in various films in the 90s.

text: Ginpirmahan ni Former Department of Justice Secretary Boying Remulla ang request sang Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) para sa Immigration Lookout Bulletin Order (ILBO) batok sa pila ka mga personalidad nga gina-angut sa flood control anomalies.
english: Former Department of Justice Secretary Boying Remulla has signed the request of the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) for an Immigration Lookout Bulletin Order (ILBO) against several personalities linked to flood control anomalies.

text: Ginkumpirma ni DOJ spokesperson Asec.
english: DOJ spokesperson Asec.

text: Mico Clavano nga kalakip sa mga ipaidalom sa ILBO amo sanday Senador Chiz Escudero, Senador Jinggoy Estrada, Senador Joel Villanueva, kag House Speaker Martin Romualdez.
english: Mico Clavano said that among those to be subjected to the ILBO are Senator Chiz Escudero, Senator Jinggoy Estrada, Senator Joel Villanueva, and House Speaker Martin Romualdez.

text: Katuyuan sang Immigration Lookout Bulletin Order (ILBO) nga mabantayan ang byahe sang mga indibidwal samtang gina-imbestigaran ang mga iregularidad sa paggamit sang pondo para sa flood control projects.
english: The purpose of the Immigration Lookout Bulletin Order (ILBO) is to monitor the movement of individuals while investigating irregularities in the use of funds for flood control projects.

text: Matandaan, una na nga gin-anunsyar ni Dizon nga naghingyo siya sang pag-issue sang immigration lookout bulletin order batuk sa mga personalidad nga involved sa ‘ghost’ flood control projects.
english: Dizon earlier announced that he requested the issuance of an immigration lookout bulletin order against personalities involved in ghost flood control projects.

text: Nag-umpisa na subong nga adlaw, Hulyo 23, ang pag-amat-amat evacuate sang mga apekatado nga residente sang Brgy.
english: The gradual evacuation of the affected residents of Brgy.

text: Sooc, Arevalo, Iloilo City, sa Sooc Regional Evacuation Center nga nahamtang man sa amo nga barangay.
english: Sooc, Arevalo, Iloilo City, at the Sooc Regional Evacuation Center which is also located in the same barangay.

text: Ini kasunod sang ginpatuman sang local government ang preemptive evacuation bangud sang padayon nga pagbubo sang ulan kag pagbaha dala sang habagat.
english: This follows the implementation of preemptive evacuation by the local government due to continuous rains and flooding caused by the southerly winds.

text: Ang Sooc Regional Evacuation Center nga may kalaparon nga 1,445 square meters, sarang mag-akomodar sang halos 500 ka mga indibidwal.
english: The Sooc Regional Evacuation Center with an area of ​​1,445 square meters, can accommodate almost 500 individuals.

text: May yara ini sang kumpleto nga pasilidad para sa mga evacuees, kaangay sang mess hall, storage area, kag mga comfort room, lakip na ang separado nga CR para sa mga persons with disabilities (PWDs).
english: It has complete facilities for evacuees, such as a mess hall, storage area, and comfort rooms, including a separate CR for persons with disabilities (PWDs).

text: Sa subong nga tion, 67 ka pamilya na ang nagatenir sa evacuation center.
english: Currently, 67 families are staying in the evacuation center.

text: Sila ang mga residente halin sa Zone 1-A, Zone 1-B, kag Zone 4 sang Brgy.
english: They are residents from Zone 1-A, Zone 1-B, and Zone 4 of Brgy.

text: San Juan, Molo, Iloilo City.
english: San Juan, Molo, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rena Presquito, isa sa mga evacuees halin sa Zone 1-B sang nasambit nga lugar, iya ginpahayag nga napilitan sila nga mag-evacuate bangud ang ila puluy-an ang lapit sa baybayon sang Molo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Rena Presquito, one of the evacuees from Zone 1-B of the said area, said they were forced to evacuate because their home is near the beach of Molo.

text: Suno sa iya, tuman gid ang iya pasalamat sa mainit nga pagbaton kag pagbulig sa ila sa evacuation center.
english: He said he was very grateful for the warm welcome and help they received at the evacuation center.

text: Gingamit sang Popstar Royalty nga si Sarah Geronimo ang entablado sa opening ceremony sang UAAP Season 88 sa University of Santo Tomas (UST) agud nga manindugan batok sa kurapsyon nga nagakatabo sa Pilipinas.
english: Popstar Royalty Sarah Geronimo used the stage at the opening ceremony of UAAP Season 88 at the University of Santo Tomas (UST) to stand up against corruption in the Philippines.

text: Antes mag-perform sang chorus sang iya 2013 hit song nga “Ikot-Ikot,” ginsal-ot sang singer ang problema subong sa pungsod partikular sa mga anomaliya sa flood control projects.
english: Before performing the chorus of his 2013 hit song “Ikot-Ikot,” the singer touched on the current problems in the country particularly the anomalies in flood control projects.

text: “Kay rami ng sakit na nilimot, napabayaan.’Di maiwasang isipin na tayo’y para bang— Parang panloloko sa bansa natin.
english: “Because there are so many diseases that have been forgotten, neglected.’It’s inevitable to think that we’re like— Like cheating on our country.

text: Pinaikot-ikot lang tayo.
english: We're just being turned around.

text: Tama na!” pahayag sang OPM icon.
english: Enough!” statement of the OPM icon.

text: “‘Di naman po lingid sa kaalaman natin na napakaraming nangyayaring kaguluhan, kasinungalingan, panloloko ang ginagawa sa ating bansa… Ang ating mga kabataan, kayo ang pag-asa ng ating bansa, ng ating bayan.
english: “It is not hidden from our knowledge that there is a lot of chaos, lies, fraud being done in our country... Our youth, you are the hope of our country, of our people.

text: One day, kayo ang magbabago ng bulok na sistema ng bansang ito.
english: One day, you will change the rotten system of this country.

text: ‘Wag kayong mawalan ng pag-asa.… Patuloy na magtiwala na balang araw mababago din ang bulok na sistemang ‘yan at uunlad din ang ating mahal na bansang Pilipinas,” dugang sini sa iya nga panawagan.
english: "Don't lose hope.... Continue to trust that one day that rotten system will change and our beloved country Philippines will develop," he added in his appeal.

text: Naghinugyaw naman ang audience sa ad lib sang singer-actress.
english: The audience cheered for the singer-actress' ad lib.

text: 30,000 ang nagtambong sa amo nga seremonya nga kadam-an amo ang mga estudyante kag student-athletes halin sa walo ka mga eskwelahan sa UAAP.
english: 30,000 people attended the ceremony, mostly students and student-athletes from the eight schools in the UAAP.

text: “Indi kita mamasol kung indi ka certain.” Liwat nga nagpanindugan si Lone District Representative Julienne “Jam Jam” Baronda sa isyu nga ginapangatubang sang proyekto sang DPWH, kasunod sang mga reklamo halin sa pila ka barangay officials sa Jaro, lakip na si Kapitan Mary Jane Jecara sang Brgy.
english: "We won't blame you if you're not certain." Lone District Representative Julienne “Jam Jam” Baronda reiterated her stand on the issue facing the DPWH project, following complaints from several barangay officials in Jaro, including Kapitan Mary Jane Jecara of Brgy.

text: Tagbak.
english: Tagbak.

text: Suno sa iya, ang lugar flood-prone na bisan sang una pa, pero karon ginatudlo ang proyekto nga rason sang pagbaha.
english: He said the area was flood-prone even in the past, but now the project is being pointed out as the reason for the flooding.

text: Para kay Baronda, kun may problema, kinahanglan sang solusyon — indi dapat mamasul dayon, labi na kun wala sang kasiguruhan.
english: For Baronda, if there is a problem, it needs a solution — it should not be immediately blamed, especially when there is no certainty.

text: Ginklaro niya nga ang proyekto sang revetment wall/ bike lane may tinutuyo nga makabulig sa epekto sang climate change kag indi lang para sa pasilidad sang bikers.
english: He clarified that the revetment wall/bike lane project aims to help with the impact of climate change and not just for the convenience of bikers.

text: Ang revetment wall, suno sa iya, gintukod agud protektahan batuk sa soil erosion.
english: The revetment wall, he said, was built to protect against soil erosion.

text: Ginkwestyon man ni Baronda ang pahayag nga gintampukan ang creek para lang himuon nga bike lane kag ginpahanumdom niya nga mismo ang mga residente sang una ang nagapanawagan nga pahimuan sang bike lane sa lugar.
english: Baronda also questioned the statement that the creek was dumped just to make it a bike lane and reminded that the residents themselves in the past called for the construction of a bike lane in the area.

text: Ginbuyagyag man niya nga may drone footage halin sa DPWH nga nagpapakita nga may husto pa nga flow sang tubig sa area.
english: He also revealed that there is drone footage from the DPWH that shows that there is still proper water flow in the area.

text: Dugang pa niya nga ang problema amo ang basura sa ‘vegetation’ nga nagtubo sa creek, nga posible nga nagaka-contribute sa pagbaha — ini, suno sa iya, dapat buligan sang tanan nga barangay officials.
english: He added that the problem is the garbage in the vegetation that has grown in the creek, which is likely to contribute to flooding — this, he said, should be helped by all barangay officials.

text: Ginpaathag man ni Baronda nga indi pwede nga litrato lang ang basehan kag dayon ibasol ang proyekto.
english: Baronda also explained that it is not possible to base it on photographs and then blame the project.

text: Dapat, kun may nakita nga problema, i-report dayon sa DPWH antes pa man magsobra ang epekto.
english: If any problems are found, they should be reported to the DPWH immediately before the impact becomes too much.

text: Ginpasalig man niya nga may kumpiyansa siya sa expertise sang mga engineers sang DPWH Regional Office kag sang Iloilo City Engineering Office.
english: He also assured that he has confidence in the expertise of the engineers of the DPWH Regional Office and the Iloilo City Engineering Office.

text: Wala siya naga-question sa kapasidad sang mga Ilonggo engineers.
english: He does not question the capacity of Ilonggo engineers.

text: Ginpahanumdom ni Baronda ang tanan nga lideres: antes magpagwa sang pahayag, siguruhon ang kamatuoran — kay sa ulihi, ang mga lider responsable sa katawhan.
english: Baronda reminded all leaders: before issuing a statement, ascertain the truth — after all, leaders are responsible to the people.

text: Nagpanguna si Luka Doncic sa Los Angeles Lakers matapos naghaboy sang 34 puntos, 12 rebounds, kag 7 assists agud lutuson ang New Orleans Pelicans, 133-121.
english: Luka Doncic led the Los Angeles Lakers with 34 points, 12 rebounds, and 7 assists to defeat the New Orleans Pelicans, 133-121.

text: Bente punto naman ang na-record ni Doncic sa una nga quarter nga naghatag sa Lakers sang 46-27 lead, pinakamataas nila nga puntos sa isa ka kwarter subong nga season.
english: Doncic scored 20 points in the first quarter to give the Lakers a 46-27 lead, their highest score in a quarter this season.

text: Dako man ang bulig ni Austin Reaves nga may 33 points, kag 8 assists, samtang si Deandre Ayton ang nagdugang sang 22 puntos kag 12 ka rebounds antes maghalin sa hampang bangud sa palanakit sang tuhod.
english: Austin Reaves also had 33 points, and 8 assists, while Deandre Ayton added 22 points and 12 rebounds before leaving the game with knee soreness.

text: Wala nakahampang si Lebron James bangud sa masakit nga left leg, apang enough sa gihapon ang opensa sang Lakers agud makuha ang ila ikaptio nga sunod-sunod nga kadalag-an.
english: Lebron James missed the game with a sore left leg, but the Lakers' offense was still enough to win their seventh consecutive victory.

text: Samtang, kulang ang Pelicans bangud wala sanday Zion Williamson kag Trey Murphy III, apang naglaom sila sa opensa nanday Bryce McGowens nga may 23 ka puntos kag Saddiq Bey nga may 22 points.
english: Meanwhile, the Pelicans were lacking without Zion Williamson and Trey Murphy III, but they relied on the offense of Bryce McGowens with 23 points and Saddiq Bey with 22 points.

text: Ini na ang ika-12 nga pagkapyerde sang Pelicans sa ulihi nga 13 ka hampang, samtang nag-angat naman ang lakers sa 7-2 record sa ila nga home court.
english: This is the Pelicans' 12th loss in their last 13 games, while the Lakers improve to a 7-2 record on their home court.

text: Pagatutukan ang Economic and Trade sa pagahiwaton nga 49th Meeting of the High-Level Task Force on ASEAN Economic Integration (HLTF-EI) sa siudad sang Iloilo nga pagahiwatun sa Pebrero 25 tubtob 27.
english: Economic and Trade will be the focus of the 49th Meeting of the High-Level Task Force on ASEAN Economic Integration (HLTF-EI) in Iloilo City from February 25 to 27.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga dako ang iya pagpasalamat bangud nga napilian ang syudad sang Iloilo nga mangin host sang nasambit nga aktibidad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas said she is very grateful that the city was chosen to host the event.

text: Suno pa sa iya, ini man amo ang tion agud nga mahatagan man sang highlight ang mga heritage houses, pagkaon kag tourist spot sa lugar.
english: He said this is also the time to highlight the heritage houses, food and tourist spots in the area.

text: Kaangot diri, nagpakig-angot naman ang alkalde sa Iloilo City Police Office para sa seguridad sang mga ginpaabot nga mga delegado.
english: In this regard, the mayor liaised with the Iloilo City Police Office for the security of the expected delegates.

text: Ang mga representative nga magapadulong sa siudad amo ang halin sa mga pungsod kaangay sang Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Timor-Leste kag Vietnam.
english: Representatives coming to the city are from countries such as Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Timor-Leste and Vietnam.

text: Kun mag-graduate ikaw nga ‘with honors’, siyempre, malipay ka gid bangud bugal mo gid ini kag bunga sang imo pinangabudlayan bilang estudyante.
english: If you graduate with honors, of course, you will be very happy because it is your pride and the fruit of your hard work as a student.

text: May isa ka babaye sa Connecticut, USA nga ginhatagan sini nga pagkilala, kag sa baylo nga malipay, ginkasuhan sini ang iya eskwelahan.
english: A woman in Connecticut, USA was given this recognition, and instead of being happy, she sued her school.

text: Istorya ini ni Aleysha Ortiz, 19, nga nabun-ag sa Puerto Rico kag nag-eskwela sa Hartford Public High School sa Hartford, Connecticut.
english: This is the story of Aleysha Ortiz, 19, who was born in Puerto Rico and attended Hartford Public High School in Hartford, Connecticut.

text: Suno kay Aleysia, bata pa lang siya, nabudlayan na siya sa pagtuon, kag nagpadayon ini bisan nga nagsaylo na sila sa United States.
english: Aleysia says she struggled with learning at a young age, and it continued even after they moved to the United States.

text: Ginsiling sini nga indi basta-basta ang iya kondisyon bangud haluson siya gani maka-uyat sang lapis, kag ang iya pangbasa ang daw kaangay sa mga kabataan sa Grade 1.
english: He said his condition is not easy because he can barely hold a pencil, and his reading skills are similar to those of Grade 1 children.

text: Pag-abot sa high school, may yara sang special teacher nga gin-assign sa iya special case apang wala man ini sang binuligan suno kay Aleysha.
english: When she arrived at high school, there was a special teacher assigned to her special case but she didn't help her, Aleysha said.

text: Sang isa ka bulan na lang ang nabilin antes ang graduation sang Hunyo, nag-conduct na gid man ang teacher sang dugang nga test nga amo ang iya ginahingyo, kag didto nareyalisar niya nga virtually illiterate man siya gihapon.
english: With only a month left before graduation in June, the teacher finally conducted an additional test that he had requested, and there he realized that he was still virtually illiterate.

text: Suno pa kay Aleysha, gintanyagan siya sang school district officials nga makabaton siya sang graduation diploma kabaylo sang intensive services, apang ginbalibaran niya ini.
english: Aleysha said school district officials offered her a graduation diploma in exchange for intensive services, but she turned it down.

text: Apang naka-graduate siya gihapon sa high school nga with honors nga nagakahulugan nga nagdemonstar siya sang academic excellence.
english: But he still graduated from high school with honors which means he demonstrated academic excellence.

text: Nakakuha pa siya sang college scholarship, apang gindayon gid ni Aleysha ang pagkaso sa iya eskwelahan sa bangud sa negligent infliction of emotional distress.
english: She even got a college scholarship, but Aleysha continued to sue her school for negligent infliction of emotional distress.

text: Gin-ako man ni Aleysha nga bisan indi siya makahibalo magbasa kag magsulat, naka-pasar lamang siya kag nakasulod pa sa University of Connecticut bangud sa bulig sang moderno nga mga application.
english: Aleysha also admitted that although she cannot read and write, she was able to pass and enter the University of Connecticut with the help of modern applications.

text: Gingamit sini ang smartphone apps para nga ma-translate ang mga nakasulat sa speech, kag ang speech naman ginahimo niya nga text paagi sa amo nga application.
english: He used smartphone apps to translate what was written in the speech, and the speech was converted into text through the application.

text: Amo man ini ang iya gingamit sa pag-fill out sang college application kag sa essay.
english: It was the same one she used to fill out the college application and the essay.

text: Apang bangud lain na ang setup sa kolehiyo, nabudlayan gid si Aleysha kag nag-untat na sang Pebrero para sa mental health treatment.
english: But since the college setup was different, Aleysha found it very difficult and dropped out in February for mental health treatment.

text: Ginsiling sini nga dayunon niya ang kaso sa iya former school bangud gusto niya nga mangin accountable sila sa iya eksperyensya, ilabi na bangud daw kaangay nga ginkawatan siya sang edukasyon bangud wala sang labot ang institusyon sa iya.
english: He said he will continue the case with his former school because he wants them to be accountable for his experience, especially since he feels like he was robbed of education because the institution has nothing to do with him.

text: WALA sing perfecto nga tawo.
english: NO ONE is perfect.

text: Wala sing perfecto nga presidente.
english: There is no perfect president.

text: Wala sing perfecto nga gobyerno.
english: There is no perfect government.

text: Kon may kaayuhan sila nga mahimo, may kapalpakan ukon kalainan man sila nga mahimo sooner or later.
english: If they can do good, they can do bad or evil sooner or later.

text: Gani kinahanglan ang pagbantay sa ila agud matadlong ini para sa kaayuhan sang mga pumuluyo.
english: Therefore, monitoring of them is necessary to correct them for the benefit of the citizens.

text: Tungod sini, importane sa sosyedad ang taga-Media agud mabantayan ang ila kapalpakan ukon kalainan man agud mapatadlong ini, nga mahimo sang Media sa ila sinumpaan nga obligasyon sa ila propesyon sa radio, TV kag pamantalaan.
english: Therefore, it is important to society for the media to monitor their mistakes or evils in order to correct them, which the media can do in their sworn obligation to their profession in radio, TV and newspapers.

text: Syempre, sunu kay Pedro, indi kalakip dira ang mga sip-sip nga mga vloggers sa social media kag kasubong nila nga nagapagamit agud magdala sang kabutigan sang mga garok nga opisyales sa gobyerno kag sang ila mga kaugyon.
english: Of course, according to Pedro, this does not include the sip-sip vloggers on social media and their likes who use it to bring the lies of corrupt government officials and their allies.

text: In fact, nagapamatok kami sa Media sa ano man nga Diniktador nga pagginahum nga naga-ipit sang kahilwayan sang mga pumuluyo sa pagtusngaw sang ila hibubun-ot kag mga reklamo.
english: In fact, we oppose the Media to any Dictatorship that restricts the freedom of the people to express their will and grievances.

text: Labi na gid kon ginatabunan nila ang mga mata sang mga pumuluyo sa Kamatuoran, kag ginapatulon pa sang ila kabutigan agud mapadayon ang kahakog sa manggad kag poder sang sining wala kalag nga mga tinuga.
english: Especially when they blind the eyes of the people to the Truth, and even swallow their lies to continue the greed for wealth and power of these soulless creatures.

text: Of course sa sini nga propesyon sang taga-Media daku man nga risgo sa kabuhi ang maatubang nila sa madiskubrihan kag ma-expose nga mga kalainan.
english: Of course in this profession of the media they also face a great risk to their lives in discovering and exposing evils.

text: Gani, nangin kaaway ang madamo sa ila sining mga sinakpan sang kadulom nga kon kis-a nagalab-ut sa ila kahalitan kag hilaw nga kamatayon.
english: Thus, many of them became enemies of these subjects of darkness, sometimes to the point of harm and raw death.

text: Pero, balewala ining mga pamahog sa madamo nga mas masupog sa ila agud lang mapaluntad ang Diyosnon nila nga misyon para sa mga pumuluyo.
english: However, these threats are ignored by many who are more courageous than them just to carry out their divine mission for the people.

text: In fact, sa masami, ang pagkatumba sang isa, may isa pa ukon duha pa gani ang nagabulos agud ipadayon ang misyon batok sa kalainan sining mga wala sing kalag.
english: In fact, usually, the downfall of one, another or even two take over to continue the mission against the evil of these soulless ones.

text:
***

Apang, quo vadis, ukon diin padulong, gid ining halos wala katapusan nga pagpamahog kag pagpamatay sang taga-Media?
english:
***

But, quo vadis, or where, is this almost endless Median threat and killing leading?

text: Ginakilala na gani sa kalibutan nga isa sang pinaka-delikado nga pungsod ang Filipinas para sa mga taga-Media.
english: The Philippines is even recognized in the world as one of the most dangerous countries for the media.

text: Salamat kay sang sining ulihi lang nangin sensational ang mga balita parti sa pagpatay sa maisug nga kolumnista sa radyo nga si Percy Lapid kag maabtik man nag-aksyon ang mga otoridad agud lagson ang nagpapatay kag nagpatay sa iya.
english: Thankfully, recently the news about the murder of the brave radio columnist Percy Lapid became sensational and the authorities quickly took action to track down the killer and killed him.

text: Ugaling man kay sang ulihi daw pakitang-tawo man lang ini kay indi man gali nila madakop ang mga suspetsado nga ginapangunahan ni anay Bilibid Chief Bantag.
english: However, later it seemed that it was just a show because they could not arrest the suspects led by former Bilibid Chief Bantag.

text: Daw may maninoy ini nga daku nga nagatago sa iya nga indi matultulan.
english: It was as if he had a big brother-in-law who was hiding him from view.

text:
***

Anyway, bisan pa-consuelo, nahibal-an sang mga pumuluyo kon ano ka importante ang kawsa sang Media batok sa corruption kag kriminalidad.
english:
***

Anyway, despite the consolation, the people know how important the cause of the Media against corruption and crime is.

text: Ginpatay si Lapid tungod luyag niya tapnaon ang padayon nga pagpangawat sa kaban sang mga pumuluyo nga padayon man nagatulod sa ila sa pil-as sang paghikahos.
english: Lapid was killed because he wanted to stop the continuous looting of the people's coffers that continues to push them to the brink of violence.

text: Makadto pa tani ining kaayuhan para sa ila.
english: This goodness would have gone for them.

text: Kag, tungod sini, ginakasubo gid nila ang natabo sa iya.
english: And, because of that, they are very sorry for what happened to him.

text: Kag salamat man sa well-meaning nga pasalig ni Acting PRO-6 director Brig.
english: And thank you also for the well-meaning assurance of Acting PRO-6 director Brig.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Sidney N. Villaflor nga nagaagda sa mga taga-Media sa pag-report dayon sa kapulisan sang mga pamahog sa ila agud maaaktuhan man dayon sini.
english: Sidney N. Villaflor who invites the media to immediately report threats to the police so that they can be acted upon immediately.

text: In fact, sunu kay Pedro, may pila man ka mga pribado nga mga tawo ang nakapabutyag sang ila luyag nga makabulig sa sining pagpamahog sa taga-Media.
english: In fact, according to Pedro, there are also some private individuals who have expressed their desire to help in this threat to the Media.

text: Nadumduman ko pa sadtong ulihi nga tinuig sang Marcos Dictatorial Regime ang pasalig sa akon sang isa ka gapakilala nga abyan.
english: I remember in the last years of the Marcos Dictatorial Regime the assurance of a friend who introduced himself to me.

text: Siling niya indi ako magkahadlok kay proteksyunan nila ako.
english: He says don’t be afraid as they will protect me.

text: Wala siya nagpakilala pero ano pa ang masiling ko kundi…Salamat!
english: He didn't introduce himself but what can I say but...Thank you!

text: Kon sin-o man ining mga nagatanyag sang bulig sa taga-Media, ugaling, wala kita kaseguruhan sa ila intensyon.
english: Whoever these offers of help to the Mede were, however, we are not sure of their intentions.

text: Basi bala mga tinawo sang kontra pulitiko.
english: Maybe they are members of the opposing politician.

text: Mga rebelde ayhan nga grupo.
english: Probably rebel groups.

text: Ayhan mga negosyante nga ang interes mabuligan sang kawsa sa Kahilwayan sang Media.
english: Perhaps businessmen whose interests would be helped by the cause of Media Freedom.

text: Kag basi mga vigilante man nga may simpatiya sa ila.
english: And maybe even vigilantes who have sympathy for them.

text:
***

So, ano ang maayo?
english:
***

So, what’s good?

text: Maayo lang seguro kon mangamlig gid lang ang kada isa, labi na gid ang nakabaton sing pamahog, nga matugutan magdala armas for personal protection.
english: It would be good if everyone, especially those who received threats, were allowed to carry weapons for personal protection.

text: Kag indi lang magbulag sa proteksyon sang gamhanan naton nga Diyos.
english: And don't just separate yourself from the protection of our mighty God.

text: Well, seguro ma-obligar gid man kita sa pag-report sining mga pamahog sa aton kapulisan kay obligasyon nila ang proteksyunan ang mga pumuluyo.
english: Well, maybe we will be obliged to report these threats to our police because it is their obligation to protect the people.

text: Kag kon may yara pa gid nga iban nga luyag magbulig sa ila matarong man nga intensyon, salamat gid kag ubayan man kamo sang Diyos sa inyo maayo nga handom sa pagpasanyog sang aton Free Press sa matarong sini nga misyon sa aton Demokrasya kag Kahilwayan./PN
english: And if there are others who want to help with their righteous intentions, thank you very much and God bless you in your good intentions in promoting our Free Press in this righteous mission of our Democracy and Freedom./PN

text: Ginpaandam ni Senator Kiko Pangilinan ang mga indibidwal nga nagatuyo nga mag-abuso sang pondo para sa mga farm-to-market road.
english: Senator Kiko Pangilinan warned individuals who intend to misuse funds for farm-to-market roads.

text: Suno kay Senator Pangilinan, iya ginpahayag nga kun sin-o man ang madakpan nga nagabuhat sang sahi nga butang ang sigurado nga magapangatubang sang nagakaigo nga penalidad kag mahimo ipatawag sa Senado agud mag-eksplikar.
english: According to Senator Pangilinan, he said that anyone caught doing such things will surely face appropriate penalties and may be summoned to the Senate to explain.

text: Dugang pa sini nga, ang Senado ang nagasekyar sang ebidensya agud makapasaka sang kaso batok sa mga madakpan nga nagapangawat sa FMR projects.
english: He added that the Senate is checking evidence to file cases against those caught stealing from FMR projects.

text: Ginpahayag man niya nga may gahum ang senado nga maka-issue sang subpoena kun matukiban nga may kalakasan o ilegal nga ginahimo ang isa ka tawo batok sa FMR nga pondo.
english: He also said that the Senate has the power to issue a subpoena if it is found that there is violence or illegal actions against the FMR fund.

text: Umaasa pa rin ang mga transport cooperatives sa Western Visayas na sabay na ipatupad ng pamahalaan ang pagbibigay ng fuel subsidy at ang hinihiling na dagdag-pasahe upang maibsan ang epekto ng patuloy na pagtaas ng presyo ng langis.
english: Transport cooperatives in Western Visayas are still hoping that the government will simultaneously implement the fuel subsidy and the requested fare surcharge to mitigate the impact of the continuous rise in oil prices.

text: Sa panayam ng Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Raymundo Parcon, Chairman ng Western Visayas Transport Cooperative, sinabi nito na patuloy na bumibigat ang kanilang operasyon dahil sa mataas na gastusin sa krudo, maintenance, at iba pang pangangailangan sa pamamasada.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Raymundo Parcon, Chairman of the Western Visayas Transport Cooperative, said their operations continue to be burdened due to the high cost of fuel, maintenance, and other transportation needs.

text: Dahil dito, iginiit nila na hindi sapat ang isa lamang sa dalawang hakbang upang matulungan ang sektor.
english: Because of this, they insist that one of the two steps is not enough to help the sector.

text: Giit ni Parcon, kung ipatutupad lamang ang fare hike nang walang fuel subsidy, maaaring mabawasan ang bilang ng mga pasahero dahil sa dagdag gastos sa pamasahe.
english: Parcon insisted that if the fare hike is implemented without fuel subsidy, the number of passengers will be reduced due to the additional cost of fares.

text: Sa kabilang banda, kung subsidy lamang ang ipagkakaloob, hindi pa rin umano nito lubusang matutugunan ang pangmatagalang pangangailangan ng mga tsuper at operator.
english: On the other hand, if only subsidies are introduced, it will not fully meet the long-term needs of drivers and operators.

text: Dagdag pa nila, mahalagang mapanatili ang balanse sa pagitan ng kapakanan ng mga mananakay at ng transport sector upang hindi maapektuhan ang araw-araw na biyahe ng publiko.
english: They added that it is important to maintain a balance between the welfare of passengers and the transport sector so as not to affect the daily travel of the public.

text: Sa kasalukuyan, hinihintay pa ng mga transport group ang magiging desisyon ng pamahalaan kaugnay sa kanilang panawagan, lalo na sa gitna ng patuloy na paggalaw ng presyo ng produktong petrolyo sa pandaigdigang merkado.
english: Meanwhile, the transport groups are still waiting for the government's decision on their call, especially amid the continuous movement of petroleum product prices in the global market.

text: Umaasa ang mga transport cooperatives na agad na tutugunan ng gobyerno ang kanilang hinaing upang matiyak ang tuloy-tuloy at abot-kayang serbisyo sa transportasyon sa Western Visayas.
english: The transport cooperatives hope that the government will immediately respond to their grievances to ensure continuous and affordable transportation services in Western Visayas.

text: Gin-athag ni Independent Commision for Infrastructure Spokesperson Brian Keith Hosaka nga magapabilin sa pribado ang mga hearing sang komisyon agud malikawan ang misleading ukon magpatalang sang testimonya sang mga tawo nga gina-imbestigaran.
english: Independent Commission for Infrastructure Spokesperson Brian Keith Hosaka explained that the commission's hearings will remain private to avoid misleading or misleading testimony of people under investigation.

text: Suno kay Hosaka, sensitibo ang mga isyu nga gina-istoryahan, gani kinahanglan anay nga siguruhon nga husto kag kompleto ang tanan nga impormasyon antes ipahibalo sa publiko.
english: Hosaka said the issues being discussed were sensitive, so it was necessary to ensure that all information was accurate and complete before being made public.

text: Tinutuyo sang komisyon nga mapabilin ang kredibilidad sang imbestigasyon kag malikawan ang mga espekulasyon nga mahimo makahalit sa reputasyon sang mga involved samtang nagapadayon pa ang proseso.
english: The commission aims to maintain the credibility of the investigation and avoid speculation that could damage the reputation of those involved while the process is still ongoing.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nakigsapol man ang bag-o nga ICI Special Adviser nga si Gen.
english: Meanwhile, the new ICI Special Adviser, Gen.

text: Rodolfo Azurin Jr.
english: Rodolfo Azurin Jr.

text: sa mga katapo sang komisyon.
english: to the members of the commission.

text: Ginalauman nga maga-upod ini sa groupo sa palaabuton nga imbestigasyon pagkatapos sang iya pagsumpa sa iya bag-o nga posisyon.
english: He is expected to join the groupo in the upcoming investigation after he is sworn into his new position.

text: Gindeklarar nga fourth runner-up ang syudad sang Iloilo sa pagtakop sang Batang Pinoy National Championships 2022 sa Vigan City, Ilocos Sur.
english: Iloilo City was declared fourth runner-up at the closing ceremony of the Batang Pinoy National Championships 2022 in Vigan City, Ilocos Sur.

text: Sa official medal tally sang Philippine Sports Commission, nakit-an nga may 46 ka mga medalya nga natipon ang syudad nga ginabug-usan sang 17 ka gold, 14 ang silver, kag 15 ang bronze.
english: The official medal tally of the Philippine Sports Commission showed that the city has 46 medals, including 17 gold, 14 silver, and 15 bronze.

text: Nauna sa ranking ang Baguio City, City of Pasig, Quezon City, kag Laguna.
english: Baguio City, City of Pasig, Quezon City, and Laguna topped the ranking.

text: Ang top five most outstanding Local Government Units ang ginkilala man kag ginhatagan sang trophies kag cash prizes.
english: The top five most outstanding Local Government Units were also recognized and awarded with trophies and cash prizes.

text: Sa 42nd spot naman ang Iloilo Province nga may 27 ka medalya — duha ang gold medals, walo ang silver, kag 17 ang bronze.
english: Iloilo Province is in 42nd place with 27 medals — two gold medals, eight silver, and 17 bronze.

text: Pormal nga gintakpan ang seremonya paagi kay Philippine Sports Comission Chairperson Noli Eala kag paagi sa simultaneous nga pagpanubo sang banners kag extinguishing sang urn.
english: The ceremony was formally closed by Philippine Sports Commission Chairperson Noli Eala and with the simultaneous lowering of the banners and extinguishing of the urn.

text: Halin sang nagsugod ang Batang Pinoy Program sang 1999, madamo na ini sang na-produce nga mga kampyeon sa nagkalain-lain nga sports lakip na ang mga ginapadala sang Pilipinas sa Olympiada.
english: Since the Batang Pinoy Program began in 1999, it has produced many champions in various sports including those sent by the Philippines to the Olympics.

text: Subong nga tuig, 6,000 ka mga participants halin sa masobra 140 local government units ang nag-compete sa siyam ka face-to-face sports kaangay sang archery, athletics, badminton, chess, cycling, table tennis, swimming, weightlifting, kag obstacle course (demonstration).
english: This year, 6,000 participants from more than 140 local government units competed in nine face-to-face sports such as archery, athletics, badminton, chess, cycling, table tennis, swimming, weightlifting, and obstacle course (demonstration).

text: Ginabanta nga masobra sa 40 ang patay matapos nagtibusok ang isa ka eroplano sa paluparan sang Aktau, Kazakhstan.
english: More than 40 people are estimated to have been killed after a plane crashed at Aktau airport in Kazakhstan.

text: Isa ini ka Azerbaijan Airlines (AZAL) plane nga halin sa Baku padulong sa Grozny.
english: It was an Azerbaijan Airlines (AZAL) plane from Baku to Grozny.

text: Nagpatigayon sang emergency landing ang eroplano matapos ang naeksperyensiyahan nga bird strike.
english: The plane made an emergency landing after experiencing a bird strike.

text: Sakay sini ang 67 ka tawo kalakip ang 62 ka pasahero kag lima ka crew members.
english: It was carrying 67 people including 62 passengers and five crew members.

text: Bangud sa madamol nga fog sa Grozny airport, ang eroplano ang una nga na-redirect sa Makhachkala kag pagkatapos, nagdirekta ini sa Aktau.
english: Due to heavy fog at Grozny airport, the plane was first redirected to Makhachkala and then, it headed to Aktau.

text: Sa tion sang emergency landing, wala nakabaton sang clearance ang crew agud maghugpa sa Grozny.
english: During the emergency landing, the crew did not receive clearance to land in Grozny.

text: Ang mga pasahero ang naghalin sa nagkalain-lain nga pungsod: 37 gikan sa Azerbaijan, 16 halin sa Russia, 6 halin sa Kazakhstan, kag 3 halin sa Kyrgyzstan.
english: The passengers came from different countries: 37 from Azerbaijan, 16 from Russia, 6 from Kazakhstan, and 3 from Kyrgyzstan.

text: Nagpalab-ot sang pagpakig-unong ang airline company sa mga pamilya sang mga biktima kag ginsiguro ang paghatag sang bulig.
english: The airline company extended its condolences to the families of the victims and ensured the provision of assistance.

text: Padayon ang imbestigasyon sa matuod nga kabangdanan sang aksidente.
english: The investigation into the true cause of the accident is ongoing.

text: Naghingyo sang Immigration Lookout Bulletin Order (ILBO) sa Department of Justice and Independent Committee on Infrastructure batok sa mga personalidad nga naangot sa maanomaliya nga flood-control projects.
english: Requested an Immigration Lookout Bulletin Order (ILBO) to the Department of Justice and Independent Committee on Infrastructure against personalities linked to anomalous flood-control projects.
