text: Magluwas nga nagaguwa na ang kakulitan, makahangop naman sang apat ka mga lenggwahe nga English, Filipino, Spanish kag French ang anak nanday Solenn Heussaff kag Nico Bolzico nga si Baby Thylane.
english: Solenn Heussaff and Nico Bolzico's daughter, Baby Thylane, can understand four languages: English, Filipino, Spanish and French.

text: Ginpahayag ni Solenn nga personal nga desisyon niya nga indi anay magbaton sang mga acting project nga may lock-in taping.
english: Solenn said it was her personal decision not to accept acting projects with lock-in taping.

text: Masako ang aktres sa subong bilang full-time mom kag naka-focus siya sa anak humalin sa pagluto, baking kag pagpinta.
english: The actress is currently busy as a full-time mom and has been able to focus on her son from cooking, baking and painting.

text: Suno kay Solenn, kun updanay sila ni Baby Thylane, lunsay French ang iya ginagamit sa pagpakig-istorya samtang Spanish naman kun si Nico ang upod sang ila anak.
english: According to Solenn, when she and Baby Thylane are together, she uses French to communicate while Spanish when Nico is with their daughter.

text: Kun kaupod naman sang bata ang iloy ni Solenn kag iban nga mga himata nila, English kag Filipino ang ginagamit sa pagpakig-istorya kay Baby Thylane.
english: When Solenn's mother and other relatives are with the child, English and Filipino are used to communicate with Baby Thylane.

text: Nakakuha na ang syudad sang Iloilo sang gold medal sa nagapadayon nga 2022 Batang Pinoy National Championships sa Vigan City, Ilocos Sur.
english: Iloilo City has won a gold medal in the ongoing 2022 Batang Pinoy National Championships in Vigan City, Ilocos Sur.

text: Ini paagi kay Harvy Dolutan nga nagpangibabaw sa 14 & 15 years old boys cycling category sa amo nga hinampang.
english: This is through Harvy Dolutan who dominated the 14 & 15 years old boys cycling category in the event.

text: Ginpanglutos sini ang 30 ka iban pa nga tagpalasakop nga nagikan sa nagkalain-lain nga lugar sa Pilipinas.
english: He beat 30 other contestants from different parts of the Philippines.

text: Antes nadag-an ang gold medal, may duha na ka silver medals nga nakuha ang syudad sang Iloilo.
english: Before winning the gold medal, Iloilo City had already won two silver medals.

text: Halin sang nagsugod ang Batang Pinoy Program sang 1999, madamo na ini sang na-produce nga mga kampyeon sa nagkalain-lain nga sports lakip na ang mga ginapadala sang Pilipinas sa Olympiada.
english: Since the Batang Pinoy Program began in 1999, it has produced many champions in various sports including those sent by the Philippines to the Olympics.

text: Subong nga tuig, 6,000 ka mga participants halin sa masobra 140 local government units ang naga-compete sa siyam ka face-to-face sports kaangay sang archery, athletics, badminton, chess, cycling, table tennis, swimming, weightlifting, kag obstacle course (demonstration).
english: This year, 6,000 participants from more than 140 local government units are competing in nine face-to-face sports such as archery, athletics, badminton, chess, cycling, table tennis, swimming, weightlifting, and obstacle course (demonstration).

text: ILOILO CITY – Preso ang isa ka hubog nga lalaki matapos nga ginpakitaan sini sang armas ang babaye nga assistant sang Indian national matapos ginsukot sang iya utang sa Barangay Osmeña, Iloilo City Proper.
english: ILOILO CITY – A drunk man was arrested after he showed a gun to a female assistant of an Indian national after she paid off her debt in Barangay Osmeña, Iloilo City Proper.

text: Ang arestado amo si alyas Jerry, tumandok sang Antique, apang temporaryo nga naga-istar sa nasambit nga lugar.
english: The arrested was identified as Jerry, a native of Antique, but temporarily residing in the said area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Willy Banesio, pakaisa ni Jerry, iya ginpahayag nga duha ka beses na ini nga nag-utang sa Indian national.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Willy Banesio, Jerry's cousin, said he has borrowed money from the Indian national twice.

text: Ang pinakaulihi sini nga utang ang nagadangat sa P5,000 sa diin kada adlaw, ginasukot ini sang P300 tubtob maimpasan.
english: The latest debt is P5,000 and every day, it is charged P300 until it is paid off.

text: Apang samtang naga-inom, ginsukot si alyas Jerry sang sekretarya, apang sa baylo nga magbayad, nagpakita ini sang iya nasukbit nga armas.
english: But while drinking, alias Jerry was charged by the secretary, but instead of paying, he showed his weapon.

text: Gilayon naman nga nagpangayo sang bulig ang sekretarya sa traffic auxiliary kag ginpalab-ot ini sa pulis.
english: The secretary immediately sought help from the traffic auxiliary and reported the matter to the police.

text: Nakuha naman sa posisyon sini ang revolver nga armas lima kag lima ka mga bala.
english: A revolver with five rounds of ammunition and five rounds of ammunition were recovered from the suspect.

text: Sa subong, preso na si alyas Jerry sa Iloilo City Police Station 7 sa diin magapangatubang ini sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act No.
english: Jerry is currently detained at the Iloilo City Police Station 7 where he will face charges of violation of Republic Act No.

text: 10591 ukon Comprehensive Firearms and Ammunition Regulation Act kag Commission on Elections (COMELEC) gun ban.
english: 10591 or Comprehensive Firearms and Ammunition Regulation Act and Commission on Elections (COMELEC) gun ban.

text: -𝗪𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗮 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗕𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗼 𝗝𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗿 𝗩𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗮
english: -Advice 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗕𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗼 𝗝𝗼𝗿𝗿𝗿 𝗩𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗮

text: Wala anay sang plano sanday Sofia Andres kag partner sini nga race car driver nga si Daniel Miranda nga sundan ang ila anak nga si Zoe.
english: Sofia Andres and her partner race car driver Daniel Miranda had no plans to follow their daughter Zoe.

text: Suno kay Sofia, kinahanglan anay nga i-enjoy nila mag-asawa si Zoe kag maghinay-hinay lang.
english: Sofia says she and Zoe need to enjoy each other first and take it easy.

text: Ginbalikan man sang duha ang nangin eksperyensya nila sang nahibaluan nga nagabusong sadto anga aktres.
english: The two also recalled their experience when they learned that the actress was pregnant.

text: Gin-ako ni Sofia nga nakabatyag siya sang kulba nga mahimo bayaan siya ni Daniael bangud sa iya sitwasyon.
english: Sofia admitted that she felt nervous that Daniael might leave her because of her situation.

text: Apang nagsala ang aktres bangud nangin tuman ka malipayon ang iya nga partner nga mangin ang ila relasyon ang nagbag-o pag-abot sang ila nga anak.
english: But the actress was wrong because her partner became so happy that even their relationship changed when their son arrived.

text: Nangin mas mature sila nga duha kag nakit-an mismo ni Sofia nga tuman ka palangga ni Daniel si Zoe.
english: They both became more mature and Sofia could see for herself that Daniel loved Zoe very much.

text:
Tropical depression Dante, padayon nga gina-monitor sa sulod sang Philippine Area of Responsibility

Padayon nga gina-monitor sa sulod sang Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) ang tropical depression Dante.
english:
Tropical depression Dante, continues to be monitored within the Philippine Area of Responsibility

Tropical depression Dante continues to be monitored within the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR).

text: Sa latest monitoring sang state weather bureau, ang sentro sang Tropical Depression DANTE ang ginabanta yara sa 880 km East sang Extreme Northern Luzon..
english: In the latest monitoring of the state weather bureau, the center of Tropical Depression DANTE is estimated to be 880 km East of Extreme Northern Luzon..

text:
Ini ang may Maximum sustained winds nga 55 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos sang tubtob sa 70 km/h.

Nagahulag ini sa direksyon nga Northwestward sa kadasigon nga 25 km/h

Si DANTE ang mahimo mangin tropical storm sa sulod sang masunod 12 ka oras .
english:
It has maximum sustained winds of 55 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 70 km/h.

It is moving in the Northwestward direction at a speed of 25 km/h

DANTE could become a tropical storm within the next 12 hours.

text: Samtang, may yara man sang isa ka Low Pressure Area ang ginabantayan man sa sulod sang PAR kag karon may yara sang mataas nga potensyal nga mangin isa tropical depression sa sulod sang masunod nga 24 oras.
english: Meanwhile, a Low Pressure Area is also being monitored within the PAR and now has a high potential to become a tropical depression within the next 24 hours.

text: Ang isa pa ka Low Pressure Area nga ginabantayan sa guwa sang PAR ang may yara man sang “MEDIUM” nga potensyal nga mangin sa isa ka tropical depression sa sulod sang masunod nga 24 oras.
english: Another Low Pressure Area being monitored outside the PAR also has the “MEDIUM” potential to become a tropical depression within the next 24 hours.

text: Ginapanugyanan ang tanan nga mag-monitor sang mga update halin sa DOST-PAGASA.
english: Everyone is advised to monitor the updates from DOST-PAGASA.

text: By: Bombo Phauline Pillora
english: By: Bombo Phauline Pillora

text: Nangayo sang bulig si Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. asked for help.

text: sa mga local chief executives sa pagpakigbato batok sa kurapsyon.
english: to local chief executives in the fight against corruption.

text: Ginhimo niya ang panawagan sa oath-taking sang League of Cities of the Philippines (LCP) executive board kag sang League of Municipalities of the Philippines (LMP) national directorate.
english: He made the call at the oath-taking of the League of Cities of the Philippines (LCP) executive board and the League of Municipalities of the Philippines (LMP) national directorate.

text: Suno sa Presidente, wala sang lugar sa iya nga administrasyon ang kurapsyon.
english: The President said corruption has no place in his administration.

text: Pahayag sini, halin pa sang una niya nga adlaw sa serbisyo, mabaskug na ang iya kampanya batok sa kurapsyon.
english: He said that since his first day in office, he has been campaigning against corruption.

text: Ginpabutyag niya nga ang maayo nga pagpangdumala sa isa ka lugar makita kag mabatyagan mismo sang mga pumuluyo adlaw-adlaw.
english: He expressed that good governance in an area can be seen and felt by the people themselves on a daily basis.

text: “Mga kasama kong mga lingkod-bayan, alam kong hindi madali ang trabaho sa lokal na pamahalaan.
english: “My fellow public servants, I know that the work in local government is not easy.

text: Marami ring hamon ang kinakaharap ng ating bansa.
english: Our country is facing many challenges.

text: Lahat tayo dismayado sa mga ulat ng katiwalian na nakikita natin sa pamahalaan,” suno sa punong ehekutibo.
english: We are all disappointed with the reports of corruption we are seeing in the government,” the chief executive said.

text: “Ngunit, malinaw ang ating adhikain.
english: “But, our adhikain is clear.

text: Sa Bagong Pilipinas, walang puwang ang korapsyon at ang pandaraya,” dugang sini.
english: In the New Philippines, there is no room for corruption and fraud,” he added.

text: Gin-abisuhan man sini ang mga opisyal nga busision sang maayo ang mga proyekto sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) nga ginahimo sa ila nga mga lugar.
english: He also advised the officials to closely monitor the projects of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) being implemented in their areas.

text: Pahayag pa sang president: “We must take responsibility to eradicate this abhorrent culture of corruption that has poisoned the public trust and has robbed us of a better future.”#
english: The president said: “We must take responsibility to eradicate this abhorrent culture of corruption that has poisoned the public trust and has robbed us of a better future.”#

text: Natapos sa trahediya ang pag-practice sa pagmaneho sang motorsiklo sang rider sang gin-upod niya ang 8-anyos nga hinablos nga babaye sa Minglanilla, Cebu.
english: The rider's motorcycle driving practice ended in tragedy when he accompanied his 8-year-old niece to Minglanilla, Cebu.

text: Natumba ang motorsiklo kag nalasakan sang truck ang bata.
english: The motorcycle fell and the child was hit by the truck.

text: Nahibaluan nga residente sa Cebu City ang biktima kag naglagaw lang sa iya nga lola.
english: The victim is a resident of Cebu City and was just visiting his grandmother.

text: Siya ang ginpasakay sang 34-anyos nga tiyo sa bag-o nga motorsiklo.
english: He was given a ride by his 34-year-old uncle on a new motorcycle.

text: Sa imbestigasyon sang otoridad, nadulaan sang balanse ang tiyo nga rider kag natumba ang motorsiklo.
english: According to the investigation of the authorities, the uncle rider lost his balance and fell on the motorcycle.

text: Nagtabog ang bata sa dalan kag natabuan nga may nagapadulong nga truck kag nalapakan gid ang bata kag napatay.
english: The child ran into the road and was hit by an oncoming truck and died.

text: Wala naman sang plano nga magpasaka sang reklamo batok sa driver ang pamilya bangud nabaton nila nga aksidente lamang ini.
english: The family has no plans to file a complaint against the driver as they accept that it was an accident.

text: Apang naghingyo sila nga buligan sila sa gasto sa pagpalubong.
english: But they asked to be helped with the cost of the funeral.

text: Nakit-an na ang duha ka mga manugpangisda nga na-missing sa Sibunag, Guimaras.
english: Two fishermen who went missing in Sibunag, Guimaras have been found.

text:
Ini amo sanday:

-Ryan Galfo, 32-anyos

-Vincent Paul Valles, 30-anyos

Ang duha ang lunsay residente sang Sitio Liningwan, Maabay, Sibunag, Guimaras.
english:
These are:

-Ryan Galfo, 32-year-old

-Vincent Paul Valles, 30-year-old

The two are both residents of Sitio Liningwan, Maabay, Sibunag, Guimaras.

text: Ulihi sila nga nakit-an sa kalalawran nga sakop sang Sebaste, Sibunag.
english: They were last seen in the waters of Sebaste, Sibunag.

text: Subong nga aga, nakit-an sila nga nagautaw-utaw sa kalalawran nga sakop man sang amo nga banwa.
english: This morning, they were found floating in the sea that is also part of the same town.

text: Ginklaro ni Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo “Ping” Lacson nga pinal na ang iya desisyon nga magpanaog bilang chairman sang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee.
english: Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo “Ping” Lacson clarified that his decision to step down as chairman of the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee is final.

text: Ini apisar sang mga panawagan sa iya nga magtinir sa pwesto sa kasagsagan sang imbestigasyon sa mga anomaliya sa flood control projects.
english: This is despite calls for him to remain in office amid investigations into anomalies in flood control projects.

text: Pahayag ni Lacson, kun nagasiling siya nga indi, buot silingon, indi; kag kun magsiling naman siya nga huo, buot-silingon, huo.
english: Lacson said, if he says no, it means no; and if he says yes, it means yes.

text: Sang Domingo sang gin-anunsyo ni Lacson ang iya nga resignation bangud ginpahayag sini nga dismayado ang pila sa mga senador sa kun paano sini ginadumala ang imbestigasyon sa flood control scandal.
english: Lacson announced his resignation on Sunday because he said some senators were disappointed with how he was handling the investigation into the flood control scandal.

text: Sang Lunes naman sang nabaton ni Senate President Vicente Sotto III ang iya sulat para sa iya nga paghalin sa pwesto.
english: Senate President Vicente Sotto III received his resignation letter on Monday.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Sotto nga lakip sa ginapilian nga magabulos sa pagpanguna sa gamhanan nga panel amo sanday Senador JV Ejercito, Raffy Tulfo, Kiko Pangilinan, Pia Cayetano, kag Risa Hontiveros.
english: Sotto earlier said that among those selected to replace the leadership of the powerful panel are Senators JV Ejercito, Raffy Tulfo, Kiko Pangilinan, Pia Cayetano, and Risa Hontiveros.

text: Sa lima nga ini, tatlo na ang nagpamalibad sa pagbaton sang katungdanan nga amo sanday Ejercito, Tulfo, kag Pangilinan.
english: Of the five, three have already refused to accept the position, namely Ejercito, Tulfo, and Pangilinan.

text: Nagpasalamat si Ejercito nga ginakonsiderar siya sa pagpamuno sa komite, apang pahayag sini, nakahibalo siya sa iya nga limitasyon.
english: Ejercito expressed gratitude that he is being considered to lead the committee, but he said he is aware of his limitations.

text: Nahibaluan man niya suno sa iya nga madamo sa iya kaupdanan ang mas nakahibalo kun paano mag-uyat sa sining importante nga committee.
english: He said he also knows that many of his colleagues know better how to handle this important committee.

text: Sa bahin ni Tulfo, nagpasalamat man ini, apang nagpamalibad nga magpamuno bangud indi sini maluyag nga madula ang iya focus sa tatlo ka committee chairmanships nga iya gina-uyatan.
english: For his part, Tulfo also thanked, but refused to lead because he did not want to lose his focus on the three committee chairmanships he holds.

text: Ini nga mga komitiba suno sa iya ang nagatutok sa iya mayor nga mga adbokasiya nga amo ang labor, migrant workers, kag public services.
english: These committees, he said, focus on his main advocacies which are labor, migrant workers, and public services.

text: Pahayag naman ni Pangilinan, chairperson na siya sang tatlo ka komite sa Senado nga amo ang Agriculture, Food, and Agrarian Reform, Justice and Human Rights, kag Constitutional Amendments and Revision of Codes, gani nga indi na maalam nga desisyon kun batunon pa sini ang Blue Ribbon.
english: Pangilinan said he is already chairperson of three committees in the Senate, namely Agriculture, Food, and Agrarian Reform, Justice and Human Rights, and Constitutional Amendments and Revision of Codes, so it is not a wise decision to accept the Blue Ribbon.

text: Magasapol ang majority bloc subong nga adlaw agud diskusyunan kun sin-o ang magabulos kay Lacson.
english: The majority bloc will meet today to discuss who will replace Lacson.

text: Nadakpan na ang suspek nga nagsunog sa isa ka babaye nga ginaalegar nagakatulog lamang sa subway car sa Brooklyn, New York sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: The suspect who set fire to a woman who was allegedly sleeping in a subway car in Brooklyn, New York in the United States of America has been arrested.

text: Gin-identify ang lalaki nga si Sebastian Zapeta-Calil, 33, isa ka Guatemalan citizen nga iligal nga nagsulod sa US sa nagligad nga anum ka tuig base sa rekord sang US Immigration and Customs Enforcement.
english: The man was identified as Sebastian Zapeta-Calil, 33, a Guatemalan citizen who entered the US illegally in the past six years based on US Immigration and Customs Enforcement records.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon sang pulis, natabo ang brutal nga krimen 7:30 sang aga (local time).
english: Based on police investigation, the brutal crime occurred at 7:30 am (local time).

text: Wala sang tinimok-timok ang suspek sang ginpalapitan sini ang biktima kag ginsindihan ang iya panapton tubtub nga nagkarab-karab ang lawas sini pila ka segundos lang ang nagligad.
english: The suspect did not hesitate when he approached the victim and lit her clothes until her body burned a few seconds later.

text: Base sa surveillance video, nagpungko pa ang suspek sa station bench kag ginlantaw ang babaye nga masunog tubtub nga nag-abot ang mga pulis.
english: According to surveillance video, the suspect sat on the station bench and watched the woman burn until police arrived.

text: Nakita pa mismo sa body-worn cameras ang maathag nga itsura sang killer suno sa New York Police Department.
english: The body-worn cameras showed the clear appearance of the killer, according to the New York Police Department.

text: Walo ka oras ang nagligad, naaresto ini sa isa ka subway station sa Manhattan sa bulig sang teenagers nga nag-report sa otoridad.
english: Eight hours later, he was arrested at a Manhattan subway station with the help of teenagers who reported him to authorities.

text: Yara na ini subong sa kustodiya sang otoridad kag napasakaan sang reklamo nga first-degree murder kag arson.
english: He is now in police custody and charged with first-degree murder and arson.

text: Wala pa sang ginpaguwa nga detalye kun ano ang motibo sini.
english: No details have been released as to the motive.

text: Ginpaiway man nga isapubliko mangin ang identity sang biktima.
english: The victim's identity was also refused to be made public.

text: Base sa inisyal nga report sang pulis, ginapatihan nga indi man magkilalahay ang duha antes ang insidente.
english: Based on initial police reports, it is believed that the two did not know each other before the incident.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang natabo ini nga insidente, naka-“Code Blue” ang syudad kun sa diin may dugang nga resources kag shelter nga gina-deploy para mabuligan ang mga natugnawan ilabi na ang mga homeless ukon wala sang puluy-an nga masami nagapaligad na lamang sang adlaw kag gab-i sa subway system sa tion nga malain ang tiyempo.
english: It was learned that when the incident occurred, the city was under “Code Blue” where additional resources and shelters were deployed to help those affected especially the homeless who often spend days and nights on the subway system during bad weather.

text: Nagapadayon sa pagnubo sang produksyon sang kalamay sa Pilipinas bangud sa malain nga tyempo kag halit nga ginbilin sang mga bagyo.
english: Sugarcane production in the Philippines continues to decline due to bad weather and damage caused by typhoons.

text: Sa circular letter sang Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) nga ginpadala sa sugar industry groups, ginpahayag ni SRA Administrator Hermenegildo Serafica nga ang sugar production sa pungsod ang nagdangat lamang sa 1.8 million metric tons (MT) as of June 15.
english: In a circular letter sent to sugar industry groups, SRA Administrator Hermenegildo Serafica said sugar production in the country reached only 1.8 million metric tons (MT) as of June 15.

text: Ang indi kinaandan nga pagnubo sa sugar production ang nakit-an sa Negros halin March 2022 tubtub May 2022 nga production data.
english: An unusual decline in sugar production was observed in Negros from March 2022 to May 2022 production data.

text: Lakip sa gintumod rason amo ang nahalitan nga mga tubo sang naglaslas ang Bagyo Odette sang Disyembre 2021.
english: Among the reasons cited were damaged pipes when Typhoon Odette ruptured in December 2021.

text: Bangud nahalitan ang dahon sang tubo, naapektuhan ang photosynthetic activity kag nabuhinan man ang tinonelada nga tubo sa amo nga mga binulan.
english: Due to the damage to the sugarcane leaves, the photosynthetic activity was affected and the tonnage of sugarcane was also reduced during these months.

text: Sa data sang Department of Agriculture- Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Operations Center, nakasaad nga P1.15 billion ang halit nga ginbilin sang Bagyo Odette sa mga tubo — katumbas sang 8.6 percent sang total agricultural damage.
english: According to the data of the Department of Agriculture- Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Operations Center, it is estimated that Typhoon Odette caused P1.15 billion in damage to pipelines — equivalent to 8.6 percent of the total agricultural damage.

text: Lakip man sa gintumod nga rason amo ang pag-ulan ulan nga nakaapekto sa maturity condition sang late milling canes.
english: Among the reasons cited was the heavy rains that affected the maturity condition of the late milling canes.

text: Matandaan nga may kaangtanan sa gin-forecast na nga pagnubo sang sugar production sa Pilipinas, nagpatuman ang SRA sang sugar importation program para sa 200,000 metric tons sang refined sugar.
english: It can be recalled that in connection with the forecasted decline in sugar production in the Philippines, the SRA implemented a sugar importation program for 200,000 metric tons of refined sugar.

text: Padayunon sang SRA ang pag-monitor sa sugar supply kag demand situation sa Pilipinas agud nga ma-manage ang sitwasyon.
english: The SRA will continue to monitor the sugar supply and demand situation in the Philippines in order to manage the situation.

text: Nag-angkon sang nanari-sari nga reaksyon ang anunsyo ni President-elect Trump nga himuon niya nga opisyal nga pagsulundan sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga duha lamang ka mga gender ang ila nga kilalahon — ang babaye kag ang lalaki.
english: President-elect Trump's announcement that he will make it an official policy in the United States of America to recognize only two genders — female and male — has drawn mixed reactions.

text:
Sa iya speech sa atubang sang conservatives sa Phoenix, Arizona, ginpahayag sini nga sa una nga adlaw sang iya pagbalik bilang president, untaton niya ang ginatawag nga “transgender lunacy.”

Suno kay Trump, pirmahan niya ang executive orders agud tapnaon ang child sexual mutilation kag paguwa-on ang transgender sa military, sa elementary schools, sa middle schools, kag sa high schools.
english:
In a speech before conservatives in Phoenix, Arizona, he said that on the first day of his return as president, he would put an end to so-called “transgender lunacy.”

Trump said he will sign executive orders to stop child sexual mutilation and exclude transgender people from the military, elementary schools, middle schools, and high schools.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga indi niya pagpa-intrahon ang mga lalaki sa sports events sang mga babaye.
english: He also said he would not allow men to participate in women's sporting events.

text: “With the stroke of my pen on day one, we’re going to stop the transgender lunacy…  I will sign executive orders to end child sexual mutilation, get transgender out of the military and out of our elementary schools and middle schools and high schools,” kabahin sang statement.
english: “With the stroke of my pen on day one, we’re going to stop the transgender lunacy… I will sign executive orders to end child sexual mutilation, get transgender out of the military and out of our elementary schools and middle schools and high schools,” part of the statement.

text: “Under the Trump administration, it will be the official policy of the United States government that there are only two genders, male and female,” dugang sini.
english: “Under the Trump administration, it will be the official policy of the United States government that there are only two genders, male and female,” it added.

text:
“Doesn’t sound too complicated, does it?”

Nahibaluan nga ang isyu sa transgender isa sa pinakadaku nga ginabaisan sa US sa sini nga mga tinuig bangud lain-lain nga mga direksyon ang luyag sang Democrats kag Republicans ilabi na sa mga polisa kaangay sang medical treatment kag ano nga mga libro kag topiko ang pahanugutan sa public ukon school libraries.
english:
“Doesn’t sound too complicated, does it?”

It is known that the transgender issue is one of the biggest debates in the US in recent years because Democrats and Republicans want different directions especially on policies such as medical treatment and what books and topics will be allowed in public or school libraries.

text: Sang nagligad nga semana, sang gin-aprubahan sang US Congress ang tuigan nga defense budget, ginlakip ang probisyon agud nga balabagan ang pag-pondo sa transgender medical treatments para sa kabataan sang military members.
english: Last week, when the US Congress approved the annual defense budget, a provision was included to block funding for transgender medical treatments for children of military members.

text: May 10,000 ka transgender nga naga-edad 6 to 22 nga may ginikanan nga aktibo sa military sa Estados Unidos base sa data sang Modern Military Association of America.
english: There are 10,000 transgender people ages 6 to 22 who have a parent on active duty in the U.S. based on data from the Modern Military Association of America.

text: Na-trangkaso ang pila ka players sang defending champions nga France samtang nga naga-preparar para sa 2022 World Cup final match batok sa Argentina.
english: Several players of defending champions France have contracted the flu while preparing for the 2022 World Cup final match against Argentina.

text: Suno sa French Football Federation (FFF), sanday Raphael Varane kag Ibrahima Konate ang katapusan nga nakaangkon sang trangkaso.
english: According to the French Football Federation (FFF), Raphael Varane and Ibrahima Konate were the last to contract the flu.

text: Matandaan nga sa semi-finals batok sa Morocco, wala man nakahampang defender nga si Dayot Upamecano kag ang midfielder nga si Adrien Rabiot bangud sa malain nga kondisyon.
english: In the semi-finals against Morocco, defender Dayot Upamecano and midfielder Adrien Rabiot also missed the game due to poor condition.

text: Wala naga-panic si France coach Didier Deschamps kag ginsiguro nga nagahalong ang team nga indi na malatnan ang iban pa nga players.
english: France coach Didier Deschamps is not panicking and has made sure the team is taking precautions to prevent other players from getting infected.

text: Suno naman sa isa pa ka player nga si Kolo Muani, gin-isolate na ang players nga nagmasakit, kag may yara sang mga doktor nga nagatatap sa ila.
english: Another player, Kolo Muani, said the players who fell ill have been isolated, and doctors are attending to them.

text: Positibo ang coach nga magaayo pa sanday Upamecano kag Rabiot para sa showdown batok sa team ni Lionel Messi sa Lusail Stadium,11:00 sa gab-i oras sa Pilipinas.
english: The coach is positive that Upamecano and Rabiot will be better for the showdown against Lionel Messi's team at Lusail Stadium, 11:00 pm Philippine time.

text: Pananglitan malain gid ang kondisyon nanday Konate kag Varane, ginapanan-aw nga mabudlayan si Deschamps sa selection decision bangud lakip sila nga duha sa top three defenders sang France.
english: For example, if Konate and Varane are in very bad condition, Deschamps is expected to have difficulty with the selection decision because they are both among the top three defenders in France.

text: Nagsaka na sa 1,100 ang casualties halin sa militar sang North Korea sang nagbulig sa giyera sang Russia batok sa Ukraine.
english: North Korea's military casualties in helping Russia's war against Ukraine have risen to 1,100.

text: Ini ang ginkumpirma sang South Korea-Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) kasunod sang report sang spy agency sa mga miyembro sang parliament sa Seoul.
english: This was confirmed by the South Korea-Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) following a report by the spy agency to members of parliament in Seoul.

text: Sang nagligad nga semana, una gin-report nga 100 ka mga soldado halin sa Pyongyang ang napatay sang nag-intra na sa amo nga away subong nga bulan.
english: Last week, it was first reported that 100 soldiers from Pyongyang had been killed when it joined the fighting this month.

text: “Through various sources of information and intelligence, we assess that North Korean troops who have recently engaged in combat with Ukrainian forces have suffered around 1,100 casualties,” kabahin sang statement sang JCS.
english: “Through various sources of information and intelligence, we assess that North Korean troops who have recently engaged in combat with Ukrainian forces have suffered around 1,100 casualties,” part of the JCS statement.

text: “We are particularly interested in the possibility of additional deployments of North Korean soldiers to aid Russia’s war effort,” dugang sini.
english: “We are particularly interested in the possibility of additional deployments of North Korean soldiers to aid Russia’s war effort,” it added.

text: Matandaan nga una na ginreport nga 12,000 ka tropa ang ginpadala ni North Korean leader Kim Jong Un agud magbulig sa mga soldado ni Russian President Vladimir Putin sa pag-atake sa Ukraine lakip na sa Kursk border region nga naagaw na sang Ukrainian forces sa mas temprano nga bahin subong nga tuig.
english: It can be recalled that earlier it was reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong Un sent 12,000 troops to help Russian President Vladimir Putin's troops in the attack on Ukraine including the Kursk border region which was captured by Ukrainian forces earlier this year.

text: Base sa statement sang JCS, nagapreparar ang North Korea sang rotation kag dugang nga deployment sang mga soldado.
english: Based on the JCS statement, North Korea is preparing rotation and additional deployment of troops.

text: Base pa sa intel report sang Seoul, nagahimo kag nagahatag ang North sang “self-destructible drones” sa Russian army pati na ang 240mm rocket launchers kag 170mm self-propelled howitzers.
english: According to Seoul's intel report, the North is producing and supplying "self-destructible drones" to the Russian army as well as 240mm rocket launchers and 170mm self-propelled howitzers.

text: Ginalantaw nga may ipadala nga dugang nga suicide drones matapos ang test nga ginpangunahan mismo ni Kim sang nagligad nga bulan.
english: More suicide drones are expected to be sent after a test led by Kim himself last month.

text: Nagbulagay na gid man bala sanday Paolo Contis kag LJ Reyes?
english: Have Paolo Contis and LJ Reyes really broken up?

text: Ini ang pamangkot sang kadam-an matapos gin-unfollow ni Paolo si LJ sa Instagram kag gin-delete man sang aktor ang tanan nga pictures sang aktres.
english: This is the question of many after Paolo unfollowed LJ on Instagram and the actor also deleted all the pictures of the actress.

text: Apang indi lang si LJ ang gin-unfollow ni Paolo bangud zero na ang “following” niya sa IG.
english: But LJ is not the only one that Paolo unfollowed because he has zero following on IG.

text: Buot silingon, gin-unfollow na niya ang tanan nga iya ginpang-follow sadto lakip na si LJ.
english: This means that he has unfollowed everyone he used to follow including LJ.

text: Apang ang ginkatingala sang netizens amo nga ang pictures na lang sang ila anak nga si Summer ang wala gin-delete sang aktor.
english: But what surprised netizens was that only the pictures of their daughter Summer were not deleted by the actor.

text: Padayon ang monitoring sang Police Regional Office (PRO) 6 sa Western Visayas kadungan sa pagdumdom sang 39th EDSA People Power Revolution.
english: The Police Regional Office (PRO) 6 continues to monitor Western Visayas in conjunction with the commemoration of the 39th EDSA People Power Revolution.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson sang Police Regional Office 6, iya ginpahayag nga magatrabaho sila ilabi na nga wala sang deklarasyon sang holiday halin sa national government.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson of the Police Regional Office 6, said they will work especially since there is no declaration of holiday from the national government.

text: Suno kay Solis, ongoing ang ila pagbantay sa mga mahimo magpatuman sang rally kadungan sang EDSA People Power Revolution.
english: Solis said they are ongoing to monitor those who may implement the rally in conjunction with the EDSA People Power Revolution.

text: Nagpahanumdom man ang talatapan sa mga maga-rally nga magkuha sang permit agud matalunsay nga makahulag sa ila nga tinutuyo.
english: The office also reminded the rally participants to obtain a permit so that they can carry out their purpose smoothly.

text: Wala naman sang nabalhag ang PRO6 nga organsisasyon nga nagpabutyag nga magpatuman sang rally.
english: PRO6 has not published any organization that has expressed interest in holding a rally.

text: May yara na sang opisyal nga kasugtanan sanday US President Donald Trump kag President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: US President Donald Trump and President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. have already signed an official agreement.

text: tuhoy sa ginpatuman nga taripa sa mga exported nga produkto.
english: regarding the imposed tariff on exported products.

text: Suno kay Trump, ang tanan nga produkto nga magahalin sa Pilipinas padulong sa Estados Unidos pagadagdagan lamang sang 19% nga taripa, humalin sa una nga plano sini nga 20%.
english: According to Trump, all products coming from the Philippines to the United States will be subject to a 19% tariff, up from its initial plan of 20%.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ang mga produkto nga halin sa US padulong sa Pilipinas hindi na pagbutangan sang taripa, isa ka desisyo nga ginkabig nga pabor sa ekonomiya sang pungsod.
english: On the other hand, products from the US to the Philippines will no longer be subject to tariffs, a decision that is considered in favor of the country's economy.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Trump nga ang pagbisita ni Marcos Jr.
english: Trump also said that the visit of Marcos Jr.

text: sa White House isa ka “makabuluhan” kag may dako nga bili sa pagpabaskog sang relasyon sa tunga sang duha ka pungsod.
english: at the White House is a “significant” and of great value in strengthening relations between the two countries.

text: Antes sini, ginsiling ni Trump nga bukas siya sa posibilidad nga trade deal upod kay Marcos.
english: Earlier, Trump said he was open to the possibility of a trade deal with Marcos.

text: Ginhingadlan ni Senate President Vicento Sotto III ang mga senador nga posible magaserbe bilang bag-o nga chairperson sang blue ribbon committee matapos nag-resign si Senator Panfilo Lacson sa pwesto.
english: Senate President Vicento Sotto III named the senators who are likely to serve as the new chairperson of the blue ribbon committee after Senator Panfilo Lacson resigned from office.

text:
Suno kay Sotto, ang mga ginakonsidera para sa chairmanship sang Senate blue ribbon committee amo sanday;

*Senator Pia Cayetano*Senator Joseph Victor “JV” Ejercito*Senator Risa Hontiveros

*Senator Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan kag;*Senator Raffy Tulfo

Pahayag niya, nakadepende kay Senator Lacson kun sin-o ang i-rekomenda sini bangud nagapati siya nga mangin epektibo ini sa pag-imbestigar sang flood control anomalies.
english:
Sotto said those being considered for the chairmanship of the Senate blue ribbon committee are;

*Senator Pia Cayetano*Senator Joseph Victor “JV” Ejercito*Senator Risa Hontiveros

*Senator Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan and;*Senator Raffy Tulfo

He said it is up to Senator Lacson who he will recommend because he believes he will be effective in investigating flood control anomalies.

text: — ADVERTISEMENT —Dugang pa sang natungdan, nagpatawag siya sang caucus bwas, Oktubre 8, agud istoryahan sang myembro sang mayorya ang pag-resign ni Lacson.
english: — ADVERTISEMENT —He added that he has convened a caucus tomorrow, October 8, to discuss Lacson's resignation with the majority members.

text: Padayon sagihapon nga gina-monitor ang tropical depression “DANTE” sa sulod sang Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR).
english: Tropical depression “DANTE” is still being monitored within the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR).

text: Ang isa pagid ka Low Pressure Area (LPA) ang gina-monitor man sa sulod sang PAR kag may “MEDIUM” nga potensyal nga mag-develop sa isa ka tropical depression sa sulod sang masunod nga 24 ka oras.
english: Another Low Pressure Area (LPA) is also being monitored within the PAR and has “MEDIUM” potential to develop into a tropical depression within the next 24 hours.

text: Samtang, may yara man sang isa pa ka LPA ang gibantayan sa gwa sang PAR nga may “MEDIUM” man nga potensyal nga mag-develop sa isa ka tropical depression sa sulod sang masunod nga 24 ka oras.
english: Meanwhile, another LPA is also monitored outside the PAR with “MEDIUM” potential to develop into a tropical depression within the next 24 hours.

text: Nagtakop ang 2022 campaign sang women’s football team sang Pilipinas paagi sa pagpaulan sang goals kag paglutos sa Papua New Guinea, 9-0, sa international friendly game sa Wanderers Football Park sa Sydney, Australia.
english: The Philippines' women's football team ended its 2022 campaign by scoring goals and beating Papua New Guinea, 9-0, in an international friendly at Wanderers Football Park in Sydney, Australia.

text: Diri nga hampang una nga naka-hat trick si Quinley Quezada sa iya nga football career ukon ang pag-skor sang tatlo ka goals sa isa lamang ka game.
english: This game was the first time Quinley Quezada scored a hat trick in his football career or scoring three goals in one game.

text: Duha ka beses naman nga naka-skor si Katrina Guillou.
english: Katrina Guillou scored twice.

text: Daku ini nga kadalag-an sa Filipinas bangud yara sa ika-51 nga pwesto ang Papua New Guinea sa women’s world rankings, mas mataas sa ranking sang Pilipinas.
english: This is a big victory for the Philippines as Papua New Guinea is ranked 51st in the women's world rankings, higher than the Philippines.

text: Ini ang ikaduha nga bes nga nalutos sang Pilipinas ang Papua New Guinea kasunod sang ila una nga pagsumpunganay sang Disyembre 11 nga nagtakop sa skor nga 5-1 pabor sa Filipinas.
english: This is the second time the Philippines have defeated Papua New Guinea following their first match on December 11 which ended with a score of 5-1 in favor of the Philippines.

text: Suno kay Coach Alen Stajcic, ini ang ika-29 kag ika-30 nga match sang Filipinas subong nga 2022.
english: According to Coach Alen Stajcic, these are the 29th and 30th matches of the Philippines in 2022.

text: Maragtason ini nga tuig para sa Pilipinas bangud subong sila naa-qualify para sa 2-23 Fifa Women’s World Cup kag subong man nga tuig naangkon ang kampyeonato sa Asean Football Federation Women’s Championship.
english: This is a historic year for the Philippines as they have now qualified for the 2-23 Fifa Women's World Cup and this year won the Asean Football Federation Women's Championship.

text: Nangin bronze medalists man ang Pilipians sa Southeast Asian Games sa Vietnam subong nga 2022.
english: The Pilipians also became bronze medalists at the Southeast Asian Games in Vietnam this 2022.

text: Ginbaton sang United States District Court – Central District of California ang guilty plea sang duha ka mga administrador sang religious group nga Kingdom of Jesus Christ (KOJC).
english: The United States District Court – Central District of California accepted the guilty plea of ​​two administrators of the religious group Kingdom of Jesus Christ (KOJC).

text: Base sa court documents, nagmandu na si Judge Terry J. Hatter Jr.
english: According to court documents, Judge Terry J. Hatter Jr. ordered the trial.

text: sa pagpreparar sang pre-sentence report para kanday Amanda Estopare kag Guia Cabactulan.
english: in preparing the pre-sentence report for Amanda Estopare and Guia Cabactulan.

text: Ang ila pag-plead sang guilty ang naangot sa Count 7 sang First Superseding Indictment nga amo ang visa fraud.
english: Their plea of ​​guilty is related to Count 7 of the First Superseding Indictment which is visa fraud.

text: Ginkweston sang judge sanday Estopare kag Cabactulan kaangot sa plea agreement sa US District Attorney’s Office sang Oktubre, kag ginkumpirma sang duha nga boluntaryo sila nga nag-ako nga guilty kag pareho nga nahangpan ang terms sang agreement.
english: The judge questioned Estopare and Cabactulan regarding the plea agreement with the US District Attorney's Office in October, and the two confirmed that they voluntarily pleaded guilty and both understood the terms of the agreement.

text: Bilang resulta, temporaryo sila nga ginhilway sang korte matapos nakapyansa.
english: As a result, they were temporarily released by the court after posting bail.

text: Dapat sila magsunod sa mga kondisyon sang korte sa tion sang pag-release sa ila.
english: They must comply with court conditions at the time of their release.

text: Ang duha ka mga akusado ang napaidalom subong sa superbisyon sang probation office kag natalana nga sentensyahan sa Abril 21, 2025.
english: Both defendants are currently under the supervision of the probation office and are scheduled to be sentenced on April 21, 2025.

text: Base sa mga dokumento sa korte, umpisa sang 2015 tubtub sa Enero 2020, ang defendants kag iban pa ang may kasugtanan nga magkomiter sang marriage fraud.
english: According to court documents, from 2015 until January 2020, the defendants and others had an agreement to commit marriage fraud.

text: Sila ang nag-arrange para sa mga miyembro sang KOJC — nga ginpadala ni Pastor Apollo Quiboloy sa Estados Unidos — para nga makasulod sa peke nga kasal sa iban pa nga KOJC members nga US citizens.
english: They arranged for KOJC members — sent by Pastor Apollo Quiboloy to the United States — to enter into fake marriages with other KOJC members who were US citizens.

text: Tuyo sini nga maka-apply sila para sa permanent resident status.
english: The aim is to enable them to apply for permanent resident status.

text: Matandaan nga una na nga nadakpan sang Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) sanday Cabactulan kag Marissa Duenas nga isa man ka KOJC administrator sa KOJC office sa Van Nuys, California, samtang si Estopare naman ang nadakpan sa Virginia sang 2020.
english: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) previously arrested Cabactulan and Marissa Duenas, who is also a KOJC administrator at the KOJC office in Van Nuys, California, while Estopare was arrested in Virginia in 2020.

text: Ang US District Court for the Central District of California ang una naman nagbaton sang guilty plea ni Duenas.
english: The US District Court for the Central District of California initially accepted Duenas' guilty plea.

text: Natalana ang iya sentensya sa masunod man nga tuig.
english: His sentencing is also scheduled for next year.

text: Itinalaga ni Pangulong Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. appointed

text: si Secretary of Justice Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla bilang bagong Ombudsman of the Republic of the Philippines, matapos ang pagtatapos ng termino ni Hon. Samuel R. Martires noong Hulyo.
english: Secretary of Justice Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla as the new Ombudsman of the Republic of the Philippines, after the end of the term of Hon. Samuel R. Martires in July.

text: Si Remulla, na nagsilbi bilang ika-59 na Secretary of Justice mula pa noong Hunyo 2022, ay pinuri ng administrasyon sa mga repormang kanyang pinangunahan upang gawing moderno ang justice system.
english: Remulla, who served as the 59th Secretary of Justice since June 2022, was praised by the administration for the reforms he led to modernize the justice system.

text: Kabilang dito ang pagbawas sa siksikan ng mga bilangguan, pagpapabilis ng case resolution, at pagpapalawak ng access sa legal services.
english: This includes reducing prison overcrowding, speeding up case resolution, and expanding access to legal services.

text: Ayon sa pahayag ng Malacañang, ang mahigit ilang dekadang karanasan ni Remulla bilang legislator, gobernador, at abogado ay nagbigay sa kanya ng malawak na respeto dahil sa kanyang integridad at paninindigan sa public service.
english: According to Malacañang, Remulla's more than several decades of experience as a legislator, governor, and lawyer have earned him widespread respect for his integrity and commitment to public service.

text: Binigyang-diin ng administrasyon na nananatili itong determinado sa paglaban sa korapsyon sa lahat ng antas ng pamahalaan.
english: The administration stressed that it remains determined to fight corruption at all levels of government.

text: Bilang Ombudsman, inaasahan si Remulla na pangunahan ang pagpapatibay ng transparency, pagpapatupad ng anti-corruption measures, at pagtiyak na ang justice system ay umiiral nang patas at mahusay.
english: As Ombudsman, Remulla is expected to lead the way in strengthening transparency, implementing anti-corruption measures, and ensuring that the justice system operates fairly and efficiently.

text: Dagdag pa ng pahayag, nanindigan ang pamahalaan na “there will be no sacred cows, no exemptions, and no excuses,” na nangangahulugang pananagutin ang sinumang lumalabag sa tiwala ng publiko.
english: The statement added that the government insists that “there will be no sacred cows, no exemptions, and no excuses,” which means that anyone who violates public trust will be held accountable.

text: Muling iginiit ni Pangulong Marcos na ang transparency, fairness, at rule of law ang mananatiling gabay ng kanyang administrasyon sa pagpapatuloy ng Bagong Pilipinas na tunay na naglilingkod sa sambayanang Pilipino./JDS
english: President Marcos reiterated that transparency, fairness, and rule of law will remain the guiding principles of his administration in continuing the New Philippines that truly serves the Filipino people./JDS

text: Gin-athag sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) nga wala sang kamatuoran ang kidnapping incident nga naglapta sa syudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: The Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) clarified that there is no truth in the kidnapping incident that spread in Iloilo City and province.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Rolando Araño, spokesperson sang IPPO, iya ginpahayag nga sa ila pagpatuman sang madalom nga imbestigasyon, nagaguwa nga wala sang basehan ang mga nagalapta nga impormasyon nga may kidnap nga nagakatabo sa probinsya kag syudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Rolando Araño, spokesperson of the IPPO, said that in their conduct of in-depth investigation, it turns out that there is no basis for the information spreading that there is kidnapping happening in the province and the city.

text: Suno kay Araño, sa amo nga mga hitabo, ang IPPO naghimo sang proactive measures agud masabat ang sitwasyon.
english: According to Araño, in such incidents, the IPPO has taken proactive measures to address the situation.

text: Ang tanan nga mga kumander sang yunit ginhingyo nga makig-angot sa mga otoridad sang eskwelahan sa pagtudlo sa mga estudyante sa importansya sang pag-verify sang impormasyon, ilabi na gikan sa socialmedia.
english: All unit commanders have been asked to engage with school authorities to educate students on the importance of verifying information, especially from socialmedia.

text: Nagpasalig man ang talatapan nga committed sila sa pagpasanyog sang ihibalo sang publiko nahanungod sa katalagman sang pagpati kag pagpalapnag sang peke nga balita.
english: The office also assured that they are committed to raising public awareness about the dangers of believing and spreading fake news.

text: Dugang pa, ginadugangan man sang IPPO ang police visibility sa mga eskwelahan kag naga-coordinate sa Liga ng mga Barangay agud ma-mobilize ang mga Barangay Tanod para sa enhanced community safety.
english: In addition, the IPPO is also increasing police visibility in schools and coordinating with the League of Barangays to mobilize Barangay Tanods for enhanced community safety.

text: Makahalanusbo para kay Araño nga ang iban nga indibidwal iresponsable nga nagapaambit sang nagapatalang nga impormasyon online, nga wala ginasapak ang posible negatibo nga epekto sa komunidad.
english: It is concerning to Araño that some individuals irresponsibly share misleading information online, ignoring the potential negative impact on the community.

text: Nag-courtesy call sanday Land Transportation Office (LTO) Region 6 Regional Director, Atty. Gaudioso P. Geduspan II kag Assistant Regional Director Jeck D. Conlu kay Police Regional Office 6 (PRO 6) Regional Director Police Brigadier General Josefino Ligan.
english: Land Transportation Office (LTO) Region 6 Regional Director, Atty. Gaudioso P. Geduspan II and Assistant Regional Director Jeck D. Conlu to Police Regional Office 6 (PRO 6) Regional Director Police Brigadier General Josefino Ligan.

text: Lakip sa ila nga mga gin istoryahan amo ang pagpabaskog sang koordinasyon sa tunga sang LTO kag Philippine National Police paagi sa pag implementar sang mga layi sa dalanon sa bilog nga rehiyon.
english: Among the topics discussed was the strengthening of coordination between the LTO and the Philippine National Police through the implementation of traffic laws throughout the region.

text: Gin-introduce man diri ni Ligan ang bag-o a Firearm Simulation System kung sa diin gindesignar ini agud mag-improve sang skills, alertness kag tactical response sang mga police officers sa tion sang high-risk scenarios.
english: Ligan also introduced the new Firearm Simulation System which is designed to improve the skills, alertness and tactical response of police officers during high-risk scenarios.

english: By: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑯𝒂𝒏𝒏𝒂 𝑨𝒏𝒅𝒔𝒂

text: Magapabilin nga co-parent sa ila anak ang aktres nga si Michelle Madrigal kag bana nga si Troy Woolfolk sa pihak sang ila pagbulagay.
english: Actress Michelle Madrigal and husband Troy Woolfolk will remain co-parents to their son despite their separation.

text: Suno kay Michelle, magapabilin sila nga mag-abyanay ni Troy para sa ila anak nga si Anika.
english: Michelle says she and Troy will remain friends for the sake of their daughter, Anika.

text: Luyag sang aktres nga hatagan anay sila sang space kag respeto sa ila nangin desisyon sang bana.
english: The actress wants to give them space and respect for their husband's decision.

text: Nakuhaan sang P1.7-million nga balor sang suspected shabu ang 26-anyos nga babaye sa ginkasa nga buy bust operation sang otoridad sa Brgy.
english: A 26-year-old woman was recovered with P1.7-million worth of suspected shabu in a buy bust operation in Brgy.

text: Jibao-an, Pavia, Iloilo.
english: Jibao-an, Pavia, Iloilo.

text: Ang subject amo si Alyas Tata, isa ka High Value Individual (HVI), wala sang ubra, residente sang Brgy Binawbawan, Pilar, Capiz apang temporaryo nga nagatinir sa amo nga barangay sa Pavia.
english: The subject was identified as Tata, a High Value Individual (HVI), unemployed, resident of Brgy Binawbawan, Pilar, Capiz but temporarily staying in the said barangay in Pavia.

text: Naglab-ot sa 260 ka gramos sang suspected shabu ang nakumpiskar sa iya nga possession.
english: A total of 260 grams of suspected shabu were seized from his possession.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Dadje Delima, chief sang Iloilo Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit (PDEU), iya ginpahayag nga naglab-ot sa malapit isa ka bulan ang monitoring sa subject antes natigayon ang operasyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Dadje Delima, chief of the Iloilo Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit (PDEU), said the monitoring of the subject lasted for nearly a month before the operation was conducted.

text: Santo sa inisyal nga imbestigasyon, sa Roxas City kag Calumpang, Molo ini nagakuha sang iya nga supply.
english: According to initial investigation, he gets his supply from Roxas City and Calumpang, Molo.

text:

english:
