text: Gin-appoint na ni President Marcos si Department of Justice (DOJ) Secretary Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla bilang bag-o nga  Ombudsman.
english: President Marcos has appointed Department of Justice (DOJ) Secretary Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla as the new Ombudsman.

text: Ginhimo sang Malacañang ang  announcement subong nga adlaw, Oktubre 7.
english: Malacañang made the announcement today, October 7.

text: Ang pag-appoint kay Remulla ang kasunod sang pagretiro ni former Ombudsman Samuel Martires sang Hulyo.
english: Remulla's appointment follows the retirement of former Ombudsman Samuel Martires in July.

text: Yari ang official announcement sang Malacañang:
english: Here is the official announcement of Malacañang:

text: ILOILO CITY – Ang pagkontrol sang pagtaas sang presyo sang mga balaklon ang nagapanguna nga “urgent national concern” sa subong basi sa survey sang OCTA Research Group.
english: ILOILO CITY – Controlling the rise in commodity prices is the most urgent national concern based on a survey by the OCTA Research Group.

text: Sa ginpatigayon nga survey sang Marso 25, 52% sang mga respondents ang nagpahayag nga dapat solusyunan sang gobyerno ang pagsipa sang presyo sang mga balaklon.
english: In a survey conducted on March 25, 52% of respondents said the government should solve the price hike.

text: Ang ikaduha nga urgent national concern amo ang pagpasaka sang sweldo nga may 43% nga ginsundan sang access sang pagkaon kaangay sang bugas, utan kag karne nga ginsabat sang 41% sa mga respondents.
english: The second urgent national concern is salary increase with 43% followed by access to food such as rice, vegetables and meat which was answered by 41% of respondents.

text: Suno kay OCTA fellow Ranjit Rye, importante nga masolusyunan ini sang gobyerno.
english: According to OCTA fellow Ranjit Rye, it is important that the government solves this.

text: Ginapanan-aw nga amo man ini sa gihapon ang sentimyento sang publiko sa incoming administration kag mangita man ang pagtaas sang trend sang isyu may kaangtanan sa inflation.
english: It is expected that the public sentiment will remain the same for the incoming administration and the trend of inflation-related issues will also increase.

text: Suno naman kay George Siy, pinuno sang Integrated Development Studies Institute, indi man direkta ang epekto sang gyera sa tunga sang Russia kag Ukraine apang dako naman ang epekto sini sa inflation.
english: George Siy, head of the Integrated Development Studies Institute, said the war between Russia and Ukraine is not directly affecting inflation.

text: Dumilian ang popular short video app nga TikTok sa Albania sa sulod sang isa ka tuig kasunod sang kamatayon sang isa ka teenager sang nagligad nga bulan nga amo ang nagpasaka sang kahangawa sa malain nga impluwensiya sang social media sa kabataan.
english: Popular short video app TikTok will be banned in Albania for a year following the death of a teenager last month which raised concerns about the harmful influence of social media on children.

text: Suno kay Prime Minister Edi Rama, natalana nga umpisahan ang pag-ban sa TikTok sa Enero 2025.
english: According to Prime Minister Edi Rama, the ban on TikTok is scheduled to begin in January 2025.

text: “For one year, we’ll be completely shutting it down for everyone.
english: “For one year, we’ll be completely shutting it down for everyone.

text: There will be no TikTok in Albania,” pahayag sang opisyal sa meeting sang grupo sang mga ginikanan kag mga manunudlo.
english: There will be no TikTok in Albania,” the official said at a meeting of the group of parents and teachers.

text: Ini nga tikang sang gobyerno ang kasunod sang natabo nga insidente kun sa diin napatay gid ang 14-anyos nga estudyante nga lalaki matapos ginbuno sang kaangay man nga estudyante.
english: The government's move follows an incident in which a 14-year-old male student was stabbed to death by a fellow student.

text: Base sa local reports, may baisay nga natabo sa tunga sang suspek kag biktima sa social media.
english: According to local reports, there was an argument between the suspect and the victim on social media.

text: Magluwas diri, may videos pa nga nagguwa sa TikTok kun sa diin may mga menor de edad nga nagpahayag sang ila suporta sa amo nga pagpatay.
english: In addition, there are videos that have appeared on TikTok where some minors expressed their support for the killing.

text: Bangud sini, ginbasol sang prime minister ang social media ilabi naang TikTok sa paggatong sang kapintas sa mga kabataan sa sulod kag guwa sang eskwelahan.
english: The prime minister blamed social media, especially TikTok, for fueling violence against children inside and outside schools.

text: “The problem today is not our children, the problem today is us, the problem today is our society, the problem today is TikTok and all the others that are taking our children hostage,” pahayag ni Rama.
english: “The problem today is not our children, the problem today is us, the problem today is our society, the problem today is TikTok and all the others that are taking our children hostage,” Rama said.

text: Nagsabat naman ang TikTok nga mangayo ini sang klaripikasyon halin sa Albanian government ilabi na bangud wala man sang ebidensya nga may TikTok accounts ang pertpetrator kag ang biktima.
english: TikTok responded that it will seek clarification from the Albanian government especially since there is no evidence that the perpetrator and the victim have TikTok accounts.

text: “We found no evidence that the perpetrator or victim had TikTok accounts, and multiple reports have in fact confirmed videos leading up to this incident were being posted on another platform, not TikTok,” suno sa company spokesperson.
english: “We found no evidence that the perpetrator or victim had TikTok accounts, and multiple reports have in fact confirmed videos leading up to this incident were being posted on another platform, not TikTok,” according to the company spokesperson.

text: Antes sini, may mga pungsod na sa Europa kaangay sang France, Germany, kag Belgium nga nagpatuman sang restrictions sa social media para sa kabataan.
english: Earlier, European countries such as France, Germany, and Belgium had imposed restrictions on social media for children.

text: Sang damlag lang, gin-aprubahan naman sa Australia ang complete social media ban sa mga kabataan nga wala pa naka-16 anyos nga amo ang ginakabig isa sa pinakamabug-at nga regulasyon nga naga-target sa Big Tech.
english: Recently, Australia approved a complete social media ban on children under the age of 16, which is considered one of the toughest regulations targeting Big Tech.

text: Nagmando si Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel sa state-owned Food Terminal Inc.
english: Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel ordered the state-owned Food Terminal Inc.

text: (FTI) nga mag-alokar sang pondo para magbakal sang dako nga bulto sang katumbal kag munggo direkta sa mga lokal nga mangunguma.
english: (FTI) to allocate funds to purchase large bulk quantities of katumbal and munggo directly from local farmers.

text: Ini agud pabaskugon ang presyo sang katumbal kag munggo kag para mabuhinan man ang pag-import sang produkto sa iban nga pungsod.
english: This is to increase the price of medicines and munggo and to reduce the import of products from other countries.

text: Suno kay Tiu Laurel, ginakilala sang ahensya ang katumbal kag munggo bilang prayoridad nga high value crops subong nga tuig.
english: According to Tiu Laurel, the agency recognizes katumbal and munggo as priority high value crops this year.

text: Suno pa sa tiglikom nga dapat mag-umpisa na bakal ang Food Terminal Inc.
english: The secretary said that Food Terminal Inc. should start buying.

text: (FTI) sang tubtob 80% sang local production para mahikayat ang mga manug-tanom paagi sa sigurado nga mga manugbakal kag maprotektahan sila batok sa pabag-o bag-o nga presyo sa merkado.
english: (FTI) of up to 80% of local production to attract farmers through secure buyers and protect them against fluctuating market prices.

text: Ginlutos sang Gilas Pilipinas ang pungsod Guam sa FIBA World Cup Asian Qualifiers kahapon, Nobyembre 28, matapos sila magdaog sa daku nga abanse nga 87-46.
english: Gilas Pilipinas defeated Guam in the FIBA ​​World Cup Asian Qualifiers yesterday, November 28, after winning with a huge lead of 87-46.

text: Nagpangibabaw sa scoring si Justin Brownlee nga may 22 puntos, samtang nagbulig man sanday AJ Edu nga may walo ka puntos kag Dwight Ramos nga may 10 puntos sa dominante nga performance sang national team.
english: Justin Brownlee dominated the scoring with 22 points, while AJ Edu with eight points and Dwight Ramos with 10 also contributed to the dominant performance of the national team.

text: Magasambuwa liwat ang Gilas kag Guam sa Disyembre 1 sa Manila Blue Eagles Gym sa Quezon City.
english: Gilas and Guam will play again on December 1 at the Manila Blue Eagles Gym in Quezon City.

text:
Nagasalig ang head coach sang Gilas Pilipinas nga si Tim Cone sa suporta sang home crowd agud mapadayon ang momentum sang Gilas kag makuha ang 2-0 record sa Group A.

Magatutok na ang national team sa ila ikaduha nga hampang batuk sa Guam kag si Cone ang nagalaum sa paghugyaw sang mga Pinoy nga makahatag sang inspirasyon sa ila kag makuha ang 2-0 record sa Group A.
english:
Gilas Pilipinas head coach Tim Cone is counting on the support of the home crowd to keep the momentum of the Gilas and get a 2-0 record in Group A.

The national team will focus on their second game against Guam and Cone hopes the cheers of the Filipinos will inspire them and get a 2-0 record in Group A.

text: SOBRA-sobra kita kadamo nga wala pa kahibalo kag naka-intiendi kon ano ining Sovereign Wealth Fund (SWF) nga luyag tawgon ni Presidente BBM kag sang Kongreso nga Maharlika Fund.
english: TOO many of us do not know and understand what this Sovereign Wealth Fund (SWF) that President BBM and the Congress want to call the Maharlika Fund.

text: Lakip man gani seguro ang aton mga kongresista kag mga senador nga daw mga lipong nga bangros nga sunud-sunuran lang sa mga poderoso sa ibabaw.
english: Probably even our congressmen and senators who are like dizzy bangros who just follow the powerful above.

text: Ang mga Maharlika sa panahon sang aton kalolohan amo ining mga katapo sang ila sosyedad nga nagahari sa mga kubos nga ginahimo lang nila esklabo.
english: The Maharlikas of our grandfather’s time were these members of their society who ruled over the lowly whom they merely made slaves.

text: Salamat kay wala gid mapatuman ni Diktador Marcos ang pag-ilis sang ngalan sang Pilipinas sa Maharlika tungod sa Edsa Revolution.
english: Thankfully, Dictator Marcos never implemented the change of the name of the Philippines to Maharlika because of the Edsa Revolution.

text: Syempre indi naton luyag matabo liwat ini, although ang pila sa aton naga-esklabo gihapon sang madamo ta nga mga pumuluyo gamit ang ila private army kag mahigko nga manggad.
english: Of course we don't want this to happen again, although some of us are still enslaving many of our citizens using their private army and dirty wealth.

text:
***

Tungod sining kakulang nga ihibalo sa state-owned SWF, luyag naton diri dalhon sa bulig sang aton research kon ano gid ini.
english:
***

Given this lack of knowledge on state-owned SWF, we want to bring here with the help of our research what it really is.

text: Ang Norway ang nagpanguna sa pagpasanyog sang SWF nga naggamit sini para pang-invest sadtong 1996.
english: Norway took the lead in promoting the SWF using it for investment in 1996.

text: Ang purpose nila sini amo ang mag-build-up sang manggad halin sa surplus nga earnings nila halin sa oil kag gas kag i-invest sa bonds, treasury notes, shares kag iban pa.
english: Their purpose is to build-up wealth from their surplus earnings from oil and gas and invest in bonds, treasury notes, shares and others.

text: Panagang nila ini batok sa pag-collapse sang ila ekonomiya sa indi na mapunggan nga pagkaubos sang ila oil kag gas reserves sa sige man baligya sini, nga mayor gid ginasaligan nila sa pag-sustain sang ila ekonomiya, kag magamit nila ining SWF sa amat-amat man pag-diversify sang ila economic concerns.
english: This is their hedge against the collapse of their economy due to the unstoppable depletion of their oil and gas reserves, which they mainly rely on to sustain their economy, and they can use this SWF to gradually diversify their economic concerns.

text: Sunu sa Sovereign Wealth Fund Institute, ang Norway isa sang pinakadaku nga investor sa stocks (share of ownership) nga nagapanag-iya sang $667 Billion ka shares sa sobra 9,000 ka kompaniya worldwide, lakip na ang Apple kag Microsoft.
english: According to the Sovereign Wealth Fund Institute, Norway is one of the largest investors in stocks (share of ownership) owning $667 billion in shares in over 9,000 companies worldwide, including Apple and Microsoft.

text: Ang pila pa ka nagapanguna nga mga pungsod sa pagtukod sang SWF nga gina-finance sang oil kag gas amo ang Abu Dhabi, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia kag Qatar.
english: Some other leading countries in the establishment of oil and gas-financed SWFs are Abu Dhabi, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia and Qatar.

text: Ini nga mga pungsod mayor nagasalig sang ila ekonomiya sa ila natural reserves nga oil kag gas.
english: These countries mainly depend their economies on their natural reserves of oil and gas.

text: In fact, ang Saudi Arabia sa karon amat-amat na gani tukod sang mga proyekto sa enerhiya halin sa solar kag wind energy.
english: In fact, Saudi Arabia is now slowly building energy projects from solar and wind energy.

text: Pati na gani ang pag-producir sang Green Technology.
english: Even the production of Green Technology.

text: Ang Japan naman gaproblema sa madasig pagdaku sang iya elderly population kag amat-amat paghuyang sang iya workforce kag ginagamit sini ang iya SWF agud maseguro ang ila pension fund kag pagpasanyog sang labor kag individual enterprise market.
english: Japan, on the other hand, is struggling with the rapid growth of its elderly population and the gradual weakening of its workforce and is using its SWF to secure its pension fund and promote the labor and individual enterprise market.

text:
***

In other words, ang importante gid nga role sang SWF amo ang magpadayon sang mga priority programs sa ila survival paagi sa ila surplus earnings nga indi mahimo sang iban nga economic activities, katulad sang limitado nila nga domestic individual enterprises kag foreign trade.
english:
***

In other words, the most important role of SWFs is to maintain priority programs in their survival through their surplus earnings that other economic activities, such as their limited domestic individual enterprises and foreign trade, cannot.

text: May amo man bala kita nga mga problema sa aton pungsod agud itukod ang SWF tungod amo gid lang ini ang makabulong sa aton ekonomiya?
english: Do we have the same problems in our country to establish the SWF because it is the only thing that can cure our economy?

text: Well, wala kita sing surplus nga matudlo agud itukod ang SWF.
english: Well, we don’t have a surplus to point to to build the SWF.

text: Obvious indi bala?
english: Obvious right?

text: Wala man kita sang economic concern nga mayor gid naton ginasaligan agud kahadlukan gid sing lubos ang pag-collapse sang aton ekonomiya.
english: We don't have an economic concern that we rely on so much to fear the collapse of our economy.

text: Diversified man ang aton economic concerns kon diin makakita sing solusyon dira mismo sa ining mga economic concerns nga indi kahadlukan ang pag-collapse sang aton ekonomiya tungod lang sa isa ka economic concern katulad sang oil kag gas.
english: Our economic concerns are also diversified where we can find solutions to these economic concerns without fear of the collapse of our economy just because of one economic concern such as oil and gas.

text: Wais man ang aton mga ekonmista sa foreign trade kay trade balancing ang aton hampang.
english: Our economists are also wise in foreign trade because trade balancing is our game.

text: Segurista man ang aton economic experts sa pag-pautang sang government development funds halin sa Land Bank, DPB, kag pati na halin sa Pag-IBIG, sa negosyo sa bonds, treasury issues kag iban pa nga financial transactions.
english: Our economic experts are also security guards in the lending of government development funds from the Land Bank, DPB, and also from Pag-IBIG, in the business of bonds, treasury issues and other financial transactions.

text: In fact, delikado gani ang luyag sang iban nga gamiton ang mga pondo sang SSS, GSIS kag kasubong nga mga security funds kay base ipuslit nila ini sa IRR sang Maharlika Fund Law, kag madisgrasya pa ang mga pondo sang mga retirees kag welfare beneficiaries katulad sang 4Ps.
english: In fact, it is dangerous for some to use the funds of SSS, GSIS and similar security funds because they will smuggle them into the IRR of the Maharlika Fund Law, and the funds of retirees and welfare beneficiaries such as 4Ps will be in danger.

text: Out of place naman kita sa pagpasanyog sang aton SWF.
english: We are out of place in promoting our SWF.

text: Yara na ang mga mas dalagku nga mga SWF.
english: The larger SWFs are already there.

text: Mga 40 ini sila tanan kag segurado indi kita maka-compete sa ila.
english: There are about 40 of them in all and we certainly can't compete with them.

text: Wala naman naton ginapabay-an ang aton mga utang.
english: We do not neglect our debts.

text: Gina-privatize naman gani naton ang pila ka government entities, katulad sang NAIA kag Iloilo Internatrional Airport, agud makuhaan sing income kag buhis kag ma-improve ang operations sini.
english: We are even privatizing some government entities, such as NAIA and Iloilo International Airport, to generate revenue and taxes and improve their operations.

text: Ginapatuman man naton sing maayo ang magpasanyog sang agricultura, infra, environment kag away sa Climate Change.
english: We are also implementing the promotion of agriculture, infra, environment and the fight against Climate Change.

text: Ti, ano pa ang aton kinahanglan sa Maharlika Fund?
english: Well, what else do we need from the Maharlika Fund?

text: Para sa pulitika kag agud makwartahan sang mga corrupt?/PN
english: For politics and to make money for the corrupt?/PN

text: Naospital ang ginabanta 10 ka mga pasahero sang isa ka jeep matapos nahulog sa banglid sa Barangay San Antonio, San Pedro City, Laguna sang Pebrero 10.
english: About 10 passengers of a jeep were hospitalized after it fell off a hill in Barangay San Antonio, San Pedro City, Laguna on February 10.

text: Ginpahayag nga nadulaan sang preno ang jeep.
english: The jeep reportedly lost its brakes.

text: Nakabunggo anay ini sa steel railing antes nagdiretso sa banglid.
english: It hit a steel railing before heading down the hill.

text: Nagkulob gid ang amo nga jeep.
english: The jeep overturned.

text: Gilayon naman nga nagresponde ang mga rescuers kag ginpangdala sa ospital ang mga biktima.
english: Rescuers immediately responded and took the victims to the hospital.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sa natabo nga disgrasya.
english: The investigation into the accident is ongoing.

text: ILOILO CITY- Masobra sa katunga sang populasyon sang kalibutan ang mangin overweight ukob obese pag-abot sang tuig 2035, base sa bag-o nga pagtuon.
english: ILOILO CITY – More than half of the world's population will be overweight and obese by 2035, according to a new study.

text: Ginapanan-aw sang World Obesity Federation’s 2023 atlas nga 51% sang populasyon ukon masobra 4 billion ka tawo ang mangin obese ukon overweight.
english: The World Obesity Federation’s 2023 atlas predicts that 51% of the population or more than 4 billion people will be obese or overweight.

text: Nakit-an nga nagataas ang rates sang obesity partikular sa mga bata sa lower income countries.
english: Rates of obesity have been found to be increasing particularly among children in lower income countries.

text: Suno kay World Obesity Federation president Louise Baur,maathag nga paandam ini gani kinahanglan nga aktuhan na ini sang mga gobyerno kag mga policymakers agud malikawan nga maglala ang sitwasyon.
english: According to World Obesity Federation president Louise Baur, this is a clear warning and governments and policymakers need to act on it to avoid worsening the situation.

text: Santo sa report, ang childhood obesity ang posible nga magtimbuok sa 208 million sa mga lalaki kag 175 million sa mga babaye sa 2035.
english: According to the report, childhood obesity is likely to increase to 208 million in men and 175 million in women by 2035.

text: Ginbisitahan sang Pollution Control Team ang sitwasyon sang ginpa-Bombo nga nagasupot nga waste water sa Laurea Subdivision Zone 7 Buhang Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: The Pollution Control Team visited the situation of the waste water that was bombed in Laurea Subdivision Zone 7 Buhang Jaro, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Engr.

text: Niel Ravena, head sang Iloilo City General Services Office, iya ginpahayag nga matapos ang ila initial findings sa lugar may ara sang patigayunon nga hearing buwas nga adlaw, Marso 25.
english: Niel Ravena, head of the Iloilo City General Services Office, said that after their initial findings in the area, a hearing will be held tomorrow, March 25.

text: Ini agud ma-eksplikar sang tag-iya kun poso negro bala ini kag kun ano ang rason sang nagasupot nga tubig kun sa diin naga-usbong na ang baho kag delikado sa ikaayong lawas sang mga tawo nga naga-istar sa lugar.
english: This is to explain to the owner whether it is a black well and what is the reason for the stagnant water where the smell is already rising and dangerous to the health of the people living in the area.

text: Suno pa kay Ravena, dapat may mga tikang nga obrahon agud indi maapektuhan ang iban nga pumuluyo.
english: Ravena said measures should be taken to prevent other residents from being affected.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga sa hearing nga matabo lantawon sang hearing officer kun ano ang violations sang tag-iya kag isa-isahon man sang mga ini ang problema agud matagaan sang solusyon.
english: He also said that in the hearing that will take place, the hearing officer will look at the violations of the owner and they will also look at the problems one by one to provide a solution.

text: Dugang pa sini nga magapirma sang commitment ang ginreklamo kun ano bala ang dapat obrahon kag ipa-notarize ini.
english: He added that the complainant will sign a commitment on what should be done and have it notarized.

text: Nahibaluan nga ini nga problema ang halin pa sang 2024 apang padayon sa gihapon nga naga-perwisyo sa mga pumuluyo sa lugar.
english: It is known that this problem has been going on since 2024 but continues to affect the residents of the area.

text: Suno pa kay Ravena nga ila pagatagaan sang solusyon ang ini nga problema agud indi na makapanghalit sa ikaayong lawas sang mga apektado.
english: Ravena said they will find a solution to this problem so that it will not harm the health of the affected.

text: Kun nagakaon kita sa guwa apang daw indi manami ang pagkaon kag eksperyensya, masami nga nagabawi kita sa reviews.
english: When we eat out but the food and experience seems unpleasant, we often fall back on reviews.

text: Apang ini nga reviews amo ang rason kun ngaa tuman ang kaakig sang isa ka ramen shop sa Japan nga nagpamahog pa sa kabuhi sang duha ka customer nga wala nanamian sa ila serbisyo.
english: But these reviews are the reason why a ramen shop in Japan is so angry that it even threatened the lives of two customers who did not like their service.

text: Natabo ini matapos nagbilin ang duha ka customer sang isa gid lamang ka star sa rating sa ila nga ramen shop.
english: This happened after two customers left only one star in the rating of their ramen shop.

text: Bangud top-rated ramen shop ang TOYOJIRO sa Kyoto, naakig ang tag-iya kag nag-rant sa social media.
english: Because TOYOJIRO is a top-rated ramen shop in Kyoto, the owner got angry and ranted on social media.

text: Sa sobra sini nga kaugot, gin-post sini pati ang picture sang mga customer.
english: In his anger, he even posted the picture of the customers.

text: Ginhangkat pa niya ini nga magbalik, magkaon liwat, kag magsulat man sang maayo nga review kag ibutang ang ila laragway.
english: He even challenged her to come back, eat again, and also write a good review and put their picture.

text: Nagsiling ang tag-iya nga indi gid sila pagpasensyahon kun indi nila ini paghimuon.
english: The owner said they wouldn't be tolerated if they didn't.

text: Nag-post man ini nga magahatag siya sang padya nga 100,000 yen (PhP38,700) sa kay bisan sin-o nga makahatag sang impormasyon kaangot sa duha ka mga customer.
english: He also posted that he would offer a reward of 100,000 yen (PhP38,700) to anyone who could provide information about the two customers.

text: Bangud sa ginhimo sang tag-iya, naglapta ang gintanyag sini nga reward, apang sa baylo nga magpabor sa iya ang sitwasyon, ginsaway siya sang mga tawo kag ginsugo nga mag-sorry.
english: Because of the owner's actions, the reward he offered spread, but instead of the situation going in his favor, people criticized him and ordered him to apologize.

text: Sang ulihi, nag-ako ang tag-iya nga daw nasobrahan gid man ang iya ginhimo, gani maga-move on na siya kag maga-reflect sa iya ginhimo.
english: Later, the owner admitted that he had gone too far, so he would move on and reflect on what he had done.

text: “I know there are pros and cons.
english: “I know there are pros and cons.

text: For an act that went too far.
english: For an act that went too far.

text: I’m reflecting on this,” Instagram post sang tag-iya sang ramen shop.
english: I’m reflecting on this,” the ramen shop owner’s Instagram post.

text: “Looking forward to continuing to reflect and move forward.
english: “Looking forward to continuing to reflect and move forward.

text:
Thank you.”

Nag-post man ang restaurant sang separado nga public apology.
english:
Thank you.”

The restaurant also posted a separate public apology.

text: Ginpabugal man nila nga naangkon nila ang champion status sa largest ramen site sa Japan nga Ramen Database isa ka bulan pa lang matapos ang ila opening, apang nagsiling nga ginahinulsulan gid nila ang ila aktwasyon.
english: They also bragged about earning champion status on Japan's largest ramen site Ramen Database just a month after their opening, but said they deeply regretted their action.

text: “Our restaurant, which achieved champion status on Japan’s largest ramen site, Ramen Database, just one month after opening, deeply regrets the recent incident we have caused,” kabahin sang statement.
english: “Our restaurant, which achieved champion status on Japan’s largest ramen site, Ramen Database, just one month after opening, deeply regrets the recent incident we have caused,” part of the statement.

text: “However, this incident has resulted in a shameful outcome for us,” dugang sang restaurant.
english: “However, this incident has resulted in a shameful outcome for us,” the restaurant added.

text: “We are committed to transforming ourselves and becoming a ramen restaurant that is truly supported by customers from around the world.”#
english: “We are committed to transforming ourselves and becoming a ramen restaurant that is truly supported by customers from around the world.”#

text: Indi maga-partisipar ang Vatican sa “Board of Peace” ni US President Donald Trump.
english: The Vatican will not participate in US President Donald Trump’s “Board of Peace”.

text: Suno kay Cardinal Pietro Parolin, top diplomat sang Vatican, ini bangud sa lain nga aspeto sang board kag ginpunto man sini ang pagpamuno sa krisis sang pungsod nga dapat iga-manage sang United Nations.
english: According to Cardinal Pietro Parolin, top diplomat of the Vatican, this is due to a different aspect of the board and he also pointed out the leadership of the country's crisis that must be managed by the United Nations.

text: Sa matandaan nga ang ini nga Board of Peace, ginlunsyar matapos ang plano ni Trump sa Gaza nga temporaryo sini nga pamunuan ang pungsod kag posible nga pagatutukan man ang global conflicts sini nga ginapangatubang.
english: The Board of Peace was launched after Trump's plan in Gaza to temporarily lead the country and possibly focus on the global conflicts it is facing.

text: Patigayunon ang ila labing una nga pagpakighinun-anon sa Washington sa Estados Unidos kun sa diin ila paga-istoryahan kag pagatutukan ang rekonstruksyon sang Gaza.
english: They will hold their first meeting in Washington in the United States where they will discuss and focus on the reconstruction of Gaza.

text: Magatambong man ang pila ka mga pungsod kaangay sang Italy kag European Union nga magaserbe bilang obserbador.
english: Several countries such as Italy and the European Union will also attend to serve as observers.

text: Nahibaluan nga naka-agom sang madamo nga kritisismo ang ini nga inisyatiba bangud sa kakulangan sang representasyon sang Palestinian.
english: It is known that this initiative has received a lot of criticism due to the lack of Palestinian representation.

text: Ginakonsidera man ang pagkapreho sini sa isa ka colonial nga estruktura nga nagadala sang pangduha-duha nga basi magalapas ini sa United Nations.
english: It is also considered its similarity to a colonial structure that raises doubts that it might violate the United Nations.

text: Sa karon padayon ang humanitarisan crisis nga ginapangatubang sa Gaza ginakonsidera sang pila ka mga human rights experts bilang genocide.
english: The humanitarian crisis facing Gaza continues to be considered by some human rights experts as genocide.

text: Ang Santo Papa, nga kritiko sang pila ka mga polisiya ni Trump ang malaka lang nagatambong sa kaangay sini nga Board kag padayon ang pagpakigbato sini sa human rights sang nasambit nga pungsod.
english: The Pope, who is a critic of some of Trump's policies, rarely attends such boards and continues to fight for the country's human rights.

text: Patay ang apat ka mga tawo sa southwest Turkey sang nagbunggo ang ambulance helicopter sa isa ka building sang ospital.
english: Four people were killed in southwestern Turkey when an ambulance helicopter crashed into a hospital building.

text: Suno sa Turkish Health Ministry, naga-take off ang helicopter halin sa Mugla Training and Research Hospital agud may kuhaon kuntani nga pasyente sa kaiping nga probinsya sang Antalya.
english: According to the Turkish Health Ministry, the helicopter was taking off from the Mugla Training and Research Hospital to pick up a patient in the neighboring province of Antalya.

text: Apang bangud sa madamol nga fog ukon poor visibility, nakaigu ang helicopter sa ikaapat nga panalgan sang building antes dalayon nga nagtibusok sa duta.
english: However, due to heavy fog or poor visibility, the helicopter hit the fourth floor of the building before immediately crashing to the ground.

text: Wala sang napatay ukon nasamaran nga yara mismo sa bulding apang ginbawian sang kabuhi ang tanan nga sakay sang aircraft nga amo ang duha ka mga piloto, isa ka doktor, kag isa pa gid ka empleyado.
english: No one in the building was killed or injured but all on board the aircraft, including two pilots, a doctor, and another employee, died.

text: Padayon pa subong ang imbestigasyon kaangot sa amo nga hitabo.
english: The investigation into the incident is ongoing.

text: Nagluntad ini nga insidente duha ka semana lamang matapos napatay man ang anum ka mga soldado sang nagbungguanay ang duha ka mga helicopter sa training exercise sang army sa southwestern Isparta province sa amo man nga pungsod.
english: The incident comes just two weeks after six soldiers were also killed when two helicopters collided during an army training exercise in southwestern Isparta province in the same country.

text: Padayon sa gihapon ang pagpangayo sang klaro nga update ni Gobernador Arthur “Toto” Defensor Jr.
english: Governor Arthur “Toto” Defensor Jr. continues to seek a clear update.

text: sa estado sang Aganan Flyover kag iban pa nga proyekto sang national government nga yara sa probinsiya sang Iloilo.
english: in the state of the Aganan Flyover and other projects of the national government in the province of Iloilo.

text: Antes pa man ginpadala ang sulat kay Department of Public Works and Highways Secretary Vince Dizon, ginpahayag nga madugay na ini nga ginamonitor sang provincial government.
english: Even before the letter was sent to Department of Public Works and Highways Secretary Vince Dizon, he said the provincial government had been monitoring it for a long time.

text: Suno sa gobernador, ginapangayo na nila ang status report sang mga proyekto sa sulod sang duha ka tuig, kag ang sulat nga ginpadala sa bag-o nga Secretary sang ahensiya, formalidad lang kuno.
english: The governor said they have been asking for the status report of the projects for two years, and the letter sent to the new Secretary of the agency is just a formality.

text: Ginpahayag man nga ang provincial government pa ang nagpahulam sang equipment sang ginpatigayon ang soil testing sa lugar sang Aganan Flyover, agud mahibaluan ang kondisyon sang duta nga gintukoran sini.
english: It was also reported that the provincial government lent the equipment when the soil testing was conducted at the site of the Aganan Flyover, to determine the condition of the soil on which it was built.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Governor Arthur Defensor Jr., ginpahayag niya nga ginamonitor na sang iya opisina ang proyekto halin pa sang nagligad nga mga binulan kag tuig.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Governor Arthur Defensor Jr. said his office has been monitoring the project for the past months and years.

text:
Ginpabutyag man sang gobernador nga kinahanglan nga mahibaluan sang lokal nga panguluhan ang kahimtangan sang mga proyekto agud masiguro nga nagaalayon ini sa plano sang probinsiya kag sa kaayuhan sang mga pumuluyo./JDS



(Reported by Bombo Phauline Pillora/Bombohanay Bigtime)
english:
The governor also stressed that the local government needs to know the status of the projects to ensure that they are in line with the provincial plan and the welfare of the people./JDS



(Reported by Bombo Phauline Pillora/Bombohanay Bigtime)

text: Gin-ako sang actress nga si Maris Racal nga nagakabatyag siya sang kulba kun ginakwestyon ang ila edad sang singer nga si Rico Blanco.
english: Actress Maris Racal admitted that she feels nervous when singer Rico Blanco questions their age.

text: 25 years ang age gap nila sang nobyo.
english: 25 years is the age gap between them and their boyfriend.

text: Suno kay Maris, masami nila ini gina-istoryahan ni Rico kag masami man siya nagakabatyag sang pressure bangud nakulbaan ini sa kun ano man ang panumdumon sang tawo.
english: According to Maris, she and Rico often talk about it and she often feels pressure because she is afraid of what people will think.

text: Ginbuyagyag man sang actress nga “babs” ang ila nga endearment.
english: The actress also revealed that their endearment is “babs”.

text: Marso 2020 sang nagguwa ang balita nga may yara sang “something” sa tunga nanday Maris kag Rico.
english: In March 2020, news broke that there was “something” between Maris and Rico.

text: Apang ang wala nahibaluan sang tanan dugang ni Maris, antes pa man sang pandemya, magkarelasyon na sila nga duha sang singer.
english: But what everyone doesn't know, Maris added, is that even before the pandemic, she and the singer were in a relationship.

text: Indi na pagpasugtan sang FIFA nga mag-oversee sang anuman man nga World Cup match subong nga tuig ang Spanish referee nga si Antonio Mateu Lahoz kasunod sang mga reklamo sang football players ilabi na halin kay Argentina captain kag superstar Lionel Messi.
english: FIFA will not allow Spanish referee Antonio Mateu Lahoz to oversee any World Cup matches this year following complaints from football players especially from Argentina captain and superstar Lionel Messi.

text: Si Lahoz amo ang in-charge sa quarterfinal game sa tunga sang Argentina kag sang The Netherlands sang nagligad nga semana.
english: Lahoz was in-charge in the quarterfinal game between Argentina and The Netherlands last week.

text: Apisar nagdaog sanday Messi paagi sa penalty shootout, ginsapubliko sa gihapon sang players ang ila mga reklamo sa amo nga referee.
english: Although Messi won on penalties, the players still made their complaints public about the referee.

text: Ini bangud sa kabug-usan nga 120 minutos nga hampang, nagpaguwa ini sang 17 ka yellow cards — lapaw pa sa 16 yellow cards nga ginpakita sang Russian referee nga si Valentin Ivanov sa hampang sa tunga sang Portugal kag The Netherlands sa 2006 World Cup.
english: This is because in a total of 120 minutes of play, it issued 17 yellow cards — more than the 16 yellow cards shown by Russian referee Valentin Ivanov in the match between Portugal and The Netherlands at the 2006 World Cup.

text: Suno kay Messi, dapat nga i-review sang FIFA kun ano ang natabo bangud nagapati siya nga indi nagakabagay si Lahoz para sa amo nga match.
english: Messi said FIFA should review what happened because he believes Lahoz is not fit for the match.

text: Suno naman sa Argentinian goalkeeper nga si Emiliano Martinez, naghatag sang 10 minutes extra time ang referee bangud luyag sini nga maka-skor pa ang kasumpong nga team sang Argentina.
english: According to Argentine goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez, the referee gave 10 minutes extra time because he wanted the opposing team of Argentina to score more.

text: Gintawag man sini nga arogante ang amo nga referee kag “pinakamalala” nga referee sa World Cup sa Qatar.
english: He also called that referee arrogant and the “worst” referee at the World Cup in Qatar.

text: Nag-akusar pa si Martinez nga bangud nalutos ang Spain sa tournament, luyag man sang Spanish referee nga ma-eliminate ang Argentina.
english: Martinez even accused that because Spain lost the tournament, the Spanish referee also wanted Argentina to be eliminated.

text: Nasapwan sa ice cooler ang tiil kag nakit-an nga naputos sa habol kag nagakadunot na ang lawas sang isa ka lalaki nga una na-report nga missing sa Caloocan City.
english: The leg of a man who was first reported missing in Caloocan City was found wrapped in a blanket and decomposing.

text: Ang biktima amo si Michael Dolina, 37-anyos, nga kilala man bilang si Shalani.
english: The victim was identified as Michael Dolina, 37, also known as Shalani.

text: Isa sa persons of interest amo ang tattoo artist nga nagaistar sa balay kun sa diin nakit-an ang lawas sang biktima.
english: One of the persons of interest is a tattoo artist who lives in the house where the victim's body was found.

text: Antes nakit-an ang lawas, tatlo ka adlaw na ini nga ginapangita.
english: Before the body was found, the search had been going on for three days.

text: Sa subong indi na makit-an ang tattoo artist apang ginapasungka ini sang iya pamilya.
english: The tattoo artist is now missing but his family is asking him to surrender.

text: Suspetsa naman sang himata sang biktima, indi lang isa ka tawo ang suspek.
english: The victim's relatives suspect that the suspect is not just one person.

text: Ginpahayag sang otoridad nga indi pa maathag kun ano ang motibo sa krimen.
english: Authorities said the motive for the crime is still unclear.

text: Ginsuspendi sang Malacañang ang klase sa tanan nga lebel kag trabaho sa mga opisina sang gobyerno sa Western Visayas sa Hulyo 23, 2025, bangud sang padayon nga mabaskog nga ulan dala sang Habagat.
english: Malacañang has suspended classes at all levels and work in government offices in Western Visayas on July 23, 2025, due to continued heavy rains brought by the Habagat.

text: Base sa Memorandum Circular No.
english: Based on Memorandum Circular No.

text: 90, apektado ang mga probinsya sang Iloilo, Capiz, Antique, Aklan, kag Guimaras, lakip pa ang pila ka lugar sa Luzon kag iban nga bahin sang Visayas.
english: 90, affected the provinces of Iloilo, Capiz, Antique, Aklan, and Guimaras, as well as some areas in Luzon and other parts of the Visayas.

text: Ginpasiguro man sang gobyerno nga ang mga ahensya nga may vital kag health services magapadayon sa operasyon agud masiguro ang serbisyo sa publiko.
english: The government also assured that agencies with vital and health services will continue to operate to ensure services to the public.

text: Ang private sector ginbilin sa desisyon sang ila tagsa ka opisina kun magapatuman man sang suspensyon.
english: The private sector is left to the decision of their respective offices whether to implement the suspension.

text: Naghakos na lang sang hugot sa puno sang lubi ang isa ka lalaki agud makaluwas sa daludo sang baha halin sa kabukiran.
english: A man hugged a palm tree tightly to escape the flood waves from the mountains.

text: Ini matapos ang halos wala untat nga pag-ulan sa Maasim, Sarangani kahapon, Oktubre 6.
english: This follows almost continuous rains in Maasim, Sarangani yesterday, October 6.

text: Padayon subong nga ginatinguhaan sang Japan nga makontrol ang paglapta sang lumpy skin disease sa mga baka sa pila ka mga farms.
english: Japan is currently trying to control the spread of lumpy skin disease in cattle on some farms.

text: Ang lumpy skin disease isa ka viral disease nga nagaapekto sa mga cattle kag masami nagaresulta sa severe complications ukon kamatayon.
english: Lumpy skin disease is a viral disease that affects cattle and often results in severe complications or death.

text: Ang mga sintomas sini amo ang hilanat, nodules sa panit kag internal organs, pagniwang sang sapat, nagabanog nga lymph nodes, kag fluid accumulation sa idalom sang panit.
english: Its symptoms include fever, nodules on the skin and internal organs, weight loss, swollen lymph nodes, and fluid accumulation under the skin.

text: Suno kay Bombo Josel Palma, international correspondent sa Japan, may yara subong sang ginapatigayon nga vaccination sa sulod sang 20-kilometer radius sang walo ka mga farms nga may na-record nga balatian.
english: According to Bombo Josel Palma, international correspondent in Japan, vaccination is currently being conducted within a 20-kilometer radius of eight farms with recorded cases.

text: Magalawig ang pagbakuna tubtob sa Marso 2025.
english: Vaccination will last until March 2025.

text: Nahibaluan nga una ini na-detect sa farm sa Itoshima, Fukuoka Prefecture.
english: It was first detected at a farm in Itoshima, Fukuoka Prefecture.

text: Matandaan nga gin-anunsyo na man sang Department of Agriculure ang pag-ban sang pag-import sang live cattle kag mga produkto sini halin sa Japan pasulod sa Pilipinas.
english: The Department of Agriculture has also announced a ban on the importation of live cattle and its products from Japan into the Philippines.

text: Ginkumpirma na sang aktres nga si Bea Alonzo ang ila relasyon ni Dominic Roque.
english: Actress Bea Alonzo has confirmed her relationship with Dominic Roque.

text: Suno kay Bea, indi nangin mahapos ang tanan apang malipayon na siya subong.
english: Bea says it hasn’t been easy but she is happy now.

text: Indi man nga ginatago sang aktres ang iya nga relasyon apang sa subong, mas mahinalungon na lang ini subong bangud sa iya man nangin eksperyensya sadto.
english: The actress is not hiding her relationship but now, she is more cautious now because of her experience.

text: Apang dugang pa ni Bea, “we only live once” kag luyag niya nga ipakigbahin sa publiko ang nagapalipay sa iya.
english: But Bea added, “we only live once” and wanted to share with the public what makes her happy.

text: Sanday Bea kag Dominic ang nakapauli na sa Pilipinas matapos ang isa ka bulan nga bakasyon sa Estados Unidos.
english: Bea and Dominic have returned to the Philippines after a month-long vacation in the United States.

text: Nagpasalig ang isa ka opisyal sang Barangay Tagbak, Jaro, Iloilo City nga mas hugton pa ang pagpanaway kag pagbantay sa mga kabataan nga naga-swimming sa suba, kasunod sang pagkadula kag pagkakita sang bangkay sang isa ka 13-anyos nga si alyas Kiel sa isa ka creek sa lugar.
english: An official of Barangay Tagbak, Jaro, Iloilo City has assured that children swimming in the river will be tightened and monitored, following the disappearance and discovery of the body of a 13-year-old alias Kiel in a creek in the area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Kagawad Eric Laburdo, may mga tanod na sila nga naga-roving kag naga-warning sa mga kabataan, apang ginpahayag sini nga indi malikawan nga nagabalik gihapon ang mga ini sa pagpaligo bisan may pahimangno na.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Kagawad Eric Labourdo said they already have tanods roving and warning the children, but he said it is inevitable that they will return to bathe even after the warning.

text: Ginkumpirmar pa ni Laburdo nga madalom gid ang bahin sang suba nga ginahalinan sang peligro, gani may ginaplano sila nga pagpatawag sang barangay meeting agud istriktuhan na gid ang pagbawal sa pagpaligo, labi na kon indi maayo ang tiyempo.
english: Labordo confirmed that the part of the river that is the source of the danger is very deep, so they are planning to call a barangay meeting to strictly prohibit bathing, especially when the weather is bad.

text: Ginapanawagan man sang barangay ang kooperasyon sang mga ginikanan agud malikawan ang pareho nga trahedya sa palaabuton.
english: The barangay also calls for the cooperation of parents to avoid a similar tragedy in the future.

text: Gintay-og sang Magnitude 4.9 nga linog ang Sipalay City, Negros Occidental pasado alas 8:00 sang aga, Oktubre 7, 2025, kag nabatyagan man sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: A magnitude 4.9 earthquake shook Sipalay City, Negros Occidental around 8:00 am on October 7, 2025, and was also felt in Iloilo City.

text: Madasig nga naggwa ang mga estudyante sang University of Iloilo-Phinma matapos mabatyagan ang pag-uyog sang duta.
english: Students of the University of Iloilo-Phinma quickly evacuated after feeling the earthquake.

text: Suno sa Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology, ang linog may kadalumon nga 10 kilometros kag nahamtang sa 51 kilometros nakatungdan sang Sipalay City.
english: According to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology, the quake measured 10 kilometers deep and was located 51 kilometers south of Sipalay City.

text: Ginreport nga Intensity II sa syudad sang Iloilo kag Instrumental Intensity I sa syudad sang Bago, Negros Occidental.
english: Reported Intensity II in Iloilo City and Instrumental Intensity I in Bago City, Negros Occidental.

text: Wala naman sang ginreport nga nasamaran ukon pagguba sa mga propedad nga naapektuhan kag gilayon naman nga nag resume ang klase.
english: No injuries or damage to the affected properties were reported and classes immediately resumed.

text: Padayon ang imbestigasyon sang Dingle Municipal Police Station sa natabo nga pagpangawat sa donation box sang Parish of St.
english: The Dingle Municipal Police Station is conducting an investigation into the theft of the donation box of the Parish of St.

text: John the Baptist sa Dingle, Iloilo.
english: John the Baptist in Dingle, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Alwin Salmon, hepe sang Dingle Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nagpalab-ot na sila sang koordinasyon sa amo nga simbahan agud gilayon ma-report kon hinali nga magbalik ang kawatan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Alwin Salmon, chief of the Dingle Municipal Police Station, said they have already reached out to the church to report immediately if the thief suddenly returns.

text: Suno kay Salmon, wala nagpa-blotter ang simbahan apang magahimo sila sang tikang agud matumod ang identity sang indibidwal.
english: Salmon said the church did not file a blotter but they will take steps to identify the individual.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga wala natigayon makakuha sang kwarta ang persona bangud sa nabudlayan ini.
english: He also explained that the person was unable to get the money because of difficulties.

text: Gintuad naman sang pamunuan sang simbahan nga may deperensya sa panghuna-huna ang indibidwal nga nagtuyo mangawat sa donation box.
english: The church leadership admitted that the individual who tried to steal from the donation box had a mental disorder.

text: Ipatuman sang Japan sa kapital sini nga Tokyo ang four-day workweek para sa mga government employees.
english: Japan will implement a four-day workweek for government employees in its capital Tokyo.

text: May kaangtanan ini sa ginaduso sang gobyerno nga buligan ang mga nagatrabaho nga mga iloy kag ma-boost ang manubo nga fertility rates sa pungsod.
english: This is in connection with the government's push to help working mothers and boost the low fertility rates in the country.

text: Suno kay Bombo Josel Palma, international correspondent sa Japan, gin-anunsyo sang Tokyo Metropolitan Government nga ang bag-o nga arrangement nga magasugod sa Abril 2025, ang makahatag sa mga empleyado sang tatlo ka adlaw nga off kada semana.
english: According to Bombo Josel Palma, international correspondent in Japan, the Tokyo Metropolitan Government announced that the new arrangement, which will start in April 2025, will give employees three days off per week.

text: Gin-anunsyo man ang isa ka policy nga magapahanugot sa mga ginikanan nga may kabataan sa grades one tubtob sa three sa elementary schools nga ikompromiso ang ila sweldo para nga temprano pa nga makapauli.
english: Also announced was a policy that would allow parents with children in grades one through three in elementary schools to compromise their salaries to go home early.

text: Sa bahin ni Tokyo Governor Yuriko Koike, ginsiling niya nga iga- review ang work styles nga may flexibility agud masiguro nga indi sang mga ini kinahanglan nga isakripisyo ang ila mga career bangud sa mga hitabo kaangay sang childbirth ukon childcare.
english: For her part, Tokyo Governor Yuriko Koike said work styles will be reviewed with flexibility to ensure that they do not have to sacrifice their careers due to events such as childbirth or childcare.

text: Dugang sang opisyal, tion na para sa Tokyo nga maghimo sang inisyatibo agud protektahan kag pasanyugon ang kabuhi sang mga tawo kag ang ekonomiya sa pangkabilugan.
english: The official added that it is time for Tokyo to take the initiative to protect and improve people's lives and the economy in general.

text: Nahibaluan nga nakalab-ot sa record low ang fertility rate sa Japan sa pihak sang kampanya sang gobyerno nga engganyuhon ang mga tawo nga magpakasal kag magtukod sang pamilya.
english: The fertility rate in Japan has reached a record low despite the government's campaign to encourage people to get married and start families.

text: Lima ka tawo, lakip ang isa ka bata, ang napatay pagkatapos nga ang isa ka salakyan nag-arado sa kadam-an sang mga tawo sa isa ka Christmas market sa Magdeburg, Germany.
english: Five people, including a child, were killed after a car plowed into a crowd of people at a Christmas market in Magdeburg, Germany.

text: Ini ang ginalaragway man sang mga lokal nga opisyales nga isa ka pag-atake sang terorismo.
english: This is also being described by local officials as a terror attack.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Bombo Aimee Andaya Hilger, Bombo International Correspondent in Germany, iya ginpahayag nga kapin sa 200 ka tawo ang napilasan sa pag-atake, nga may 40 nga yara sa kritikal nga kondisyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Bombo Aimee Andaya Hilger, Bombo International Correspondent in Germany, said more than 200 people were injured in the attack, with 40 in critical condition.

text: Suno kay Hilger, gin-aresto sang mga pulis ang isa ka 50-anyos nga doktor gikan sa Saudi Arabia nga ila ginapatihan nga responsable sa pag-atake, suno man sa ila German state premier.
english: Hilger said police had arrested a 50-year-old doctor from Saudi Arabia who they believed was responsible for the attack, according to their German state premier.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga isa ka Saudi source nagsiling nga ang Saudi Arabia nagpaandam sa mga awtoridad sang amo nga pungsog nahanungod sa nag-atake pagkatapos nga nag-post siya sang mga extremist nga mga pahayag sa iya personal nga X account nga nagapamahog sang kalinong kag seguridad.
english: He also said a Saudi source said Saudi Arabia alerted the country's authorities about the attacker after he posted extremist statements on his personal X account that threatened peace and security.

text: Ginlaragway sang mga opisyal sa pungsod nga makamamatay ang pag-atake sa Magdeburg kag isa ka “makatalagam nga buhat”.
english: Officials in the country described the Magdeburg attack as deadly and a “dangerous act”.

text: Ginpabutyag man sini nga wala na sang mas malinong kag masinadyahon nga lugar sang sa isa ka Christmas market, sa diin ang mga tawo nagakadto upod ila mga abyan kag pamilya agud mag-enjoy sang gluhwein ukon wine kag magpangita sang pila ka pagpamalandong kag kalipay.
english: He also pointed out that there is no more peaceful and cheerful place than a Christmas market, where people come with their friends and family to enjoy gluhwein or wine and find some reflection and joy.

text: Nagsindi naman sang mga kandila kag nagbutang sang mga bulak sa guwa sang isa ka simbahan malapit sa merkado ang mga nagpakita sang ila kasubo sa natabo nga insidente.
english: Mourners lit candles and laid flowers outside a church near the market.

text: Nakasulod sa Top 75 sang Miss Universe Philippines 2021 pageant ang tiglawas sang Iloilo City nga si Keshapornam Ramachandran.
english: Iloilo City representative Keshapornam Ramachandran made it to the Top 75 of the Miss Universe Philippines 2021 pageant.

text: Ang Top 75 nga mga kandidata, sandig sa anunsyo sang Miss Universe Philippines Organization, ang ginpili paagi sa mga natipon nga boto sa Headshot, Intro Video Challenges, kag boto halin sa pageant organization.
english: The Top 75 contestants, according to the announcement of the Miss Universe Philippines Organization, were selected through the accumulated votes in the Headshot, Intro Video Challenges, and votes from the pageant organization.

text: Lakip man sa Top 75 ang tatlo ka iban pa nga beauty queen sa Panay: Cheri Angel Anne Flejoles sang Capiz, Christelle Abello sang Aklan, kag Noelyn Rose Mabuhay Campos sang Antique.
english: Also in the Top 75 are three other beauty queens in Panay: Cheri Angel Anne Flejoles of Capiz, Christelle Abello of Aklan, and Noelyn Rose Mabuhay Campos of Antique.

text: Ang Top 75 ang maga-compete pa para sa spot sa Top 50.
english: The Top 75 will still compete for a spot in the Top 50.

text: Ang grand coronation sang pageant ang patigayunon sa Septyembre 25 kag ang mapilian nga winner ang magatiglawas sang Pilipinas sa Miss Universe pageant sa Israel sa bulan sang Disyembre.
english: The grand coronation of the pageant will be held on September 25 and the winner will represent the Philippines in the Miss Universe pageant in Israel in December.

text: Naglawig sang 120 minutos ang hampang sa knockout stage sa tunga sang Japan kag Croatia apang yara sa gihapon sa 1-1 ang skor rason nga ginpaagi sa penalty kick shootout agud nga matumod kun sin-o ang mangin winner kag magasulod sa quarterfinals.
english: The knockout stage match between Japan and Croatia lasted 120 minutes but the score was still 1-1 so it was sent to a penalty kick shootout to determine who would be the winner and enter the quarterfinals.

text: Ini ang labing-una nga tion sa World Cup 2022 nga naglab-ot sa penalty kick shooutout ang pagdeterminar sa winning team.
english: This is the first time in World Cup 2022 that the determination of the winning team has come down to a penalty kick shootout.

text: Sa shootout, tutok ang atensyon sang tanan sa Croatian goalie nga si Dominik Livakovic.
english: In the shootout, all attention was focused on Croatian goalie Dominik Livakovic.

text: Na-save sini ang una nga duha ka kicks halin sa Japan kag naghatag sang huge advantage sa Croatia.
english: It saved the first two kicks from Japan and gave Croatia a huge advantage.

text: Na-save pa gid sini ang ikaapat nga attempt sang Asian team.
english: It also saved the Asian team's fourth attempt.

text: Naka-skor naman ang Croatia sang three out sang ila una nga apat ka attempts.
english: Croatia scored three outs on their first four attempts.

text: Atubangon sang Croatia sa quarterfinals ang magadaog sa tunga sang Brazil kag South Korea.
english: Croatia will face the winner of Brazil and South Korea in the quarterfinals.

text: 3:00 am oras sa Pilipinas ang knockout match sa tunga sang duha ka nasambit nga teams.
english: The knockout match between the two teams will be played at 3:00 am Philippine time.

text: Naglab-ot sa kapin P28 million ang balor sang ginbilin nga kahalitan sang Bagyo Crising kag habagat sa Moises Padilla, Negros Occidental.
english: More than P28 million worth of damage was caused by Typhoon Crising and Habagat in Moises Padilla, Negros Occidental.

text: Ini base sa data sang Municpial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (MDRRMC)..
english: This is based on data from the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (MDRRMC).

text: Ang may pinakamataas nga balor sang kahalitan amo ang sa sektor sang imprastraktura nga naglab-ot sa P22.5 million.
english: The highest value of damage was in the infrastructure sector which reached P22.5 million.

text: Ini ginasundan sang agrikultura nga yara sa P4.3 million.
english: This is followed by agriculture at P4.3 million.

text: Sa bahin sang apektado nga populasyon, naglab-ot sa 300 ka pamilya ukon 900 ka mga indibidwal ang ginpang-evacuate.
english: As for the affected population, 300 families or 900 individuals were evacuated.

text: Ginkadismaya sang isa ka Piso Wifi owner ang makapila na ka beses nga makawatan ang iya negosyo sa Brgy.
english: A Piso Wifi owner was disappointed that his business in Brgy.

text: Rizal Ilawod, Calinog, Iloilo.
english: Rizal Ilawod, Calinog, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Denmark “Bokbok” Dalipe, iya ginpahayag nga nataban sang kawatan ang masobra P300 nga sensilyo sa iya Piso Wifi.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Denmark “Bokbok” Dalipe said the thief stole more than P300 coins from his Piso Wifi.

text: Suno kay Dalipe, apisar sang ginbutang sini nga duha ka kandado sa machine, natigayon sa gihapon ini nga mabuksan sang kawatan.
english: According to Dalipe, despite putting two locks on the machine, the thief still managed to open it.

text: Gintuad man sini nga sang ginsekyar niya ang closed circuit television (CCTV), natukiban nga duha ang mga suspek kag nagserbe nga lookout kag driver ang isa diri.
english: He also admitted that when he checked the closed circuit television (CCTV), it was discovered that there were two suspects and one of them served as a lookout and a driver.

text: Ginkumpirma ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. confirmed that

text: nga isaylo sa sektor sang edukasyon ang masobra P26 bilyones nga una nga ginpain para sa mga proyekto sa flood control.
english: to transfer to the education sector the more than P26 billion initially allocated for flood control projects.

text: Gin-anunsyo niya ini kadungan sang pagpanguna ni Marcos sang selebrasyon sang National Teachers’ Month kag World Teachers’ Day sa Pasay City, Oktubre 6.
english: He announced this while Marcos led the celebration of National Teachers' Month and World Teachers' Day in Pasay City, October 6.

text: Pahayag sini, ipain ini para sa pagpatukod sang mga classroom, child nutrition, teacher compensation kag teknolohiya sa mga eskwelahan.
english: He said it will be allocated for the construction of classrooms, child nutrition, teacher compensation and technology in schools.
