english: “This Administration is also preparing and investing for the long term.

text: The Senate and Congress have already proposed the 2026 budget for DepEd.
english: The Senate and Congress have already proposed the 2026 budget for DepEd.

text: Meanwhile, we have allocated P26.55 billion for DepEd programs from the funds of the flood control projects, which we have deemed not to be viable,” kabahin sang speech ni Marcos.
english: Meanwhile, we have allocated P26.55 billion for DepEd programs from the funds of the flood control projects, which we have deemed not to be viable,” Marcos said in part of his speech.

text: “Because we believe that education is the best, the best investment that any nation can make in its people,” dugang sini.
english: “Because we believe that education is the best, the best investment that any nation can make in its people,” it added.

text: Una na sini ginklaro nga bisan nga ginhimo na nga zero budget ang para sa flood control projects sa 2026, indi mag-untat ang mga programa sang administrasyon para sa imprastraktura.
english: Earlier, he clarified that even though the budget for flood control projects has been made zero in 2026, the administration's infrastructure programs will not stop.

text: Magluwas sa mga programa sa edukasyon, may ipain man para sa sektor sang ikaayong-lawas kag sa agrikultura.
english: In addition to educational programs, there will also be allocations for the health sector and agriculture.

text: Gin-alokar ang P29 billion sa Department of Health (DOH) para sa medical assistance kag pagtapos sa specialty hospitals; P60 billion para sa Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) agud pasangkaron ang coverage sini; kag masobra sa P39 billion naman ang magakadto sa Department of Agriculture (DA).
english: P29 billion was allocated to the Department of Health (DOH) for medical assistance and completion of specialty hospitals; P60 billion for the Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) to expand its coverage; and more than P39 billion will go to the Department of Agriculture (DA).

text: Gin-realign ang budget nga para kuntani sa flood control projects matapos madiskubrehan ang mga anomaliya sa public works partikular ang ghost kag substandard nga mga inubrahan nga nagabalor sang binilyon ka pesos.#
english: The budget for flood control projects was realigned after anomalies in public works particularly ghost and substandard works worth billions of pesos were discovered.

text: Makabaton sang tag-P7,000 nga cash aid ang isa ka milyon nga mga mangunguma sa idalom sang ginaduso nga P6.7 trillion nga budget para sa 2026.
english: One million farmers will receive P7,000 each in cash aid under the proposed P6.7 trillion budget for 2026.

text: Gin-anunsyo ini ni House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III kadungan sang joint hearing sang House Committee on Agriculture and Food kag Committee on Ways and Means subong nga adlaw, Oktubre 6.
english: This was announced by House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III during the joint hearing of the House Committee on Agriculture and Food and Committee on Ways and Means today, October 6.

text: Pahayag sang Speaker, ihatag ang kuwarta bilang bulig bangud sa kapierdehan sang mga mangunguma dala sang manubo nga farmgate prices sang humay.
english: The Speaker said the money will be given as relief to farmers due to the low farmgate prices of rice.

text: “Aid is ensured for our farmers.
english: “Aid is ensured for our farmers.

text: The P7,000 cash aid will be given to them to address their losses due to low farmgate prices of palay,” pahayag ni Dy.
english: The P7,000 cash aid will be given to them to address their losses due to low farmgate prices of palay,” said Dy.

text: Magabulig ini nga tikang suno sa iya sa implementasyon sang Executive Order No.
english: He said this step will help in the implementation of Executive Order No.

text: Sa idalom sini nga order, gin-suspinde ang rice importation agud nga maproteksyunan ang local producers sa oversupply kag sa manubo nga presyo.
english: Under this order, rice importation was suspended to protect local producers from oversupply and low prices.

text: Ginpahayag man sang House leader nga naghingyo sila kay President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The House leader also said they have asked President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: nga himuon na lamang nga cash ang tanan nga subsidiya halin sa Department of Agriculture.
english: to convert all subsidies from the Department of Agriculture into cash.

text: Lakip diri ang ginahatag nga seed subsidy.
english: This includes the seed subsidy.

text: Matapos ang delay nga dala sang pandemya, ginkasal na gid man pinaagi sa civil ceremony ang actress kag philanthropist nga si Angel Locsin kay Neil Arce nga isa ka film producer.
english: After a delay caused by the pandemic, actress and philanthropist Angel Locsin was finally married in a civil ceremony to Neil Arce, a film producer.

text: Ang civil wedding ang ginhiwat sa Taguig City antes ang pagpatuman sang lockdown sa Metro Manila.
english: The civil wedding was held in Taguig City before the implementation of the lockdown in Metro Manila.

text: Gintambongan lamang sang 10 ka tawo ang kasal nanday Angel kag Neil.
english: Only 10 people attended Angel and Neil's wedding.

text: Sila nga duha ang magkarelasyon sa sulod sang masobra tatlo ka tuig.
english: They both have been in a relationship for more than three years.

text: Nangin engage sang Hunyo 2019 kag nakaplano na kuntani sa Nobyemre 8 sang nagligad tuig ang kasal apang gin-postpone bangud sa COVID-19 pandemic.
english: They got engaged in June 2019 and their wedding was scheduled for November 8 last year but was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Ginpatuman na epektibo subong nga adlaw sang Martes ang big time price hike ukon pagsaka sa presyo sang produktong petrolyo.
english: The big time price hike of petroleum products was implemented effective Tuesday.

text:
Sa ginpagwa nga advisory sang mga oil companies, yari ang pagsaka sa presyo:

Kun lantawon naman ang data sang Department of Energy (DOE), yari ang net increase ukon ang ginsaka sa presyo sang gasolina halin sang una nga semana sang Enero 2022 tubtub sa katapusan nga petsa nga may yara sang oil price movement:

** Ang kada litro sang gasolina ang nagsaka sang P23.85** P30.30 per liter ang saka sa litro sang diesel** kag P27.65 per liter ang saka sa litro sang kerosene

Suno sa mga eksperto halin sa oil industry, posible nga magpabilin nga mataas ang presyo sang produktong-petrolyo matapos nga nag-anunsyo ang Saudi Arabi nga pasakaon sini ang presyo sang crude oil sa Hulyo.
english:
In the advisory issued by the oil companies, here are the price increases:

Looking at the data of the Department of Energy (DOE), here is the net increase in gasoline prices from the first week of January 2022 to the last date of oil price movement:

** Per liter of gasoline increased by P23.85** Diesel increased by P30.30 per liter** and kerosene increased by P27.65 per liter

According to experts from the oil industry, the price of petroleum products is likely to remain high after Saudi Arabia announced that it will raise the price of crude oil in July.

text: Ini apisar nga nagsugtanay na ang Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC+) kag ang ila nga mga kaalyado nga padamuon pa ang ila nga produkto sa Hulyo kag sa Agusto.
english: This is despite the fact that the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC+) and its allies have agreed to increase their production in July and August.

text: Ginapahayag nga nagasaka man ang demand sa sini nga produkto, ilabi na bangud summer season sa Estados Unidos kag bangud nga ginpahalog na ang Covid-19 restrictions sa China.
english: The demand for this product is also reportedly increasing, especially since it is summer season in the United States and since the Covid-19 restrictions in China have been lifted.

text: Ginkamasaan sang World Number 1 kag five-time champions nga Brazil ang South Korea, 4-1, sa knockout stage sa World Cup 2022.
english: World Number 1 and five-time champions Brazil defeated South Korea, 4-1, in the knockout stage of the 2022 World Cup.

text: Ang naka-skor para sa Brazil amo sanday: Vini Jr sa 7th minute, penalty kick ni Neymar sa 13th minute, Richarlison sa 29th minute, kag Lucas Paqueta sa 36th minute — lunsay sa first half.
english: Scoring for Brazil were: Vini Jr in the 7th minute, Neymar’s penalty kick in the 13th minute, Richarlison in the 29th minute, and Lucas Paqueta in the 36th minute — all in the first half.

text: Apisar nakahibalo ang South Korea nga heavy underdog ini sa hampang, wala man ini nagpasugot nga matapos ang hampang nga indi maka-goal.
english: Although South Korea knew it was a heavy underdog in the game, it did not allow the game to end without a goal.

text: Ang naka-skor para sa Asian team amo si Paik Seoung-ho sa 76th minute sang match.
english: Scoring for the Asian team was Paik Seoung-ho in the 76th minute of the match.

text: Sa pagselebrar sang ila nga kadalag-an, gin-uyatan man sang Brazilian players ang banner nga may nawong kag pangalan ni Pele, isa sa ginakabig greatest players of all time.
english: In celebration of their victory, the Brazilian players also held a banner with the face and name of Pele, one of the greatest players of all time.

text: Naka-admit subong ang 82-anyos nga Brazilian soccer great sa Sao Paulo hospital agud nga i-reevaluate ang iya nga cancer treatment.
english: The 82-year-old Brazilian soccer great is now admitted to the Sao Paulo hospital to reevaluate his cancer treatment.

text: Balantayan ang sunod nga hampang sang Brazil batok sa Croatia sa quarterfinals.
english: Watch Brazil's next match against Croatia in the quarterfinals.

text: Ginsabat ni anay Senador Antonio Trillanes ang mga report nga nagaangut sa insidente kun sa diin ginpahayag nga nasapwan nga wala sang pangalibutan si anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte samtang yara ini sa detention center sang International Criminal Court (ICC) sa The Hague, Netherlands.
english: Former Senator Antonio Trillanes responded to reports regarding the incident where former President Rodrigo Duterte was found unconscious while in the detention center of the International Criminal Court (ICC) in The Hague, Netherlands.

text: Suno kay Trillanes, indi matuod ang ginapahayag nga insidente kag ginpasiguro niya nga may nakahanda nga medical team sa sulod mismo sang detention center, magluwas pa sa mga ambulansya nga naga-standby sa guwa.
english: Trillanes said the alleged incident is not true and he assured that there is a medical team ready inside the detention center, in addition to ambulances on standby outside.

text: Pahayag pa ni Trillanes, lima lang ka minutos ang kalayuon sang ospital halin sa ICC, gani suno sa iya, imposible nga indi gilayon maatipan kag madala sa ospital ang anay presidente sa tion sang emergency.
english: Trillanes said the hospital is only five minutes away from the ICC, so it is impossible for the former president not to be immediately treated and taken to the hospital in case of emergency.

text: Dugang pa niya, wala man sang klaro nga basehan ang alegasyon nga may problema sa memorya si Duterte, nga una na ginpahayag sang iya abogado nga si Atty. Nicholas Kauffman, nga may yara ini sang cognitive deficiencies.
english: He added that there is no clear basis for the allegation that Duterte has memory problems, which his lawyer Atty. Nicholas Kauffman, that she had cognitive deficiencies.

text: Ang pahayag ni Trillanes ang naguwa kasunod sang ginpahayag ni Vice President Sara Duterte, kun sa diin ginbuyagyag niya nga nasapwan nga unconscious ang iya amay sa sulod sang kwarto sini sa ICC detention facility.
english: Trillanes' statement followed a statement by Vice President Sara Duterte, where she revealed that her father was found unconscious inside his room at the ICC detention facility.

text: Matandaan nga ginkwestyon ni VP Sara ang ICC bangud sa ginatawag niya nga kapabayaan sang institusyon sa paghatag sang simple nga medical nga kinahanglanon sang iya amay, kaangay na lamang sang pagbulong sang ingrown sang tiil sini.
english: It can be recalled that VP Sara questioned the ICC for what he called the negligence of the institution in providing simple medical needs of his father, such as the treatment of an ingrown leg.

text: ILOILO CITY – Kampante si incoming Finance Secretary Benjamin Diokno kag subong incumbent Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Governor nga magnubo sa single digit ang poverty incidence sang pungsod antes pa man magtapos ang termino ni President-elect Ferdinand Bongbong Marcos Jr.
english: ILOILO CITY – Incoming Finance Secretary Benjamin Diokno and now incumbent Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Governor are confident that the country's poverty incidence will drop to single digits before the end of President-elect Ferdinand Bongbong Marcos Jr.

text: sa tion nga padayon nga magasanyog ang ekonomiya sang pungsod tubtob sa 6 percent.
english: at a time when the country's economy will continue to grow up to 6 percent.

text: Suno kay Diokno, sa padayon nga pagsanyog sang pungsod, masolbar ang problema sa revenue nga amo ang magasolbar sang deficit problem kag makabulig agud nga malab-ot ang tinutuyo nga mangin upper-middle-income country sa mga masunod nga tuig.
english: According to Diokno, with the country's continued development, the revenue problem will be solved which will solve the deficit problem and help achieve the goal of becoming an upper-middle-income country in the coming years.

text: Ang poverty rate sang pungsod ang nagnubo sa 16.7 percent sang 2018 humalin sa 23.5 percent sang 2015 apang nagsarurot pagid sang ngaliligad nga mga tinuig bangud sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: The country's poverty rate fell to 16.7 percent in 2018 from 23.5 percent in 2015 but has worsened in recent years due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Antes pa man ang pandemya, ang ekonomiya sang Pilipinas ang nagsanyog sa average nga 6 percent.
english: Even before the pandemic, the Philippine economy grew by an average of 6 percent.

text: Sang 2020, ang ekomoniya ang nagsanyog sang 9.6 percent.
english: In 2020, the economy grew by 9.6 percent.

text: Nagpasalig ang mga economic managers nga mabawi sang pungsod ang kapigaduhon kaangay sang pre-pandemic level.
english: Economic managers have promised that the country will recover poverty to pre-pandemic levels.

text: Magluwas sa pagsolbar sang kapigaduhon, ginpahayag ni Diokno nga maga-implementar sang mga programa nga makabulig sa pungsod agud nga malab-ot ang A ukon investment-grade rating.
english: Besides solving poverty, Diokno said he will implement programs that will help the country achieve an A or investment-grade rating.

text: Wala sa gihapon ma-identify sang kapulisan ang ginaalegar tatlo ka mga indibidwal nga may tuyo nga mag- abduct sa 11-anyos nga lalaki sa Barangay Capaliz,Dumangas, Iloilo.
english: Police have yet to identify the three individuals who allegedly intended to abduct an 11-year-old boy in Barangay Capaliz, Dumangas, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Kenn Albert Lepsia, Chief of Police sang Dumangas Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga naligaran pa sang pila ka adlaw antes nga nakapanugid ang bata rason nga ulihi naman nakaresponde ang kapulisan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Kenn Albert Lepsia, chief of police of Dumangas Municipal Police Station, said it took several days before the child was able to tell the police.

text: Suno kay Lepsia kag santo sa panaysayon sang bilktima, gindulogan siya sang isa ka motorsiklo kag ginpanaogan sang tatlo ka mga kalalakihan kag ginlagas.
english: According to Lepsia and based on the victim's statement, he was hit by a motorcycle and three men got off and chased him.

text: Nag-untat na lang ang paglagsanay sang biktima kag ginapahayag tatlo ka mga kalalakihan sang may nakakita sa ila.
english: The victim stopped chasing and was reportedly three men when someone saw them.

text: Gintuad man sang biktima nga may bonnet ang mga kalalakihan.
english: The victim also admitted that the men were wearing bonnets.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Lepsia nga wala nakitaan sang amay sang 11-anyos nga bata sang pagbag-o sa pamatasan sini kasunod sang natabo.
english: Lepsia also said the father of the 11-year-old did not see any change in his behavior following the incident.

text: Ginalantaw naman sang otoridad ang madamo nga posibilidad sa natabo nga incidente kon sa diin, nagapati si Lepsia nga kon matuod ang natabo, wala na kontani nakapalagyo ang biktima sa tatlo ka kalalakihan.
english: Authorities are looking at many possibilities in the incident where, Lepsia believes that if the incident was true, the victim would not have escaped from the three men.

text: Para sa Dumangas PNP, isa lamang ka alegasyon kag madamo sang posible mahimo nga ihuna-huna sang 11-anyos nga bata.
english: For Dumangas PNP, there is only one allegation and many possible things that the 11-year-old can think of.

text: Agud sigurohon naman ang seguridad sa lugar, may ginapalibot na nga police patrol.
english: To ensure security in the area, a police patrol is already in place.

text: Ginhublasan kag gin-gaid sa poste ang isa ka pulis matapos ini nga nagpinamuyayaw.
english: A policeman was stripped naked and guided to a pole after he made fun of him.

text: Natabo ini sa Para, Brazil.
english: This happened in Para, Brazil.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, ginpangbuyayaw sang pulis ang mga empleyado sang isa ka energy company.
english: According to the investigation, the police harassed the employees of an energy company.

text: Suno sa mga empleyado, nagub-an sang makina ang ila truck sa tunga sang karsada kag natabuan nga naglabay ang pulis gani indi makaagi ang iya salakyan.
english: According to the employees, their truck broke down in the middle of the road and the policeman happened to pass by so his vehicle could not pass.

text: Didto ini nanaug kag nagpinangakig.
english: There it came down and became angry.

text: Apisar gintulod pahigad sang mga empleyado ang truck, wala nakuntento ang pulis sa espasyo gani namwersa pa gid ini.
english: Although the employees pushed the truck aside, the policeman was not satisfied with the space and forced it.

text: Didto na siya ginpulihan sang mga tawo, ginhublasan kag gin-gaid sa poste bag-o sila nagtawag sang pulis.
english: That's when people replaced him, stripped him naked and guided him to a pole before they called the police.

text: Base sa otoridad, naka-sick leave ang amo nga pulis kag wala naka-duty.
english: According to the authorities, the policeman was on sick leave and was not on duty.

text: Gin-aresto ini kag ginpasakaan sang kaso ang amo nga pulis.
english: He was arrested and the police officer was charged.

text: Gin-ako ni mega star Sharon Cuneta nga nagpabuhin siya sang dughan sang yara siya sa Estados Unidos.
english: Mega star Sharon Cuneta admitted that she lost weight while in the United States.

text: Suno kay Sharon, nadugangan ang iya bug-at sang yara siya sa US apang may yara naman sang may naggamay sa iya — kag ini amo ang iya nga dughan.
english: According to Sharon, she gained weight while in the US but there was something that shrank — and that was her chest.

text: Pahayag niya, natural ang procedure nga ginhimo sa iya kag indi breast implant bangud madamo siya sang skin kag fats.
english: She said the procedure was natural and not a breast implant because she had a lot of skin and fats.

text: Samtang ginbuyagyag man sang aktres nga padayon ang iya pag-audition sa mga Hollywood productions.
english: Meanwhile, the actress also revealed that she continues to audition for Hollywood productions.

text: Target sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) nga umpisahan subong nga adlaw, Oktubre 6 ang rehabilitasyon sang mga imprastraktura nga naguba sa Cebu kasunod sang pag-igo sang magnitude 6.9 nga linog.
english: The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) targets to begin today, October 6, the rehabilitation of infrastructure damaged in Cebu following the magnitude 6.9 earthquake.

text: Suno kay DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon, pagatukuron na subong nga semana ang permanente nga mga pagkay-o sa mga naguba nga imprastratura sa lugar.
english: According to DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon, permanent repairs to the damaged infrastructure in the area will be started this week.

text: Ginpahayag ni Dizon nga nagbilin sang ginabulubanta P2.5 billion nga balor sang danyos ang linog sa mga dalan kag taytay sa probinsya.
english: Dizon said the quake left an estimated P2.5 billion worth of damage to roads and bridges in the province.

text: Magluwas diri, wala pa sang final nga estimate ang halit nga naangkon sang mga eskwelahan kag ospital, gani posible pa nga magtaas ang kabug-usan nga kantidad sang danyos sa mga masunod nga inadlaw.
english: In addition, there is no final estimate of the damage caused to schools and hospitals, so the total amount of damage is likely to increase in the coming days.

text: Samtang, base sa report sang National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC), 713 ka imprastraktura na ang nahalitan sa Central Visayas, lakip pa ang 18,154 ka kabalayan nga apektado sa rehiyon.
english: Meanwhile, based on the report of the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC), 713 infrastructures have been damaged in Central Visayas, including 18,154 houses affected in the region.

text: Nagpasugot ang Malaysia nga i-resume ang search operations sa eroplano nga nadula 10 ka tuig na ang nakaligad.
english: Malaysia has agreed to resume search operations for the plane that went missing 10 years ago.

text: Ang missing nga Malaysia Airlines Flight MH370 isa sa ginakabig nga pinakadaku nga misteryo sa patag sang aviation sa bilog nga kalibutan kag ginakabig nga pinakamakamamatay nga kaso sang pagkadula sang aircraft.
english: The missing Malaysia Airlines Flight MH370 is considered one of the biggest mysteries in the field of aviation worldwide and is considered the deadliest case of aircraft disappearance.

text: Isa ini ka Boeing 777 nga nagakarga sang 227 ka mga pasahero kag 12 crew nga halin sa Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia kag pakadto kuntani sa Beijing, China sang Marso 8, 2014.
english: It was a Boeing 777 carrying 227 passengers and 12 crew that was departing from Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia and was bound for Beijing, China on March 8, 2014.

text: Apisar ginlunsar na anay ang ginakabig nga largest search sa aviation history, wala gihapon ini nakit-an kag wala gihapon nahibal-an kun ano ang natabo.
english: Although the largest search in aviation history was launched, it has not been found and it is still unknown what happened.

text: Suno kay Malaysian Transport Minister Anthony Loke, ang proposal nga padayunon ang pagpangita sa 15,000 square kilometer area sa southern Indian Ocean ang naghalin sa exploration firm nga Ocean Infinity.
english: According to Malaysian Transport Minister Anthony Loke, the proposal to continue exploration in the 15,000 square kilometer area in the southern Indian Ocean came from exploration firm Ocean Infinity.

text: Amo man ini nga kumpaniya ang naglunsar sang search operations para sa amo man nga eroplano apang gintapos ang operasyon sadtong 2018.
english: The same company launched search operations for the same plane but ended the operation in 2018.

text: Suno kay Loke, makabaton ang kumpaniya sang $70 million kun may makit-an nga bastante nga wreckage ukon mga parte sang eroplano.
english: According to Loke, the company will receive $70 million if enough wreckage or parts of the plane are found.

text: Amo ini suno kay Loke ang ila kabigon nga makahatag sang closure sa mga himata sang mga biktima.
english: Loke said this is what they will consider to give closure to the relatives of the victims.

text: “Our responsibility and obligation and commitment is to the next of kin,” suno sa transport minister.
english: “Our responsibility and obligation and commitment is to the next of kin,” according to the transport minister.

text:
“We hope this time will be positive, that the wreckage will be found and give closure to the families.”

Nahibaluan nga antes ini, may kumpaniya man halin sa Australia nga nagpangita sa aircraft kag naglawig sang tatlo ka tuig antes gin-untat ang operasyon sang 2017.#
english:
“We hope this time will be positive, that the wreckage will be found and give closure to the families.”

Earlier, an Australian company searched for the aircraft and lasted three years before stopping operations in 2017.

text: Wala na sang Jane Marczewski ukon Nightbirde nga mabatian sa America’s Got Talent matapos ginnkumpirma mismo sang singer nga magaatras na siya sa kumpetisyon subong nga season bangud sang iya nagalala nga health kondisyon.
english: Neither Jane Marczewski nor Nightbirde will be heard on America's Got Talent after the singer herself confirmed that she will be withdrawing from the competition this season due to her deteriorating health condition.

text: Bantog si Nightbirde bangud magluwas nga siya ang ginhatagan ni AGT judge Simon Cowell sang “Golden Buzzer”, natandog ang balatyagon sang publiko bangud sa iya istorya sa pagpakigbato sa cancer.
english: Nightbirde is famous because besides being awarded the “Golden Buzzer” by AGT judge Simon Cowell, she touched the hearts of the public with her story of fighting cancer.

text: Nangin popular man ang iya pagkanta sang It’s Okay.
english: His singing of It’s Okay also became popular.

text: Apang sa subong suno sa singer, naglala pa ang iya nga sitwasyon kag kinahanglan niya magfocus sa away batok sa cancer.
english: But now, according to the singer, his situation has worsened and he needs to focus on the fight against cancer.

text: Sang audition sang nagligad nga Hunyo, ginbuyagyag ni Jane nga naglapta na ang cancer sa iya lungs, spine, kag liver.
english: During the audition last June, Jane revealed that the cancer had spread to her lungs, spine, and liver.

text: Two percent na lang suno sa iya ang ginhatag sa iya agud nga mabuhi, apang suno sa iya, two percent is not zero kag malipayon siya gihapon bangud sini.
english: He said he was only given two percent to survive, but he said two percent is not zero and he is still happy because of it.

text: Wala pa sa gihapon nakit-an tubtob subong ang 14-anyos nga solterito nga gina-alegar nga nalumos sa suba sa Barangay Tagbak, Jaro, Iloilo City kahapon, Hulyo 20.
english: The 14-year-old boy who allegedly drowned in the river in Barangay Tagbak, Jaro, Iloilo City yesterday, July 20, is still missing.

text: Ini amo si alyas Kiel, residente sang Zone 5 sa amo man nga barangay.
english: This is alias Kiel, resident of Zone 5 in the same barangay.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay alyas Noy, bestfriend kag upod ni Kiel nga naligo sa suba, iya ginpahayag nga nagsugod sila paligo halin alas-12 sang udto tubtob alas-5 sang hapon upod pa ang walo nila ka kabarkada bisan pa nga mabaskog ang ulan kag madalom ang tubig sa suba.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Noy, Kiel's bestfriend and companion who was bathing in the river, said they started bathing from 12 noon to 5 pm with eight of their friends despite the heavy rain and deep water in the river.

text: Suno kay Noy, nagbatyag sang pagkabiring sa tiil si Kiel samtang nagapaligo apang nagpahuway lang ini sang makadali kag nagpadayon gihapon sa paglangoy kag pagpraktis sang backdive.
english: According to Noy, Kiel felt a twinge in his leg while taking a bath but he rested for a while and continued swimming and practicing backdive.

text: Ginsita sila sang tanod bangud delikado ang lugar rason nga nagpuli si Noy kag ang iban pa nila nga mga upod.
english: The tanod arrested them because the area was dangerous so Noy and his other companions went home.

text: Ila man ginhagad pauli si Kiel apang wala siya nagsunod kag nahibaloan nga may iban pa siya nga grupo nga nakaupod sa suba sang ulihi siya nakita.
english: They also invited Kiel home but he refused and it was learned that he was with another group in the river when he was last seen.

text: Dugang pa ni Noy, pagkabugtaw niya sang aga, Hulyo 21, didto na lang niya nabal-an nga wala nakapuli si Kiel kag bayo na lang sang bata ang nakita sa lugar sang insidente.
english: Noy said that when he woke up on the morning of July 21, he found out that Kiel had not returned home and only the child's clothes were found at the scene of the incident.

text: Kaina sang hapon, nagpatigayon sang search and rescue operation ang mga otoridad sa kilid sang suba nga malapit sa ginakaayo nga esplanade kag Green Garden Memorial Park sa Zone 5, Tagbak apang wala pa gihapon nakit-an ang lawas ni Kiel ukon ano man nga palatandaan.
english: Yesterday afternoon, authorities conducted a search and rescue operation along the river near the esplanade and Green Garden Memorial Park in Zone 5, Tagbak but Kiel's body or any signs have not been found.

text: Sa separado nga interview sang Bombo Radyo kay JM Galvez, rescue volunteer sang Emergency Management Volunteer Response Team Inc., iya ginpahayag nga nabudlayan sila sa operasyon bangud sa mga nagkalain-lain nga impormasyon kag pahayag nga ila nabaton.
english: In a separate interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, JM Galvez, rescue volunteer of the Emergency Management Volunteer Response Team Inc., said they had difficulty in the operation due to the various information and statements they received.

text: May yara nagasiling nga nakita pa si Kiel nga nagabakal sa convenience store sang hapon sang Hulyo 20.
english: Some say Kiel was still seen shopping at a convenience store on the afternoon of July 20.

text: Bangud sini, ginapanawagan sang rescue team ang mga nakaupod ni Kiel sang adlaw sang insidente nga magkooperar agud mahibaloan kon ano gid man ang matuod nga natabo kag mabuligan nga makita gilayon ang bata.
english: The rescue team is calling on those who were with Kiel on the day of the incident to cooperate to find out what really happened and help find the child immediately.

text: Ang suba nga ila ginpaligoan konektado sa sapa sa Buntatala padulong sa Leganes, rason nga magapadayun ang operasyon sang rescue team buwas sang aga sa mga posible nga agyan ukon sang-itan ni Kiel pananglitan man nga nalumos ini.
english: The river where they bathed is connected to the river in Buntatala to Leganes, which is why the rescue team will continue the operation tomorrow morning in the possible routes or streams of Kiel in case he drowned.

text:
Sa subong, nagapanawagan ang mga otoridad kag ang pamilya nga kun may nakakita ukon may impormasyon parte kay Kiel, ipahibalo gilayon ini sa barangay ukon sa pinakamalapit nga estasyon sang kapulisan.#

(Article: Bombo Krylle Melliza)
english:
Authorities and the family are appealing to anyone who sees or has information about Kiel to immediately report it to the barangay or the nearest police station.

(Article: Bombo Krylle Melliza)

text: Isa pa ka Asian country ang nakasulod sa knockout stage sang FIFA World Cup 2022 matapos naghimo sang upset ang South Korea kag ginlutos ang powerhouse team nga Portugal nanday Christiano Ronaldo sa group match, 2-1.
english: Another Asian country made it to the knockout stage of the FIFA World Cup 2022 after South Korea pulled off an upset and defeated Christiano Ronaldo’s powerhouse Portugal in the group match, 2-1.

text: Bangud sini, abante na sa round of 16 ang South Korea nga ginkalipay naman sang Asian football fans kasunod man sang pag-qualify sang Japan sa amo nga round.
english: As a result, South Korea advanced to the round of 16, which Asian football fans were delighted with after Japan qualified for the round.

text: Sa hampang sang South Korea batok sa Portugal, ang naka-goal para sa Asian powerhouse team amo sanday Kim Young-gwon sa 27th minute kag ang stoppage-time strike ni Hwang Hee-chan sa first minute sang added time.
english: In South Korea’s game against Portugal, the goals for the Asian powerhouse team were Kim Young-gwon in the 27th minute and Hwang Hee-chan’s stoppage-time strike in the first minute of added time.

text: Ang isahanon naman nga goal sa Portugal ang nagikan kay Ricardo Horta sa ika-lima nga minuto sang hampang.
english: Portugal's only goal came from Ricardo Horta in the fifth minute.

text: Apisar nalutos sa sini nga match, una na nga naka-qualify ang Portugal sa knockout stage matapos sini gindaog ang una nga duha ka hampang.
english: Despite losing this match, Portugal qualified for the knockout stage first after winning the first two games.

text: Ang kadalag-an sang South Korea batok sa Portugal nagakahulugan man nga taktak na sa World Cup tournament ang isa pa ka powerhouse team sa Group H — ang former champions nga Uruguay.
english: South Korea’s victory over Portugal also means another powerhouse team in Group H — former champions Uruguay — will now be in the World Cup tournament.

text: Ini apisar ginlutos sang Uruguay ang Ghana, 2-0, sa ila final nga group match.
english: This is despite Uruguay beating Ghana, 2-0, in their final group match.

text: Kun lantawon ang group tally, patas nga may apat ka puntos ang South Korea kag ang Uruguay kag pareho man nga zero sa goal differential.
english: Looking at the group tally, South Korea and Uruguay are tied with four points and both have zero goal differential.

text: Ang sunod nga tiebreaker amo ang na-skor nga goal — diri abanse ang Asian team bangud duha lang ang na-skor sang Uruguay.
english: The next tiebreaker was the scored goal — here the Asian team was ahead as Uruguay only scored two.

text:
Yari ang natipon nga puntos sa Group H:

PORTUGAL – 2 wins, 0 draw, 1 loss – 6 pointsSOUTH KOREA – 1 win, 1 draw, 1 loss – 4 pointsURUGUAY – 1 win, 1 draw, 1 loss – 4 pointsGHANA – 1 win,0 draw, 2 losses – 3 points
english:
Here are the accumulated points in Group H:

PORTUGAL – 2 wins, 0 draw, 1 loss – 6 pointsSOUTH KOREA – 1 win, 1 draw, 1 loss – 4 pointsURUGUAY – 1 win, 1 draw, 1 loss – 4 pointsGHANA – 1 win,0 draw, 2 losses – 3 points

text: Plano ni Iloilo 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar nga i-address ang issue sa serye sang holdup incidents sa lebel sang Sangguniang Panlalawigan.
english: Iloilo 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar plans to address the issue in the series of holdup incidents at the Sangguniang Panlalawigan level.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Board Member Mondejar, Chairman sang Committee on Public Order and Security, iya ginpahayag nga kinahanglan may yara anay siya sang detailed study may kaangtanan sa mga insidente nga natabo antes makahimo sang epektibo nga estratehiya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Board Member Mondejar, Chairman of the Committee on Public Order and Security, said he needs to have a detailed study on the incidents that occurred before developing an effective strategy.

text: Santu sa data sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office, sa sulod lang sang bulan sang Pebrero 2025, nakarekord na ini sang apat ka mga holdup incidents lakip na ang sa Pavia sang Pebrero 10 sa diin nakuha sang mga suspek ang P300,000 nga benta sang fuel tanker sang Metro Iloilo Transport Service Cooperative.
english: According to the data of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office, in the month of February 2025 alone, it has recorded four holdup incidents including the one in Pavia on February 10 where the suspects took the P300,000 sale of the fuel tanker of the Metro Iloilo Transport Service Cooperative.

text: Pebrero 11, natabo naman ang ika-duha nga insidente sa Santa Barbara sa diin nabiktima ang isa ka manugbaligya sang herbal product kag nakuha sa iya ang ginabanta P20,000, bulong kag cellphone.
english: On February 11, the second incident occurred in Santa Barbara where a herbal product vendor was victimized and was robbed of P20,000, medicine and a cellphone.

text: Pebrero 18 sang udto natabo naman ang holdup incident sa Barotac Viejo sa diin isa ka Indian national ang nabiktima kag nakuha sang mga suspek ang P4,500.
english: On February 18 afternoon, a holdup incident occurred in Barotac Viejo where an Indian national was victimized and the suspects stole P4,500.

text: Isa sa duha ka mga suspek ang nadakpan sang kapulisan.
english: One of the two suspects was arrested by the police.

text: Samtang pagkagab-i sang Pebrero 18, ginholdup ang isa ka manugbaligya isda sa diin nakuha sang mga suspek ang P159,000 nga cash kag cellphone.
english: Meanwhile, on the night of February 18, a fish vendor was robbed where the suspects seized P159,000 in cash and a cellphone.

text: Suno kay Mondejar, bangud sa madamo nga insidente sang holdup sa Iloilo, kinahanglan magdoble effort pa ang mga kapulisan kag mapabaskog ang ila mga tikang sa pag-identify kag pagdakop sang mga suspek kag agud indi na liwat nga matabo ang kaangay nga insidente.
english: According to Mondejar, due to the many holdup incidents in Iloilo, the police need to redouble their efforts and strengthen their measures to identify and arrest the suspects and to prevent such incidents from happening again.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, kun indi masolusyonan ang holdup incidents sa Iloilo mangin makaalarma ini sa publiko.
english: He added that if the holdup incidents in Iloilo are not resolved, it will be alarming to the public.

text: Abanse na sa knockout stage ang Japan matapos ginlutos ang anay FIFA World Cup Champion nga Spain sa bag-o lang gid nagtakop nga hampang, 2-1.
english: Japan advanced to the knockout stage after beating former FIFA World Cup champion Spain 2-1 in the recently concluded match.

text: Ginpierde sang Japan ang Spain sa ila hampang nga ginpatigayon sa Khalifa International Stadium kun sa diin naghimo man ini sang daku nga upset sang nagligad nga semana kag ginlutos man ang former World Cup Champion nga Germany.
english: Japan defeated Spain in their match held at the Khalifa International Stadium where they also made a big upset last week and also defeated former World Cup Champion Germany.

text: Ang naka-score para sa Japan amo sanday Ritso Doan sa 48th minute, kag Ao Tanaka sa 51st minute.
english: Scoring for Japan were Ritso Doan in the 48th minute, and Ao Tanaka in the 51st minute.

text: Sunod nga atubangon sang Japan ang 2018 runner-up nga Croatia sa knockout rounds.
english: Japan will next face 2018 runner-up Croatia in the knockout rounds.

text: Apisar nalutos sang Japan ang Spain, maga-abanse man ini sa knockout stage kag sunod nga atubangon ang Morocco.
english: Although Japan defeated Spain, it will also advance to the knockout stage and next face Morocco.

text: Ini bangud patas sila sang Germany nga yara sa apat ka puntos apang ang Spain ang magaabanse sa last 16 bangud sa goal difference.
english: This is because they are tied with Germany on four points but Spain will advance to the last 16 due to goal difference.

text:
Yari ang kabug-usan nga mga puntos sa Group E:

JAPAN – 2 wins, 0 draw, 1 loss – 6 points

SPAIN – 1 win, 1 draw, 1 loss – 4 points

GERMANY – 1 win, 1 draw, 1 loss -4 points

COSTA RICA – 1 win, 0 draw, 2 losses – 3 points
english:
Here are the total points in Group E:

JAPAN – 2 wins, 0 draws, 1 loss – 6 points

SPAIN – 1 win, 1 draw, 1 loss – 4 points

GERMANY – 1 win, 1 draw, 1 loss -4 points

COSTA RICA – 1 win, 0 draws, 2 losses – 3 points

text: Indi na naman madayon ang koronasyon sang Miss World Philippines sa Agusto 8 bangud sa pagpaidalom sa National Capital Region (NCR) sa Enhanced Community Quarantine (ECQ).
english: The coronation of Miss World Philippines on August 8 will be canceled due to the National Capital Region (NCR) being placed under Enhanced Community Quarantine (ECQ).

text: Wala pa sang detalye ang organisasyon sa mangin petsa sang koronasyon.
english: The organization has not yet released details on the date of the coronation.

text: Ini na ang ika-duha ka beses nga ginpa-iway ang Miss World Philippines pageant nga natalana kuntani sang Hulyo 25 apang bangud ginpaidalom anay ang NCR sa heightened GCQ restrition, gin-isol ini sa Agusto 8.
english: This is the second time that the Miss World Philippines pageant, which was scheduled for July 25, was postponed to August 8 due to the heightened GCQ restriction.

text: Ang mangin hosts sa coronation night amo sanday Xian Lim, Winwyn Marquez kag Alyssa Muhlach.
english: Hosting the coronation night will be Xian Lim, Winwyn Marquez and Alyssa Muhlach.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Ann Palmares amo ang pambato sang Iloilo City sa diin nakuna sini ang atensyon sang netizens bangud sa iya batchoy inspired national costume.
english: Nahibaluan nga si Ann Palmares amo ang pambato sang Iloilo City sa diin nakuna sini ang atensyon sang netizens bangud sa iya batchoy inspired national costume.

text:
[Trigger Warning: Mention of Mental Health Problem]

Wala na sang plano ang pamilya nga magpasaka pa sang kaso batok sa isa ka iloy nga amo ang nagsulod sang iya kaugalingon nga bata sa drum sa atubang sang ila balay sa Barangay Sipitan, Tigbauan, Iloilo.
english:
[Trigger Warning: Mention of Mental Health Problem]

The family has no plans to file a case against a mother who put her own child in a drum in front of their house in Barangay Sipitan, Tigbauan, Iloilo.

text: Suno ini kay Police Captain Alfred Mansoy, hepe sang Tigbauan Municipal Police Station, sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, Hulyo 21.
english: This was stated by Police Captain Alfred Mansoy, chief of Tigbauan Municipal Police Station, in an interview with Bombo Radyo, July 21.

text: Gin-refer man ini sang pulis sa Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSDWO) para sa case study.
english: The police also referred him to the Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSDWO) for case study.

text: Kaina sang nasapwan na lamang ang bangkay sang bata kun sa diin ang ginatudlo may kahimuan amo ang iloy nga si Mary Jane, 27.
english: The body of the child was found yesterday and the suspect is the mother, Mary Jane, 27.

text: Sa interview kay Wilma Ojerio, punong barangay sang Sipitan, Tigbauan, ginpahayag sini nga sang Domingo, Hulyo 20, ginhagad sang live-in partner si Mary Jane nga magsimba sila apang wala nagsunod ang babaye kag nagpabilin lang sa ila balay upod ang ila bata.
english: In an interview with Wilma Ojerio, barangay captain of Sipitan, Tigbauan, she said that on Sunday, July 20, her live-in partner invited Mary Jane to church with them but the woman did not follow and stayed at home with their child.

text: Pagkauli sang lalaki, wala na niya nakit-an si Mary Jane kag ang ila nga bata.
english: When the man returned home, he did not find Mary Jane and their child.

text: Gilayon nila ginpangita ang mag-iloy tubtob sang gab-i sang Domingo kag ila nakit-an kainang aga sang Hulyo 21 si Mary Jane nga nagapanago sa kawayanan nga ginabanta may 300-metros ang kalayuon halin sa ila balay.
english: They immediately searched for the mother and daughter until Sunday night and found Mary Jane on the morning of July 21 hiding in a bamboo tree about 300 meters away from their house.

text: Suno pa kay Ojerio, may ginabatyag na daan si Mary Jane nga problema sa panghuna-huna antes pa sini nga insidente, kag posible nga nakuha niya ini nga kondisyon pagkatapos niya magbata.
english: According to Ojerio, Mary Jane was already suffering from mental problems before the incident, and it is possible that she acquired this condition after giving birth.

text: Pahayag pa sang barangay official, wala gid nakaagi pa-check up sa doktor si Mary Jane bangud sang kapigaduhon sang ila kabuhi.
english: According to the barangay official, Mary Jane never went to the doctor for a check up because of the poverty of their lives.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang bata nga napatay amo ang naga-isahanon nga anak ni Mary Jane sa iya ikaduha nga live-in partner.
english: It was learned that the child who died was Mary Jane's only child with her second live-in partner.

text: Sa una sini nga live-in partner, may yara siya sang duha pa ka kabataan nga didto na sa pagtatap sang lalaki.
english: With her first live-in partner, she had two other children who were already in the man's care.

text: Sa separado nga interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Mansoy, iya ginpahayag nga gin-ako mismo ni Mary Jane nga siya ang nagbutang sang iya bata sa drum, apang wala siya nakahibalo kon ngaa nahimo niya ini.
english: In a separate interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Mansoy said Mary Jane herself admitted that she put her child in the drum, but she did not know why she did it.

text: Sang nasapwan ang bata nagapalamuti na ini kag mabaho na.
english: When the child was found, he was bleeding and smelling bad.

text: Ginabanta nga kulang na lang sang tunga ka dangaw agud mapuno na ang tubig sa drum.
english: It is estimated that the drum is only half a gallon away from being filled with water.

text:
Base sa pagpangusisa sang Bombo Radyo, ang bata nga lalaki ang maga-selebrar pa lang kuntani sang iya una nga kaadlawan sa Byernes, Hulyo 25.#

(With reports from: Bombo Krylle Melliza)
english:
Based on Bombo Radyo's investigation, the boy was about to celebrate his first birthday on Friday, July 25.#

(With reports from: Bombo Krylle Melliza)

text: Gin-ako ni Cavite 4th District Representative Kiko Barzaga nga apisar nga wala siya sa karon sa isa ka relasyon, aktibo siya nga naga-date sang duha tubtob tatlo ka beses sa isa ka semana.
english: Cavite 4th District Representative Kiko Barzaga admitted that although he is not currently in a relationship, he actively dates two to three times a week.

text: Sa interview kay Boy Abunda, ginpahayag sang lamharon nga kongresista nga masako siya sa trabaho agud makasulod sa seryoso nga relasyon sa subong.
english: In an interview with Boy Abunda, the young congressman said he is busy with work to get into a serious relationship right now.

text: Apang, suno sa iya, bukas siya sa casual dating.
english: However, she says she is open to casual dating.

text: Ginpaambit man ni Barzaga nga mas madamo ang naga-message sa iya online, kalabanan halin sa LGBTQ+ community.
english: Barzaga also shared that more people are messaging her online, mostly from the LGBTQ+ community.

text: Ginklaro sini nga straight siya kag wala naga-intra sa kasubong nga mga relasyon.
english: He clarified that he is straight and does not participate in such relationships.

text: Gin-ako man ni Barzaga sa isa ka istorya nga naka-date siya sang isa ka transgender woman nga wala niya gilayon nakilala nga trans.
english: Barzaga also admitted in a story that he dated a transgender woman whom he didn’t immediately recognize as trans.

text: Pahayag pa niya, wala sang may natabo sa tunga nila kag nahibaluan niya lang ini sa isa ka babaye nga abyan.
english: She said nothing happened between them and she only learned about it from a female friend.

text: Wala napaslawan nga makasulod sa Top 3 ang bugal sang Barangay Ravina, Sibunag, Guimaras nga si Kimberly Clark matapos nagpasundayag sa Miss Filipina International 2021.
english: Kimberly Clark, the pride of Barangay Ravina, Sibunag, Guimaras, did not fail to make it to the Top 3 after her performance in Miss Filipina International 2021.

text: Ginpatigayon ang coronation night sa Redondo Beach Performing Arts Theater, sa California.
english: The coronation night was held at the Redondo Beach Performing Arts Theater, in California.

text: Diri kag naangkon sang Guimaras beauty ang 2nd runner up nga title.
english: Guimaras beauty won the 2nd runner up title.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Beniel Frank Aspero, anay manunudlo ni Clark sa Holy Rosary Academy sa Nueva Valencia, Guimaras, iya ginpahayag nga yara na sa senior high school ang iya former student sang ginpadayon sini ang pag-eskwela sa Estados Unidos.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Beniel Frank Aspero, Clark's former teacher at the Holy Rosary Academy in Nueva Valencia, Guimaras, said his former student was already in senior high school when he continued his studies in the United States.

text: Suno kay Aspero, sang na-qualify ang 20 anyos nga si Clark para sa Miss Filipina International pageant, nagbalik siya sa Pilipinas para sa iya training.
english: According to Aspero, when 20-year-old Clark qualified for the Miss Filipina International pageant, she returned to the Philippines for her training.

text: Dugang pa niya, dako na nga dungog para sa Guimaras nga nakuha ni Clark ang 2nd runner up nga pwesto ilabi na nga first time sini mag-intra sa isa ka international pageant sa iya nga edad.
english: He added that it is a great honor for Guimaras that Clark won the 2nd runner up position especially since it is his first time participating in an international pageant at his age.

text: Ginapapangita na subong sang Department of Justice ang testigo nga si Orly Guteza, ginapahayag nga anay security consultant ni resigned Ako Bicol Rep.
english: The Department of Justice is now looking for witness Orly Guteza, allegedly a former security consultant of resigned Ako Bicol Rep.

text: Zaldy Co.
english: Zaldy Co.

text: Suno kay Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin ‘Boying’ Remulla, iya na ini ginsiling sa National Bureau of Investigation agud matukiban na ang lokasyon sang amo nga testigo.
english: Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin 'Boying' Remulla said he has already told the National Bureau of Investigation to locate the witness.

text: Matandaan nga si Orly Guteza ang nagbuyagyag sang minaleta nga basura, codename sa kwarta nga ginapadala kanday former House Speaker Martin Romualdez kag Congressman Zaldy Co.
english: It can be recalled that Orly Guteza revealed the garbage can, codename for the money sent to former House Speaker Martin Romualdez and Congressman Zaldy Co.

text: “Wala pa, but we’re asking the NBI nga to trace his whereabouts so that he can shed light on the notarization and other issues that are part of it,” pahayag ni Sec.
english: “Not yet, but we’re asking the NBI to trace his whereabouts so that he can shed light on the notarization and other issues that are part of it,” said Sec.

text: Jesus Crispin ‘Boying’ Remulla sang Department of Justice.
english: Jesus Crispin ‘Boying’ Remulla of the Department of Justice.

text: Kasunod sang iya indi pagsipot sa naestoryahan kuntani nga pagkitaay nila sang tiglikom, tuyo ni Justice Secretary Remulla nga mahatagan klaro pa ang tuhoy sa iya affidavit.
english: Following his failure to attend the scheduled meeting with the secretary, Justice Secretary Remulla intends to clarify his affidavit.

text: Isa ka 26-anyos nga criminology graduate nga nagpadulong sa Manila halin sa Samar para mangita sang trabaho ang napatay matapos ginbuno kag ginkastigo sang mga tawo.
english: A 26-year-old criminology graduate who came to Manila from Samar to look for work died after being stabbed and beaten by people.

text: Ang biktima ginkawatan sang cellphone apang napasibangdan pa nga siya ang kawatan.
english: The victim was robbed of a cellphone but was accused of being the thief.

text: Natabo ang insidente sa Barangay 718 sa Maynila.
english: The incident occurred in Barangay 718 in Manila.

text: Sa video footage, nakit-an nga nagauba kag nagakaya ang wala na nagahulag nga si Christian Ambon, nha may igo sang buno sa kilid.
english: In the video footage, Christian Ambon was seen naked and lying on the floor, with a gunshot wound to the side.

text: Gindala siya sa ospital apang ginbawian sang kabuhi.
english: He was rushed to the hospital but died.

text: Bag-o napatay, nakahambal pa ang biktima nga isa ka “Junjun” ang nagkuha sang iya nga cellphone gani ginlagas niya ini.
english: Before he died, the victim said that a “Junjun” took his cellphone and he chased him.

text: Apang may nagsinggit sang tinaga nga kawatan kag si Christian ang napasibangdan.
english: But someone shouted the word thief and Christian was blamed.

text: Nagapatigayon na sang imbestigasyon ang Manila Police District sa insidente.
english: The Manila Police District is conducting an investigation into the incident.

text: Luyag naman sang pamilya nga madala pauli sa Samar ang bangkay ni Christian apang kulang ang ila nga kwarta.
english: The family wants to bring Christian's body back to Samar but they lack the money.

text: Nagtimbuok pa sa P12.76 trillion ang utang sang Pilipinas sa katapusan nga bahin sang Abril, 2022.
english: The Philippines' debt rose to P12.76 trillion as of the end of April, 2022.

text: Suno sa Bureau of Treasury, mas mataas ini sang 0.7 percent ukon P83.40 billion sa P12.68 trillion nga narekord nga utang sang pungsod sang bulan sang Pebrero.
english: According to the Bureau of Treasury, this is 0.7 percent or P83.40 billion higher than the country's P12.68 trillion recorded debt in February.

text: Sa kabug-usan nga utang, 30 percent ang halin sa guwa sang pungsod, kag 70 percent ang domestic borrowings.
english: Of the total debt, 30 percent is from outside the country, and 70 percent is domestic borrowings.

text: Ang P8.93 trillion nga domestic debt sang Abril ang ginapahayag nga 0.8 percent nga mas mataas ipaanggid sa utang sang bulan sang Marso.
english: The P8.93 trillion domestic debt in April was reportedly 0.8 percent higher compared to the debt in March.

text: Ang external debt naman nga P3.83 trillion ang mas mataas sang 0.4 percent ipaanggid sang nagligad nga bulan.
english: External debt of P3.83 trillion was 0.4 percent higher than last month.

text: Sandig sa rekord sang Bureau of Treasury, halin sang nagpungko si Presidente Rodrigo Duterte, nag-sobra sa doble ang utang sang pungsod halin anay sa P5.95 trillion nga narekord sa katapusan sang Hunyo 2016.
english: According to Bureau of Treasury records, since President Rodrigo Duterte took office, the country's debt has more than doubled from P5.95 trillion recorded at the end of June 2016.

text: Ang incoming administration ni president-elect Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos, Jr.
english: The incoming administration of president-elect Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos, Jr.

text: ang nagapangatubang sang responsiblidad nga magsalo sini nga utang samtang nga ginatutukan man ang pagpabangon sang ekonomiya.
english: is facing the responsibility of taking on this debt while also focusing on economic recovery.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang Department of Finance (DOF) nga may yara sang fiscal consolidation plan agud nga makatipon sang P284 billion kada tuig sa masunod nga napulo ka tuig.
english: Earlier, the Department of Finance (DOF) said it has a fiscal consolidation plan to raise P284 billion annually for the next ten years.

text: Ini agud makumpleto bayad ang P3.2 trillion nga nautang sang Pilipinas bangud sa gingasto bilang response sa COVID-19 pandemic.
english: This is to complete the repayment of the P3.2 trillion owed by the Philippines due to spending in response to the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Ini nga fiscal consolidation plan ang nagalakip sang pagpatuman sang bag-o nga buwis, pag-postpone sang personal income tax reductions, kag pagpasangkad sang value added tax base.
english: This fiscal consolidation plan includes implementing new taxes, postponing personal income tax reductions, and expanding the value added tax base.

text: Nagtakop ang hampang sang Germany kag Costa Rica sa skor nga 4-2.
english: The match between Germany and Costa Rica ended with a score of 4-2.

text: Apisar daog batok sa Costa Rica, huyhuy ang abaga sang four-time World Cup champion nga Germany bangud eliminated na sila sa 2022 World Cup tournament.
english: Despite the win over Costa Rica, four-time World Cup champions Germany are shaking their shoulders as they are eliminated from the 2022 World Cup tournament.

text: Ini bangud sa Group E, patas sila sang Spain nga yara sa apat ka puntos apang ang Spain ang magaabanse sa round of 16 bangud sa goal difference.
english: This is because in Group E, they are tied with Spain on four points but Spain will advance to the round of 16 due to the goal difference.

text: Daku ini nga kalutusan sa Germany bangud sang 2014, sila ang nagdaog sa World Cup apang na-eliminate sa duha ka sunod-sunod nga group stages.
english: This is a big defeat for Germany because in 2014, they won the World Cup but were eliminated in two consecutive group stages.

text: Third placer man ang national team sang 2010 kag runner-up sang 2002.
english: The national team was also third place in 2010 and runner-up in 2002.

text:
Yari ang kabug-usan nga puntos sa Group E:

JAPAN – 2 wins, 0 draw, 1 loss – 6 points

SPAIN – 1 win, 1 draw, 1 loss – 4 points

GERMANY – 1 win, 1 draw, 1 loss -4 points

COSTA RICA – 1 win, 0 draw, 2 losses – 3 points
english:
Here are the total points in Group E:

JAPAN – 2 wins, 0 draws, 1 loss – 6 points

SPAIN – 1 win, 1 draw, 1 loss – 4 points

GERMANY – 1 win, 1 draw, 1 loss -4 points

COSTA RICA – 1 win, 0 draws, 2 losses – 3 points

text: Nabuko sang mga otoridad nga indi matuod nga may duha ka mga estudyante ang ginkidnap sang puti nga van kag naglapta sa social media sa Davao City.
english: Authorities have discovered that it is not true that two students were kidnapped by a white van and spread on social media in Davao City.

text: Base sa naggwa nga impormasyon, may duha ka estudyante nga ginkidnap kag ginpasakay sa puti nga van malapit sa isa ka sang Pebrero 19, 2025.
english: According to reports, two students were kidnapped and taken in a white van near a ka on February 19, 2025.

text: Apang naggwa sa imbestigasyon nga nagligoy ang mga estudyante kag naglagaw sa isa mall.
english: However, the investigation revealed that the students took a bath and went for a walk in a mall.

text: Ginpilasan pa sang hungod sang mga estudyante ang ila lawas para suportahan ang ila pagbinutig.
english: The students even deliberately injured themselves to support their lies.

text: Apang sang ulihi, nakit-an sila sa isa ka convenience store.
english: But later, they were found in a convenience store.

text: Suno kay Police Captain Hazel Tuazon, Davao City Police Office (DCPO) spokesperson, nahadlok ang mga estudyante nga maakigan sang ila ginikanan rason nga nag-imbento sila sang istorya.
english: According to Police Captain Hazel Tuazon, Davao City Police Office (DCPO) spokesperson, the students were afraid of being angry with their parents so they invented a story.

text: Ipaidalom ang duha ka estudyante sa assessment kag monitoring sang social workers.
english: The two students will be subjected to assessment and monitoring by social workers.

text: Nagahulag ang Severe Tropical Storm Paolo padulong sa direksyon sang southern China.
english: Severe Tropical Storm Paolo is moving towards southern China.

text: Sandig ini sa 11:00 sa aga nga bulletin sang state weather bureau, Oktubre 4.
english: This is based on the 11:00 am bulletin of the state weather bureau, October 4.

text:
Ulihi nga nakit-an ang sentro sang bagyo sa kalayuon nga 440 km nakatundan sang Sinait, Ilocos Sur samtang dala ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 110 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 135 km/h.

Nagahulag ini pa-nakatundan naaminhan-nakatundan sa kadasigon nga 20 km/h.

Wala naman sang areas sa Luzon nga napaidalom pa sa bisan ano nga wind signal.
english:
The center of the typhoon was last spotted 440 km west of Sinait, Ilocos Sur with winds of 110 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 135 km/h.

It is moving west northwest at a speed of 20 km/h.

No areas in Luzon are still under any wind signal.

text: Sa track forecast, magapadayon sa paghulag ang bagyo sa direksyon nga pa-nakatundan naaminhan-nakatundan padulong sa southern China.
english: According to the track forecast, the typhoon will continue to move in a westerly northwesterly direction towards southern China.

text: Samtang nga yara pa ini sa West Philippine Sea, mahimo ini magbaskog liwat kag magbalik sa Typhoon category.
english: While it is still in the West Philippine Sea, it could strengthen again and return to the Typhoon category.

text: Alas singko sa kaagahon kaina sang ginkumpirma sang bureau nga nakaguwa na sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) ang amo nga bagyo.
english: The bureau confirmed that the typhoon had left the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) at 5:00 am yesterday.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, sa latest monitoring sang DOST-PAGASA, mataas ang tyansa nga mangin Tropical Depression sa masunod nga 24 oras ang Low Pressure Area (LPA) nga yara sa guwa sang PAR.
english: Meanwhile, according to the latest monitoring of DOST-PAGASA, the Low Pressure Area (LPA) outside the PAR is likely to become a Tropical Depression in the next 24 hours.

text: As of 8:00 a.m., na-monitor ini sa kalayuon nga 2,300 kilometros Nakatundan Naaminhan-Nakatundan sang Extreme Northern Luzon.
english: As of 8:00 a.m., it was monitored at a distance of 2,300 kilometers west northwest of Extreme Northern Luzon.

text: Dalayon na nga nagpaalam sa 2022 World Cup ang World Number 2 nga Belgium matapos nga nagtakop sa scoreless draw ang hampang sini sa Group F batok sa Croatia.
english: World Number 2 Belgium immediately said goodbye to the 2022 World Cup after their Group F match against Croatia ended in a scoreless draw.

text: Wala naman sang sudlan ang kalipay sang pang-numero 12 nga Croatia bangud magaabanse na ini sa knockout stage.
english: No. 12 Croatia is overjoyed to advance to the knockout stage.

text: Matandaan nga yara sa ikatatlo nga pwesto sang 2018 ang Belgium, apang sa subong nga tuig, isa ka bes lamang ini nga nagdaog kag amo ini ang imbukada nga hampang batok sa Canada, 1-0.
english: Belgium was in third place in 2018, but this year, it has won only once and this is the opening game against Canada, 1-0.

text: Sunod ini nga nagsuprer sang kalutusan sa kamot sang Morocco nga pang-22 lang sa FIFA rankings rason nga indi man makapati ang football fans kag may riot pa nga natabo mismo sa Brussels, Belgium.
english: It next suffered a defeat at the hands of Morocco, which is only 22nd in the FIFA rankings, which left football fans in disbelief and a riot broke out in Brussels, Belgium.

text: Antes ini nga masakit nga group stage exit, ang Belgium amo man ang nagapanguna sa world rankings halin sang September 2018 tubtub sa March 2022.
english: Before this painful group stage exit, Belgium were also at the top of the world rankings from September 2018 to March 2022.

text:
Yari ang kabug-usan nga puntos sa group match:

MOROCCO – 2 wins, 1 draw, 0 loss – 7 points

CROATIA – 1 win, 2 draws, 0 loss – 5 points

BELGIUM – 1 win, 1 draw, 1 loss – 4 points

CANADA – 0 win, 0 draw, 3 losses – 0 point
english:

MOROCCO – 2 wins, 1 draw, 0 loss – 7 points

BELGIUM – 1 win, 1 draw, 1 loss – 4 points
