text: Ginpahayag ni incoming Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) Secretary Ivan Uy nga lauman sang tatlo ka telecommunications providers sa pungsod nga mangin mas madamo kag hugot pa ang kumpetisyon sa telco industry sa masunod nga mga tuig.
english: Incoming Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) Secretary Ivan Uy said the three telecommunications providers in the country expect more and fiercer competition in the telco industry in the coming years.

text: Posible ang senaryo nga ini matapos nga ginpasar sang gobyerno ang pila ka amendments kaangay sang Public Services Act, Foreign Investments Act, kag Retail Liberalization Law nga amo ang ginapanan-aw nga maka-attract sang dugang nga foreign investors sa Pilipinas.
english: This scenario is possible after the government passed several amendments such as the Public Services Act, Foreign Investments Act, and Retail Liberalization Law which are expected to attract more foreign investors to the Philippines.

text: Suno pa kay Uy, gamay para sa Pilipinas ang tatlo lang ka providers kun yara sa 100 ka milyon ang populasyon.
english: According to Uy, the Philippines has only three providers with a population of 100 million.

text: Mangin ang Singapore suno sa natungdan nga isa man ka gamay nga pungsod ang may yara sang lima ka telco companies.
english: Singapore, which is also a small country, has five telco companies.

text: Ginpahayag pa sini nga madamo pa ang asikasuhon sang pungsod pag-abot sa pag-improve sang internet connectivity sa Pilipinas, ilabi na sa malayo nga mga lugar.
english: He said the country still has a lot to take care of when it comes to improving internet connectivity in the Philippines, especially in remote areas.

text:
Diri kag nagasulod suno kay Uy ang Starlink broadband satellite services ni Elon Musk — ang ginakabig nga “perfect technology” kag isa man ka “game-changing event.”

Matandaan nga sang Byernes, gin-aprubahan na sang National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) ang registration sang Starlink bilang value-added service (VAS) provider.
english:
This is where Uy said Elon Musk’s Starlink broadband satellite services come in — considered the “perfect technology” and also a “game-changing event.”

It can be recalled that on Friday, the National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) approved the registration of Starlink as a value-added service (VAS) provider.

text: Wala ginpalampuwas sang aktres kag vlogger nga si Ivana Alawi ang mga negatibo nga komento nga iya nabaton sa social media kaangay na lamang sang pagtawag sa iya nga retokada kag bold star.
english: Actress and vlogger Ivana Alawi did not hide the negative comments she received on social media such as calling her a retokada and bold star.

text: Suno kay Ivana, pango man sa gihapon ang iya nga ilong.
english: According to Ivana, her nose is still stuffy.

text: Isa ka netizen ang nagpahayag man nga gubaon ang ngipon sang sexy actress.
english: A netizen also claimed that the sexy actress's teeth are broken.

text: Depensa ni Ivana, ang importante nga naga-toothbrush siya duha ka beses sa isa ka adlaw kag nagapadentista.
english: Ivana said the important thing is that she brushes her teeth twice a day and goes to the dentist.

text: Para naman sa mga nagahambal sa iya nga bold star, pahayag sang vilogger, kalipayan niya ang magsuksok sang bikini kag wala man niya gina-uba ang iya nga bra kag panty.
english: For those who call her a bold star, the vilogger said she enjoys wearing a bikini and doesn't take off her bra and panty.

text: Ginsabat ni Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne Jamjam Baronda ang pahayag ni Mayor Raisa Treñas nga posible ang isa sa mga rason sa pagbaha sa pila ka mga areas sa Jaro, amo ang proyekto sang kongresista.
english: Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne Jamjam Baronda responded to Mayor Raisa Treñas' statement that one of the reasons for the flooding in some areas in Jaro may be the congressman's project.

text: Una diri, ginpahayag sang alkalde nga naglab-ot na sa tatlo ka tapak ang tubig sa mga lugar nga sadto, wala gid nagabaha kag isa sa ginatudlo sang mga residente nga balasulon amo ang mga proyekto nga ginapatuman ni Cong.
english: Earlier, the mayor said the water level has reached three feet in areas that used to never flood and one of the reasons blamed by residents is the projects implemented by Cong.

text: JamJam Baronda.
english: ClockClock Baronda.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Baronda, iya gin-athag nga madugay na nga may pagbaha sa amo nga mga lugar, indi lamang subong ini nagsugod kag indi man dapat iangot sa iya mga proyekto.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Baronda explained that flooding in these areas has been going on for a long time, not just now and should not be linked to his projects.

text: Suno pa kay Baronda, may pamatuod nga bisan sang wala pa siya sa pwesto, may kasaysayan na ang problema sa drainage system sa Lawaan kag kasilingan sini.
english: Baronda said there is evidence that even before he was in office, there was a history of problems with the drainage system in Lawaan and its surroundings.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Baronda nga ang proyekto nga ginatudlo nga kabangdanan, kabahin sang iya pagpanikasog nga mangin sabat sa madugay na nga problema sang pumuluyo, apang subong, imbes pasalamatan, ginabasol pa.
english: Baronda also said that the project, which is allegedly the cause, is part of his efforts to be the answer to the long-standing problem of the people, but now, instead of being thanked, he is being blamed.

text: Ginpangabay niya ang ‘pasensya’ sang publiko kag ginpasalig nga may klaro siya nga plano kag determinasyon nga tapuson ang problema nga wala natagaan solusyon sang pila na ka dekada.
english: He asked for the public's 'patience' and assured that he has a clear plan and determination to end the problem that has not been given a solution for several decades.

text: Suno kay Baronda, may commitment siya nga matapos ang trabaho kag mahatagan sang permanente nga sabat ang mga apektado nga lugar.
english: Baronda said he is committed to completing the work and providing permanent answers to the affected areas.

text: Napatay na sa edad nga 89 ang retired actor turned director nga si Robert Redford.
english: Retired actor turned director Robert Redford has died at the age of 89.

text: Suno kay Cindi Berger, CEO sang publicity firm nga Rogers & Cowan PMK, ginbawian sang kabuhi ang Hollywood legend sa ila puluy-an sa Sundance, Utah, Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: According to Cindi Berger, CEO of publicity firm Rogers & Cowan PMK, the Hollywood legend passed away at his home in Sundance, Utah, United States of America.

text: Wala gintumod ni Berger ang rason sang kamatayon sang entertainment icon.
english: Berger did not specify the entertainment icon’s cause of death.

text:
Pagkatapos nga magsikat sang 1960s, isa si Redford sa ginatangla sang 1970s bangud sa mga pelikula nga “The Candidate,” “All the President’s Men” kag “The Way We Were.”

Natapos niya ang amo nga dekada nga ginpasidunggan bilang Best Director sa Oscars para sa pelikula nga “Ordinary People” sang 1980 nga amo man ang nagdaug bilang Best Picture.
english:
After rising to fame in the 1960s, Redford was one of the most watched in the 1970s for films such as “The Candidate,” “All the President’s Men” and “The Way We Were.”

He ended that decade being honored as Best Director at the Oscars for the film “Ordinary People” in 1980 which also won for Best Picture.

text:
Nakit-an man siya bilang Alexander Pierce sa mga pelikula nga “Avengers: Endgame” kag “Captain America: The Winter Soldier.”

Si Redford man ang founder sang Sundance Film Festival nga tuigan nga ginapatigayon sa Utah halin pa sang 1978.#
english:
He was also seen as Alexander Pierce in the films “Avengers: Endgame” and “Captain America: The Winter Soldier.”

Redford is also the founder of the Sundance Film Festival, which has been held annually in Utah since 1978.#

text: Iloilo – Nag-ayo na ang tanan nga kaso sang hand-foot-and-mouth disease nga narekord sang probinsya sang Iloilo humalin sang Enero 1 tubtob Pebrero 11, 2023.
english: Iloilo – All cases of hand-foot-and-mouth disease recorded in the province of Iloilo from January 1 to February 11, 2023 have recovered.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor, Jr., iya ginpahayag nga wala na niya ginakonsidera pa ang pagpaidalom sa probinsya sa State of Calamity bangud fully recovered na ang 1,647 cases.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor, Jr., said he is no longer considering placing the province under a state of calamity because 1,647 cases have been fully recovered.

text: Apisar sini suno kay Gov.
english: Despite this, according to Gov.

text: Defensor, padayon sa gihapon ang mga protocols nga ginahimo sa kada banwa kaangay na lang sa pag-disinfect sang mga pasilidad agud nga indi maglapta ang balatian.
english: Defensor, protocols are still being implemented in each town such as disinfecting facilities to prevent the spread of the disease.

text: Samtang, nag-ako naman ang gobernador nga indi pa mahimo nga makadeklarar sang probinsya sang state of calamity sa amo nga balatian bangud kulang ini sa pondo.
english: Meanwhile, the governor acknowledged that the province cannot declare a state of calamity due to lack of funds.

text: Samtang, ginpahayag naman ni Dr. Maria Socorro Quiِnon, head sang Provincial Health Office, nga mild kag self-limiting lamang ang hand-foot-and-mouth disease.
english: Meanwhile, Dr. Maria Socorro Quinínon, head of the Provincial Health Office, said the hand-foot-and-mouth disease is mild and self-limiting.

text: Buot silingon, naga-ayo man ang pasyente sa sulod sang pito tubtob napulo ka adlaw ilabi na kun manami ang response sang immune system.
english: This means that the patient recovers within seven to ten days especially if the immune system responds well.

text: Sa subong suno kay Dr. Quinon, wala sang may nabaton nga report ang Provincial Health Office nga may yara sang pasyente nga naglapaw sa napulo ka adlaw ang pagsuprer sini sang nasambit nga balatian.
english: Currently, according to Dr. Quinon said the Provincial Health Office has not received any reports of patients who have been suffering from the disease for more than 10 days.

text: Paano kun nagbugtaw ka nga wala ka na sang sag-ang?
english: What if you woke up with nothing to eat?

text: Mahilibion ka gid kaangay sang natabo sa isa ka pasyente sa Roma.
english: You will be moved to tears, as happened to a patient in Rome.

text: Ini nga 35-anyos nga lalaki ang nagkadto sa Umberto I Dental Clinic para nga ipa-extract kuntani ang iya nga wisdom tooth kag cyst.
english: The 35-year-old man went to Umberto I Dental Clinic to have his wisdom tooth and cyst extracted.

text: Matapos ang biopsy sa cyst, ginhambalan ang lalaki nga may “malignant” tumor na na ini gani kinahanglan nga kuhaon ang iya sag-ang paagi sa surgery.
english: After a biopsy of the cyst, the man was told that he had a “malignant” tumor and that his tumor would need to be surgically removed.

text: Nagsugot siya sa operasyon para nga makaluwas sa balatian gani nga pagkatapos sang surgery, nakaangkon ini sang permanent facial damage partikular sa tuo nga bahin sang iya baba.
english: He agreed to the surgery to get rid of the disease so that after the surgery, he suffered permanent facial damage particularly on the right side of his mouth.

text: Isa ka bulan ang nagligad, tuman ang iya kakibot sa follow-up tests sa tumor bangud negatibo na ang resulta.
english: A month later, she was shocked by the follow-up tests on the tumor because the results were negative.

text: Ginsilingan man ini nga indi na kinahanglan ang chemotherapy.
english: She was also told that chemotherapy was no longer needed.

text: Nagpangayo ini sang second opinion, kag sang gin-check ang pareho man nga biological material sa lain nga laboratory sa Catholic University of Rome, natukiban nga wala man siya sang tumor.
english: He sought a second opinion, and when the same biological material was checked in a different laboratory at the Catholic University of Rome, it was found that he did not have a tumor.

text: Ang mas malala, natukiban man niya nga indi na kuntani kinahanglan nga magpaidalom siya sa surgery.
english: What’s worse, she also discovered that she wouldn’t have needed to undergo the surgery.

text: Natukiban sini sa ulihi nga nasimpon gali sang staff sa Umberto I Dental Clinic ang resulta.
english: He later discovered that the staff at Umberto I Dental Clinic had collected the results.

text: Iya ini sang pasyente nga may malignant tumor sa iya nga sag-ang.
english: It belonged to a patient who had a malignant tumor in his neck.

text: Indi mahangpan sang lalaki ang iya batyagon subong bangud buhi siya, healthy, kag wala sang fatal disease, apang daku na ang nangin kulang sa iya nawong.
english: The man could not understand how he felt now because he was alive, healthy, and without a fatal disease, but his face was missing a lot.

text: Nagpasaka man sang kaso ang lalaki batok sa hospital kag nagpanukot sang damages.
english: The man also filed a lawsuit against the hospital and demanded damages.

text: Nagapadayon naman ang imbestigasyon sa natabo nga medical mix-up.
english: The investigation into the medical mix-up is ongoing.

text: Magasaka na naman ang presyo sang produktong petrolyo sa masunod nga semana.
english: The price of petroleum products will rise again next week.

text:
Sandig sa industry estimates sa Mean of Platts Singapore (MOPS) trading sa nagligad nga adlaw, yari ang gina-project nga paghulag sa presyo:

Gasoline – posible magsaka sang P0.60 per literDiesel – posible magsaka sang P1.35 per literKerosene – posible magsaka sang P1.00 per liter

Suno sa Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau, wala pa nalakip diri ang operating cost sang mga kumpaniya sang langis kag iban pa nga premiums nga posible magtupa sa P0.40 tubtub sa P0.50.
english:
Based on industry estimates on Mean of Platts Singapore (MOPS) trading on the previous day, here is the projected price movement:

Gasoline – likely to rise by P0.60 per literDiesel – likely to rise by P1.35 per literKerosene – likely to rise by P1.00 per liter

According to the Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau, this does not include the operating cost of oil companies and other premiums that are likely to fall to P0.40 to P0.50.

text: Gina-angot sang ahensya ang potensyal nga price hike sa geopolitical tension sa Iran kun sa diin linibo ka mga indibidwal ang napatay bangud sa pagprotesta, kag may posibilidad pa nga mag-intra ang Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: The agency links the potential price hike to geopolitical tensions in Iran where thousands of individuals have been killed in protests, and there is a possibility that the United States will get involved.

text: Ini nga gamo suno sa DOE ang magaapekto sa pagsaka sa presyo apisar sang oversupply sang oil products sa una nga bulan sang 2026.
english: This unrest, according to the DOE, will affect price increases despite the oversupply of oil products in the first month of 2026.

text: Ginamensyonar man sa projected numbers ang padayon nga pagluya sang balor sang Philippine Peso kontra sa US dollar.
english: The projected numbers also mention the continued depreciation of the Philippine Peso against the US dollar.

text: Kahapon, nagtakop ang trading sa bag-o nga historic low nga P59.46.
english: Yesterday, trading closed at a new historic low of P59.46.

text: Gin-anunsyo sang fuel firms ang price adjustments sa kada Lunes, kag ginapatuman sa kada Martes sang aga.
english: Fuel firms announced the price adjustments every Monday, and are implemented every Tuesday morning.

text: Matandaan nga sang Martes, Enero 13, nagpasaka ang petroleum retailers sang P0.30 sa kada litro sang gasolina; P0.20 sa diesel; kag P0.30 sa kerosene.
english: On Tuesday, January 13, petroleum retailers increased the price of gasoline by P0.30 per liter; P0.20 of diesel; and P0.30 for kerosene.

text: Ini ang pangtatlo nga sunod-sunod nga semana nga may price hike sa diesel kag kerosene.
english: This is the third consecutive week of price hike in diesel and kerosene.

text: NAPAT-UD na sang Third Party Consultant (TPC) ang problema sang Ungka Flyover sa tunga sang siyudad sang Iloilo kag sang banwa sang Pavia, nga nagapabilin nga cerrado sugod pa sadtong Setyembre 2022 pagkatapos nga ginbuksan ini sang Hunyo 2022.
english: The Third Party Consultant (TPC) has identified the problem of the Ungka Flyover between Iloilo City and Pavia town, which has remained closed since September 2022 after being opened in June 2022.

text: Manabaw lang gali ang lubong sang mga pelote para sa mga haligi sang taytay.
english: The pellets for the bridge pillars were buried shallowly.

text: Mga 28 ka tapak lang ini nga wala makalab-ut sa matig-a nga kabatuhan sa idalom sang duta kon diin makatindug ini sing mabakod.
english: It was only about 28 feet short of the hard rock below the surface where it could stand firmly.

text: Nakadangat lang gali ini sa mahumok nga duta (“liquefied soil”, sa tawag sang TPC) nga ginkabangdan sang pag-usmod sang flyover sa pila ka bahin sini sa sige agi sang madamo nga salakyan dira.
english: It actually reached the soft soil (“liquefied soil”, as TPC calls it) which caused the flyover to collapse in some parts of it due to the constant passage of many vehicles.

text: Dapat gali nakalab-ut gid ang pelote sa mga 50 ka tapak sa idalom kon diin maigu sini ang matig-a nga kabatuhan agud makatindug sing mabakod ang flyover.
english: The pelote must have reached about 50 feet below where it would hit the hard rocks in order for the flyover to stand firm.

text: Ngaa ayhan wala ini mahibal-an sang DPWH nga nag-disenyo sining flyover, nga ginsunod man lang sang contractor nga International Builders Corporation?
english: Why didn't the DPWH that designed this flyover know about it, which was followed by the contractor International Builders Corporation?

text: Posible tungod seguro ginbasehan lang nila ang ila experyensya sa pagtukod sang taytay sa palibut nga mga lugar sa amo man nga kadalumon nga pelote nga wala na sing lubos nga “boring test”.
english: Possibly because they probably just based their experience of building bridges in the surrounding areas on the same depth pelote without a complete “boring test”.

text: In other words, wala sila naniguro sa posibilidad nga may bahin ini nga mahumok sa kaidadalman.
english: In other words, they did not rule out the possibility that it had a soft part in the depths.

text: Ukon wala gid man sila sing teknolohiya kag kagamitan nga lubos matungkad ang kahimtangan sang duta nga patindugan sang flyover tubtub sa amo ina nga kadalumon, nga ang TPC lang ang may yara sing ihibalo kag kagamitan.
english: Or they do not have the technology and equipment to fully assess the condition of the land on which the flyover will be built to that depth, which only TPC has the knowledge and equipment.

text: Kon matuod ini, dapat naninguha tani ang gobyerno nga maka-provide sang teknolohiya kag kagamitan para sa DPWH agud indi matabo ang kasubong nga kapalpakan kag makadto lang sa wala ang minilyon ka pesos nga magasto dira paagi sa palagpat lang nga pamaagi nga kon tawgon “Palagpatisom” sang aton abyan nga si Pedro.
english: If this is true, the government should have tried to provide technology and equipment for the DPWH so that such a mistake does not happen and the millions of pesos that will be spent there will go to waste through a short-term method that our friend Pedro calls “Palagpatisom”.

text: Labi na gid kay wala labot sa aton problema sa trapiko madamo pa gid ka mga problema ang aton ginaatubang nga tani natagaan man sing kasubong nga importansya.
english: Especially since besides our traffic problem, we are facing many other problems that should be given the same importance.

text: Katulad lang abe sang daku nga kakulangan sang mga buluthuan nga padayon nagapa-usmod (katulad man seguro sang Ungka Flyover) sang kalidad sang aton edukasyon.
english: It's like the huge shortage of schools that continues to deteriorate (like the Ungka Flyover) the quality of our education.

text: Hambalon pa, wala na seguro sing paglaum ang aton mga kubos agud mag-asenso sa pangabuhi kundi paagi sa maayo nga edukasyon nga makahatag sa sila sing maayo nga palamugnan sa ining panahon nga nagakinahanglan sang lubos nga ihibalo sa siyensya, teknolohiya kag professionalism sa ano man matapusan nga kinaalam.
english: In other words, there is probably no hope for our poor to progress in life but through good education that can give them a good job in this age that requires full knowledge of science, technology and professionalism in any final knowledge.

text:
***

Ginpresentar ining problema sang Ungka Flyover ni Engr.
english:
***

This problem of Ungka Flyover was presented by Engr.

text: Adam Abinales sang TPC sadtong Mayo 15, 2023 sa Infrastructure Development Committee sang Regional Dev’t Council, nga gina-chair ni Mayor Jerry Trenas.
english: Adam Abinales of TPC on May 15, 2023 at the Infrastructure Development Committee of the Regional Development Council, chaired by Mayor Jerry Trenas.

text: Gintambungan man ini ni Iloilo Gov.
english: It was also attended by Iloilo Gov.

text: Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: Arthur Defensor Jr.

text: kag Pavia Mayor Luigi Gorriceta.
english: and Pavia Mayor Luigi Gorriceta.

text: Siling niya nga isa sang “bored piles” (pelote) nagatindug gali sa isa ka mahumok nga duta kag gin-rekomendar nga islan ang pila ka pelote sa tatlo ka section sang P680M nga flyover.
english: He said one of the “bored piles” (pelote) was actually standing on a soft ground and recommended that some pelote be replaced in three sections of the P680M flyover.

text: Agud ma-repair ining flyover kinahanglan gid ang mga P250M nga funding, sunu kay Engr.
english: To repair this flyover, about P250M funding is needed, according to Engr.

text: Abinales.
english: Abinales.

text: Siling ni DPWH Undersec.
english: DPWH Undersec.

text: Roberto Bernardo ugaling nga wala pa siya kahibalo kon diin kuhaon ining P250M nga galastuhon.
english: Roberto Bernardo however, he does not know where the P250M expenditure will come from.

text:
***

Ti,ano ang aton anay mahimo meantime?
english:
***

Well, what can we do in the meantime?

text: May nagasiling nga indi na gid lang pagpasigehon ang flyover kag gamiton ang P250M para sa pag-improbar kag pagpatukod sang mga eskwelahan.
english: Some say that the flyover should not be continued and the P250M should be used for the improvement and construction of schools.

text: May yara man nga luyag na gid lang gub-on ining flyover kag palaparon ang dalan sa idalom sini agud sal-i sabat sa problema sang trapiko sa sina nga lugar.
english: There are also those who want to demolish this flyover and widen the road under it to solve the traffic problem in that area.

text: Ang isa ka konsehal sang siyudad nga si Konsehal Plaridel Nava luyag gid gani pasakaan kaso ang DPWH kag ang contractor nga IBC kag pasabton sa sining kapalpakan.
english: A city councilor, Councilor Plaridel Nava, wants to sue the DPWH and the contractor IBC and hold them accountable for this failure.

text: Personally, luyag ta man pasabton sa sining kapalpakan ang sin-o man nga dapat gid man manabat.
english: Personally, we want to hold whoever is responsible accountable for this failure.

text: Bala nagpabaya gid man ang DPWH sa iya katungdanan tungod sa masami ginasiling nga “envelope” nga ginabaton sang kon sin-o nga may poder sa mga bagis, ukon buwaya pa gani, dira sa ahensya?
english: Has the DPWH really neglected its duty because of the so-called “envelope” received by those who have power over the sharks, or even crocodiles, in the agency?

text: May bahin man bala ang contractor nga IBC sa sining kapalpakan?
english: Is the contractor IBC also involved in this failure?

text: Kag kon ano pa dira nga “graft and corrupt” practice nga nagluntad sa pagpatigayon sining “sinking flyover” kon si Mayor Trenas pa ang magtawag sini?
english: And what about the “graft and corrupt” practice that occurred in the implementation of this “sinking flyover” if Mayor Trenas calls it?

text: Kon wala man lang, basi pa man lang mamedyosan nga mapainan inining pag-repair sang Ungka Flyover sang ginakinahanglan nga PhP250M.
english: If not, maybe it will be possible to reduce the repair of the Ungka Flyover by the required PhP250M.

text: Maayo na lang ina sangsa lubos nga indi mapuslan ining PhP680 nga Ungka Flyover./PN
english: That's better than completely useless this PhP680 Ungka Flyover./PN

text: May espesyal nga shoutout si Pope Francis sa mga Pilipino nga Katoliko bangud sa dalayawon kag hugot nga pagtuo.
english: Pope Francis has a special shoutout to Filipino Catholics for their admirable and strong faith.

text: Natabo ini sa speech sang Santo Papa sa pagbisita sang Filipino community halin sa Spain.
english: This happened in the Pope's speech during the visit of the Filipino community from Spain.

text: “The Filipinos are men of faith, women of faith.
english: “The Filipinos are men of faith, women of faith.

text: Some of you work here in the Vatican and it is fantastic, the faith they have and the witness they give is fantastic,” pahayag sini.
english: Some of you work here in the Vatican and it is fantastic, the faith they have and the witness they give is fantastic,” it said.

text: Nagpasalamat ini sa Filipino Catholics kag naghingyo nga padayunon ang amo sini nga pagtuo sa tunga sang sosyudad nga puno na sang manggad kag nagapaindis-indis.
english: He thanked the Filipino Catholics and urged them to continue this faith in the midst of a society that is already full of wealth and competition.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang pagbisita sang mga Pinoy sa Vatican ang kadungan sang ika-25 nga anibersaryo sang canonical establishment sang personal parish sang Immaculate Conception kag Saint Lorenzo Ruiz sa syudad sang Barcelona sa Espanya.
english: The visit of the Filipinos to the Vatican coincides with the 25th anniversary of the canonical establishment of the personal parish of the Immaculate Conception and Saint Lorenzo Ruiz in Barcelona, ​​Spain.

text:
Ginlaragway man ni Pope Francis si Saint Lorenzo Ruiz bilang “beautiful figure” nga nagapakita sang “integration of cultures.”

“He had to leave his homeland because of injustice, in his case defamation, like many people who even today find themselves forced to emigrate to save their own lives or to seek a better future,” suno sa Santo Papa.
english:
Pope Francis also described Saint Lorenzo Ruiz as a “beautiful figure” who exemplifies the “integration of cultures.”

“He had to leave his homeland because of injustice, in his case defamation, like many people who even today find themselves forced to emigrate to save their own lives or to seek a better future,” according to the Pope.

text:
“Finally, once he arrived in the land that should have welcomed him, God asked him to bear witness to his faith with the greatest test of love: by offering his own life.”

Bisan 88-anyos na si Pope Francis, wala man sini ginkalimtan ang iya pagbisita sa Pilipinas sang 2015.
english:
“Finally, once he arrived in the land that should have welcomed him, God asked him to bear witness to his faith with the greatest test of love: by offering his own life.”

Although Pope Francis is 88 years old, he has not forgotten his visit to the Philippines in 2015.

text: “I cherish two beautiful memories of you, of my visit to your homeland: the seven million people at the Mass in Manila, and then the Mass in Tacloban.
english: “I cherish two beautiful memories of you, of my visit to your homeland: the seven million people at the Mass in Manila, and then the Mass in Tacloban.

text: With the rain and the wind, I remember we had to rush out because a storm was coming,” suno sa Santo Papa.
english: With the rain and the wind, I remember we had to rush out because a storm was coming,” the Pope said.

text: Matandaan nga sa selebrasyon sang ika-500 nga anibersaryo sang pag-abot sang Katolisismo sa Pilipinas, gindayaw man ni Pope Francis ang mga Pinoy sa ila ihibalo sa pagpas-an sa krus kag pagpadayon sa paglakat bisan sang mga kasakit kag kabudlayan.
english: It can be recalled that in the celebration of the 500th anniversary of the arrival of Catholicism in the Philippines, Pope Francis also praised the Filipinos for their knowledge of carrying the cross and continuing to walk despite the pains and difficulties.

text: Sang 2019, gin-updan man sang Santo Papa ang mga Pilipino sa Vatican sa tradisyonal nga Simbang Gabi kun sa diin gintawag sini ang mga Pinoy nga malipayon nga mga tawo bangud sa pagtuo sa ila nga mga tagipusuon.
english: In 2019, the Pope also accompanied Filipinos to the Vatican for the traditional Simbang Gabi where he called Filipinos happy people because of the faith in their hearts.

text: Patay na sang masapwan sa idalom sang kapahuan ang isa ka 16-anyos nga dalagita sa Bayambang, Pangasinan.
english: A 16-year-old girl was found dead under a tree in Bayambang, Pangasinan.

text: Ginapatihan nga ginhimuslan ini antes ginpatay sang tatlo ka mga suspek nga iya nakaupod sa ilimnan.
english: She is believed to have been raped before being killed by three suspects she was with at the bar.

text: Suno sa pamilya sang biktima, gab-i na sang naghalin sa ila balay ang dalagita kag wala ini naglisensya.
english: According to the victim's family, the girl left home late at night without a license.

text: May nagsugat nga tricycle kag gindala ini sa isa ka abandonado nga balay kag nag-inom kaupod ang mga suspek.
english: A tricycle met him and took him to an abandoned house and had a drink with the suspects.

text: Suno sa imbestigasyon, nagpasugot ang biktima nga makighilawas sa isa ka suspek.
english: According to the investigation, the victim agreed to have sex with a suspect.

text: Apang luyag man sang isa pa ka lalaki nga makighilawas apang namalibad ang biktima nga nagresulta sa paghimulos kag pagpatay sa iya.
english: However, another man also wanted to have sex but the victim refused, which resulted in her being raped and killed.

text: Nakit-an ang iya bangkay pila ka metros halin sa abandonado nga balay kag gintabunan sang sako.
english: His body was found a few meters from the abandoned house and covered with a sack.

text: May pilas ini sa ulo nga posible ginlampusan sang matig-a nga bagay.
english: He had a head injury that may have been caused by a hard object.

text: Naaresto naman ang tatlo ka mga suspek.
english: The three suspects were arrested.

text: Ipaidalom sa autopsy ang bangkay agud mapat-ud ang matuod nga natabo sa iya.
english: The body will be subjected to an autopsy to determine the truth of what happened to him.

text: Nagapangatubang sa kaso nga rape with homicide ang mga suspek.
english: The suspects are facing charges of rape with homicide.

text: Padayon gihapon ang ginahimo nga imbestigasyon sang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) may kaangtanan sa nasapwan nga patay nga lawas sang isa ka pulis sa Esplanade 1, Mandurriao kahapon sang adlaw, Hulyo 20, 2025.
english: The Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) is still investigating the discovery of the body of a policeman in Esplanade 1, Mandurriao yesterday, July 20, 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PMAJ.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PMAJ.

text: Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson sang ICPO, tuman gid ang kasubo sang ila departamento sa natabo, kag nagpaabot man sila sang pagpakig-unong sa pamilya sang pulis.
english: Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson of the ICPO, said the department is deeply saddened by the incident, and they also extended their condolences to the policeman's family.

text: Ginbuyagyag ni Sangrines nga magabuligay ang iya team sa case review nga pagatambongan man sang city director agud mahibaluan ang kabangdanan sang kamatayon sang biktima kag mabuligan nga matukiban ang personal nga impormasyon kag background sang biktima.
english: Sangrines revealed that his team will cooperate in the case review that will also be attended by the city director to determine the cause of the victim's death and help discover the personal information and background of the victim.

text: Ginsiling ni Sangrines nga ginausisa man ang mga tawo nga ulihi nga nakaupod sang biktima agud matumod kun may yara sang foul play nga anggulo sa iya kamatayon.
english: Sangrines said the people who were last with the victim are also being investigated to determine if there is a foul play angle in his death.

text: Suno pa sa Regional Forensic Unit, ipaidalom na ang bangkay sa autopsy.
english: According to the Regional Forensic Unit, the body will be subjected to an autopsy.

text: Ginapahayag man ni Sangrines nga importante gid ang kooperasyon sang pamilya sang biktima sa paghatag sang dugang nga impormasyon, kag padayon ang ila pagpakig-angot sa mga ini para sa mas madasig kag husto nga imbestigasyon.
english: Sangrines also said that the cooperation of the victim's family is very important in providing more information, and they continue to communicate with them for a faster and more accurate investigation.

text:
Sa labing una nga tion sa sulod sang 36 ka tuig, nakaabanse na gid man sa knockout stage ang Morocco matapos ini nga nagpangibabw sa Group F kag ginlutos ang Canada sa skor

2-1, sa ila hampang nga ginpatigayon sa Al Thumama Stadium sa Qatar.
english:
For the first time in 36 years, Morocco finally advanced to the knockout stage after dominating Group F and beating Canada on a scoreline

2-1, in their match played at the Al Thumama Stadium in Qatar.

text: Ang Morocco ang ikaduha nga African Country sunod sa Senegal nga nag-qualify sa World Cup last 16 subong nga 2022.
english: Morocco is the second African Country after Senegal to qualify for the World Cup last 16 this 2022.

text: Maragtason ini para sa bilog nga pungsod bangud ini ang ikaduha nila nga pagsulod sa knockout stage halin sang 1986 sa Mexico sang ginlutos nila ang Portugal sa skor nga 3-1, sa group match.
english: It was historic for the entire country as it was their second entry into the knockout stage since 1986 in Mexico when they beat Portugal 3-1, in the group match.

text: Antes ang kadalag-an batok sa Canada, nangin kasumpong sang Morocco ang 2018 finalists nga Croatio kag nagtakop sa 0-0 draw ang match.
english: Before the victory over Canada, Morocco faced 2018 finalists Croatia and the match ended in a 0-0 draw.

text: Sa sunod nila nga hampang, ginlutos sang Morocco ang World No.2 nga Belgium sa skor nga 2-0.
english: In their next game, Morocco defeated World No.2 Belgium 2-0.

text:
Yari tanan ang natipon nga puntos sang kada team sa Group F:

MOROCCO – 2 wins, 1 draw, 0 loss – 7 points

CROATIA – 1 win, 2 draws, 0 loss – 5 points

BELGIUM – 1 win, 1 draw, 1 loss – 4 points

CANADA – 0 win, 0 draw, 3 losses – 0 point
english:
Here are all the points accumulated by each team in Group F:

MOROCCO – 2 wins, 1 draw, 0 loss – 7 points

CROATIA – 1 win, 2 draws, 0 loss – 5 points

BELGIUM – 1 win, 1 draw, 1 loss – 4 points

CANADA – 0 wins, 0 draws, 3 losses – 0 points

text: Nagdepensa ang aktor nga si Robin Padilla sa mga pagpakamalaot nga iya nabaton bangud sa nangin pahayag sini nga normal sa mga lalaki ilabi na sa mga yara sa showbiz, nga mangbabaye.
english: Actor Robin Padilla has defended himself against the criticism he received for his statement that it is normal for men, especially those in showbiz, to be women.

text: Sa isa ka vlog, ginpamangkot ni Mariel Rodriguez ang bana tuhoy sa nangin pahayag sini nga mabudlay likawan ang temptasyon.
english: In a vlog, Mariel Rodriguez asked the husband about his statement that it is difficult to avoid temptation.

text: Suno kay Robin, ang iya nangin pahayag ang naangot mismo sa iya nangin eksperyensya.
english: According to Robin, his statement was directly related to his experience.

text: May yara masami sang temptasyon ang kabuhi pahayag niya apang indi buot silingon nga tanan nga tawo ang nangin biktima sini.
english: There are often temptations in life, he said, but that does not mean that everyone has become a victim of them.

text: Dugang pa sang aktor, advance manumdom ang mga netizen kag wala nahangpan ang iya nga punto.
english: The actor added that netizens remember in advance and did not understand his point.

text: Nagapaligo sa kaugalingon nga dugo kag wala na sang ulo ang isa ka lalaki matapos ginlabo kag gin-utdan sang ulo sang isa ka mangunguma a Maltibog, Bukidnon.
english: A man is bathing in his own blood and has no head after being stabbed and beheaded by a farmer in Maltibog, Bukidnon.

text: Suno sa suspek, nakit-an niya ang biktima nga nagapangawat sang iya mga tanom.
english: According to the suspect, he saw the victim stealing his plants.

text: Naggwa sa imbestigasyon nga nalagyo ang biktima sang naaktuhan ini nga nagapangawat kag ginlagas siya sang suspek kag naabtan.
english: Investigation revealed that the victim fled when he was caught stealing and the suspect chased him and caught him.

text: Didto na sini ginlabo ang lalaki kag gin-utdan sang ulo.
english: He then stabbed the man and cut off his head.

text: Ginsaysay sang suspek nga nahimo niya ang krimen bangud sa sobra nga kaakig bangud makapila ka beses na siya nga ginakawatan sang biktima.
english: The suspect said he committed the crime out of anger because the victim had robbed him several times.

text: Sang ulihi, ginpagwa man sa presuhan ang mangunguma matapos nag-atras sa pagpasaka sang kaso ang himata sang napatay.
english: Later, the farmer was also released from jail after the relative of the deceased withdrew from filing a case.

text: Napatay sang mga katapo sang Security Service of Ukraine ang top Russian general nga ginaakusahan amo ang responsable sa paggamit sang chemical weapons batok sa Ukrainian troops.
english: Members of the Security Service of Ukraine killed the top Russian general accused of being responsible for the use of chemical weapons against Ukrainian troops.

text: Ini amo si Lieutenant General Igor Kirillov nga amo ang chief sang Russia’s Nuclear, Biological and Chemical Protection Troops.
english: This is Lieutenant General Igor Kirillov who is the chief of Russia’s Nuclear, Biological and Chemical Protection Troops.

text: Natabo ang asasinasyon kay Kirillov sa Moscow sang yara ini sa gwa sang isa ka apartment building upod sa iya assistant sang naglupok ang isa ka bomba nga nakatakos sa isa ka electric scooter.
english: The assassination of Kirillov took place in Moscow when he was outside an apartment building with his assistant when a bomb the size of an electric scooter exploded.

text: Base sa isa ka unverified video footage, makit-an ang duha ka lalaki nga nagapagwa sa building agud magsakay sa kotse nga ginsundan naman sang matunod nga pagsigabong.
english: Based on unverified video footage, two men can be seen leaving the building to get into a car followed by a sudden fire.

text: ILOILO CITY- May masahe nga kinahanglan mo gid sang masahista apang may masahe nga bisan ikaw lang mahimo mo sa imo kaugalingon.
english: ILOILO CITY- There are massages that you need a masseuse but there are massages that you can do on your own.

text: Ini amo ang scalp massage ukon pagmasahe sang anit nga mahimo mo bisan samtang nagapaligo kag nagapang-shampoo kag ini ang may benepisyo sa imo.
english: This is a scalp massage or scalp massage that you can do even while taking a bath and shampooing and it will benefit you.

text: Suno kay Dr. Debra Jaliman, isa ka dermatologist sa Upper East Side Manhattan kag author sang Skin Rules: Trade Secrets from a Top New York Dermatologist, iya ginpahayag nga ang scalp massage maka- increase sang blood flow sa scalp kag sa hair follicles nga naga-contribute sa pagtubo sang buhok kag pagdamol sini.
english: According to Dr. Debra Jaliman, a dermatologist on the Upper East Side of Manhattan and author of Skin Rules: Trade Secrets from a Top New York Dermatologist, said scalp massage can increase blood flow to the scalp and hair follicles which contributes to hair growth and thickness.

text:
Ini isa man ka natural remedy para sa migraines kag headaches bangod base sa research, ang scalp massage maka-reduce sang frequency sang chronic headaches, kag iban man nga benefits kaangay sang mood boosts paagi sa increase sa serotonin ukon ang “happy hormone.”

Nagapabalanse man ini sang nervous system bangud ginapa relax sini ang physical stress kag maachieve ang balance sa nervous system.
english:
It is also a natural remedy for migraines and headaches because based on research, scalp massage can reduce the frequency of chronic headaches, and also other benefits like mood boosts through an increase in serotonin or the “happy hormone.”

It also balances the nervous system because it relaxes physical stress and achieves balance in the nervous system.

text: Ini man ang tuman ka convenient bangud pwede mo ini mahimo bisan sa sulod lang sang 15 minutos nga indi mo kinahanglan nga maggasto.
english: It is also very convenient as you can do it even in just 15 minutes without having to spend money.

text: Lima ang napatay lakip na ang suspek kasunod sang pagpangluthang sa sulod sang isa ka eskwelahan sa Wisconsin sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Five people were killed including the suspect following a shooting inside a school in Wisconsin in the United States of America.

text: Natabo ini sa Abundant Life Christian School sa Madison nga capital sang state kag ginabanta apat ka kilometros ang kalayuon halin sa police training centre.
english: The incident occurred at Abundant Life Christian School in Madison, the state capital, about four kilometers from the police training center.

text: Suno kay Madison City police chief Shon Barnes, sang nag-abot ang pulis sa area, patay na nga daan ang suspek.
english: According to Madison City police chief Shon Barnes, when police arrived at the area, the suspect was already dead.

text: Wala pa sang ginhatag nga dugang nga detalye apang ginapatihan nga ang shooter ang estudyante man anay sang amo nga eskwelahan.
english: No further details were provided but it is believed the shooter was also a former student at that school.

text: Base pa sa Madison Police Department, magluwas sa mga napatay, may lima ka iban pa nga pilason — minor tubtub critical — kag subong yara na sa ospital.
english: According to the Madison Police Department, besides the dead, five others were injured — minor to critical — and are now in hospital.

text: Namensyonar nga may mga estudyante kag staff members nga posible nakaangkon sang fatal injuries.
english: It was mentioned that some students and staff members may have sustained fatal injuries.

text: “Multiple injuries have been reported.
english: “Multiple injuries have been reported.

text: This remains an active and ongoing investigation.
english: This remains an active and ongoing investigation.

text: More information will be released as it is available,” suno sa incident report sang pulis.
english: More information will be released as it is available,” according to the police incident report.

text: Nagapadayon pa ang secondary searches sa building kag sa mga salakyan kag gin-abisuhan ang mga tawo nga indi anay magpalapit sa area.
english: Secondary searches are still ongoing in the building and vehicles and people have been advised not to approach the area.

text: Ang Abundant Life Christian School isa ka K-12 school kun sa diin ginabanta may 390 students suno sa ila nga website.
english: Abundant Life Christian School is a K-12 school with an estimated 390 students according to their website.

text: Natabo ang insidente isa ka semana antes ang pormal nga pagtakop sang klase para sa Christmas vacation.
english: The incident occurred a week before the formal closing of classes for the Christmas vacation.

text: Flattered si Miss Universe 1969 Gloria Diaz sa mga memes nga nagalapta online nga naga-angot sa iya sa Olympic gold medalist nga si Hidilyn Diaz.
english: Miss Universe 1969 Gloria Diaz is flattered by memes circulating online linking her to Olympic gold medalist Hidilyn Diaz.

text: Ini bangud magkaangay ang ila apelyido kag ginakabig man nga history makers sa Pilipinas.
english: This is because they have the same surname and are also considered history makers in the Philippines.

text: Si Gloria amo ang labing-una nga Filipina Miss Universe sang koronahan siya sang 1969, samtang si Hidilyn naman ang labing-una nga atleta halin sa Pilipinas nga nakaangkon sang Olympic gold.
english: Gloria was the first Filipina Miss Universe when she was crowned in 1969, while Hidilyn was the first athlete from the Philippines to win Olympic gold.

text: Sa isa ka caption sa iya post, ginpahayag pa ni Gloria nga daw langaw siya nga nagatungtong sa karabaw sa subong.
english: In a caption to her post, Gloria said she feels like a fly on a buffalo right now.

text: Gintawag ni Gloria nga champ ang 30 anyos nga si Hidilyn kag asud-asud man ang iya pagrepost sang memes sa iya nga stories online.
english: Gloria called 30-year-old Hidilyn a champ and she often reposts memes in her stories online.

text: Nagsungka sa otoridad ang subject sa buy bust operation nga ginpatigayon sa Trapiche, Oton, Iloilo.
english: The suspect surrendered to the police in a buy bust operation conducted in Trapiche, Oton, Iloilo.

text: Ang subject amo si Mike Cantera, singkwentahon ang edad, kag tumandok sang amo nga barangay.
english: The subject was identified as Mike Cantera, 50 years old, and a native of the said barangay.

text: Matandaan nga ginpatigayon ang operasyon sang Pebrero 19 sang gab-i apang samtang yara sa kustodiya sang kapulisan sa area kun sa diin siya nadakpan, hinali lang nga may nagpalupok sang pusil nga nag-igo sa isa ka pulis kag nangin kahigayunan agud makapalagyo kaupod ang ginapatihan nga himata sini nga nagpalupok sang armas-luthang.
english: The operation was conducted on February 19 night but while in police custody in the area where he was arrested, suddenly someone fired a gun that hit a policeman and became an opportunity to escape with his suspected relative who fired the firearm.

text: Ang naigo nga pulis amo si Police Corporal Gilbert Lingaya nga nagaserbe nga backup, residente sang Barangay Damires, New Lucena, Iloilo kag yara na subong sa maayo nga kondisyon.
english: The hit policeman was identified as Police Corporal Gilbert Lingaya, resident of Barangay Damires, New Lucena, Iloilo.

text: Matapos ang isa ka dekada nga pagtinir sa presuhan sa Indonesia, makapauli na gid man si Mary Jane Veloso sa Pilipinas sa Miyerkules sang aga, Disyembre 18.
english: After a decade in prison in Indonesia, Mary Jane Veloso will finally return to the Philippines on Wednesday morning, December 18.

text: Santo sa kumpirmasyon sang Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA), 12:50 sa kaagahon ang oras sang paghalin sang eroplano sa Jakarta sakay ang convicted overseas Filipino worker (OFW) kag ginalauman nga magahugpa sa Manila 6:00 sang aga.
english: According to the confirmation of the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA), the plane left Jakarta at 12:50 am with the convicted overseas Filipino worker (OFW) and is expected to land in Manila at 6:00 am.

text: Sa statement naman sang Malacañang paagi kay Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin, ginpahayag nga tuman gid ang apresasyon kag pagpasalamat sang Pilipinas sa Republika sang Indonesia sa pagpahanugot nga makabalik sa pungsod si Veloso.
english: In a statement, Malacañang through Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin said the Philippines is very grateful to the Republic of Indonesia for allowing Veloso to return to the country.

text: Suno sa palasyo, ang homecoming sang Pinay amo ang bunga sang masobra isa ka dekada nga diskusyon, konsultasyon, kag diplomasya.
english: According to the palace, the Filipina's homecoming is the result of more than a decade of discussions, consultations, and diplomacy.

text: “Duty-bound as we are to honor the conditions for her transfer to the Philippine jurisdiction, we are truly elated to welcome Mary Jane back to her homeland and family, from whom she has been distracted for too long,” suno kay Bersamin.
english: “Duty-bound as we are to honor the conditions for her transfer to the Philippine jurisdiction, we are truly elated to welcome Mary Jane back to her homeland and family, from whom she has been distracted for too long,” according to Bersamin.

text: Si Veloso, 39, ang yara sa death row sa amo nga Asian country bangud sa ginaalegar nga drug trafficking matapos nadakpan nga may sulod nga 2.6 kilos nga iligal nga droga ang iya luggage sang nag-abot siya sa Yogyakarta sang 2010.
english: Veloso, 39, is on death row in the Asian country for alleged drug trafficking after he was caught with 2.6 kilos of illegal drugs in his luggage when he arrived in Yogyakarta in 2010.

text: Sang 2015, si anay Indonesian President Joko Widodo ang nagpahayag nga naghatag lamang ang ila gobyerno sang “temporary reprieve” kay Veloso gikan sa iya kuntani natalana nga execution bangud sa ginaalegar tuyo nga pagpalusot sang iligal nga droga.
english: In 2015, former Indonesian President Joko Widodo said his government had only granted Veloso a “temporary reprieve” from his scheduled execution for allegedly intentionally smuggling illegal drugs.

text: Sang Enero sini nga tuig, nagpadala ang pamilya Veloso sang mga sulat kanday former President Widodo kag Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: In January this year, the Veloso family sent letters to former President Widodo and Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: para i-apelar ang clemency para sa Pinay nga ginpahayag biktima lamang sang sirkumstansya.
english: to appeal for clemency for the Filipina who was allegedly a victim of circumstance.

text: Sang Nobyembre, ginkumpirma ni Marcos nga nakalab-ot na ang Manila kag Jakarta sa kasugtanan nga isaylo si Veloso sa Pilipinas.
english: In November, Marcos confirmed that Manila and Jakarta had reached an agreement to transfer Veloso to the Philippines.

text: Ginpasalamatan sini si Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto kag iya gobyerno sa maayo nga panimuot.
english: He thanked Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto and his government for their goodwill.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, sanday Cesar kag Celia nga ginikanan ni Mary Jane ang nag-apelar man sa gobyerno sang Pilipinas nga i-transfer ang ila bata sa safe local facility bangud sa kahangawa nga may mga pamahog halin sa international drug syndicate nga nag-implicate sa iya.
english: Meanwhile, Cesar and Celia, parents of Mary Jane, also appealed to the Philippine government to transfer their daughter to a safe local facility due to concerns that there are threats from the international drug syndicate that implicated her.

text: Kun balikan ang mga hitabo antes sini, may mga kaso na nga human trafficking kag large-scale illegal recruitment nga na-file batok sa traffickers ni Veloso nga sanday Julius Lacanilao kag Cristina Sergio sa Regional Trial Court sang Nueva Ecjia.
english: Looking back at the events before this, there are already cases of human trafficking and large-scale illegal recruitment filed against Veloso's traffickers Julius Lacanilao and Cristina Sergio in the Regional Trial Court of Nueva Ecjia.

text: Sang 2020, nagdagdag ang korte sang guilty verdict sa illegal recruitment case sa recruiters apang pending pa subong ang kaso nga trafficking.#
english: In 2020, the court added a guilty verdict in the illegal recruitment case against the recruiters but the trafficking case is still pending.

english: When the students left around 12 noon, the two groups crossed paths and a fight broke out.

english: Despite the incident, the Culasi Police Station is now calling for donations, particularly clothes and food for the affected members of the Muslim community who lost their homes.

text: By: Bombo Volunteer Lyka Sandiego
english: By: Bombo Volunteer Lyka Sandiego

text: Ginhatag sang Morocco ang isa pa ka daku nga historic upset sa World Cup 2022 paagi sa paglutos sa favorite team nga Belgium, 2-0, sa Group F Match sa Al Thumama Stadium sa Qatar.
english: Morocco delivered another massive historic upset at the World Cup 2022 by defeating favorite team Belgium, 2-0, in the Group F Match at the Al Thumama Stadium in Qatar.

text: Ginapahayag nagamatuod na ang pahayag nga naga-tigulang na ang ”Golden Generation” sang Belgium, isa sa favorites subong nga World Cup kag ika-duha sa FIFA standings, bangud ang naglutos sa ila ang yara lamang sa ika-22 nga rank sa kalibutan.
english: The statement that Belgium's "Golden Generation", one of the favorites in the current World Cup and second in the FIFA standings, is said to be true, as the one who beat them is only ranked 22nd in the world.

text: Ang duha ka goals sang Morocco ang nagikan kay Romain Saiss sa ika-73 nga minuto kag Zakaria Aboukhlal sa second minute sang added time.
english: Morocco's two goals came from Romain Saiss in the 73rd minute and Zakaria Aboukhlal in the second minute of added time.

text: Kun wala kuntani nalutos sa Morocco, posible nga ang Belgium pa ang nagpangaduha nga team (sunod sa defending champion nga France) nga nakaabanse sa last 16.
english: If they hadn't lost to Morocco, Belgium would have been the second team (after defending champion France) to advance to the last 16.

text: Atubangon sang Belgium ang 2018 World Cup finalist nga Croatia sa final group game agud nga malikawan nga matabo ang ila pinaka-temprano nga World Cup elimination halin sang 1998.
english: Belgium will face 2018 World Cup finalists Croatia in the final group game to avoid their earliest World Cup elimination since 1998 happening.

text: Ini ang ginakabig third big upset subong nga World Cup matapos ang kalutusan sang powerhouse team nga Argentina sa Saudi Arabia, kag pagkalutos man sang four-time World champions nga Germany sa Japan.
english: This is considered the third big upset of the current World Cup after powerhouse team Argentina's defeat to Saudi Arabia, and four-time World champions Germany's defeat to Japan.

text: Kun naghilibi ang Morocco fans sa stadium kasunod sang paglutos sang Atlas Lions sa Belgium, lain naman ang natabo sa Brussels sa Belgium.
english: If Moroccan fans cried in the stadium following the Atlas Lions' defeat in Belgium, it was different in Brussels, Belgium.

text: Nag-deploy ang mga pulis sang water cannons kag nag-gamit sang tear gas agud ma-disperse ang mga tawo nga nag-riot matapos nasaksihan ang resulta sang hampang.
english: Police deployed water cannons and used tear gas to disperse the crowd that rioted after witnessing the outcome of the match.

text: May mga fans nga nangbuka sang bintana, naghaboy sang fireworks, kag nagsunog sang mga salakyan sa dalan.
english: Some fans broke windows, threw fireworks, and set cars on fire in the street.

text: Suno sa statement sang pulis sa Brussels, bisan wala pa man natapos ang hampang sang duha ka pungsod, may yara sang madamo nga tawo nga nakasuksuk sang hoodies nga na-involve sa kumprontasyon sa mga pulis kag naghatag risgo sa public safety.
english: According to a police statement in Brussels, although the match between the two countries was not over, there was a large number of people wearing hoodies who were involved in confrontations with the police and posed a risk to public safety.

text: May pila man ka fans nga nagdala sang mga stick.
english: Some fans also brought sticks.

text: May journalist man nga napilasan sa nawong bangud sa fireworks.
english: A journalist was also injured in the face by the fireworks.

text: Yara sa 100 ka mga pulis ang gin-mobilize kag ginpaandaman ang publiko nga likawan anay ang mga dalanon sa sentro gid sang syudad.
english: About 100 policemen were mobilized and warned the public to avoid the streets in the city center.

text: Ginsirado man ang metro stations amo man ang dalanon agud nga malikawan nga maglapta pa ang violence nga ginhimo sang mga fans.
english: Metro stations and roads were also closed to prevent the violence committed by the fans from spreading.

text: ILOILO CITY- Dismayado ang asosasyon sang mga vendors sa Iloilo Central Market matapos nga wala sila gin-imbitar nga magtambong sa pagsinapol nga ginpatawag ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas may kaangtanan sa pagpaidalom sa Public Private Partnership (PPP) sang amo nga merkado kag sang Iloilo Terminal Market ukon Super.
english: ILOILO CITY – The association of vendors in the Iloilo Central Market is disappointed after they were not invited to attend the meeting convened by Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas regarding the submission of the market to the Public Private Partnership (PPP) and the Iloilo Terminal Market or Super.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Rex Donasco, presidente sang Association of Stall Owners & Transient Vendors (ASTRAVEN) sa Iloilo Central Market, iya ginpahayag nga duha ka tuig na ang nagligad sang ulihi sila nga ginpatawag ni Mayor Trenas sa isa ka conference agud istoryahan ang privatization sang amo nga merkado publiko.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Rex Donasco, president of the Association of Stall Owners & Transient Vendors (ASTRAVEN) in Iloilo Central Market, said two years have passed since they were last summoned by Mayor Trenas to a conference to discuss the privatization of the public market.

text: Suno pa sa iya, sang nagligad nga semana, nakapamangkot man ini kay Ma.
english: He said that last week, he also asked Ma.

text: Dolores Trabasas, market-in-charge sang Iloilo Terminal Market kun may ano gid man ang plano ni Mayor apang ang sabat lang ni Trabasas amo nga naga-income man ang concerned nga mga merkado kag indi na kinahanglan nga ipaidalom ini sa PPPP.
english: Dolores Trabasas, market-in-charge of the Iloilo Terminal Market, asked what the Mayor's plan was but Trabasas' only answer was that the concerned markets are also earning income and do not need to be subjected to PPPP.

text: Apang nakibot na lang si Donasco nga nagpatigayon sang pagsinapol kahapon kag wala sila maimbitar.
english: But Donasco, who held a meeting yesterday, was surprised and they were not invited.

text: Ginpostpone ang coronation night sang Miss World Philippines 2021 matapos ginpaidalom sang gobyerno ang Metro Manila sa general community quarantine (GCQ) “with heightened restrictions” tubtob sa Hulyo 31.
english: The coronation night of Miss World Philippines 2021 was postponed after the government placed Metro Manila under general community quarantine (GCQ) “with heightened restrictions” until July 31.

text: Gin-isol sa Agusto 8 ang pageant nga natalana kuntani bwas, Hulyo 25.
english: The pageant, which was scheduled for tomorrow, July 25, has been postponed to August 8.

text: Ang Miss World Philippines ang may yara sang 45 ka mga kandidata lakip na ang tiglawas sang Iloilo City nga si Ann Palmares.
english: Miss World Philippines has 45 contestants including Iloilo City representative Ann Palmares.

text: Walo ka mga korona ang paga-agawan sang mga maanyag nga mga kandidata lakip na ang Miss World Philippines, Miss Supranational Philippines, Miss Eco Philippines, Miss Eco Teen Philippines, Reina Hispanoamericana Filipinas, Miss Multinational Philippines, Miss Philippines Tourism, kag Miss Environment International Philippines.
english: Eight crowns will be up for grabs including Miss World Philippines, Miss Supranational Philippines, Miss Eco Philippines, Miss Eco Teen Philippines, Reina Hispanoamericana Filipinas, Miss Multinational Philippines, Miss Philippines Tourism, and Miss Environment Philippines International.

english: The candidates for Mr. & Ms. Philippine Youth Iloilo 2025 in the Good Morning Philippines program.

text: Isa-isa nga nila nga ginplastar ang ila nga mga advocacies nga konektado sa hashtag nga #sustainablebeauty.
english: One by one, they presented their advocacies connected to the hashtag #sustainablebeauty.

text: Siyam tanan ka mga female candidates kag walo ka male candidates ang magapaindis-indis agud mangin masunod nga Mr. & Ms. Philippine Youth Iloilo 2025 kag mahatagan sang kahigayunan nga itiglawas ang syudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo sa national stage.
english: A total of nine female candidates and eight male candidates will compete to become the next Mr. & Ms. Philippine Youth Iloilo 2025 and will be given the opportunity to represent the city and province of Iloilo on the national stage.

Let's listen to Miguel Espinosa in his advocacy:

text: Ginpaiway sang isa ka kompaniya sang Japan nga handom nga mangin pinakauna nga pribado nga firm nga makapahamtang sang satellite sa orbit ang rocket launch sini sa ikatatlo na nga kahigayunan.
english: A Japanese company that wants to be the first private firm to put a satellite in orbit has postponed its rocket launch for the third time.

text: Gintalana kuntani sang Tokyo-based nga Space One ang ila ikatlo nga pagpalupad sang ila Kairos rocket halin sa launch pad sini sa Wakayama kaina, las-onse sang aga (oras sa Japan) matapos nga wala man nadayon ang pagpalupad sini kahapon nga adlaw.
english: Tokyo-based Space One was scheduled to launch its third Kairos rocket from its launch pad in Wakayama yesterday, at 11 am (Japan time) after its launch was canceled yesterday.

text: Suno kay Bombo Josel Palma, international correspondent sa Japan, ang rason sang wala nadayon nga launching amo ang mabaskog nga hangin kag indi paborable nga tiempo.
english: According to Bombo Josel Palma, international correspondent in Japan, the reason for the canceled launch was strong winds and unfavorable weather.

text: Matandaan nga sang Marso, ang amo nga rocket ang naglift- off nga may dala nga government test satellite apang may na-detect nga technical problems rason nga ginpalupok ini.
english: It can be recalled that in March, the rocket lifted off carrying a government test satellite but technical problems were detected and it was shot down.

text: Sa ikaduha nga launch attempt, ang rocket nagakarga kuntani sang lima ka satellites kalakip ang isa nga halin sa Taiwan Space Agency kag iban nga gindesinyo sang Japanese students kag corporate ventures.
english: In the second launch attempt, the rocket was supposed to carry five satellites including one from the Taiwan Space Agency and others designed by Japanese students and corporate ventures.

text: Ang Space One gintukod sang 2018 sang major businesses kaangay sang Canon Electronics, IHI Aerospace, construction firm Shimizu, kag government-run Development Bank of Japan.
english: Space One was founded in 2018 by major businesses like Canon Electronics, IHI Aerospace, construction firm Shimizu, and government-run Development Bank of Japan.

text: Natalana ang masunod nga launch attempt sa Mierkules.
english: The next launch attempt is scheduled for Wednesday.

text: ILOILO – Yara na sa mayo nga kahimtangan ang pulis nga natiruhan sa ginpatigayon nga buy bust operation sang Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit (PDEU) sa Sitio Tuburan, Barangay Trapiche, Oton, Iloilo.
english: ILOILO – A policeman who was stabbed in a buy bust operation conducted by the Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit (PDEU) in Sitio Tuburan, Barangay Trapiche, Oton, Iloilo is in good condition.

text: Ang pulis amo si Police Corporal Gilbert Lingaya nga nagaserbe nga backup, residente sang Barangay Damires, New Lucena, Iloilo.
english: The policeman was identified as Police Corporal Gilbert Lingaya, a resident of Barangay Damires, New Lucena, Iloilo.

text: Samtang ang main subject naman sa buybust amo si Mike Cantera, singkwentahon ang edad, kag tumandok sang amo nga barangay.
english: Meanwhile, the main subject of the buybust is Mike Cantera, 50 years old, and a native of the said barangay.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson ng Police Regional Office 6, iya ginpahayag nga naoperahan na ang pulis matapos ginluthang sang pakaisa sang subject sang operasyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson of the Police Regional Office 6, said the policeman was operated on after being shot by the cousin of the subject of the operation.

text: Suno kay Solis, nag-angkon sang pilas sa nawala nga bukton ang biktima kag gilayon man nga gindala sa ospital.
english: Solis said the victim sustained injuries to his left arm and was rushed to the hospital.

text: Sang nadakpan na ang suspek, nanotisyaran sang operatiba nga may tawo pa sa sulod sang balay, kag sang gintulod ang puertahan, nagpalupok na ang gunman nga ginapatihan nga himata man ni Cantera.
english: When the suspect was arrested, the operative noticed that there were still people inside the house, and when the door was pushed, the gunman, believed to be a relative of Cantera, opened fire.

text: Naigu ang pulis sa butkon, kag nagsinggit ini nga mag-withdraw bangud may pusil kag granada ang gunman nga nakasanto man sa ila nga impormasyon halin sa confidential asset.
english: The policeman was hit in the arm, and he shouted to withdraw because the gunman had a gun and a grenade, which was also in line with their information from the confidential asset.

text: Ginsapar sang mga pulis ang seguridad sang ila kaupod kag ginhingalitan naman ini sang subject kag kaupod sini nga makapalagyo matapos ang tatlo ka oras nga negosasyon nga magsungka.
english: The police compromised the security of their companion and the suspect and his companion managed to escape after three hours of negotiations to surrender.

text: Nakuha naman sa ginluntaran sang insidente ang tatlo ka grams sang suspected shabu nga nagabalor sang P12,000 kag isa ka basiyo sang 12 gauge homemade shotgun.
english: Three grams of suspected shabu worth P12,000 and a round of 12 gauge homemade shotgun were recovered from the scene.

text: Nakakas na ang Canada sa 2022 FIFA World Cup kasunod sang 4-1 loss sa 2018 finalists nga Croatia.
english: Canada has been eliminated from the 2022 FIFA World Cup following a 4-1 loss to 2018 finalists Croatia.

text: Sa pamuno sang hampang, buhi ang paglaum sang Canada matapos nag-skor si Alfonso Davies sa ika-68 nga segundo — ini ang first goal sang Canada sa World Cup, kag amo man subong ang fastest goal nga na-skor sa ongoing edition sang FIFA World Cup.
english: Heading into the game, Canada’s hopes were alive after Alfonso Davies scored in the 68th second — it was Canada’s first goal of the World Cup, and also now the fastest goal scored in the ongoing edition of the FIFA World Cup.

text: Apang wala na naghatag liwat sang tyansa ang Croatia: naka-goal sanday Andrej Kramaric, Marko Livaja, kag Lovro Majer nga amo ang dalayon nga nagpa-us-os sang paglaum sang Canada nga makaguwa pa sa group stage.
english: But Croatia did not give another chance: Andrej Kramaric, Marko Livaja, and Lovro Majer scored goals that immediately dashed Canada's hopes of reaching the group stage.

text: Antes ang kalutusan subong nga adlaw, una na nga ginpierde sang World No.2 nga Belgium ang Canada,1-0.
english: Before today's defeat, World No.2 Belgium had previously beaten Canada, 1-0.

text: Nasapwan ang bangkay sang isa ka pulis nga nagalutaw sa Iloilo River sa Esplanade 1 nga sakop sang Barangay San Rafael, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.
english: The body of a policeman was found floating in the Iloilo River in Esplanade 1 of Barangay San Rafael, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.

text: Base sa report sang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO), patrolman ang ranggo sang biktima, naga-edad sang 28-anyos, kag residente sang Bayawan City, Negros Oriental.
english: According to the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO), the victim was a patrolman, 28 years old, and a resident of Bayawan City, Negros Oriental.

text: Ginkumpirma man sang Police Regional Office (PRO) VI nga ang amo nga lalaki ang naka-assign sa Regional Communication and Electronics Unit 6 – National Support Unit.
english: The Police Regional Office (PRO) VI also confirmed that the man is assigned to the Regional Communication and Electronics Unit 6 – National Support Unit.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Val Cambel, hepe sang Iloilo City Police Station 10, iya ginpahayag nga nakit-an sang isa ka lalaki nga naga-jog sa esplanade ang lawas sang personnel pasado alas nueve kaina sang aga.
english: Police Captain Val Cambel, chief of Iloilo City Police Station 10, said the body of the personnel was found by a man jogging on the esplanade around 9 am yesterday.

text: Indi pa matumod ang rason sang kamatayon sini bangud nagapadayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang Scene of the Crime Operations (SOCO) VI.
english: The cause of his death is yet to be determined as the Scene of the Crime Operations (SOCO) VI is still investigating.

text: Nang-hostage ang isa ka lalaki matapos ginpahayag nga wala ini ginswelduhan sang iya employer.
english: A man was taken hostage after his employer allegedly did not pay him.

text: Natabo ang insidente sa Recto sa Avenida,Maynila kun sa diin isa ka babaye ang iya gintayaan sang kutsilyo.
english: The incident occurred in Recto in Avenida, Manila where he stabbed a woman.

text: Ginpahayag nga ginlagas sang mga pulis ang suspek bangud sa ginapangatubang nga kaso sang pagpangbuno nga natabo sang damlag lang.
english: Police reportedly pursued the suspect because of a stabbing case that occurred recently.

text: Apang magluwas diri, nahibaluan nga nagpadulong sa Recto ang suspek para kuntani manukot sang iya nga sweldo sa amo nga P20,000 nga indi paghatag sa iya.
english: However, it was learned that the suspect went to Recto to collect his salary for the P20,000 that was not given to him.

text: Sa pagdalagan sang suspek para malagyo, nagsulod siya sa isa ka printing shop kag gin-hostage ang babaye.
english: As the suspect ran to escape, he entered a printing shop and took the woman hostage.

text: Sa negosasyon, ginhingyo sang suspek nga mabayaran siya kag makita ang iya nga iloy.
english: During the negotiation, the suspect demanded that he be paid and see his mother.

text: Matapos ang negosasyon, nagsungka ang suspek.
english: After negotiations, the suspect surrendered.

text: Nahatag man sang amo ang P20,000 nga sweldo sang suspek kag gintugyan ang kwarta sa iloy.
english: The employer also gave the suspect's P20,000 salary and handed over the money to the mother.

text: Mangatubang ang suspek sa mga reklamo nga illegal detention, alarm and scandal, kag illegal possession of deadly weapon.
english: The suspect will face charges of illegal detention, alarm and scandal, and illegal possession of deadly weapon.

text: Ginpabugal sang tiglawas sang Iloilo City sa Miss World 2021 ang “The Original LaPaz Batchoy” bilang iya nga National Costume.
english: The representative of Iloilo City in Miss World 2021 boasted “The Original LaPaz Batchoy” as her National Costume.

text: Sa post ni Ann Palmares, iya ginpahayag nga ang sabor sang LaPaz Batchoy ang nagatumod sa mga Ilonggos bilang mainabyanon nga sahi sang tawo, maabi-abihon kag malulo.
english: In Ann Palmares' post, she said that the taste of LaPaz Batchoy refers to Ilonggos as a friendly type of person, hospitable and gentle.

text: Ang noodles naman ang nagapakita sang closeness kag kabakod sang Ilonggo families.
english: The noodles, on the other hand, show the closeness and strength of Ilonggo families.

text: Ang “The Original LaPaz Batchoy” costume ni Ann ang gindesinyo ni Paul Jerome “Tata” Blas Pinuela.
english: Ann’s “The Original LaPaz Batchoy” costume was designed by Paul Jerome “Tata” Blas Pinuela.

text: Natalana sa Hulyo 25 ang coronation night sa diin pito ka mga titulo ang mahimo makuha sang mga kandidata.
english: The coronation night is scheduled for July 25 where seven titles can be won by the candidates.

text: Ini amo ang Miss World Philippines, Miss Supranational Philippines, Miss Eco Philippines, Reina Hispanoamericana Filipinas, Miss Environment Philippines, Miss Eco Teen Philippines, kag Miss Tourism Philippines.
english: These are Miss World Philippines, Miss Supranational Philippines, Miss Eco Philippines, Reina Hispanoamericana Filipinas, Miss Environment Philippines, Miss Eco Teen Philippines, and Miss Tourism Philippines.

text: Linibo ka South Koreans ang nagselebrar sa Seoul matapos nga opisyal nga nagboto ang parliament agud i-impeach si President Yoon Suk Yeol.
english: Thousands of South Koreans celebrated in Seoul after parliament officially voted to impeach President Yoon Suk Yeol.

text: Ini kasunod sang hinali nga deklarasyon ni Yool sang martial law sang nagligad nga semana nga gilayon man niya nga ginbawi bangud sa pagpamatok sang lawmkers kag pagprotesta sang mga tawo.
english: This follows Yool's sudden declaration of martial law last week which he immediately withdrew due to opposition from lawmakers and protests from the people.

text: Kabug-usan nga 204 ang nagboto pabor sa motion nga i-impeach si Yoon samtang 85 naman ang nagpamatok.
english: A total of 204 voted in favor of the motion to impeach Yoon while 85 voted against.

text: Opisyal na subong nga gin-suspend si Yoon sa iya nga official duties samtang nagaserbe naman bilang acting president si Prime Minister Han Duck-soo.
english: Yoon has now been officially suspended from his official duties while Prime Minister Han Duck-soo serves as acting president.

text: Nagakinahanglan ang constitutional court sang anum ka bulan agud maka-desisyon kun i-sustain ang impeachment batok sa president.
english: The constitutional court needs six months to decide whether to sustain the impeachment against the president.

text: Kun makumpirma, siya ang ikaduha nga South Korean president nga pormal nga kakason sa opisina kasunod sang kaangay man nga impeachment kay Park Geun-hye nga amo ang una nga female leader sang amo nga pungsod.
english: If confirmed, she will be the second South Korean president to be formally removed from office following the similar impeachment of Park Geun-hye, the country's first female leader.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga semana, una na nga nagtilaw ang opposition parties nga i-impeach si Yoon apang nakaluwas ini matapos nga gin-boycott sang ruling party nga People Power Party ang binotohay sa parliament.
english: Last week, opposition parties tried to impeach Yoon but he survived after the ruling People Power Party boycotted the parliamentary vote.

text: Ang nagapungko subong nga acting president ang gina-imbestigaran man sa papel sini sa desisyon sang presidente sa pagdeklarar sang martial law gani indi pa sigurado kun ano ang mangin dalagan sang mga hitabo.
english: The incumbent acting president is also being investigated for his role in the president's decision to declare martial law so it is not yet clear what the course of events will be.

text: “At times like this, more than ever, we must prioritise national security,” pahayag sang acting president sa una nga national security meeting.
english: “At times like this, more than ever, we must prioritize national security,” the acting president said at the first national security meeting.

text:
“I feel a heavy sense of responsibility in this difficult national situation.”

Sa pihak nga bahin, ginpahayag naman sang US nga mabakod ang ila alyansa sang South Korea apisar sang nagakatabo subong sa Seoul.
english:
“I feel a heavy sense of responsibility in this difficult national situation.”

Meanwhile, the US said its alliance with South Korea is strong despite what is happening in Seoul.

text: Suno kay US ambassador to South Korea Philip Goldberg, suportahan sang US ang South kag magapabilin ang democratic and constitutional process para sa ila nga mga pumuluyo.
english: According to US ambassador to South Korea Philip Goldberg, the US will support the South and maintain the democratic and constitutional process for their people.

text: Mayor nga kaalyado sang US ang South Korea sa Asya kag nagabuligay sila sa away sang Seoul batok sa North Korea.
english: South Korea is a major ally of the US in Asia and they are working together in Seoul's fight against North Korea.

text:
Subong lang nga kaagahon, nagtakop sa 1-1 draw ang hampang sang duha ka former World Cup winners nga Spain kag Germany sa Group E.

Ang naka-skor sa Spain amo si Alvaro Morata sa 62nd minute samtang sa Spain naman, naka-goal si Niclas Fullkrug sa 83rd minute.
english:
This morning, the match between two former World Cup winners Spain and Germany in Group E ended in a 1-1 draw.

Alvaro Morata scored for Spain in the 62nd minute while Niclas Fullkrug scored in the 83rd minute.

text: Kasunod sang draw, nagapanguna sa gihapon ang Espanya sa group, samtang mabaka-baka naman ang Germany sa masunod sini nga match batok sa Costa Rica.
english: Following the draw, Spain are still leading the group, while Germany will face Costa Rica in their next match.

text:
