english:
Here are the latest standings in Group E:

SPAIN – 1 win, 1 draw, 0 loss – 4 pointsJAPAN – 1 win, 0 draw, 1 loss – 3 pointsGERMANY – 0 win, 1 draw,1 loss – 1 pointCOSTA RICA – 1 win, 0 draw, 1 loss – 3 points

text: Nagpasaka sang reklamo sa Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) ang mga empleyado sang Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) companies sa Cebu.
english: Employees of Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) companies in Cebu have filed a complaint with the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE).

text: Suno sa BPO Industry Employees Network (BIEN-Cebu), ginlapas sang mga kompaniya ang Occupational Safety and Health Standards matapos sila nga ginpilit nga magbalik sa ubra bisan pa nga bag-o lang nagtay-og ang magnitude 6.9 nga linog sang Martes.
english: According to the BPO Industry Employees Network (BIEN-Cebu), companies violated Occupational Safety and Health Standards after they were forced to return to work despite the recent magnitude 6.9 earthquake on Tuesday.

text: May mga empleyado man nga gindagdagan sang sanctions matapos nga ginpili nila ang ila safety kag sang ila nga pamilya.
english: Some employees were also given increased sanctions after they chose their safety and that of their families.

text: Ginpakamalaot sang grupo ang amo nga “business-as-usual” approach sang BPO companies.
english: The group condemned the “business-as-usual” approach of BPO companies.

text: Kaangot diri, ginpanawagan naman ni Akbayan Party-list Rep.
english: In this regard, Akbayan Party-list Rep.

text: Perci Cendaña sa Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) nga imbestigaran ang insidente kag dagdagan sang sanction ang ginareklamo nga mga kompaniya.
english: Perci Cendaña to the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) to investigate the incident and increase sanctions against the complaining companies.

text: Patay ang mag-asawa kag tatlo nila ka kabataan nga lunsay menor de edad sang nagbunggo sa truck ang ginasakyan nila nga motorsiklo sa Initao, Misamis Oriental.
english: A couple and their three children, all minors, were killed when their motorcycle collided with a truck in Initao, Misamis Oriental.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon sang otoridad, papuli na na ang amo nga pamilya sa Lanao del Norte sang natabo ang trahediya.
english: According to the investigation of the authorities, the family was returning home from Lanao del Norte when the tragedy occurred.

text: Ginpahayag nga tuyo sang motorsiklo nga mag-overtake sa isa pa ka salakyan kag didto na nagbunggo sa nagasugata nga truck.
english: The motorcycle reportedly tried to overtake another vehicle and collided with an oncoming truck.

text: Halin sa birthday party ang mga biktima antes ang insidente.
english: The victims were returning from a birthday party before the incident.

text: Nagpa-BOMBO ang mga residente sang Brgy.
english: Residents of Brgy.

text: Balanak, Janiuay, Iloilo kasunod sang naguba nga dalan sa ila lugar nga posible magresulta pa gid sang mas malala nga insidente kon indi dayon matagan sang solusyon.
english: Balanak, Janiuay, Iloilo following the damaged road in their area that could result in a worse incident if not immediately resolved.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Paulino Parian, ginpahayag sini nga gilayon ginhatagan sang aksyon ang problema paagi sa Municipal Engineering Office.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Paulino Parian said the problem was immediately addressed through the Municipal Engineering Office.

text: Ginpatuman ang inisyal nga solusyon paagi sa pagbutang sang drainage system, apang naguba man ini bangud gamay lang ang ginamit nga tamburong.
english: The initial solution was implemented by installing a drainage system, but it was also damaged because only a small drum was used.

text: Ginpasiguro ni Mayor Parian nga ila na ini gina-ayo subong paagi sa pagbutang sang mas manami kag mas mapag-on nga tamburong agud magtawhay na ang daloy sang tubig kag malikawan ang paglala sang dalan.
english: Mayor Parian assured that they are now repairing it by installing a better and stronger tamburong to calm the flow of water and prevent the road from deteriorating.

text: Ginalantaw nga umpisa gilayon ang proyekto pag-apruba sang Program of Works kag pangitaan na sang pondo.
english: The project is expected to start immediately after the approval of the Program of Works and the search for funds.

text: Ginapaninguhan sang lokal nga panguluhan nga mapatigayun ini sa pinakamadali nga panahon para sa seguridad sang mga residente.
english: The local government is trying to get this done as soon as possible for the safety of the residents.

text: Gin-impeach na si South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol.
english: South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol has been impeached.

text: Ini matapos nagboto ang mga lawmakers agud kakson ini sa posisyon matapos ang napaslawan nga pagpatuman niya sang martial law sang nagligad nga semana.
english: This comes after lawmakers voted to remove him from office after his failed implementation of martial law last week.

text: Sa 300 ka mga mamalidha, 204 ang nagboto agud i- impeach ang president bangud sa alegasyon sang insureksyon samtang 85 ang nagboto batok sa impeachment.
english: Of the 300 lawmakers, 204 voted to impeach the president over allegations of insurrection while 85 voted against impeachment.

text: Tatlo ang nag-abstain, kag walo ka boto ang na-nullify.
english: Three abstained, and eight votes were nullified.

text: Sa subong, si Yoon ang suspendido sa iya pwesto samtang ang South Korea’s Constitutional Court ang magapatigayon sang deliberasyon kun papag-unon ang pagkakas sa iya.
english: Yoon is currently suspended from office while South Korea's Constitutional Court will deliberate on whether to approve his removal.

text: Si Prime Minister Han Duck-soo ang magapungko bilang interim president.
english: Prime Minister Han Duck-soo will take over as interim president.

text: May yara naman sang 180 ka adlaw ang korte para desisyunan ang palaabuton ni Yoon.
english: The court has 180 days to decide Yoon's fate.

text: Kun suportahan sang korte ang pagkakas kay Yoon, siya ang mangin ikaduha nga president sa South Korean history nga madinalag-on nga na- impeach.
english: If the court upholds Yoon's removal, he will become the second president in South Korean history to be successfully impeached.

text: Duha ka mga Ilongga beauties ang nakasulod sa Miss Universe Philippines 2021.
english: Two Ilongga beauties have entered Miss Universe Philippines 2021.

text: Si Khesha Ramachandran ang tiglawas sang Iloilo City samtang si Monica Villanueva naman ang tiglawas sang Iloilo Province.
english: Khesha Ramachandran represents Iloilo City while Monica Villanueva represents Iloilo Province.

text: Ginpaguwa na sang Miss Universe Philippines 2021 ang 100 delegates nga magapaidalom sa nagkalain-lain nga mga challenges sa masunod nga mga semana.
english: Miss Universe Philippines 2021 has released the 100 delegates who will undergo various challenges in the coming weeks.

text: Sa 100 delegates, mangin 75 na lang ini kag pagabotohan naman ang 50 delegates sa Miss Universe Philippines mobile app.
english: Of the 100 delegates, it will be 75 and 50 delegates will be voted on the Miss Universe Philippines mobile app.

text: Ang “Top 50” ang kinahanglan nga magpadulong sa Metro Manila para sa in-person interviews sa organization.
english: The “Top 50” will have to travel to Metro Manila for in-person interviews with the organization.

text: Gikan sa 50, pili-on ang 30 delegates nga amo ang maga-compete live kag in person kadungan sang coronation night sa September 25.
english: From the 50, 30 delegates will be selected to compete live and in person during the coronation night on September 25.

text: Natalana naman nga ipasa sang Ilongga nga si Rabiya Mateo ang korona sa iya mangin successor.
english: Ilongga Rabiya Mateo is scheduled to pass the crown to her successor.

text: Ginsuspendi liwat subong nga aga ang biyahe sang mga fiberglass boats halin Iloilo padulong Guimaras sa Parola Wharf bangud sa indi maayo nga kondisyon sang panahon.
english: The voyage of fiberglass boats from Iloilo to Guimaras at Parola Wharf was suspended again this morning due to bad weather conditions.

text: Suno sa Philippine Coast Guard Iloilo Station, ginbasihan nila ang kanselasyon sa presensya sang ulan kag posible nga mabaskog nga hangin.
english: According to the Philippine Coast Guard Iloilo Station, they based the cancellation on the presence of rain and possible strong winds.

text: Antes sini, may pila ka mga sakayan nga nakalarga pa mga alas 5:50 sang kaagahon antes gin-untat ang operasyon.
english: Earlier, there were several boats that were still able to leave around 5:50 am before the operation was suspended.

text: Padayon nga ginamonitor sang PCG ang kahimtangan sang panahon para sa posible nga pagbalik sang biyahe.
english: PCG continues to monitor weather conditions for possible flight resumption.

text: BY: BOMBO RAY GERALD BADIANG
english: BY: BOMBO RAY GERALD BADIANG

text: Liwat nga nagpatigayon ang Russia sang pagpang-atake sa energy infrastructure sang Ukraine rason nga napilitan ang pungsod nga magpatigayon sang emergency power outages.
english: Russia has once again launched attacks on Ukraine's energy infrastructure, forcing the country to implement emergency power outages.

text: Wala pa ginklaro sang Ukrainian energy minister kun ano kalapad ang gin-atake sang Russia apang may mga opisyal sa Ivano-Frankivsk nga nagsiling nga ini ang “worst attack” sa ila nga rehiyon.
english: The Ukrainian energy minister did not clarify the extent of Russia's attack but some officials in Ivano-Frankivsk said it was the "worst attack" in their region.

text: Gin-abisuhan man ang mga tawo nga indi anay magguwa sa ila nga mga balay.
english: People were also advised not to leave their homes.

text: Suno sa Ukrenergo nga amo ang energy grid operator, na-damage ang power facilities sa madamo nga rehiyon rason nga gin-utod anay ang suplay sang kuryente.
english: According to Ukrenergo, the energy grid operator, power facilities were damaged in many regions, causing power supply to be cut off.

text: Ini na ang pang-12 nga daku nga atake sang Russia sa power system sang Ukraine subong nga 2024.
english: This will be Russia’s 12th major attack on Ukraine’s power system as of 2024.

text: Suno sa Moscow, ang ila atake amo ang balos sa Ukrainian strike sa military airbase sa south-west Russia nga gingamitan sang US-made missiles.
english: Moscow said its attack was in retaliation for a Ukrainian strike on a military airbase in south-west Russia that used US-made missiles.

text: Kahapon, halos wala sang tawo sa mga dalanon sa Kyiv nga kapital sang Ukraine matapos nagpaandam ang air force nga posible iguon sang ballistic kag air missiles ang pila ka parte sang pungsod.
english: Yesterday, the streets of Kyiv, the Ukrainian capital, were almost empty after the air force warned that ballistic and air missiles could hit parts of the country.

text: Sang nagligad nga bulan, matandaan nga nagpaandam si Russian President Vladimir Putin nga iguon sini liwat ang Ukraine gamit ang bag-o nga nuclear-capable ballistic missile.
english: Last month, Russian President Vladimir Putin warned that he would strike Ukraine again with a new nuclear-capable ballistic missile.

text: Nagpasugot ang Department of Agriculture (DA) sa pag-import sang pula kag puti nga mga bombay amo man sang carrots.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) has agreed to import red and white bombays as well as carrots.

text: Suno kay DA Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., tuyo sini nga tikang nga mapabilin nga estable ang presyo sa lokal nga mga merkado.
english: According to DA Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., the move aims to keep prices stable in local markets.

text: Nagsaka suno sa tiglikom ang presyo sang pula nga bombay sa P140-P160 kada kilo sang nagligad nga duha ka semana kag nakit-an nga sobra-sobra ini.
english: The secretary said the price of red bombay rose to P140-P160 per kilo in the past two weeks and was found to be excessive.

text: Pahayag sini kadungan sang 47th Meeting sang ASEAN Ministers on Agriculture and Forestry, gintugutan niya nga mag-abot ang imports antes ang inisyal nga target nga Oktubre 15.
english: He said during the 47th Meeting of ASEAN Ministers on Agriculture and Forestry that he allowed imports to arrive before the initial target of October 15.

text: Nagalab-ot sa 3,000-5,000 ang import volume para sa red onions.
english: The import volume for red onions is about 3,000-5,000.

text: Nagsugod naman ang importasyon sang white onions sang nagligad nga bulan kag suno sa tiglikom, nagnubo na sa P100-P120 ang presyo subong halin anay sa P160 kada kilo.
english: The importation of white onions started last month and according to the collector, the price has now dropped to P100-P120 from P160 per kilo.

text: Nag-umpisa naman sang Oktubre 1 ang importasyon sang carrots halin sa China, Netherlands, kag Cambodia.
english: Imports of carrots from China, the Netherlands, and Cambodia began on October 1.

text: Nakuhaan sang 200 gramos nga ginapatihan shabu nga nagabalor sang ₱1,360,000 ang isa ka manugbaligya sang prutas sa ginpatigayon nga drug buy-bust operation sang Iloilo City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU), Iloilo City Police Station 4 (ICPS4), kag Regional Police Drug Enforcement Unit (RPDEU6) subong nga hapon sa Barangay San Juan, Molo, Iloilo City.
english: A fruit vendor was recovered with 200 grams of suspected shabu worth ₱1,360,000 in a drug buy-bust operation conducted by the Iloilo City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU), Iloilo City Police Station 4 (ICPS4), and Regional Police Drug Enforcement Unit (RPDEU6) in Barangay Juanay, San Juan this afternoon. Molo, Iloilo City.

text: Ang subject amo si alyas ‘Bebot’, 57-anyos, may asawa, kag residente sang Barangay San Juan, Molo kag ginakabig bilang isa ka high-value individual (HVI).
english: The subject is alias 'Bebot', 57-years-old, married, and resident of Barangay San Juan, Molo and considered as a high-value individual (HVI).

text: Nakuha sa operasyon ang kabug-usan nga 11 ka plastik nga sachets kag tatlo ka knot-tied nga transparent plastic bags nga nagaunod sang mga shabu.
english: A total of 11 plastic sachets and three knot-tied transparent plastic bags containing shabu were recovered from the operation.

text: Ang suspek ang yara na subong sa kustodiya sang kapulisan kag magapangatubang sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: The suspect is now in police custody and will face charges of violation of Republic Act 9165 or Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: Sa subong, ang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO), nakarekord na sang 26 ka operasyon sa first half sang bulan nga nagresulta sa pagkarekober sang 656 gramos sang shabu nga may balor nga mga ₱4,460,800 kag pagkaaresto sa 33 ka mga drug personalities.
english: So far, the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO), has recorded 26 operations in the first half of the month that resulted in the recovery of 656 grams of shabu worth about ₱4,460,800 and the arrest of 33 drug personalities.

text: Nagpanghatag sang pagkaon sanday Mayor Raisa Treñas kag Sangguniang Bayan Member Katya Tico Delgado sang Jordan, Guimaras sa mga pasahero nga na-stranded sa Parola Wharf bangud sang temporaryo nga pagsuspender sang biyahe pa-Guimaras tungod sa bagyo.
english: Mayor Raisa Treñas and Sangguniang Bayan Member Katya Tico Delgado of Jordan, Guimaras distributed food to passengers stranded at Parola Wharf due to the temporary suspension of flights to Guimaras due to the typhoon.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Tum-Tum Paulino, kagawad sang Brgy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Tum-Tum Paulino, kagawad of Brgy.

text: Concepcion, City Proper, Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga ginbuligan sang alkalde kag sang SB member ang mga na-stranded nga pasahero paagi sa pagdistribuer sang cup noodles, tinapay, kag tubig, paluto sang kan-on kag sud-an agud mabuligan ang ila kinahanglanon samtang ginahulat ang pagbukas liwat sang biyahe.
english: Concepcion, City Proper, Iloilo, he said the mayor and the SB member helped the stranded passengers by distributing cup noodles, bread, and water, cooking food and snacks to meet their needs while waiting for the reopening of the flight.

text: Dugang pa ni Paulino nga padayon ang pagmonitor kag pagbulig sang mga opisyal sang Barangay Concepcion, City Proper, kaupod ang City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO), sa mga pasahero nga na-stranded.May mga health personnel man nga naka-standby sa lugar sa tion nga may pasahero nga magakinahanglan sang medikal nga bulig.
english: Paulino added that officials of Barangay Concepcion, City Proper, together with the City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO), continue to monitor and assist the stranded passengers. There are also health personnel on standby in the area in case a passenger needs medical assistance.

text: Ginpahayag man nga may mga pasahero nga halin pa alas-12 sang udto ang na-stranded kag padayon nga nagahulat nga mabalik ang biyahe pa-Guimaras.
english: It was also reported that there are passengers who have been stranded since 12 noon and are still waiting for the flight to Guimaras to resume.

text: Padayon ang koordinasyon sang mga otoridad agud masiguro ang seguridad kag kahimtangan sang mga pasahero samtang ginapadayon ang suspension sang byahe.
english: Authorities are continuing to coordinate to ensure the safety and well-being of passengers while the suspension of flights continues.

text: By: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑲𝒓𝒚𝒍𝒍𝒆 𝑴𝒆𝒍𝒍𝒊𝒛𝒂
english: By: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑲𝒓𝒚𝒍𝒍𝒆 𝑴𝒆𝒍𝒍𝒊𝒛𝒂

text: Padayon pa nga nagapaayo sa ospital si former US House Speaker Nancy Pelosi matapos nakaangkon ang injury sa iya pagbyahe sa Luxembourg.
english: Former US House Speaker Nancy Pelosi is still recovering in hospital after sustaining an injury during her trip to Luxembourg.

text: Suno sa opisina sang 84-anyos nga Democrat nga amo pa subong ang representative sang California sa US House, isa ini ka official trip kaupod ang bipartisan Congressional delegation para sa ika-80 nga anibersaryo sang Battle of the Bulge sa World War II.
english: According to the office of the 84-year-old Democrat who is still California’s representative in the US House, it was an official trip with a bipartisan Congressional delegation for the 80th anniversary of the Battle of the Bulge in World War II.

text: Wala gindetalye kun ano kalala ang injury sini.
english: The severity of his injury was not detailed.

text: May yara sang reports nga natumba si Pelosi samtang yara sa isa ka event.
english: There were reports that Pelosi collapsed while at an event.

text: Isa ka prominent figure sa US politics si Pelosi bangud sa iya karera nga nagalawig sang pito na ka presidential administrations.
english: Pelosi is a prominent figure in US politics because of her career that spans seven presidential administrations.

text: ENGLAND VS.
english: ENGLAND VS.

text:
IRAN (GROUP B)

Ginkamasaan sang England ang Iran, 6-2, sa opening Group B match sa FIFA World Cup 2022 sa Khalifa International Stadium sa Qatar.
english:
IRAN (GROUP B)

England thumped Iran, 6-2, in the opening Group B match at the FIFA World Cup 2022 at the Khalifa International Stadium in Qatar.

text: Ang una nga nag-score sang goal para sa England amo ang 19-anyos nga si Jude Bellingham sa ika-35 nga minuto sang hampang.
english: The first to score a goal for England was 19-year-old Jude Bellingham in the 35th minute of the match.

text: Ini ang una nga na-deliver ni Bellingham nga goal para sa pungsod kag una niya ini nga ginhimo sa World Cup stage.
english: It was Bellingham’s first delivered goal for the country and the first time he had done so on the World Cup stage.

text: Ang ikaduha nga goal ang nagikan kay Bukayo Saka sa 43rd minute.
english: The second goal came from Bukayo Saka in the 43rd minute.

text: Kaangay ni Bellingham, ang tuig 2022 amo man ang World Cup debut ni Saka.
english: Like Bellingham, the year 2022 will also be Saka’s World Cup debut.

text: Ginsundan ni Raheem Sterling ang goal sa ika-45 nga minuto sang match.
english: Raheem Sterling followed up the goal in the 45th minute of the match.

text: Sa second half naman, nag-goal liwat si Saka apang tatlo ka minutos ang nakaligad, nakabawi ang Iran sa ika-65 nga minuto paagi sa goal halin sa Iranian star nga si Mehdi Taremi.
english: In the second half, Saka scored again but three minutes later, Iran recovered in the 65th minute with a goal from Iranian star Mehdi Taremi.

text: Wala nagpasugot ang England kag nagbawi liwat paagi kanday Marcus Rashford nga amo ang naghatag sang Goal Number 5 kag si Jack Grealish nga amo ang nagdul-ong sang Goal Number 6.
english: England didn’t let up and fought back again with Marcus Rashford providing Goal Number 5 and Jack Grealish delivering Goal Number 6.

text: Sa katapusan nga minuto sang hampang, may foul nga natabo kag nagkadto ang penalty spot sa Iran.
english: In the last minute of the game, a foul occurred and the penalty spot went to Iran.

text: Nangin duha ang goals sang Iran matapos ang penalty kick nga halin gihapon kay Mehdi Taremi.
english: Iran's goals were two after a penalty kick from Mehdi Taremi.

text: Talalupangdon naman nga wala naka-score ang team captain sang England nga si Harry Kane nga isa ka former Golden Boot award-winner kag top scorer sa 2018 World Cup.
english: England team captain Harry Kane, a former Golden Boot award-winner and top scorer at the 2018 World Cup, did not score.

text: US VS.
english: US VS.

text:
WALES (GROUP B)

Nagtapos sa 1-1 draw ang opening group B match sang team sang Estados Unidos sa 2022 World Cup matapos naka-score ang Wales sa late penalty kick.
english:
WALES (GROUP B)

The United States team's opening group B match of the 2022 World Cup ended in a 1-1 draw after Wales scored on a late penalty kick.

text: Ang una nga goal sang US team ang natabo sa 36th minute paagi kay Timothy Weah, apang natupungan sang team captain sang Wales nga si Gareth Bale nga amo ang nag-score para sa Wales paagi sa penalty kick sa ika- 82 nga minuto.
english: The US team's first goal came in the 36th minute through Timothy Weah, but Wales team captain Gareth Bale scored for Wales with a penalty kick in the 82nd minute.

text: NETHERLANDS VS.
english: NETHERLANDS VS.

text:
SENEGAL (GROUP A)

Daog ang Netherlands batok sa ila opening game batok sa Senegal, 2-0.
english:
SENEGAL (GROUP A)

The Netherlands won their opening game against Senegal, 2-0.

text: Natapos ang first half sang hampang nga wala gid sang naka-score sa duha ka team.
english: The first half of the game ended with neither team scoring.

text: Pag-umpisa sang second half, ginpasa-pasa sang Netherlands ang bola samtang nagahulat naman ang Senegal sa defensive side sang pitch.
english: At the start of the second half, the Netherlands passed the ball around while Senegal waited on the defensive side of the pitch.

text: Una nga naka-sore si Philips Sport Vereniging striker Cody Gakpo sa ika-53 nga minuto sang hampang paagi sa pag-assist sang midfielder sang Barcelona nga si Frankie de Jong.
english: Philips Sport Vereniging striker Cody Gakpo scored first in the 53rd minute with an assist from Barcelona midfielder Frankie de Jong.

text: Sa katapusan nga minuto naman, nag-score ang midfielder nga si Davy Klaassen sang isa pa kag amo na ang katapusan nga goal sa hampang.
english: In the last minute, midfielder Davy Klaassen scored another and that was the last goal of the game.

text: ECUADOR VS.
english: ECUADOR VS.

text:
QATAR (GROUP A)

Ginlutos sang Ecuador ang host nation nga Qatar, 2-0, sa opening match sang 2022 FIFA World Cup sa Al Bayt Stadium.
english:
QATAR (GROUP A)

Ecuador defeated host nation Qatar, 2-0, in the opening match of the 2022 FIFA World Cup at Al Bayt Stadium.

text: Ang duha ka goal sang Ecuador ang lunsay nagikan sa 33-anyos nga team captain nga si Enner Valencia nga amo ang all-time top scorer sang pungsod.
english: Both of Ecuador's goals came from 33-year-old team captain Enner Valencia, the country's all-time top scorer.

text: Natigayon ini nga duha ka goals sa first half sang hampang: una, paagi sa penalty kick sa ika-15 nga minuto bangud sa foul sang Qatar keeper nga si Saad Al Sheeb.
english: These two goals were achieved in the first half of the match: first, through a penalty kick in the 15th minute due to a foul by Qatar keeper Saad Al Sheeb.

text: Ini ang labing-una nga tion sa World Cup history kun sa diin ang opening goal sa single edition sang tournament ang na-score pinaagi sa penalty spot.
english: This is the first time in World Cup history that the opening goal in the single edition of the tournament was scored through the penalty spot.

text: Ang ikaduha naman nga goal ni Valencia amo ang 31st-minute header nga naghatag sang lead sa Ecuador.
english: Valencia's second goal was a 31st-minute header that gave Ecuador the lead.

text: Antes sini, may yara na kuntani sang goal halin kay Valencia sa ikatatlo nga minuto pa lang sang hampang apang gin-disallow kasunod sang ‘Video Assistant Referee’ review bangud sa marginal offside.
english: Earlier, there was supposed to be a goal from Valencia in the third minute of the game but was disallowed following a 'Video Assistant Referee' review due to marginal offside.

text: Kun halimbawa wala gin-disallow ang una nga goal ni Valencia sa ika-tres minutos sang hampang, ini kuntani ang kabigon nga pinakadasig nga World Cup goal sa opening match.
english: If Valencia's first goal had not been disallowed in the third minute, it would have been the fastest World Cup goal in the opening match.

text:
[Warning: This article contains information about a violent incident.]

Patay ang 16-anyos nga iloy matapos gintiro sang bana sa iya ulo sa Maguindanao del Sur.
english:
[Warning: This article contains information about a violent incident.]

A 16-year-old mother was shot dead by her husband in Maguindanao del Sur.

text: Suno sa imbestigasyon, nagapasuso ang biktima sa iya lapsag sang gintiro sang suspek.
english: According to the investigation, the victim was breastfeeding her baby when the suspect shot her.

text: Gin-alegar nga nag-away ang duha bangud sa pagpangimon sang bana kag ini ang posible rason sa natabo nga krimen.
english: The two allegedly had a fight over her husband's jealousy and this was the possible reason for the crime.

text: Wala naman sang malain nga natabo sa lapsag matapos ginkup-an ini sang maayo sang biktima antes siya gintiro.
english: The baby was unharmed after the victim hugged him tightly before he was shot.

text: Madasig naman nga nalagyo ang suspek matapos ang pagpatay.
english: The suspect quickly fled the scene after the murder.

text: Love is a timeless force that binds people together.
english: Love is a timeless force that binds people together.

text: Kun magpakasal ang duha ka tawo, isa ini ka lifelong commitment, apang sa panahon subong nga wala-tuo nga pagbulaganay, matuod pa bala ini?
english: When two people get married, it's a lifelong commitment, but in today's world of unbelievable divorce, is that still true?

text: Matuod ini para sa mag-asawa sa Brazil nga subong naga-uyat sang record sang pinakamalawig nga pag-asawahay para sa couple nga pareho pa nga buhi tubtub subong.
english: This is true for the Brazilian couple who currently hold the record for the longest marriage for the couple who are both still alive today.

text: Ini amo sanday Manoel Angelim Dino, 105, kag Maria de Sousa Dino, 101, nga kasado sa sulod na sang 84 ka tuig kag 77 ka adlaw sang adlaw nga ginhatag sa ila ang titulo halin sa Guinness World Records.
english: They are Manoel Angelim Dino, 105, and Maria de Sousa Dino, 101, who have been married for 84 years and 77 days on the day they were awarded the title from Guinness World Records.

text: 1940 sang ginkasal sanday Manoel kag Maria sa Brazil, apang sang amo nga tion, tuman pa kalayo ang itsura kag mga hitabo sa ila pungsod.
english: It was 1940 when Manoel and Maria were married in Brazil, but at that time, the appearance and events in their country were still very far away.

text: Wala pa gani sila nakaagi daog sa FIFA World Cup sang amo nga tion, kag wala pa sang naimbento nga programmable electronic computer.
english: They had never even won the FIFA World Cup at the time, and the programmable electronic computer had not been invented.

text: Apang halin sadto, nagbunga ang ila paghigugmaanay sang 13 ka kabataan kag masobra 100 na ang apo lakip dira ang 55 grandchildren, 54 great-grandchildren, kag 12 great-great-grandchildren.
english: But since then, their love has produced 13 children and more than 100 grandchildren, including 55 grandchildren, 54 great-grandchildren, and 12 great-great-grandchildren.

text: Subong nga naga-hinunod ang ila kabuhi, updanay gihapon sila ilabi na sa pagpamati sa rosary prayer sa radio kag paglantaw sang televised mass.
english: Now that their lives are changing, they are still together especially listening to the rosary prayer on the radio and watching the televised mass.

text: Ano ang ila sikreto sa malipayon nga relasyon?
english: What is their secret to a happy relationship?

text: Diretso ang sabat sang duha: “love.”
english: The answer from both was straightforward: “love.”

text: Kaangut sa ginapatuman sang LTO nga “Anti-Sardinas Policy”, nagpahayag si Iloilo City Councilor Atty. Sedfrey Cabaluna, Chairman sang Committee on Transportation, nga isa sa mga nagapanguna nga rason sang overloading sa mga pampasahero nga salakyan amo ang kakulangan sang units sa karsada.
english: Regarding the implementation of the LTO's “Anti-Sardinas Policy”, Iloilo City Councilor Atty. Sedfrey Cabaluna, Chairman of the Committee on Transportation, said one of the main reasons for overloading in passenger vehicles is the lack of units on the road.

text: Suno kay Cabaluna sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, nagapadayon ang sistema sang “boundary” kag “commission basis” sa transport sector, rason kun ngaa ginatuyo sang iban nga mga driver nga pun-on ang ila salakyan agud mas daku ang ila kita.
english: According to Cabaluna in an interview with Bombo Radyo, the system of “boundary” and “commission basis” in the transport sector continues, which is why some drivers try to fill their vehicles to increase their income.

text: Ginpunto man sang konsehal nga ang overloading indi lang isyu sang disiplina kundi may kaangtanan man sa economic conditions sang mga driver kag operators.
english: The councilor also pointed out that overloading is not only an issue of discipline but also related to the economic conditions of drivers and operators.

text: Bangud sini, ginpanawagan ni Cabaluna nga ang Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) ang dapat magpatuman sang angay nga mga disiplinaryo nga tikang batok sa mga nagalapas sa kapasidad nga ginatugot sang layi.
english: In this regard, Cabaluna called for the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) to implement appropriate disciplinary measures against those who violate the capacity allowed by law.

text: Ginpanindugan niya nga kinahanglan may hugot nga monitoring kag enforcement nga maghalin mismo sa LTFRB agud masiguro ang kaluwasan kag ‘convenience’ sang mga pasahero.
english: He insisted that there should be strict monitoring and enforcement from the LTFRB itself to ensure the safety and convenience of passengers.

text: Magatambong si FIFA President Gianni Infantino sa pagbukas sang 2025 Futsal Women’s World Cup sa Philsports Arena.
english: FIFA President Gianni Infantino will attend the opening ceremony of the 2025 Futsal Women’s World Cup at the Philsports Arena.

text: Ginkumpirma ini ni Philippine Football Federation President John Gutierrez samtang nga masako na ang preparasyon para sa pagbukas sang tournament sa weekend.
english: This was confirmed by Philippine Football Federation President John Gutierrez as preparations for the opening of the tournament over the weekend are already busy.

text: Suno kay Gutierrez, nagalaum sila nga makakadto man sa seremonya si President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: Gutierrez said they hope President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr. will also attend the ceremony.

text: Diri naman sa Pilipinas ang 15 ka mga team halin sa iban nga mga pungsod nga magapasakop sa hinampang — ang Italya, Portugal, Spain, Poland, Columbia, Argentina, Brazil, Canada, Panama, Morocco, Tanzania, New Zealand, Iran, Thailand, kag Japan.
english: Here in the Philippines are 15 teams from other countries that will participate in the games — Italy, Portugal, Spain, Poland, Columbia, Argentina, Brazil, Canada, Panama, Morocco, Tanzania, New Zealand, Iran, Thailand, and Japan.

text: Maga-atubangay sa imbukada nga hampang ang Morocco kag Argentina 6:00 sa gab-i kag pagasundan sang opening ceremony sa 8:00 p.m. Sunod nga magahampang ang Pilipinas kontra sa Poland.
english: Morocco and Argentina will face each other in the opening match at 6:00 pm followed by the opening ceremony at 8:00 p.m. Next, the Philippines will play against Poland.

text: Ang World Cup players nga sanday Jaclyn Sawicki, Katrina Guillou kag Isabella Flanigan amo ang magapanguna sa team sang Pilipinas.
english: World Cup players Jaclyn Sawicki, Katrina Guillou and Isabella Flanigan will lead the Philippine team.

text: Nakahanas na sila sa Espanya kag nagbalik diri sa pungsod sang Nobyembre 12.
english: They have trained in Spain and returned to the country on November 12.

text: Nakibot na lang ang tag-iya sang salakyan nga ginpaarakan sang tiro sa Poblacion A, Duenas, Iloilo nga upod sa nagsakay si Marigold Jamelo sa pick-up nga ginpa-drive sini sa iya mekaniko nga si Wilber Auditor.
english: The owner of the vehicle that was shot in Poblacion A, Duenas, Iloilo was shocked that Marigold Jamelo was among the passengers in the pick-up that he had driven by his mechanic, Wilber Auditor.

text: Ini bangud sang pagkuha sini sa ila balay ang sakay lamang sini amo si Wilbert kag helper sini nga si Gerry Pampag.
english: This is because when he was taken from his house, only Wilbert and his helper Gerry Pampag were on board.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Alyas Ann, tag-iya sang salakyan, iya ginpahayag nga ginhulam ni Wilbert nga mekaniko sini ang salakyan agud nga i-drive test kag ipakay-o ang aircon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Alyas Ann, the owner of the vehicle, said Wilbert, his mechanic, borrowed the vehicle to drive test and repair the aircon.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga nakibot na lang ini sang nagpanawag si Wilbert sa iya nga gintiro ang salakyan sini.
english: He said he was surprised when Wilbert called him and said that his car had been shot.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga amo sini ang una nga bes nga natabo ang nasambit nga insidente kag nadalahig ang iya salakyan.
english: He also said that this is the first time the incident occurred and his vehicle was involved.

text: Ginpanginwala naman sini nga siya ang target sang pagpangtiro bangud suno pa sa iya nga wala man ini sang kontra kag ginagamit pa sini ang salakyan nga magkadto sa nagkalain-lain nga lugar sa Iloilo.
english: He denied being the target of the shooting because he said he had no opponent and was still using the vehicle to go to different places in Iloilo.

text: Samtang, nagapati naman ang isa sa nagresponde sa insidente nga si Alyas Ronie nga ang target sang nasambit nga shooting insident amo ang babayi nga si Marigold Jamelo.
english: Meanwhile, one of the responders, alias Ronie, believes that the target of the shooting incident was a woman named Marigold Jamelo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, iya ginpahayag nga sunod-sunod nga lupok sang pusil ang ila nabatian sa lugar kag sang pagkadto na nila sa ginluntaran sang insidente, ato na kag ila nasaksihan nga nagadunglay na lang ang ulo sang biktima nga si Marigold kag wala na ini sang kabuhi.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, he said they heard a series of gunshots in the area and when they went to the scene of the incident, they witnessed the victim, Marigold, lying on the head and dead.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga nakaagom lamang sang gamay nga pilas ang kaupdanan ni Jamelo.
english: He said Jamelo's companions sustained only minor injuries.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Alyas Ronnie nga bangud sa pagka-abriya sang salakyan, nagpundo anay ang mga ini sa talyer, wala naman naglaom ang mga biktima nga may magdulog nga pula nga awto malapit sa ila nahamtangan kag paulanan ang mga ini sang tiro.
english: Alyas Ronnie also said that due to the opening of the vehicle, they stopped at the workshop, the victims did not expect that a red car would stop near their location and shoot them.

text: Dugang pa ni Alyas Ronie nga kun ang target kuntani sang suspek ang iban pa nga sakay sang salakyan wala tani ginpatam-an sang luthang ang babayi nga si Marigold.
english: Ronie added that if the suspect had targeted the other occupants of the vehicle, he would not have shot the woman, Marigold.

text: Nahibaluan nga na-rekober sa lugar ang 23 ka mga empty shells nga ginapatihan bala sang M16.
english: Twenty-three empty shells believed to be M16 were recovered from the scene.

text: Dugang pa diri, nadala man sa naigo nga pagpangtiro ang tag-iya sang talyer kun sa diin natabo ang insidente kag sa karon upod kay Wilbert kag Gerry ginalapatan na sang pagbulog sa ospital.
english: The owner of the workshop where the incident occurred was also shot and is now being treated at the hospital along with Wilbert and Gerry.

text: Ginkumpirma ni Transportation Secretary Giovanni Lopez nga may P1.00 nga saka sa plete sa traditional jeepneys kag P2.00 naman para sa modern jeepneys.
english: Transportation Secretary Giovanni Lopez confirmed that there will be a P1.00 fare increase for traditional jeepneys and P2.00 for modern jeepneys.

text: Bangud sini, nagsaka na sa P14 ang minimum nga pamasahe sa tradisyonal nga jeep, samtang P17 naman para sa modernized units.
english: As a result, the minimum fare for traditional jeeps has increased to P14, while P17 for modernized units.

text: Pahayag sang Department of Transportation (DOTr), mangin epektibo ini nga adjustment umpisa sa Huwebes, Marso 19.
english: According to the Department of Transportation (DOTr), this adjustment will be effective starting Thursday, March 19.

text: “Inaprubahan na po natin kagabi ang pagtaas ng pamasahe pagdating sa mga provincial buses, metro buses, P2P, kasama din po ang jeepneys, at airport taxis,” suno kay Lopez.
english: “We approved last night the fare increase for provincial buses, metro buses, P2P, including jeepneys, and airport taxis,” Lopez said.

text: “Pagdating sa ating mga jeepney, ngayon po ang traditional jeepney natin ang pamasahe natin is P13.00.
english: “When it comes to our jeepneys, now our traditional jeepney fare is P13.00.

text: May conditional increase pong kasama yan, yan ay ginawa na natin permanent at nagdagdag pa tayo ng P1.00.
english: There is a conditional increase with that, that we have made permanent and we have added P1.00.

text: So, P14.00 na po sa first four kilometers.
english: So, P14.00 for the first four kilometers.

text: That’s for the traditional jeepney,” dugang sang transportation official.
english: That’s for the traditional jeepney,” the transportation official added.

text: Ginpatuman ini nga fare increase sa tunga sang nagapanglakaak nga presyo sang gatong bangud sang epekto sang giyera sa Middle East.
english: The fare increase was implemented amid rising fuel prices due to the impact of the war in the Middle East.

text: Nauna na nga gin-anunsyo sang Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) ang fare increase sang Domingo, apang subong lang nga aga gin-anunsyo ang eksakto nga balor sang isaka.
english: The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) earlier announced the fare increase on Sunday, but only this morning announced the exact value of one.

text: Una naman nga ginmandu ni President Ferdinand ”Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: Earlier, President Ferdinand ”Bongbong” Marcos Jr. ordered the

text: ang pag-release sang P5,000 cash assistance para sa public utility vehicle drivers agud nga mabuhinan ang palas-anon samtang mataas ang presyo sang gatong.
english: the release of P5,000 cash assistance for public utility vehicle drivers to ease the burden amid high fuel prices.

text: NI KIS-A wala ini natabo sa panahon sang Panay Electric Company.
english: NEVER did this happen during the time of the Panay Electric Company.

text: Kon may problema sadto sa brownout nagakatabo ato sa pila lang ka lugar kag sa sulod lang sang pila ka oras nga ma-tolerar sang mga pumuluyo kay dayon man balik sang kuryente.
english: If there was a problem with brownout, it happened in only a few places and within a few hours that the residents could tolerate because the electricity was immediately restored.

text:
Sang Huwebes, naka-experyensya ang bug-os nga Panay (Iloilo, Antique, Capiz, Aklan), Guimaras kag Negros sang brownout sa sulod sang at least 7 ka oras tubtub mga a las 11 sa gab-i.

Nagbalik ang kuryente kag liwat ugaling nag-brownout sang mga a las 3 sang kaagahon sang Biyernes kag tubtub na sa halos bug-os nga Sabado.
english:
On Thursday, the entire Panay (Iloilo, Antique, Capiz, Aklan), Guimaras and Negros experienced brownout for at least 7 hours until about 11 pm.

Power was restored and again but the brownout broke out around 3 am on Friday and lasted for almost all of Saturday.

text: Kag pakadto pa gani sa Domingo.
english: And even going into Sunday.

text: Samtang, masami man may mga naga-blackout sa mga franchise areas tungod kuno sa maintenance work.
english: Meanwhile, there are often blackouts in franchise areas due to maintenance work.

text: Nagalab-ut ini sang 12 ka oras nga wala nagakatabo sadto sa Panay Electric Company.
english: This takes 12 hours which was not the case with the Panay Electric Company.

text: Kag ina sang wala pa ang 2001 EPIRA Law (Electric Power Industry Reform Act), nga may goal kuno sang total electrification sa pag-abot sang 2022, supply security kag affordability sang kuryente paagi sa mas malawak nga privatization sang electric industry halin sa generation, transmission kag distribution samtang ginapasalig ang padayon nga energy industry competitiveness sa aton ekonomiya.
english: And that was before the 2001 EPIRA Law (Electric Power Industry Reform Act), which supposedly had the goal of total electrification by 2022, supply security and affordability of electricity through wider privatization of the electric industry from generation, transmission and distribution while ensuring continued energy industry competitiveness in our economy.

text: Pero ano gid bala ang natabo?
english: But what really happened?

text: Ang natabo pa gani amo ang supply insecurity, nga ang malala gid nga natabo amo ang blackout sa bug-os nga Panay, Negros kag Guimaras sadtong Hwebes tubtub Sabado, nga gina-consuelohan lang sing isa tubtub tatlo ka oras nga kuryente now and then.
english: What even happened was supply insecurity, with the worst happening being the blackout in the entire Panay, Negros and Guimaras from Thursday to Saturday, which was only comforted by one to three hours of electricity now and then.

text: Padayon man ang mataas gihapon nga electric bills.
english: Electricity bills continue to be high.

text: Nangin-hostage man kita sang monopliya sang National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP), ang private corporation nga natugyanan sa pag-operate sang gov’t-run National Power Corporation, nga nagapadalagan indi lang sang power generation kag distribution kundi pati na sang transmission sa ginatos ka lawig nga transmission lines nga, sunu kay anay Iloilo Press Club president Lemuel Fernandez, “subject to faults, calamities, anomalies ang disturbances, manmade and natural”.
english: We have also been held hostage by the monopoly of the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP), the private corporation entrusted with the operation of the gov’t-run National Power Corporation, which runs not only power generation and distribution but also transmission along hundreds of long transmission lines that, according to former Ilomulo Press Club President Ferguson Ferguson, are subject to failure. calamities, anomalies the disturbances, manmade and natural”.

text: Tungod sini, sunu pa sa iya, daw gina-rasyunan lang ang nagakalain-lain nga mga grid sang power sang NGCP nga kon san-o lang luyag sini.
english: Because of this, he said, it seems that the various power grids of NGCP are being rationed whenever it wants.

text: Indi katulad sadto nga may bilateral agreement ang PECO sa Panay Power Corp.
english: Unlike when PECO had a bilateral agreement with Panay Power Corp.

text: kag sa Panay EnergyDev’t Corp agud mag-serve lang sang power needs sang PECO para sa siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: and Panay EnergyDev't Corp to serve only the power needs of PECO for Iloilo City.

text: Sunu gani sa isa pa naton ka source, ina tungod nagakini kuno sa imported oil ang NGCP.
english: According to another source, that's because NGCP is dependent on imported oil.

text: Gali kay agud sige mapasanyog gihapon ang lokal nga coal production, nga environment unfriendly, sang mga private corporation, samtang wala gina-obligar sing maayo ang pag-produce sang kinahanglanon nga renewable energy, katulad sang hydropower kag solar power nga labi naton kinahanglan sa karon agud maaway ang ClimateChange.
english: In fact, to continue to promote local coal production, which is environmentally unfriendly, by private corporations, while not properly obliged to produce the necessary renewable energy, such as hydropower and solar power that we need more now to fight Climate Change.

text: Daw ginahaso lang kuno gani ang EPIRA LAW sining private power corporations.
english: It seems that the EPIRA LAW is being pushed by these private power corporations.

text: Kag, in effect man, wala man gali pulos ang EPIRA LAW kag dapat na ma-abolish.
english: And, in effect, the EPIRA LAW is useless and should be abolished.

text:
***

Samtang, tungod sang malawig nga brownout diri sa siyudad sang Iloilo sang Sabado may mga 50 ka panimalay ang nasunog sa PalaPala 2 tungod sa kandila nga gingamit agud masigahan ang isa ka puluy-an.
english:
***

Meanwhile, due to the long brownout here in Iloilo City on Saturday, about 50 houses were burned in PalaPala 2 due to a candle used to light a house.

text: Malawig man ang pag-antos sang mga pumuluyo.
english: The villagers also suffered for a long time.

text: Nanimaho ang mga lulutuon nga mga isda kag karne nga sulod sang mga ref sa mga puluy-an kag mga tindahan nga kinahanglan ang cooling system.
english: The smell of cooked fish and meat inside refrigerators in homes and shops that need cooling systems.

text: Indi makagamit ang madamo sang ila mga celfone tungod wala sing kuryente para maka-charge.
english: Many cannot use their cellphones because there is no electricity to charge them.

text: Halos na-paralyze man ang mga komunikasyon sang mga eskwelahan, mga upisina, kag mga negosyo nga nagakinahanglan sang internet.
english: The communications of schools, offices, and businesses that needed the internet were also virtually paralyzed.

text: Sa aga na lang gani ginapa-eskwela ang mga estudyante tungod sa sobra nga init sa palibut.
english: Students are even sent to school in the morning because of the extreme heat.

text: Naglala ang may balatian nga asthma kag iban pa nga kasubong nga balatian tungod sa sobra nga init sa palibut kay wala man sing bentilador nga magamit.
english: Asthma and other similar illnesses worsened because of the extreme heat in the environment because there was no fan available.

text: Sa siyudad sang Iloilo nagdangat na gani sa 42 degrees Celsius ang heat index nga dala sang init kag sang mataas nga humidity.
english: In Iloilo City, the heat index reached 42 degrees Celsius due to the heat and high humidity.

text: Madamo man seguro ang na-damage nga mga TV kag electronics gadgets, lakip na ang mga ref kag iban pa nga gamit nga sensitive sa power fluctuations.
english: Many TVs and electronics gadgets, including refrigerators and other appliances sensitive to power fluctuations, were also probably damaged.

text: Subong man ang mga heaters, motors, kag iban pa nga HVAC (Heat, Ventilation and Air Conditioning) components nga sensitive sa power surge.
english: As well as heaters, motors, and other HVAC (Heat, Ventilation and Air Conditioning) components that are sensitive to power surges.

text: Lakip na ang madamo nga appliances katulad sang mga washers, dryers kag microwaves nga kontrolado sang micrprocessors nga “extremely vulnerable” sa voltage variations.
english: This includes many appliances such as washers, dryers and microwaves controlled by microprocessors that are “extremely vulnerable” to voltage variations.

text: Subong man ang mga lights, clocks, timers sa tion sang power outage tungod ang power surge maka-damage sa ila.
english: Also lights, clocks, timers during a power outage as a power surge can damage them.

text: Etc./PN
english: Etc./PN

text: Iloilo City – Ginareklamo sang pila ka mga residente sa syudad sang Iloilo ang huol nga tuga sang ginpatigayon nga pagkay-o ukon maintenance activity sa linya sang tubig sang Metro Pacific Iloilo Water.
english: Iloilo City – Some residents in Iloilo City are complaining about the inconvenience caused by the repair or maintenance activity on the water line of Metro Pacific Iloilo Water.

text: Ini matapos ang ginpatuman nga Water Distribution Reconfiguration schedule subong nga adlaw sa pila ka mga lugar sa syudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo lakip na ang distrito sang Arevalo, Lapuz, City Proper, La Paz, Mandurriao, kag Jaro, kag amo man ang mga banwa sang Pavia kag Sta.
english: This follows the implementation of the Water Distribution Reconfiguration schedule today in several areas in Iloilo City and province including the districts of Arevalo, Lapuz, City Proper, La Paz, Mandurriao, and Jaro, as well as the towns of Pavia and Sta.

text: Barbara, Iloilo.
english: Barbara, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Vilma Ituriaga, residente sang Barangay Rizal, Lapuz, Iloilo City, iya ginpahayag nga nabudlayan ini manghakot sang tubig ilabi na nga siya lang ang bilin sa iya panimalay gani ginpakamaayo niya magtipon sang tubig antes pa man ang maintenance activity.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Vilma Ituriaga, resident of Barangay Rizal, Lapuz, Iloilo City, said she found it difficult to fetch water especially since she was the only one left in her household so she decided to collect water before the maintenance activity.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang paglubog sang tubig kag improvement activties sang mga bulk water suppliers ang rason sang maintenance activity.
english: It was learned that the water level and improvement activities of the bulk water suppliers are the reason for the maintenance activity.

text: Samtang, ginalauman nga ang maintenance activity ang magaresulta sang limitado nga supply sang tubig sa apektado nga mga lugar.
english: Meanwhile, the maintenance activity is expected to result in limited water supply in the affected areas.

text: Nagdangat sa 54 ka journalists sa bilog nga kalibutan ang ginpangpatay subong nga tuig samtang nga nagahimo sang ila obligasyon nga kaangot sa ila propesyon.
english: A total of 54 journalists around the world have been killed this year while performing their professional duties.

text: Base sa annual report sang Reporters Without Borders (RSF) nga isa ka press freedom non-government organization, ang Israeli Army amo ang may kahimuan sa pagpatay sa 18 sa sini nga mga biktima kun sa diin ginaalegar 16 ang napatay sa Gaza kag duha sa Lebanon.
english: According to the annual report of Reporters Without Borders (RSF), a press freedom non-government organization, the Israeli Army was responsible for the killing of 18 of these victims, of which 16 were allegedly killed in Gaza and two in Lebanon.

text: Suno pa sa organisasyon, ang Palestine amo ang nangin pinaka-delikado nga lugar para sa mga taga-media nga may mas mataas nga death toll ipaanggid sa bisan diin nga pungsod sa nagligad nga lima ka tuig.
english: According to the organization, Palestine has become the most dangerous place for media personnel with the highest death toll compared to any other country in the past five years.

text: Naka-file naman ang organisasyon sang apat ka reklamo sa International Criminal Court (ICC) bangud sa ginaalegar nga “war crimes” nga gin-komiter sang military sang Israel batok sa journalists.
english: The organization has filed four complaints with the International Criminal Court (ICC) over alleged war crimes committed by the Israeli military against journalists.

text: Gindugang pa sa report nga halin sang nagsugod ang Gaza war sang Oktubre 2023, may masobra 145 journalists nga napatay kun sa diin 35 ang naga-trabaho sang tion nga ginbawian sang kabuhi.
english: The report added that since the beginning of the Gaza war in October 2023, there have been more than 145 journalists killed of which 35 were working at the time of their deaths.

text:
Ginlaragway ini nga numero nga “an unprecedented bloodbath.”

Sa separado nga report sang International Federation of Journalists (IFJ), gin-report nga 104 journalists ang napatay sa 2024 kag masobra tunga ang halin sa Gaza.
english:
This figure has been described as “the unprecedented bloodbath.”

In a separate report by the International Federation of Journalists (IFJ), it was reported that 104 journalists will be killed in 2024 and more than half will be from Gaza.

text: Nahibaluan nga lain-lain ang numero nga gina-uyatan sang duha ka organisasyon bangud sa lain-lain man nga methodologies sa pag-isip sang patay.
english: It is known that the numbers held by the two organizations are different due to different methodologies in counting the dead.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang nagasunod sa Gaza bilang pinakamakamamatay nga lugar para sa journalists subong nga 2024 amo ang Pakistan nga may pito nga napatay; kag ang Bangladesh kag Mexico nga may tag-lima.
english: It is known that following Gaza as the deadliest place for journalists as of 2024 is Pakistan with seven deaths; and Bangladesh and Mexico with five each.
